title: Development Engineer 2
location: India - Chennai, Comcast India Engineering Cent
description:
Comcast brings together the best in media and technology. We drive innovation to create the world's best entertainment and online experiences. As a Fortune 50 leader, we set the pace in a variety of innovative and fascinating businesses and create career opportunities across a wide range of locations and disciplines. We are at the forefront of change and move at an amazing pace, thanks to our remarkable people, who bring cutting-edge products and services to life for millions of customers every day. If you share in our passion for teamwork, our vision to revolutionize industries and our goal to lead the future in media and technology, we want you to fast-forward your career at Comcast.

Job Summary

Responsible for validating product quality by analyzing and testing the quality of the code base. Focuses on writing code that will be executed in an automated and repeatable fashion which will reduce manual testing efforts and increase code quality and consistency. Develops and maintains code that validates front-end, middleware and database systems, using the latest tools and programming languages. Partners with software engineers to write efficient automation code using coding standards and best practices. Works with engineering team to deliver automated tests that satisfy product automation requirements. Executes automated code and creates written summary test reports for team. Repair intermediate complexity broken automation scripts. Works with moderate guidance in own area of knowledge.

Job Description

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES –

  • As an experienced SAP HR Engineer you will be responsible for design, build, test and maintain SAP programs, custom extension of SAP programs, reports, interfaces, conversion, and enhancements for SAP Payroll, third party time SaaS, and custom time management applications.
  • You will support enhancements and troubleshoot for payroll schemas, PCRs, wage types, time evaluation schemas/rules, and posting to Finance.
  • Develop and optimize ABAP programs, payroll drivers, custom reports, BADIs enhancements, and payroll-related BAPIs.
  • Ensuring technology solutions enable accurate time evaluation and feeding into payroll processing
  • Partner with HR functional expertise to understand requirements, translate into technical specification and solutions with options as applicable, and provide level of effort including estimates in time, complexity, and cost.
  • Conduct knowledge sharing sessions, design/code walk through, and ensure best practice.
  • Ideal candidate should design and/or leverage existing modular solutions while assessing impact to existing functionality.
  • Conduct root cause analysis and resolve production issues assuring meeting service level agreement.
  • Provide support to batch job scheduling, transport management, and data exchange for internal and external partners.
  • You should be able to work at individual capacity and own the entire design to deployment of solution with minimal supervision.
  • Collaborate with functional teams to translate user stories and problem statements into project/solution requirements.
  • Develop solutions quickly through an Agile process utilizing incremental minimal viable products to obtain user feedback and iterate towards a final solution.
  • Job requires working multiple projects in parallel and maintaining a set delivery schedule on all projects.
  • Support year-end payroll processing activities, tax updates through BSI/TUBs and regulatory compliance.
  • Provide recommendations, develop customized solutions as needed, and manage follow-up & evaluation for all solutions
  • Assist with identified stabilisation & simplification initiatives to improve overall SAP processes & performance.

Required Qualifications

  • 3+ years of experience in SAP ECC HCM ABAP development and ABAP Workflow with demonstration experience in taking ownership and ensuring high quality solutions and with specialization in Payroll and Time management.
  • 3+ years of experience of leveraging S4/HANA

  • Utveckla medarbetare genom coachning, återkoppling, utbildning och kompetensutvecklingsinsatser.
  • Skapa en prestationsinriktad, ansvarstagande och inkluderande arbetsmiljö där olika perspektiv uppmuntras och där alla medarbetare känner sig respekterade, uppskattade och ges förutsättningar att prestera sitt bästa.
  • Säkerställa effektiv kommunikation av information mellan kollegor och team.
  • Säkerställa rätt bemanning för att möta verksamhetens behov.

Säkerhet, efterlevnad och standarder

  • Säkerställa en trygg och säker arbetsmiljö i enlighet med företagets riktlinjer, lagkrav och gällande säkerhetsstandarder.
  • Främja och upprätthålla en stark säkerhetskultur inom produktionsområdet.
  • Säkerställa efterlevnad av etablerade processer, rutiner, arbetsinstruktioner och operativa standarder.
  • Rapportera riskobservationer, incidenter och olyckor, initiera utredningar i MIA samt följa upp och säkerställa att förbättringsåtgärder genomförs.
  • Utfärda arbetstillstånd i enlighet med gällande lagstiftning och verksamhetens säkerhetskrav.
  • Vidta omedelbara åtgärder för att hantera säkerhetsrisker och minimera produktionsstörningar.

Effektiv produktion

  • Planera, prioritera och samordna produktionsaktiviteter för att säkerställa ett effektivt produktionsflöde.
  • Leverera produktionsmål avseende volym, kvalitet, produktivitet, effektivitet och leveransprecision.
  • Följa upp produktionsutfall, identifiera avvikelser samt initiera korrigerande och förebyggande åtgärder.
  • Upprätthålla en stabil drift samtidigt som förbättringar inom prestation och effektivitet drivs framåt.

Ständiga förbättringar

  • Driva förbättringsinitiativ för att stärka säkerhet, kvalitet, produktivitet och kostnadseffektivitet.
  • Säkerställa samt kontinuerligt utveckla 5S-standarder inom produktionsområdet.
  • Samarbeta med andra funktioner för att identifiera och implementera hållbara processförbättringar.
  • Begära, samordna och prioritera underhållsinsatser för att säkerställa en säker och driftsäker produktion.

Befogenheter (mandat)

Som Produktionsledare har du befogenhet att:

  • Stoppa produktionsprocesser vid säkerhetsrisker, osäkra arbetsförhållanden eller kvalitetsavvikelser.
  • Begära, samordna och prioritera underhållsinsatser för att säkerställa driftsäkerhet.
  • Utfärda arbetstillstånd i enlighet med lagstiftning, företagets rutiner och verksamhetens krav.
  • Initiera korrigerande åtgärder som krävs för att upprätthålla en säker och effektiv verksamhet.

Vem är du?

För att lyckas i rollen ser vi att du har:

  • Erfarenhet från tillverknings-, produktions- eller industriverksamhet med god förståelse för produktionsprocesser. Erfarenhet från stålindustrin är ett plus.
  • Erfarenhet och/eller starkt intresse av att leda, coacha och utveckla medarbetare.
  • God förståelse för arbetsmiljö, säkerhet, kvalitet och principer för operational excellens.
  • Erfarenhet av att driva produktivitetsförbättringar och förbättringsarbete.
  • God förmåga att planera, prioritera och lösa problem.
  • Stark kommunikativ förmåga och förmåga att skapa engagemang hos intressenter på olika nivåer i organisationen.
  • Ett proaktivt och resultatorienterat arbetssätt med fokus på att skapa hållbara förbättringar.
  • Teknisk gymnasieutbildning krävs; högskoleutbildning är meriterande
  • Goda kunskaper i svenska och engelska, både i tal och skrift
  • B-körkort är ett krav

Varför söka denna roll?

  • Möjlighet att leda och påverka en viktig del av vår verksamhet.
  • En företagskultur som präglas av säkerhet, samarbete och ständiga förbättringar.
  • Goda möjligheter till kompetensutveckling och karriärutveckling.
  • En arbetsmiljö där ditt ledarskap och dina idéer gör skillnad.

Actuarial Exams, Actuarial Science, Mathematical Analysis, Mathematics, Microsoft Excel

title: Software Engineer - Kubernetes (K8s) Go (Golang) Python Microservices,Linux,AI-assisted development - 8 to 10 years
description:
Meet the Team

Cisco Nexus Dashboard is the unified operations platform designed to simplify and accelerate data center management. Built on a robust, Kubernetes-based microservices architecture, it serves as a single pane of glass for the Cisco data center portfolio, including ACI and Nexus Dashboard Fabric Controller (NDFC). By integrating advanced telemetry, orchestration, and policy management services, the platform empowers organizations to streamline their operational workflows, enhance visibility, and ensure consistent configuration and security across diverse physical and virtual environments.

The Nexus Dashboard infrastructure team serves as the backbone of our platform, engineering the critical services that ensure stability, security, and seamless lifecycle management for our global data center customers. By managing the core Kubernetes-based architecture, our team provides the essential foundation upon which advanced orchestration, telemetry, and policy services are built and scaled. We are a fast-paced, dynamic group of engineers who thrive on collaboration and constant innovation, working closely with cross-functional teams to solve complex infrastructure challenges in real-time. We foster a culture of continuous learning and technical excellence, making this the ideal environment for engineers who are passionate about building robust, high-scale infrastructure.

Your Impact

Joining Nexus Dashboard infrastructure team means operating at the cutting edge of platform technologies, where you will have the opportunity to directly influence the future of data center automation and platform reliability.

- Core Platform Engineering: Architect and maintain the core infrastructure of the Nexus Dashboard, a Kubernetes-based platform, ensuring high availability and performance across its integrated data stack, including PostgreSQL, OpenSearch, and Kafka.

- Cluster Lifecycle Management: Oversee the full deployment lifecycle of multi-node clusters, including automated installation, configuration, and seamless inline software upgrades across diverse physical and virtual form factors.

- System Reliability & Observability: Develop and support critical infrastructure services, including robust backup and restore frameworks, automated anomaly detection, and comprehensive audit logging to ensure platform reliability and operational transparency.

- Security & Identity Infrastructure: Implement and manage enterprise-grade security protocols, focusing on centralized Authentication and Authorization (AAA) and end-to-end certificate lifecycle management for both cluster-level and microservice-level communications.

- Scalability & Performance Optimization: Collaborate with cross-functional engineering teams to optimize platform scalability and resource efficiency, ensuring the Nexus Dashboard remains a resilient and performant foundation for data center telemetry and orchestration services.

Minimum Qualifications

- Bachelors 8+ years related experience or Masters +4 years of related experience.

- Experience programming in languages such as Go and Python, including leveraging AI-assisted development tools to write, test, and optimize code.

- Experience with rapid prototyping of AI solutions and AI workflow/agent engineering.

- Proven experience in developing, deploying, and managing microservices on Kubernetes-based orchestration platforms.

- Experience designing and implementing robust test plans to ensure software quality, reliability, and coverage across all use cases.

- Solid understanding of computer science fundamentals and software engineering, with an aptitude for learning new technologies.

Preferred Qualifications

- Proficiency in Linux system internals, including process management, file systems, and networking.

- Understanding of distributed databases and messaging systems, such as PostgreSQL, OpenSearch, Kafka.

- Hands-on experience with CI/CD pipelines.

Why Cisco?

At Cisco, we’re revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era – and beyond. We’ve been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint.

Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you’ll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale. Because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere.

We are Cisco, and our power starts with you.

title: Technical Authority IP
description:
Join our Team

About this opportunity:
We are seeking an experienced Technical Authority Expert to support alarm analysis, operations and maintenance, troubleshooting, and change implementation across IP network nodes, including routers, switches, firewalls, load balancers and security gateways. You will contribute to managed services delivery through the Ericsson Operations Engine across the Create, Sustain and Evolve lifecycle.
You will analyse and resolve customer and Level 2 trouble tickets, manage faults across routers and switches, coordinate escalations, develop automation, improve recovery processes, and contribute to global technology standards.

What you will do:
- Monitor ITSM queues, resolve incidents and support MTTR targets.
- Analyse P0–P4 incidents, identify root causes and recommend actions.
- Act as first contact for alarm, event and KPI-related issues.
- Collaborate with field teams on hardware failures, unreachable nodes and site activities.
- Support service restoration, high availability and SLA commitments.
- Proactively identify risks, complete health checks, backups and troubleshooting.
- Share MIR and CSR details with relevant teams.
- Apply end-to-end network expertise to support operations.
- Support OEM engagement, problem management, analytics and customer governance.
- Develop automation to improve managed services delivery.
- Provide technical guidance to internal teams.
- Drive continuous improvement across recovery processes and service delivery.
- Support complex change analysis and execution.
- Develop strategies that improve customer experience.

You will bring:
- Strong IP networking knowledge, including OSPF, ISIS, BGP, BGP-LU, MPLS, Inter-AS, LDP, RSVP, TE, L2VPN, L3VPN, BFD, Segment Routing and Cisco ACI.
- Understanding of VLAN, STP, RSTP, MSTP, VRRP, HSRP and Nexus VPC.
- Knowledge of IPSEC, GRE, VPN, CGNAT, DDoS, Genie and Radware.
- Experience with Cisco technologies, spine-leaf and border-leaf architecture, and VX-LAN.
- Telecommunications knowledge across 2G, 3G, 4G and 5G service flows and interfaces.
- Mandatory Cisco product and vendor knowledge; Ericsson knowledge highly regarded.
- Strong analytical, problem-solving and troubleshooting skills.
- Excellent communication skills and ability to manage priorities.
- Minimum 5 years’ relevant IP domain experience.
- Working knowledge of Cisco, Juniper, RAD-ETX, Huawei, Nokia/Alcatel, Check Point, Fortinet, Cisco and Nokia BNG, and F5 load balancers.
- Understanding of Ericsson Operations Engine and managed services automation.
- Network-level competence and ability to support cross-domain solutions.
- Experience in capacity management, lifecycle management, system configuration and administration.
- Knowledge of network configuration, change management, diagnostics, MS TOP, WLAs and SLAs.

At Maersk, we believe in the power of diversity, collaboration, and continuous learning and we work hard to ensure that the people in our organisation reflect and understand the customers we exist to serve.

With over 100,000 employees across 130 countries, we work together to shape the future of global trade and logistics.

Join us as we harness cutting-edge technologies and unlock opportunities on a global scale. Together, let's sail towards a brighter, more sustainable future with Maersk.

We offer


We offer an exciting and attractive career in an ambitious and competitive environment with the possibility of continuous professional and personal development across a world class organization. This is an exciting opportunity for professional development in a field of transportation.

We recognize that everyone is different and that the way in which people want to work and deliver at their best is different for everyone. In this role, we can offer a full-time role with full presence in the office.


The environment is friendly and dynamic, with focus on high performance, results, and respect for our employees; you’re valued as part of our team.


You will work with colleagues in a large variety of positions and roles enabling you to build a great network within Maersk Group.


Key responsibilities:


The role of the Customer Experience Agent is to own/manage the customer experience of customers assigned in the portfolio. This includes proactively monitoring and managing the end-to-end shipment process in compliance with all company procedures, ensuring that the cargo is transported as per the transport plan promised to the customer and/or that the customers is kept informed of relevant deviations. This requires close cooperation with the counterparts in One Team CS (GSC) who are executing the majority of the transactional tasks. Building relationships with the customers, understanding their business drivers should be leveraged to continuously improve cooperation and process to the mutual benefit of the customer and Maersk Group.

In addition to:

  • Actively building strong relationships with assigned customers and gain an understanding of their business, service needs, drivers and desires through everyday phone/mail contact and customers visits.

  • Owning overall process for shipments including but not limited to coordination of deliveries/loadings with special focus on rail/truck transport arrangement together with internal intermodal team.

  • Remain current on changes in local & foreign rules, internal & external procedures and product developments, build and maintain understanding of the cargo you are shipping and requirements that come with it and understanding of cross functional processes and how they link it to your role.

  • Take ownership of reaching common team goals and KPI targets, and actively support team priorities.

  • Continue upgrading of own soft and technical skills to deliver world class customer service.

  • In general, actively seek out and act on continuous improvement opportunities both in relation to customers and internal / external stakeholders.

We are looking for:

  • Strong experience in customer service in freight forwarding and logistics.

  • Customer-centric mindset.

  • Good knowledge of MS Excel and experience working with multiple systems.

  • Fluency in English both written and spoken is a must. Second European language will be an advantage.

  • Problem-solving and critical thinking skills.

  • Teamwork and team mindset.

title: Ohjaaja (lähihoitaja), Onnikoti Veeruska, Vartiala
description:
Ohjaaja (lähihoitaja), Onnikoti Veeruska, Vartiala


Tule tekemään kehitysvammaisten ohjaustyötä ainutlaatuiseen joukkoomme Onnikoti Veeruskaan, Vartialaan.

Haemme nyt lähihoitajaa ohjaajaksi vakituiseen osa-aikaiseen (60%) työsuhteeseen kauniiseen ja moderniin kotiimme.

Mihin tulet töihin?
Haluaisitko olla luomassa lämminhenkistä ilmapiiriä Onnikoti Veeruskassa luonnon äärellä Savulahdessa, Riistaveden kupeessa. Ympärivuorokautisen asumisen kodissamme asuu 11 persoonallista ja touhukasta asukasta, jotka toivovat ohjaajan olevan reilu ja kohtaavan heidät lämmöllä sekä tukevan arjen touhuissa. Työyhteisössämme arvostetaan tekevää ja asukkaita kuuntelevaa työkaveria ja jaamme yhteisen huumorin työyhteisön sekä asukkaiden kesken. Sinulla on mahdollisuus kehittää toimintaa yhdessä työyhteisön kanssa. Teemme tiivistä yhteistyötä pihapiirissä sijaitsevien Veeruskan yhteisöllisen asumisen kodin sekä Onnikoti Vilholan kanssa.


Mitä pääset tekemään?
Lähihoitajana pääset tekemään jokapäiväistä hoito- ja ohjaustyötä ja kehittämään yksikkömme toimintaa yhteistyössä muiden tiimiläisten kanssa. Arkemme on toiminnallista ja järjestämme jatkuvasti aktiviteetteja asukkaillemme.

Kuka sinä olet?
Olet koulutukseltasi lähihoitaja. Joukossamme viihtyy parhaiten positiivisesti asioihin suhtautuva ja oma-aloitteinen henkilö, joka on aidosti kiinnostunut vammaistyöstä. Vammaistyön osaaminen katsotaan eduksesi.

Miksi tulisit meille töihin?

Onnikoti Veeruskassa pääset osaksi yhteen hiileen puhaltavaa työyhteisöä, jossa töitä tehdään hymy huulilla. Mehiläisenä saat käyttöösi hyvät henkilöstöedut, kuten liikuntasaldon, työterveyshuollon ja digiklinikan palvelut 24/7. Onnikotien työtekijänä sinulla on monipuoliset koulutus- ja kehittymismahdollisuudet.

Työ on 3-vuorotyötä ja työsuhde on osa-aikainen 60% työajalla. Mahdollisuus lisätyöhön. Palkkaus on sos.tes:in mukainen G20C.

Sosiaali- ja terveydenhuollon valvonnasta annetun lain mukaisesti tehtävään valittavien ikääntyvien tai vammaisten henkilöiden kanssa työskentelevien on esitettävä nähtäväksi rikosrekisterilain 6 §:n 2 momentissa tarkoitettu rikosrekisteriote.

Työ edellyttää tartuntatautilain mukaista rokotesuojaa, tuberkuloosiselvitystä ja salmonellatodistusta sekä voimassa olevaa Suosikki/Terhikkirekisteröintiä, ammattikorttia ja hygieniapassia.

Työkielenä meillä on suomi. Hoito-/ohjaustyön tehtävien hoitaminen edellyttää vähintään B1- tasoa suomen kielessä.

Haethan tehtävää rekrytointijärjestelmämme kautta 6.9.2026 mennessä. Toimithan nopeasti, sillä täytämme paikan heti sopivan henkilön löytyessä. Haastattelemme hakijoita jo hakuajalla. Työ alkaa sopimuksen mukaan.

Kerron mielelläni lisää:
Yksikönjohtaja Heidi Räsänen

040 198 1295 (arkisin klo 8–16)
heidi.rasanen2@onnikodit.fi


Koti täynnä ainutlaatuista elämäniloa.

Onnikodeissa tarjoamme tukea tarvitsevalle kodin, jossa hän voi elää mahdollisimman antoisaa ja turvallista arkea. Panostamme yksilöllisyyteen sekä laatuun ja palvelumme lähtökohtana ovat aina asukkaan omat ainutlaatuiset ominaisuudet, vahvuudet, mielenkiinnon kohteet sekä tuen tarpeet.

Onnikodit on osa Mehiläistä. Mehiläisen sosiaali- ja terveyspalveluiden ammattilaiset työskentelevät joka päivä tinkimättömästi yksityis-, yritys- ja hyvinvointialueasiakkaidemme hyväksi. Tervetuloa mukaan vahvistamaan ammattilaistemme joukkoa!

title: Apotektekniker/apotekmedarbeider
description:
Our team members are at the heart of everything we do. At Cencora, we are united in our responsibility to create healthier futures, and every person here is essential to us being able to deliver on that purpose. If you want to make a difference at the center of health, come join our innovative company and help us improve the lives of people and animals everywhere. Apply today!

Job Details

Apotektekniker/apotekmedarbeider

Boots apotek Nesttun er et travelt lokalapotek i Alti Nesttun. Apoteket ligger i kjøpesenterets 1. etasje med kort gangavstand fra bybanestoppet og har en stab som består av 8 ansatte: 4 farmasøyter inkludert apoteker og 4 apotekteknikere

Åpningstider: Mandag-fredag: 09:00-20:00

Lørdag : 10:00-18:00

Er du apotektekniker og får energi av å hjelpe kunder med deres helsebehov?

Vi mener det er nettopp medarbeiderne som utgjør den viktigste forskjellen for kunden!

Bli med på vårt team og få muligheten til å veilede og gi rådgivning til kunder i et miljø som setter kvalitet i kundemøtet og utvikling av helsetjenester i fokus! Bli med på å forme fremtidens apotek!

Søknadsfrist: snarest

Tiltredelsesdato: 25.08.2026 eller etter avtale

Arbeidsoppgaver

• Som apotektekniker hos Boots apotek vil du ha en sentral rolle i å veilede og gi rådgivning til kundene våre. Dette innebærer å velge riktige produkter og forstå hvordan de skal brukes, samt gi informasjon om og utføre helsetjenester. På denne måten bidrar du med din kompetanse til bedre helse og økt livskvalitet for kundene!

Kvalifikasjoner

• Vi søker etter en apotektekniker eller noen med annen relevant bakgrunn, ideelt sett med erfaring fra norske apotek.

Personlige egenskaper

• I denne rollen er det viktig at du liker å bruke din kompetanse i kundemøtene. Du bør være engasjert i å hjelpe kundene med deres individuelle behov og kunne kommunisere tydelig om medisiner, tjenester og helseprodukter.

• Ditt engasjement driver deg til å stadig strekke deg etter det beste. Du ønsker alltid å levere den beste servicen til kundene dine ved å være kunnskapsrik, profesjonell og imøtekommende.

• Gode mellommenneskelige ferdigheter er viktige i denne rollen da du vil jobbe tett sammen med kolleger og samhandle daglig med kunder. Evnen til å etablere gode relasjoner, være utadvendt og ha et positivt humør vil bidra til en trivelig arbeidsatmosfære.

Vi tilbyr

• Stillingen som apotektekniker hos Boots apotek gir deg muligheten til å bli en del av en anerkjent apotekkjede.

• Vår virksomhet er preget av et nytenkende apotekkonsept som setter stor vekt på kvalitet i kundemøtet. Vi ønsker aktivt å utvikle helsetjenester slik at vi kan møte kundenes behov på best mulig måte.

• Vi investerer også i din personlige og faglige videreutvikling gjennom opplæringsprogrammer eller interne kurs slik at du kan trives og lykkes i stillingen din hos oss.

Ved spørsmål om stillingen, kontakt Irina.

.

Alliance Healthcare Norge Apotekdrift AS eier og driver over 150 Boots apotek i Norge. Vi har kjedekontor på Økern i Oslo og grossisten Alliance Healthcare Norge AS, med administrasjon og lager på Drøbak og lager i Tromsø.

Boots, som har mer enn 160 års erfaring fra internasjonal apotekdrift, åpnet sitt første apotek i Norge i 2008. Selskapet er i dag et av verdens best kjente merkenavn. I samarbeid med forskere og spesialister innen helse og hudpleie, utvikler og produserer Boots flere bestselgende merkevarer for eksempel No7, Soap & Glory og Soltan. Disse distribueres gjennom Boots Apotek i Norge. Boots Apotek/Alliance Healthcare Norge Apotekdrift AS og Alliance Healthcare Norge AS er en del av det internasjonale selskapet Cencora.

Cencora er et ledende, globalt selskap innen farmasøytiske tjenester. Vårt fokus er å forbedre livene til mennesker og dyr over hele verden. Vi samarbeider med farmasøytiske innovatører på tvers av verdikjeden for å lette og optimalisere markedstilgangen til legemiddelbehandling. Vi sørger for sikker og pålitelig leveranse av legemidler, helseprodukter og løsninger. Selskapet har 46 000+ ansatte globalt, som alle bidrar til selskapets formål: Vi står sammen om vårt ansvar for å skape en sunnere fremtid. Cencora er rangert som nr. 11 på Fortune 500 og nr. 24 på Global Fortune 500 med mer enn 200 milliarder USD i årlig omsetning. Les mer om selskapet på www.cencora.com

title: Lead Infrastructure Engineer -Theta Lake administrator
description:
About this role:

Wells Fargo is seeking a Lead Infrastructure Engineer to own the administration, reliability, and technical governance of our Electronic Communications Archiving and Surveillance platform, Theta Lake. This role will serve as the primary Theta Lake platform owner and administrator, responsible for platform stability, feed ingestion, surveillance enablement, compliance readiness, and integrations across regulated communication channels such as email, chat, collaboration tools, and voice.

The role is critical to ensuring regulatory compliance, data completeness, integrity, and surveillance effectiveness for electronic communications.


In this role, you will:

  • Lead complex initiatives to develop infrastructure to provide solutions for business applications

  • Participate in various projects intended to continually improve or upgrade the infrastructure

  • Evaluate internal and external software solutions which could be leveraged to meet target state architecture goals

  • Review and analyze high impact outages to ensure the proper processes and procedures are in place to avoid problems in the future

  • Design, build, deploy and maintain infrastructure solutions through collaborative efforts with the team and third party vendors

  • Design, code, test, debug and document programs using Agile development practices

  • Make decisions in technical designs, implementation plans and identify project risks and resource requirements

  • Direct the daily risk and control flow of operations, focusing on policies, procedures and work standards to ensure success

  • Recommend courses of action to maintain cost effectiveness and achieve results

  • Collaborate and consult with peers, colleagues and managers to resolve issues and achieve goals

  • Interact with customer and vendor


Required Qualifications:

  • 5+ years of Technology Infrastructure Engineering and Solutions experience, or equivalent demonstrated through one or a combination of the following: work experience, training, military experience, education


Desired Qualifications:

  • Experience with electronic communication archival and regulated financial services surveillance programs (e.g., broker-dealer / banking compliance environments).
  • Familiarity with complementary platforms/tools: Verba, ZL, Microsoft Purview, or other archival and compliance ecosystems.
  • Understanding of governance frameworks and audit practices: control evidence, approvals, change logs, and policy traceability.
  • Experience with scripting/automation for operational reporting (PowerShell, Python) and data analysis (SQL, KQL, Splunk).
  • Exposure to eDiscovery and legal hold processes and cross-functional workflows.
  • Administer Theta Lake environment(s): user access controls, roles, entitlements, integrations, and workflow configuration.
  • Evaluate internal and external software solutions which could be leveraged to meet target state architecture goals
  • Surveillance Rule Engineering & Tuning: Configure and maintain Theta Lake surveillance policies, including keyword/lexicon detection, behavioral patterns, risk scoring, and alert routing. Tune rules to reduce false positives/false negatives while maintaining regulatory defensibility and coverage.
  • Create and maintain rule documentation, rationale, change history, and approvals aligned to governance processes.
  • Partner with messaging/archiving/source teams to ensure ingest integrity from upstream sources (e.g., M365/Teams/Exchange, voice recording systems, file shares).
  • Validate completeness and accuracy of ingested content and metadata against source systems, support reconciliation and evidence integrity checks.
  • Identify data gaps, ingestion anomalies, and mapping issues, drive remediation through engineering and vendor support channels.
  • Compliance & Regulatory Alignment -Translate regulatory and policy requirements into implementable surveillance controls (e.g., monitoring coverage, retention alignment, audit trails).
  • Support audits/exams by producing configuration evidence, control mapping, and surveillance outcome metrics.
  • Ensure surveillance workflows support legal hold and eDiscovery readiness, where applicable.
  • Review and analyze high impact outages to ensure the proper processes and procedures are in place to avoid problems in the future
  • Design, build, deploy and maintain infrastructure solutions through collaborative efforts with the team and third-party vendors
  • Design, code, test, debug and document programs using Agile development practices
  • Make decisions in technical designs, implementation plans and identify project risks and resource requirements
  • Direct the daily risk and control flow of operations, focusing on policies, procedures and work standards to ensure success
  • Recommend courses of action to maintain cost effectiveness and achieve results
  • Collaborate and consult with peers, colleagues and managers to resolve issues and achieve goals
  • Interact with customer and vendor

Job Expectations:

  • 5+ years of experience in eComms compliance, surveillance engineering, archiving governance, or related security/compliance engineering roles.
  • Direct experience with Theta Lake, ZL, environment setup, operations, upgrades, ingestion troubleshooting, and vendor coordination.
  • Strong hands-on experience with Theta Lake configuration and surveillance capabilities (policy, lexicon, workflow, and alerting).
  • Working knowledge of communications platforms and data sources such as Microsoft 365 (Teams, Exchange Online), chat systems, voice/recording platforms, and digital collaboration tools.
  • Experience in data validation concepts: data completeness, accuracy, lineage, evidence integrity, and reconciliation approaches.
  • Proven ability to troubleshoot ingestion issues, mapping inconsistencies, and operational failures using logs, metadata, and platform tools.
  • Strong documentation and stakeholder communication skills—able to explain technical configurations in compliance terms.
  • Hands on experience of 5+ years in Application & Production support with hands on experience with Windows/Linux Operating System, Oracle database
  • Hands on experience of 3+ years in ZL, Vantage, Theta Lake and Similar platform
  • Hands on experience with one or more of these tools - Splunk, App Dynamics, Grafana, Autosys
  • Good understanding of Incident & Problem Management and Service Now
  • Self-starter with good verbal and communication skills
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills

title: MS Core Cloud Specialist Fixed Voice
description:
Join our Team

About this opportunity
Ericsson is seeking a highly skilled MS Core Cloud Specialist – Fixed Voice to join our team in Sydney, NSW. This senior role requires deep expertise in Ribbon and GENBAND voice switching platforms to support and evolve Fixed Voice network infrastructure across Australian Data Centers.

What you will do
· Operate and maintain Ribbon/GENBAND Fixed Voice nodes (DMS100, CS2000/CS2K, C20 and sub-elements) across Sydney-based and national Data Centers
· Perform fault management, incident resolution, and root-cause analysis for voice platform outages
· Execute software upgrades, patch management, and planned maintenance on GENBAND/Ribbon platforms
· Configure and manage C20 elements: GWC, CCA, USP/SP2K, AMS, MAS, NGSS/SST, SSL/SESM/A2, CS-LAN, CBM, CMT/IEMT, IEMS, RTP MP EM, PMDM, MG3.5K, MG15K, NDM, TNSI
· Monitor network KPIs using Grafana and Kalix; resolve degradations proactively
· Manage SBC provisioning, SIP trunking, and policy rules via Ribbon NMS
· Develop and review MOPs for change management and maintenance windows
· Collaborate with IMS, PS CORE, and NOC teams on cross-domain incidents
· Provide Level 3 support and escalation management with Ribbon/GENBAND vendor TAC
· Maintain accurate network documentation and knowledge-base articles

You will bring

Education and experience
· Education: Bachelor’s in Telecom, Electronics, Computer Science or equivalent
· Experience: 15+ years Wireline/Fixed Voice — hands-on experience on Ribbon or GENBAND platforms

Mandatory technical skills
· Deep expertise in DMS100, CS2000 (CS2K), and C20 platform elements
· Strong operational knowledge of Ribbon/GENBAND Fixed Voice architectures and SBC platforms

Tool knowledge
· Grafana
· Kalix
· Ribbon NMS
· ServiceNow / ITSM
· Unix / Linux CLI

Protocol and technology knowledge
· SIP (RFC 3261)
· H.248 / MEGACO
· SS7 / ISUP
· SIGTRAN
· TDM E1 / T1 / PRI
· RTP / RTCP
· G.711 / G.729
· DTMF RFC 2833
· LNP / ENUM
· IPv4 / IPv6

Node types and platforms
· Ribbon / Nortel – DMS100: Class 5 wireline switch — operation, provisioning, fault resolution
· GENBAND / Ribbon – CS2000 (CS2K): Softswitch — call control, trunk management, signalling configuration
· GENBAND / Ribbon – C20 Softswitch: GWC, CCA, USP/SP2K, AMS, MAS, NGSS/SST, SSL/SESM/A2, CS-LAN, CBM, CMT/IEMT, IEMS, RTP MP EM, PMDM, MG3.5K, MG15K, NDM, TNSI
· Ribbon – SBC: Session Border Controller — SIP trunking, media policy, SIP/TDM interworking

Additional advantages and requirements
· Added advantage: Good understanding of network KPIs (call completion rate, ASR, NER, MOS) for Fixed Voice, with ability to interpret and act on KPI degradation trends
· Certifications: Ribbon/GENBAND certifications and CCNA/CCNP Voice (preferred)

description:

Join Our Global Team and Shape the Future with Ericsson 5G Advanced!
Senior ASIC IP Verification – Be the Architect of Tomorrow

Are you ready to take your career to the next level and play a pivotal role in advancing 5G technology? At Ericsson, we're not just shaping the future; we're pushing the boundaries with Ericsson 5G Advanced. This isn't just the next step in 5G—it's a revolutionary leap forward.


As part of our international team, you'll work alongside world-class talent on cutting-edge ASIC projects. We're engaged in all Ericsson ASIC initiatives, creating a vast network and serving these with SoC-level IPs and subsystems. This includes Clock and Reset controllers, Top-level device processor subsystems, accelerators, chip-level trace and debug architecture, and all interfaces for inter-chip communication or control of external devices.


Imagine revolutionizing the driving experience with smart, connected vehicles or transforming entertainment with immersive virtual reality. Ericsson 5G Advanced is the key to enabling high-performing programmable networks that ensure consistent and superior user experiences.


Why Ericsson?


• Pioneering Technology: Be part of our world-leading 5G RAN portfolio, with Ericsson 5G Advanced as a key enabler for high-performing programmable networks.
• People-Centric Culture: We put people first, focusing on your career aspirations and personal growth. Inclusiveness is at our core, and we celebrate diversity across our teams.
• Global Collaboration: Work closely with talented teams in Austin, US, while being based in our vibrant Lund, Sweden office.
• Fun and Engagement: Enjoy frequent social activities that foster team spirit and make work enjoyable.

What will you do

• Take full responsibility for the verification of designs, whether at the block or subsystem level.
• Define and implement UVM-based test environments.
• Break down requirements to create a Verification Strategy and develop and execute a Verification Plan.
• Develop, run, and debug test cases to ensure design quality.
• Collaborate closely with other verifiers, designers, and architects.
• Continuously improve and optimize verification methodologies.
• Generate comprehensive documentation throughout the verification lifecycle.
• Develop competence in the technical domain.


Skills you bring


• Master’s in Electronic Engineering or equivalent.
• Minimum of 8 years in ASIC verification, with proven success in advanced SoC development.
• Deep understanding of ASIC technology, SoC, IP verification, and methodologies, with proficiency in System Verilog and UVM.
• Track record of successful cross-team and cross-site cooperation.
• Results-Driven Mindset: Results-driven, with a focus on meeting expectations and delivering high-quality results.

Additional Requirements:


• Experience with Formal Verification.
• Familiarity with Agile methodologies.

Preferred Skills:


• Experience with SystemVerilog Assertions.
• Understanding of radio access systems and their components.
• Expertise in low-power design verification.

title: HR Student Assistant
description:
Would you like to complement your studies with a job where you can develop your HR skills and gain hands-on experience in a large global organisation? Are you a data-driven person who thrives on administrative tasks and working with data? Then apply for this student position and support us in our daily work in the HR Admin & Payroll Team. It's important to note, that speaking and writing Danish and English is a prerequisite for this position.

Your future team:

You will join a collaborative and supportive HR team, consisting of 5 HR Coordinators working with HR admin, 1 focused on payroll, and the Section Manager of HR Admin and Payroll. Together, we support all areas of ROCKWOOL Nordic region with the full range of HR administrative and payroll tasks. Being a small, close-knit team, we are deeply dependent on teamwork and knowledge sharing.

What you will be doing:

As a Student Assistant in Human Resources (HR) you will get a chance to work with back-office human resources administration and get a solid understanding of core elements of the full employee life cycle.

Your tasks will vary and will include:

  • Supporting the HR team with general administrative tasks which are critical in ensuring that our operation is running smoothly including archiving and updating employee related data in our various information systems. We use Workday, SharePoint & SAP.

  • Supporting with recruitment related tasks, such as candidate management, coordinating interviews, and helping with practicalities for career fairs etc.

  • Helping with onboarding related tasks like introduction courses.

  • Conducting data analysis and reports.

  • Assisting with presentations, templates, guidelines and other HR documents.

  • Assisting with various ad hoc HR tasks.

Don’t worry if you don’t know how to do all these tasks. We value drive, curiosity and positivity above all and are looking for someone eager to learn!

What you bring:

  • You possess a natural interest in HR and administrative processes.

  • You work in an organized fashion, have a great sense of detail and care for quality.

  • You are trustworthy, service-minded, flexible and understand the importance of commitments and deadlines.

  • It comes natural for you to be a team player, and you contribute with your good mood and positive mindset.

  • You are currently studying a bachelor’s or master’s degree within Business, HR, Economics, Data & Analytics, Social Sciences, IT/Digitalisation, or a related field.

  • You are comfortable working with Microsoft Office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint).

  • You are proficient in Danish and English, spoken and written.

What we offer:

You will get the opportunity to become part of a dynamic and growing organization, where you will experience an informal yet professional atmosphere. The position provides you with a great opportunity to learn about core HR processes and employment law through working with HR professionals in a global organization.

The job is approximately 15 hours per week, but of course we are flexible and understand that your studies come first.

We are located at our headquarters in Hedehusene close to Copenhagen and Roskilde.

Compensation & Benefits:
Salary:
Bachelor students: 160 DKK/hour
Master students: 175 DKK/hour
Transportation allowance: 1000 DKK/month

Benefits:
Health insurance
Christmas gift
On-site newly renovated Fitness center
Canteen (take away available at affordable prices)
Fruit, coffee and tea

Socials:
A variety of societies (e.g. RockSocial, Sport Society, Art Society)
Holiday parties

Ready to apply?

Please submit your application in English via the below link no later than 15 September 2026. Interviews are held on an ongoing basis.

If you want to know more, don’t hesitate to contact Section Manager, HR Admin & Payroll Nordics, Pernille Tvorup Friis at pernille.tvorup.friis@rockwool.com.

Who we are

We are the world leader in stone wool solutions. Founded in 1937 in Denmark, we transform volcanic rock into safe, sustainable products that help people and communities thrive. We are a global company with more than 12,000 employees, located in 40+ countries with 51 manufacturing facilities all focused on one common purpose – to release the inherent power of stone to enrich modern living.

Sustainability is central to our business strategy. ROCKWOOL was one of the first companies to commit to actively contributing to the United Nations Sustainable Development Goals (SDG’s) framework and are actively committed to 11 SDGs, including SDG 14, Life Below Water. Through our partnership with the One Ocean Foundation and in connection with our sponsorship of the Denmark SailGP team, we will help raise awareness around ocean health challenges in an effort to accelerate solutions to protect it.

Diverse and Inclusive Culture

We want all our people to feel valued, respected, included and heard. We employ 79 different nationalities worldwide and are committed to providing equal opportunities to all employees, promoting diversity, and working against all forms of discrimination among ROCKWOOL employees.

At ROCKWOOL, you will experience a friendly team environment. Our culture is very important to us. In fact, we refer to our culture as “The ROCKWOOL Way”. This is the foundation in which we operate and is based upon our values of ambition, responsibility, integrity and efficiency.

title: Senior Linux/Unix Server Administrator - OCI
description:
Job Description:

Key Responsibilities

Infrastructure Administration

  • Install, configure, and administer Linux/Unix servers (RHEL, Oracle Linux, CentOS, AIX, Solaris) across physical, virtual, and cloud environments.
  • Manage IaaS instances on OCI including Compute, Block Storage, Virtual Cloud Networks (VCN), and associated networking constructs.
  • Perform OS patching, upgrades, kernel tuning, and lifecycle management in line with client change management processes.
  • Administer logical volume management (LVM), filesystem layouts, NFS/SMB mounts, and storage provisioning.
  • Configure and maintain high-availability and disaster recovery solutions (clustering, failover, replication).

Cloud & OCI Operations

  • Provision and manage OCI Compute instances, including Bare Metal, VM Shapes, and Dedicated VM Hosts.
  • Configure OCI networking components: VCN, subnets, security lists, network security groups, load balancers, and FastConnect/VPN.
  • Manage OCI Identity and Access Management (IAM), compartments, policies, and tenancy governance.
  • Implement and manage OCI Block Volume, File Storage, and Object Storage for workload requirements.
  • Monitor and optimise OCI resource utilisation, costs, and performance via OCI Monitoring, Logging, and Alarms.

Automation & DevOps

  • Develop and maintain automation scripts using Shell (Bash/Ksh), Python, or Ansible for provisioning, configuration management, and routine operations.
  • Leverage OCI CLI, Terraform, and/or OCI Resource Manager for infrastructure-as-code deployments.
  • Integrate with ITSM tooling (ServiceNow or equivalent) for incident, change, and problem management workflows.

Security & Compliance

  • Apply OS-level security hardening (CIS benchmarks, SELinux/AppArmor, firewall rules, PAM configuration).
  • Manage user accounts, RBAC, SSH key infrastructure, and privileged access in line with least-privilege principles.
  • Support audit and compliance activities including log management, vulnerability remediation, and evidence collection.

Monitoring & Incident Management

  • Monitor system health, capacity, and performance using tools
  • Act as L2/L3 for infrastructure incidents; lead root cause analysis and drive resolution within SLA.
  • Produce operational reports, runbooks, and technical documentation for managed platforms.

Qualifications & Experience

Required

  • 5+ years of hands-on Linux/Unix server administration in an enterprise or managed services environment.
  • Deep expertise in Red Hat Enterprise Linux (RHEL) or Oracle Linux; proficiency in at least one additional Unix variant (AIX, Solaris, HP-UX).
  • Strong understanding of TCP/IP networking, DNS, DHCP, NFS, and enterprise storage protocols (iSCSI, FC).
  • Proven scripting skills in Bash, Python, or Perl for automation and operational tasks.
  • Experience with enterprise virtualisation platforms (VMware vSphere, KVM, OVM).
  • Familiarity with ITIL-aligned service delivery processes (Incident, Change, Problem Management).
  • Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills with the ability to work independently under pressure.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills for client-facing engagement.

Preferred

  • Hands-on experience with Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) — Compute, Networking, Storage, IAM.
  • Exposure to Oracle Engineered Systems: Exadata, Oracle Database Appliance (ODA), or SPARC SuperCluster.
  • Infrastructure-as-Code experience: Terraform, Ansible, OCI Resource Manager.
  • Experience in a professional services / managed services delivery model with multiple concurrent client engagements.

Certifications

Highly Desirable

  • Oracle Cloud Infrastructure Foundations Associate (1Z0-1085)
  • Oracle Cloud Infrastructure Architect Associate or Professional (1Z0-1072 / 1Z0-1067)
  • Red Hat Certified System Administrator (RHCSA) or Red Hat Certified Engineer (RHCE)
  • Oracle Linux System Administrator (1Z0-100)
  • ITIL Foundation v4

Core Competencies

  • Client Focus — proactively manages expectations and builds trusted relationships with client technical teams.
  • Problem Solving — systematic approach to diagnosing complex infrastructure issues with minimal guidance.
  • Collaboration — works effectively within multi-disciplinary delivery teams across time zones.
  • Accountability — takes ownership of outcomes and maintains quality standards under delivery pressure.
  • Continuous Improvement — identifies and implements process improvements to reduce toil and improve reliability.

title: AI Architect
description:
As of 2 September 2025, Vivicta, former Tietoevry Tech Services, now operates as a standalone company under our new brand. We’ve officially launched Vivicta, your trusted Nordic transformation partner, making everyday easier through technology. You can explore more about our brand and what we stand for at

Ready to join us? Click ‘Apply’ and complete our short application form to get started. Prefer another option? Apply via LinkedIn to automatically populate your details using your profile.

Vivicta is building AI solutions that create measurable impact today while preparing enterprises for the next generation of intelligent, agent-based systems.

We are looking for an AI Architect to help design and deliver production-grade AI solutions for enterprise customers. This is a hands-on architecture role for someone who understands both the technical depth of modern AI systems and the practical realities of deploying them securely, reliably, and at scale.

You will work across LLM applications, RAG architectures, agentic workflows, classical machine learning, cloud-native platforms, and responsible AI governance. The right candidate knows when to use generative AI, when traditional ML is the better fit, and how to design solutions that are robust, compliant, maintainable, and aligned with business needs.

This role also requires strong customer-facing skills. You should be able to explain complex AI concepts and architectures clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders, contribute to RFPs and proposals, and help customers understand how AI can solve real business problems.

What you’ll be working on

  • Designing and delivering enterprise AI solutions using LLMs, RAG pipelines, embeddings, vector search, classical ML, and agentic architectures.

  • Building applications where AI systems can reason, plan, use tools, retrieve knowledge, and support complex business workflows.

  • Shaping scalable AI architectures across platforms such as Azure AI Foundry, AWS, GCP, and multi-cloud environments.

  • Establishing best practices for MLOps and LLMOps, including CI/CD, evaluation, observability, monitoring, model governance, and lifecycle management.

  • Helping customers make informed platform and architecture choices based on security, compliance, data residency, scalability, and business value.

  • Contributing to Vivicta’s AI capabilities, including our work with secure, compliant, and sovereign AI environments.

  • Embedding responsible AI principles into every solution, with attention to GDPR, the EU AI Act, enterprise security requirements, and customer-specific governance frameworks.

  • Creating reusable reference architectures, technical accelerators, and delivery practices that help teams build AI solutions faster and more consistently.

  • Supporting sales, pre-sales, and proposal work by translating customer needs into credible AI solution concepts, architectures, and delivery plans.

  • Acting as a senior advisor to customers, delivery teams, and technical stakeholders.

What we’re looking for

  • Strong communication skills in both Finnish and English. This is required for customer-facing work.

  • At least 8 years of experience in AI, machine learning, data platforms, cloud architecture, or software architecture roles.

  • A strong track record of designing and delivering production-ready AI or data-driven systems.

  • Strong proficiency in Python and hands-on experience building AI-enabled applications.

  • Hands-on experience with LLMs, RAG pipelines, embeddings, vector databases, prompt engineering, evaluation, and AI application development.

  • Experience with agentic frameworks or orchestration patterns, such as Pydantic AI, Vercel AI SDK, Microsoft Agent Framework, LangGraph, LangChain, or equivalent approaches.

  • Strong expertise in at least one major cloud AI/ML platform, such as Azure AI Foundry, AWS SageMaker, or Google Vertex AI.

  • Good understanding of MLOps, LLMOps, model evaluation, monitoring, observability, and production operations.

  • Ability to design end-to-end architectures, evaluate trade-offs, document decisions, and guide teams from concept to production.

  • Ability to explain technical concepts, solution architectures, risks, and business value clearly to non-technical stakeholders.

  • Experience contributing to sales, pre-sales, RFP responses, proposals, workshops, or customer presentations.

  • Understanding of security, privacy, compliance, data residency, and responsible AI requirements in enterprise environments.

Job Description:

The opportunity

The PLM Engineer will play a key role in managing, improving, and migrating engineering data within PTC Windchill. This position supports Engineering and Design teams by ensuring accurate, consistent, and high‑quality CAD and product data throughout the product lifecycle. As a Windchill and CAD data expert, the PLM Engineer will drive data clean‑up initiatives, enable smooth system migrations, and help establish best practices for PLM governance and CAD data management across the organization.

How you’ll make an impact

  • Serve as a key contributor and subject‑matter expert for Windchill PLM and CAD data management activities.

  • Extract and collect product and CAD data from multiple design and legacy systems in collaboration with business stakeholders.

  • Develop, implement, and continuously improve data clean‑up processes and procedures to ensure accuracy, consistency, and reliability of data in Windchill.

  • Review CAD models and assemblies to ensure they are complete, accurate, and compliant with company standards and engineering procedures.

  • Collaborate closely with Engineering and Design teams to understand requirements and provide hands‑on support for Windchill CAD management. Partner with stakeholders to define data migration scope, requirements, timelines, and success criteria.

  • Develop and execute detailed migration plans, including data mapping, transformation, validation, and post‑migration verification.

  • Work with legacy system owners to extract required data while ensuring data integrity throughout the migration process. Identify, analyze, and resolve data quality issues such as missing, incomplete, or inconsistent information.

  • Create and maintain documentation related to CAD clean‑up and migration activities, including reports, progress summaries, and process improvement recommendations.

  • Provide training, onboarding, and ongoing support to end users on Windchill usage and data quality best practices.

  • Actively contribute to improving PLM processes, standards, and automation opportunities.

  • Responsible for ensuring compliance with applicable internal procedures, engineering standards, and data governance guidelines.

  • Live the organization’s core values of safety, integrity, and accountability, taking responsibility for your actions while caring for colleagues and the business.

Your background

  • Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical / Electrical Engineering or a related field with 2-5 years of relevant experience.

  • Strong hands‑on experience with PTC Creo and Windchill PLM. Solid understanding of PLM/PDM concepts and Windchill system architecture.

  • Experience with data mapping, transformation, validation, and reconciliation techniques. Proven experience in Windchill data migration and CAD data clean‑up projects.

  • Good knowledge of Windchill PLM configuration and customization.

  • Strong analytical and problem‑solving skills with a high attention to detail.

  • Ability to manage multiple tasks and priorities effectively in a fast‑paced environment.

  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work independently and as part of a team.

  • Proficiency in both spoken and written English language.

description:

Job Description:

Your Work Shapes the World at Caterpillar Inc.

When you join Caterpillar, you're joining a global team who cares not just about the work we do – but also about each other. We are the makers, problem solvers, and future world builders who are creating stronger, more sustainable communities. We don't just talk about progress and innovation here – we make it happen, with our customers, where we work and live. Together, we are building a better world, so we can all enjoy living in it.

Role Definition
Assesses the supplier quality and ensures that all the products are free from defects and are in compliance with manufacturing specifications and legal standards.

Responsibilities
• Ensuring the quality of supplies by conducting tests and assessments on incoming supplies to identify any quality issues; Developing supplier inspection, testing, and evaluation mechanism.
• Generating reports on supplier quality, by monitoring their defect rates and areas that can lead to potential flaws; Guiding suppliers to reduce these defect rates.
• Researching the potential vendors, assessing their manufacturing environment, practices, and procedures; Conducting supplier quality control audits to ensure compliance with organizational and federal policies and standards.
• Supporting suppliers in improving their performance through process enhancements, implementing process controls, and developing quality assurance plans.

Degree Requirement
Degree or equivalent experience desired

Skill Descriptors

Effective Communications: Understanding of effective communication concepts, tools and techniques; ability to effectively transmit, receive, and accurately interpret ideas, information, and needs through the application of appropriate communication behaviors.
Level Working Knowledge:
• Delivers helpful feedback that focuses on behaviors without offending the recipient.
• Listens to feedback without defensiveness and uses it for own communication effectiveness.
• Makes oral presentations and writes reports needed for own work.
• Avoids technical jargon when inappropriate.
• Looks for and considers non-verbal cues from individuals and groups.

Problem Solving: Knowledge of approaches, tools, techniques for recognizing, anticipating, and resolving organizational, operational or process problems; ability to apply knowledge of problem solving appropriately to diverse situations.
Level Working Knowledge:
• Identifies and documents specific problems and resolution alternatives.
• Examines a specific problem and understands the perspective of each involved stakeholder.
• Develops alternative techniques for assessing accuracy and relevance of information.
• Helps to analyze risks and benefits of alternative approaches and obtain decision on resolution.
• Uses fact-finding techniques and diagnostic tools to identify problems.

Process Improvement: Understanding and insight into evaluating current product quality and production methods and ability to maintains focus on the continuous improvement of processes, products and services.
Level Working Knowledge:
• Defines the critical workflow for executing key processes.
• Identifies process problems that limit performance.
• Implements methods for improving and establishing controls for critical processes.
• Focuses on the most significant problems to maximize efficiency gains.
• Surfaces systemic problems to be addressed at the organizational level.

Quality Orientation: Knowledge of quality management methods, tools, and techniques; ability to create and support an environment that meets the quality goals of the organization.
Level Working Knowledge:
• Confronts root causes of problems wherever they exist.
• Eliminates unnecessary work and all non value-added activities.
• Uses objective quality criteria and data to drive decisions.
• Documents learnings regarding quality outcomes so that the data can be used for improvement.
• Surfaces quality problems whose root causes fall outside the group's responsibility.

Production Part Approval Process (PPAP): Knowledge of Production Part Approval Processes (PPAP) elements, submissions, and objectives; ability to determine whether a supplier can manufacture products that meet the quality requirements and standards of their customers consistently.
Level Extensive Experience:
• Develops testing and validation procedures to test the quality of manufactured parts/products so that it meets desired customer standards.
• Identifies and resolves key issues with PPAP implementation and submissions.
• Monitors the execution of PPAP steps within a facility and ensures their compliance with industry standards and internal guidelines.
• Oversees PPAP implementation; establishes a high trust relationship between stakeholders.
• Reviews the complex documentation and elements required during the PPAP submission process.
• Trains others on the execution of PPAP to get the required approvals and teaches them about the different PPAP submission levels.

Manufacturing Standards, Procedures and Policies: Knowledge of organizational standards, procedures and policies in manufacturing activities; ability to plan, guide, and monitor manufacturing processes for compliance.
Level Working Knowledge:
• Contributes to the development and implementation of specific manufacturing procedures.
• Investigates the need to refer potential exceptions upward for review and approval.
• Explains the rationale for procedures and standards in own area of responsibility.
• Participates in the implementation of manufacturing standards and procedures to one's own function.
• Provides feedback for improvement of procedures.

Supplier Management - MFG: Knowledge of processes and methods to effectively manage business relationships and transactions with suppliers of raw materials or product components; ability to apply related knowledge, experience and skills into real practice.
Level Extensive Experience:
• Facilitates supplier partnering arrangements that share risk and reward.
• Monitors supplier performance; works to resolve discrepancies between performance and agreements.
• Develops quality standards and controls for suppliers.
• Builds and maintains partnerships with multiple and/or large suppliers.
• Evaluates issues and terminates supplier relationships as appropriate; works with legal departments.
• Ensures the fulfillment of report and record-keeping requirements.

Supplier Evaluations and Certification: Knowledge of supplier evaluations and certification; ability to identify the methods, tools and documentation for evaluating, selecting and certifying vendors, suppliers and partners.
Level Working Knowledge:
• Documents and pursues results of reference calls or other sources for a specific supplier.
• Participates in selecting and certifying a specific supplier and/or product.
• Assists with the steps and procedures for supplier certification.
• Researches several types of sources of information for a supplier's or a product's reputation.
• Assesses a product or service using pre-defined evaluation criteria.

title: Head of Labor Law and Employee Relations Sweden
description:
Head of Employee Relations and Labor Law

Are you ready to shape employee relations in one of Sweden’s most fast paced and critical business environments? Look no further – I have the perfect challenge for you!

What will help you thrive in this role:

  • A university degree in HR, labor law, or a related field.

title: iScala ERP Analyst

In this role, you will support iScala ERP users and help keep core business processes running smoothly through reliable functional support, troubleshooting, and continuous improvement.

Role Overview

The iScala ERP Analyst will provide day-to-day application support across iScala ERP and connected solutions, helping users resolve issues, maintain stable operations, and improve how the system supports business processes. This role is well suited for someone with 4-6 years of hands-on experience in ERP support or techno-functional analysis who enjoys solving problems, working with cross-functional teams, and supporting end users in a fast-paced environment.

Key Responsibilities

  • Provide functional support for iScala ERP users and resolve application issues, service requests, and support tickets.

  • Support troubleshooting and hyper care activities across iScala ERP and the Edge Apps ecosystem.

  • Work with business and technical teams to analyze issues, identify root causes, and coordinate fixes or workarounds.

  • Assist with functional deployment across Build, SIT, UAT, and end-user training activities.

  • Support localization, electronic invoicing, advanced functions, and statutory or regulatory compliance needs within the ERP environment.

  • Develop and maintain reports, interfaces, and workflow integrations using relevant Epicor and database technologies.

  • Document solutions, user guidance, and support outcomes to improve system understanding and future issue resolution.

  • Contribute to upgrades, testing, and process improvements that strengthen overall ERP performance.

How You Will Do It

description:
Position Purpose

The Learning & Development Partner (ASIA) SJ Global Academy plays a pivotal role in shaping and delivering impactful learning experiences across ASIA for the SJ Group. The position blends creativity with strategic thinking to support Regional development as well as contribute to Global learning initiatives. The incumbent will lead instructional design, e-learning development, program facilitation and Learning Management System (LMS) operations, while driving key programs such as Graduate Development, induction and compliance training.

The Learning & Development Partner will deliver the ASIA programmes including Leadership, Management, Mentorship, Soft Skills, Sponsorship and Culture Programs, as well as orientation and induction training for our people.

Strong collaboration with the broader SJ Global Academy team, People & Culture team and Business Leadership teams is expected to build and implement practical learning solutions in line with business strategy. High energy and adaptability is also expected to deliver impactful and dynamic workshops and development sessions tailored to diverse audiences.

The incumbent will role model the SJ Group values, ethics and code of conduct and ensure all business activities are carried out in accordance with these guiding principles.

Key Accountabilities

Manage instructional design and e-learning development to create impactful learning and experiences that align to the needs of learners, under the direction of global academy priorities. Deliver and facilitate learning and development programs and workshops both in-person and virtual, ensuring effective transfer of knowledge in line with learning objectives. Oversee the delivery of induction and compliance training to ensure all employees meet regulatory and organizational requirements; Build and maintain strong, collaborative relationships with both internal and external stakeholders to support learning and development initiatives. Manage the Learning Management System (LMS) for the Region, including overseeing reporting and analytics to demonstrate learning impact and support data-driven decision-making.

Ideal Person Specification

Formal Qualifications

  • Tertiary qualifications in HR, Learning & Organisational Development, Psychology, or related field required;

  • Certificate IV in Training & Assessment ideal;

  • Additional qualifications or certifications in learning design, learning facilitation, business and performance coaching (or similar) desirable.

Experience

Has a minimum of four years’ experience ideally in a Learning and/or Organisational Development role. Has the demonstrated ability to consistently:

  • Display proven experience in instructional design and e-learning, preferably in technical or consulting environments;

  • Deliver development programs, induction and compliance training;

  • Display hands-on LMS management experience (e.g., Docebo, Workday Learning).

  • Demonstrate ability to manage multiple projects;

  • Demonstrate facilitation experience across a range of learning interventions and audiences;

  • Lead initiatives through the entire learning cycle;

  • Show proficiency in creating quality learning materials;

  • Ability to produce quality outcomes with competing demands and tight deadlines;

  • Coordinate and manage logistics of programs;

  • Create training materials, graphics and presentations.

Skills / Knowledge

  • Proficiency in learning technologies (e.g., Articulate360 Rise, ElevenLabs, Adobe Captivate, Vyond);

  • Proficiency in using AI-first Learning Management Systems (LMS) i.e. Docebo;

  • Strong analytical and data-driven decision-making skills;

  • Strong facilitation skills and learner engagement capability;

  • Excellent interpersonal and communication skills with stakeholder engagement ability;

  • Ability to effectively collaborate with global teams;

  • Strong working knowledge of L&D techniques and strategies;

  • Design, development and implementation Learning and Culture programs;

  • Strong facilitation skills in the context of organisational learning programs;

  • Excellent project management skills;

  • Expert knowledge of L&D best practice;

  • Consulting, negotiation and facilitation skills in the context of resolving L&D related issues;

  • Support and develop team knowledge and skills;

Personal Drivers

Values

  • Integrity

  • People

  • Professionalism

  • Partnership

  • Purpose

At Surbana Jurong, we put talent, hard work, teamwork and a fun workplace together to approach problems and solve them creatively and collaboratively. Join us in making a positive impact on the world!
