title: Aftermarket Operations Manager – Africa – Mobile Crushing and Screening
description:
At Sandvik Rock Processing Solutions (“SRP”), we are passionate about development and advanced technology, and we always aim to offer the best possible experience for our customers in a sustainable way. It is a mission that takes commitment, but as an industry leader we aim for nothing but excellence in everything we do.

The Role

Responsible for leading and growing the Aftermarket organization in Sales Area Africa for Mobile Crushing & Screening, aligning the Africa aftermarket strategy with the Division / Business Line strategy and executing territory-specific action plans and initiatives. Manage and grow aftermarket sales for parts, wear and spares, maintenance services, service solutions, warranty / guarantee support, product upgrades and lifecycle offerings across direct customers and distributors, ensuring customer needs are understood and matched with Sandvik’s offering to maximize customer value, retention, satisfaction and profitable aftermarket growth.

Leads the Aftermarket organization and support territory teams across Africa to deliver agreed budgets, forecasts, lifecycle strategies, capture-rate improvement, installed-base development, commercial discipline and high standards of product, technical and customer service support.

Key Performance Areas

Sales strategy, revenue growth and lifecycle execution

  • Develop and implement the Africa Sales Area aftermarket plan based on Division / Business Line aftermarket strategy, with clear territory action plans for growth, retention and customer engagement.
  • Drive profitable aftermarket growth across spare parts, wear parts, maintenance services, repair solutions, warranty extensions, product upgrades and lifecycle services.
  • Set, monitor and deliver aftermarket sales targets, KPIs, budgets and forecasts, including order intake, revenue, margin, capture rate, customer retention, NPS and revenue per installed machine.
  • Coordinate lifecycle strategies in the territories, report on activities and improvements, and ensure all responsible stakeholders execute agreed actions.

Customer and distributor relationship management

  • Build and maintain strong relationships with key mining customers, distributors and internal stakeholders to secure repeat business, retention and high customer satisfaction.
  • Provide consultative selling by understanding customer / distributor needs and recommending aftermarket solutions that improve equipment performance, reliability and lifecycle value.
  • Address and resolve customer complaints or issues related to aftermarket products and services promptly and professionally, coordinating escalation where required.

Commercial offerings, pricing and contract management

  • Promote aftermarket agreements and the full commercial offering to secure aftermarket business and improve coverage across the installed base.
  • Lead or support pricing negotiations, service and supply contracts, warranty / guarantee agreements and extended service offerings, ensuring alignment with company policies, profitability goals and market conditions.
  • Participate in the establishment of the commercial strategy, including 3–5-year plans, BAPs and ABPs, and follow up on actions required to meet strategic objectives.

Sales operations, forecasting and performance management

  • Oversee sales forecasts, budgets and sales plans for the aftermarket segment, translating annual targets into quarterly, monthly and weekly sales activity priorities.
  • Monitor sales performance, pipeline, market share, margins and aftermarket KPIs, and provide data-driven recommendations to improve performance.
  • Ensure adherence to relevant aftermarket sales processes and standard operating procedures, including quoting, order processing, customer service and follow-up discipline.

Installed base, digital tools and market intelligence

  • Ensure installed-base, fleet and market-share databases are accurate, properly developed and used to identify opportunities for growth, gap analysis, consumption modelling and competitor equipment replacement.
  • Promote the use of available tools, including digital tools, to improve customer service, track the active fleet and monitor the status of digitized equipment.
  • Conduct regular market analysis to track industry trends, competitor activity, pricing, customer needs, regulations, technology developments and new product / service opportunities.

Product introduction, technical support and service capability

  • Promote and follow the introduction of new products and ensure aftermarket capture-rate plans are in place for any new installed base.
  • Create and maintain an organization that provides high-quality technical assistance on products and applications to Divisions, territories and customers.
  • Develop a competency roadmap for lifecycle support and increase service team capability through certifications, training, webinars and knowledge-sharing initiatives across the region.
  • Gather and manage cross-functional teams to perform root cause analysis for failures at strategic customers, collect troubleshooting information and refer it to the factory support line where required.
  • Consolidate and communicate technical and safety bulletins and monitor correct application of new technical and safety measures.

Resources, repair strategy, supply chain and customer support

  • Establish and maintain an organization capable of supporting strategic and financial objectives, ensuring aftermarket resources are appropriate for Africa region requirements.
  • Work with Territory Managers and Territory Service Managers to build business cases for additional resources, investments, partners or facilities required to support growth.
  • Promote the repair strategy to enhance and grow the aftermarket business, including necessary partners or facilities to support repair execution.
  • Work with logistics and inventory management functions to ensure optimal supply chain setup, inventory availability, timely customer order fulfilment and improved availability through forecasting and planning.
  • Ensure optimal setup and management of customer service / support (CSC) and technical sales support to optimize customer experience.

Leadership, governance and broader support

  • Lead, support and coordinate sales, product support, field service, sales support and training resources to deliver aftermarket commitments across Africa.
  • Collaborate with Territory Managers, Territory Service Managers, Sales Managers, Commercial Operations Support, Procurement, Logistics, Product Managers, Training and Backline teams to execute strategy.
  • Support additional aftermarket growth opportunities within the reasonable scope of the role, including cross-division opportunities where relevant.

EHS Responsibilities

  • Deliver the necessary resources for the effective control of EHS risks.
  • Promote the EHS Policy and Company Values with a focus on EHS.
  • Develop the EHS activities and actions associated with its annual commitment.
  • Deliver the necessary resources for the effective control of EHS risks.
  • Ensure compliance and execution of audits in safety, health and environment.
  • Ensure compliance and application of the EHS Plan, strategies in safety, health and environment.
  • Ensure the non-repetition of events through effective learning from incidents.
  • Verify at Ground Zero the understanding and application of rules and procedures and the role of leaders.
  • Ensure the implementation of corrective actions based on incidents or learning.
  • Promote and encourage continuous improvement, innovation and implementation of best practices.
  • Encourage the recognition of staff for achievements in safety, good practices.
  • 16.2 appointee under the Occupational Health & Safety Act 85 of 1993 Section 16(2)

Your Profile

Minimum Requirements

  • Degree in Industrial Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Metallurgical Engineering, or a closely related engineering discipline.
  • Minimum of 5 years’ experience in a similar managerial role, with exposure to mining or related industries (Mandatory requirement)
  • English proficiency
  • Willingness to travel into Africa
  • Valid passport

Competencies

  • Knowledge of vibrating and/or crushing equipment
  • Good understanding of mining site plants and process engineering
  • Sound judgement and problem-solving ability
  • Listening and logic interpretation
  • Strong customer orientation
  • Advanced communication skills
  • Demonstrated leadership & mentoring skills
  • Must be flexible and self-reliant, self-starter
  • Excellent time management
  • Sound commercial reasoning and contract management
  • Financial understanding and preparation of budgets & forecasts
  • Strong understanding and compliance with Health and Safety in the workplace
  • The ability to make sound decisions, execute plans & take initiative
  • Computer Literacy & MS Office proficiency

How to apply

Please apply online through Workday (ESS) or access the Sandvik website

Applications close: 28 August 2026

title: Collections Specialist
description:
Angle Finance is a leading non-bank asset finance company operating in the rapidly growing intermediary asset finance market. Our signature is Faster, Easier Finance, provided by consistent, predictable and reliable service propositions in everything we do.

Our people make us remarkable. So we’ve built a culture of empowerment, enabling our people to make decisions that drive our speed, our agility, and our ability to see things from different angles.

As a Collections Specialist at Angle Finance, you will manage an assigned portfolio of overdue accounts, helping reduce arrears, maximise recoveries and support fair customer outcomes.

This role suits someone who can balance empathy with accountability, communicate clearly, manage a busy portfolio and make sound decisions in a fast-paced collections environment.

  • Strong negotiation, communication and problem-solving skills.

  • Ability to assess customer circumstances, payment behaviour and account risk.

  • High attention to detail and accurate account documentation.

  • Ability to balance customer outcomes with commercial priorities.

  • A collaborative style and willingness to contribute to a high-performing team.

Experience in asset finance, commercial lending, hardship, mercantile recoveries or legal recoveries will be highly regarded.

title: Heat Response and Relief Program Manager
description:
Job Description Summary

Department - Health

Job Description

Job Type: Classified

Job Classification: 5373 - Public Health Program Manager I

Salary Grade: 14

Pay Range

Hiring Range: $65,457 - $78,540 Annually

Pay Range: $65,457 - $91,644 Annually

Range Explanation:

  • Hiring Range is an estimate of where you can receive an offer. The actual salary offer will carefully consider a wide range of factors, including your skills, qualifications, experience, education, licenses, training, and internal equity.

  • Pay Range is the entire compensation range for the position.

The Heat Response and Relief Program Manager plays a critical role in protecting community health by leading efforts that reduce heat-related illness and strengthen emergency response capacity. This position oversees program planning, coordination, and evaluation while building partnerships across government, community organizations, and coalitions to ensure effective and equitable service delivery. The Program Manager manages resources, collaborates with diverse teams, and integrates the perspectives of marginalized communities to support comprehensive, data‑informed public health strategies

Essential Functions:

As defined under the Americans with Disabilities Act, this classification may include any of the following tasks, knowledge, skills, and other characteristics. This list is ILLUSTRATIVE ONLY and is not a comprehensive listing of all functions and tasks performed by incumbents of this class. Work assignments may vary depending on the department’s need and will be communicated to the applicant or incumbent by the supervisor.

  • Develops, implements, and manages public health programs and initiatives in alignment with department goals and public health priorities;

  • Oversees execution of program activities and grant deliverables, including outreach, education, and service delivery;

  • Ensures programs are carried out efficiently and effectively, adhering to timelines and budgets;

  • Monitors program progress and makes adjustments as needed to achieve desired outcomes;

  • Collects, analyzes, and interprets program data to assess impact and effectiveness;

  • Uses data to inform program improvements, identify trends, and measure outcomes;

  • Prepares and presents program reports to internal stakeholders and senior leadership;

  • Builds and maintains relationships with community partners, local agencies, and stakeholders;

  • Develops and manages program budgets, including grant budgets, ensuring efficient allocations of resources and expenditures;

  • Supervises and mentors program staff, providing guidance, support, and professional development opportunities.


Minimum Qualifications:

Bachelor’s degree from an accredited college or university with a major in business administration, public administration, public health, healthcare administration or related field as determined by the department head at the time of recruitment, AND four years of related experience in the coordination and/or implementation of activities for public health programs, clinics and/or community-based initiatives.

(Relevant experience and/or education from an accredited college or university may be substituted.)

OR:

Three years of experience with Pima County as a Public Health Program Coordinator, or other related management or supervisor or coordinator level job classification.

Qualifying education and experience must be clearly documented in the "Education" and "Work Experience" sections of the application. Do not substitute a resume for your application or write "see resume" on your application.

Preferred Qualifications: (Be specific in describing your experience in your application. Ensure the descriptions provided illustrate your competencies, specifically addressing the required and preferred qualifications.):

  • Master’s degree in public health, climate health, global health, or related field.

  • Minimum two (2) years experience supervising staff, interns, or volunteers.

  • Minimum one (1) year experience in emergency preparedness, emergency management, or emergency response.

  • Minimum two (2) years experience managing a public health program or initiative.

  • Minimum two (2) years experience in partnership collaborations.

Selection Procedure:
Pima County Human Resources Department reserves the right to admit to the selection process only those candidates that meet the minimum qualifications. All applications will be assessed based on an evaluation of the listed education and experience. Candidates meeting the minimum qualifications may be further evaluated/scored against any advertised Preferred Qualifications. The hiring authority will interview and select the successful candidate from a referral list provided by Human Resources. Additional assessments/testing may be required as part of the selection process.

Supplemental Information:

Licenses and Certificates: Valid driver license is required at time of application. Valid AZ driver license is required at time of appointment. The successful applicant will be subject to a 39-month DOT Motor Vehicle Record review to determine applicant’s suitability to operate county vehicles in accordance with Pima County administrative procedures. Failure to obtain and maintain the required licenses and certifications shall be grounds for termination. Any offer of employment resulting from this recruitment is contingent upon Fleet Services’ review and approval of the candidate’s driving record.

Special Notice Items: The County requires pre-employment background checks. Successful candidates will receive a post-offer, pre-employment background screening to include verification of work history, education, and criminal conviction history. A prior criminal conviction will not automatically disqualify a candidate from employment with the County. This position will require a post-job offer physical and/or drug screen. This position will require post-job offer proof of immunization(s) or immunization(s) and/or a TB screening.

Physical/Sensory Requirements: Constantly operates a computer and other office equipment. Constantly observes details at close range. Frequently remains at stationary position. Occasionally moves about inside an office. Occasionally operates out in the community at events, meetings and developing partnerships. Action Activity - bending, climbing, kneeling, reaching, squatting and stooping; Motion Activity - grasping; Hearing Activity - in noisy areas, on radio, behind themselves, and alarms; Speaking Activity - in person, on the phone, on a radio, and on a cell; Vision - may be required to operate a motor vehicle, distinguish colors, have depth perception and peripheral vision. Frequently required to lift, push or pull objects weighing up to 50 pounds.

Working Conditions: The Public Health Program Manager I operates within a professional office setting, conducting desk-based tasks and attends meetings. Regular, daily attendance is an essential function for this position; however, an alternative work schedule or telecommuting may be options based on the Division’s needs. This is determined by the senior leadership for the Division. This role may also participate in community events and meetings.

EEO Information: Pima County Government is an Equal Employment Opportunity employer. We are committed to an inclusive and diverse workforce and will not discriminate in employment opportunities or practices on the basis of race, color, religion, national origin, age, disability, gender, sexual orientation, kinship, political interest, or any other characteristic protected by law.

Boots apotek Arendal søker en engasjert og kvalifisert sykepleier/helsefagarbeider til vårt dedikerte team.Vi er stolte av å være en del av Boots HomeCare, en avdeling i Boots apotek med spesialkompetanse innenfor legemidler , handelsvarer og medisinsk forbruksmateriell.

Dette innebærer å velge riktige produkter og forstå hvordan de skal brukes, samt gi informasjon om og utføre helsetjenester. På denne måten bidrar du med din kompetanse til bedre helse og økt livskvalitet for kundene!

Kvalifikasjoner

  • Vi søker etter en sykepleier/helsefagarbeider eller noen med annen relevant bakgrunn, ideelt sett med erfaring fra norske apotek, HSP, sykehus eller sykehjem.

  • Ditt engasjement driver deg til å stadig strekke deg etter det beste. Du ønsker alltid å levere den beste servicen til kundene dine ved å være kunnskapsrik, profesjonell og imøtekommende.
  • Gode mellommenneskelige ferdigheter er viktige i denne rollen da du vil jobbe tett sammen med kolleger og samhandle daglig med kunder. Evnen til å etablere gode relasjoner, være utadvendt og ha et positivt humør vil bidra til en trivelig arbeidsatmosfære.

  • Vi investerer også i din personlige og faglige videreutvikling gjennom opplæringsprogrammer eller interne kurs slik at du kan trives og lykkes i stillingen din hos oss.

Ved spørsmål om stillingen, kontakt med apoteker Marin Magdu på e-post: marin.magdu@boots.no

.

title: Conferral Assistant Registrar I
description:

#LI-Remote

title: Stagiair Adviseur Vermogen regio Utrecht
description:
Stagiair Adviseur Vermogen

Heeft beleggen jouw interesse? En sta je open voor een carrière binnen de financiële sector? Deze meewerkstage voor de periode vanaf februari 2027 betekent dat je onder begeleiding van een persoonlijke coach binnen Adviesteam Vermogen in- en outbound werkzaamheden verricht die een Adviseur Vermogen dagelijks doet. Afgestemd op jouw kennis en ervaring doorloop je, samen met maximaal drie andere stagiaires, een leertraject en ga je aan de slag met het (verder) ontwikkelen van jouw gespreksvaardigheden, sales skills en het behalen van de benodigde vakdiploma’s. Het doel is om je zelfstandig, op een ING locatie en digitaal (vanuit huis), te laten werken en dagelijks contact te laten hebben met particuliere- en zakelijke klanten over beleggen bij ING.

Leertraject fase 1:

  • Je start tegelijkertijd met maximaal vier stagiaires en komt te werken binnen het Digitaal Vermogen Team (DVT). Een groot team van adviseurs die het 1e aanspreekpunt zijn voor bestaande klanten in het ‘Guided model’ (belegd vermogen van € 50.000 tot € 500.000) én verantwoordelijk zijn voor de centrale leadgeneratie vanuit outbound-, inbound- en online activiteiten richting de commerciële teams van Adviesteam Vermogen en Private Banking.
  • Je gaat onder begeleiding van een persoonlijke coach vrijwel direct starten met klantcontact via outbound bellen om je gespreksvaardigheden ‘on the job’ te ontwikkelen en de Way of Working te leren. Indien nodig behaal je onder werktijd de benodigde vakdiploma’s waardoor je meer verschillende type klantcontacten mag afhandelen.

Leertraject fase 2:

  • Na het succesvol afronden van fase 1 ga je ‘echt’ aan het werk. De nadruk in deze fase ligt op het verder ontwikkelen van je (sales) vaardigheden en gaat het tempo van klantcontact omhoog via outbound- en inbound belwerkzaamheden.
  • Je krijgt targets en gaat deelnemen aan performance dialogen met de andere stagiaires met als doel om van elkaar te leren. Een persoonlijke coach blijft je gedurende deze periode begeleiden.
  • Je krijg presentaties van collega’s die jou gaan uitleggen wat zij doen en gaat op locatie meekijken. Hiermee krijg je een beter beeld van mogelijke banen binnen ING.

Wat vraagt deze stage van je?

Je wilt graag tijd investeren in het verder ontwikkelen van jouw gespreksvaardigheden en je ervaring in klantcontact. Beleggen heeft je interesse, je bent een goede gesprekspartner en wilt klanten graag helpen bij het maken van de juiste keuzes. Je bent sales gedreven, resultaat gericht, neemt initiatief en kunt goed omgaan met feedback. Verder:

  • Je studeert aan een Hbo-opleiding en spreekt vloeiend Nederlands.
  • Je hebt WFT Basis in je bezit of bent bereid deze te halen voordat je bij ons start. Het liefst heb je ook WFT Vermogen en/of MiFID Informeren of ben je bereid deze te halen. Alle opleidingskosten worden vergoed door ING.
  • Je bent flexibel inzetbaar en combineert thuiswerken met werken vanuit één van de hub locaties Den Haag, Eindhoven, Leeuwarden, Zaandam en Zwolle of vanuit een ING-huis bij jou in de buurt.

Wat bieden wij?

  • Een meewerkstage vanaf februari 2027 afgestemd op de eisen vanuit jouw opleiding.
  • Een persoonlijke coach en leren onder werktijd.
  • Een uitdagende en leerzame omgeving met veel inzichten over mogelijke werkzaamheden binnen ING.
  • Een marktconforme stagevergoeding van EURO 700,- (bruto) bij een 36-urige werkweek.

Jouw sollicitatie

Stuur je CV voorzien van een motivatie waarin je uitlegt wie je bent, waarom jij de juiste kandidaat bent voor dit leertraject en op welke wijze je affiniteit met beleggen en/of de financiële markten hebt? Wij maken graag kennis met je.

Heb je vragen? Stuur dan een mail naar Bart Janssen, Digitaal Vermogen Team: Bart.Janssen1@ing.com.

Job Purpose:

We are seeking an experienced and driven Enterprise Job Scheduling Platform Engineer to support the engineering, governance, and continuous improvement of Enterprise Job Scheduling Platform Services. The role is responsible for ensuring that enterprise scheduling platforms are reliable, resilient, secure, and operated in accordance with established technology and operational standards.

You will play a key role in managing scheduler infrastructure and configurations, strengthening platform governance, supporting workload onboarding and migration, and partnering with internal stakeholders to deliver consistent and effective scheduling services across the enterprise.

Job description

  • Manage enterprise scheduling platform engineering: Provide engineering ownership for enterprise scheduling platforms and their supporting components, including scheduler master servers, agents, database repositories, authentication and security integrations, high availability configurations, and related infrastructure.

  • Own platform lifecycle, availability and resiliency: Plan and execute platform installation, configuration, patching, upgrades, capacity management, high availability, disaster recovery, and lifecycle activities. Ensure scheduling services are designed and maintained to support operational resilience and critical business workloads.

  • Drive standardisation and operational excellence: Develop, implement, and maintain enterprise scheduling standards, procedures, and engineering practices within the organisation. Drive consistency across environments and improve platform reliability, supportability, and efficiency through automation, monitoring, and continuous improvement.

  • Support workload onboarding and platform transformation: Partner with application owners and production support teams to onboard, migrate, and integrate workloads onto enterprise scheduling platforms. Contribute to platform modernisation and migration initiatives while ensuring appropriate planning, validation, control, and service continuity.

  • Strengthen security, risk and regulatory compliance: Ensure scheduling platforms comply with internal policies, regulatory requirements, security standards, and audit expectations. Identify platform risks and vulnerabilities, coordinate remediation activities, and support risk acceptance processes where remediation cannot be completed within the required timeline.

  • Govern processes and change implementation: Maintain standard operating procedures and process controls for enterprise scheduling services. Work closely with Change Management and Infrastructure teams to ensure platform changes are assessed, approved, implemented, validated, and documented in a controlled manner.

  • Provide technical support and stakeholder engagement: Provide technical guidance and support for complex scheduling, infrastructure, configuration, and integration issues. Work effectively with application owners, production support teams, Change Management, Infrastructure, and senior management stakeholders to resolve issues and deliver service improvements.

Qualification Requirement

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.

  • Minimum 5 years of experience in enterprise job scheduling, workload automation, platform engineering, or related infrastructure services within a large-scale enterprise environment.

  • Experience supporting mission-critical production services and platforms with high availability, resiliency, security, and regulatory requirements.

  • Experience in one or more enterprise workload automation or job scheduling platforms is advantageous (e.g., Control-M, HCL Workload Automation, Automic Automation, or equivalent).

Working experience/ Skills

  • Strong technical knowledge of enterprise job scheduling and workload automation platforms, including scheduler master servers, agents, database repositories, authentication integrations, and high availability architectures.

  • Hands-on experience in platform installation, configuration, patching, upgrades, capacity planning, disaster recovery, lifecycle management, and troubleshooting.

  • Good working knowledge of Windows and Linux operating systems, databases, networking, security controls, certificates, and automation or scripting technologies.

  • Experience in workload onboarding, scheduling design, application integration, platform migration, and production implementation activities.

  • Experience supporting regulatory compliance, audit requirements, process governance, platform risk management, vulnerability remediation, and risk acceptance activities.

  • Proven ability to establish and maintain technical standards, operating procedures, controls, metrics, and continuous improvement initiatives for enterprise services.

  • Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills with the ability to manage complex platform incidents, perform root cause analysis, and implement preventive measures.

  • Ability to balance technical engineering responsibilities with service management, governance, planning, and stakeholder coordination.

  • Ability to cope with reasonably high levels of operational demand and demonstrate resiliency, initiative, accountability, and professional integrity.

  • Team player with excellent consultative and communication skills, and the proven ability to work effectively with application owners, production support teams, Change Management, Infrastructure, vendors, and senior management stakeholders.

Side note:

This role requires 100% work in office, based at Tampines Centre 1

description:

Job Purpose

The IT Knowledge Analyst is responsible for managing and maintaining the Known Error Database (KEDB) to enable rapid incident resolution and organizational learning. This role ensures that known errors are accurately documented, searchable, and integrated into operational workflows. The IT Knowledge Analyst also monitors KEDB effectiveness and drives improvements in usability and governance.

Key Responsibilities

Known Error Database (KEDB) Management

  • Own day-to-day maintenance of KEDB entries, ensuring completeness and accuracy of symptoms, impacted services, root causes, workarounds, and permanent fix status.

  • Validate and update entries based on RCA outputs and remediation progress.

  • Ensure KEDB is integrated with Incident Management workflows for quick search and application by Service Desk and Technology Command Centre.

  • Monitor KEDB effectiveness (search success rate, usage metrics) and recommend enhancements to improve adoption and impact.

Governance & Standards

  • Enforce standards for KEDB taxonomy, templates, metadata, and version control.

  • Conduct periodic reviews to ensure entries remain current and actionable.

  • Support audits and compliance checks related to knowledge governance.

Collaboration & Communication

  • Work closely with Problem Analyst and Problem Manager to ensure timely updates and alignment with RCA outputs.

  • Provide guidance to Service Desk and technical teams on KEDB usage and best practices.

Analytics & Continuous Improvement

  • Track and report KEDB performance metrics; identify gaps and propose improvements.

  • Contribute to initiatives that enhance knowledge accessibility and usability across the Group.

  • Bachelor’s degree in IT or related field.

  • At least 5yrs in IT Service Management or operations; experience with knowledge or database management preferred.

  • Familiarity with ITIL practices (Incident, Problem, Change, Knowledge); ITIL v4 certification is an advantage.

  • Strong attention to detail, documentation skills, and ability to enforce governance standards.

  • Good communication and collaboration skills.

Side note: This role requires 100% work in office and is based at Loyang

description:

Job Description:

Your Work Shapes the World at Caterpillar Inc.

When you join Caterpillar, you're joining a global team who cares not just about the work we do – but also about each other. We are the makers, problem solvers, and future world builders who are creating stronger, more sustainable communities. We don't just talk about progress and innovation here – we make it happen, with our customers, where we work and live. Together, we are building a better world, so we can all enjoy living in it.

Job Title: Supplier Development Engineer

Salary starting from £57,737 (depending on level of experience)

Location: Peterborough, Stafford or Peterlee

Benefits:

  • 25 days annual leave,

  • Up to 12% Bonus

  • Contributory pension scheme - Caterpillar will double the employee's contribution Up to 10%

  • Contributory share scheme - Caterpillar will match 50% of the employee's contribution.

  • Optional flexible benefits including access to health and dental care plans, EV car lease, holiday purchase.

The Opportunity

We are seeking an experienced Supplier Development Engineer to join our team, to provide on-site assistance & leadership to Caterpillar’s supply base in the execution of Advanced Product Quality Planning (APQP), the implementation of process control and the deployment of a continuous quality improvement processes. You will ensure that suppliers can meet corporate and business unit requirements for certification and quality of purchased material.

What You Will Do

Working with suppliers to ensure that robust process controls are in place to prevent nonconformities, to continuously monitor supplier’s key manufacturing processes and quality management system for improvement opportunities and to assist suppliers with Advanced Product Quality Planning (APQP) activities to ensure production readiness for New Product Introduction (NPI).

The SDE is responsible for the supplier’s processes from design concept to the end of product life (cradle to grave), including the following activities:

  • Assess and develop supplier quality management systems, process capability, and manufacturing readiness, including people, training, tooling, and equipment.

  • Lead supplier quality activities for new product introduction, ensuring APQP and PPAP requirements are completed and approved.

  • Review and approve quality documentation, including PFMEAs, Control Plans, MSA/Gage R&R, and corrective action plans.

  • Conduct supplier audits, capability assessments, and evaluations to verify compliance, process control, and quality standards.

  • Manage supplier process changes and ensure timely implementation of Process Change Notifications (PCNs).

  • Support suppliers in resolving quality issues through robust root cause analysis, corrective actions, and continuous improvement initiatives.

  • Drive supplier performance improvements through quality metrics, performance reviews, and targeted development plans.

  • Partner with suppliers to implement Lean principles and build sustainable quality excellence across the supply base.

  • Provide technical support during product launches and manufacturing start-up activities.

What You Will Have

Effective Communications: Understanding of effective communication concepts, tools and techniques; ability to effectively transmit, receive, and accurately interpret ideas, information, and needs through the application of appropriate communication behaviors.
Level Working Knowledge:

Problem Solving: Knowledge of approaches, tools, techniques for recognizing, anticipating, and resolving organizational, operational or process problems; ability to apply knowledge of problem solving appropriately to diverse situations.
Level Extensive Experience:

  • Experience of applying 8D process or other structured problem-solving techniques in a manufacturing environment

Process Improvement: Understanding and insight into evaluating current product quality and production methods and ability to maintains focus on the continuous improvement of processes, products and services.
Level Extensive Experience:

Quality Orientation: Knowledge of quality management methods, tools, and techniques; ability to create and support an environment that meets the quality goals of the organization.
Level Extensive Experience:

  • Experience driving quality standards and process compliance across engineering supplier networks to ensure consistent delivery and performance.

Production Part Approval Process (PPAP): Knowledge of Production Part Approval Processes (PPAP) elements, submissions, and objectives; ability to determine whether a supplier can manufacture products that meet the quality requirements and standards of their customers consistently.
Level Extensive Experience:

  • Sound knowledge and demonstrated experience of APQP, including the PPAP process, FMEA’s, control plans, process flow, GR&R, and capability studies.


Manufacturing Standards, Procedures and Policies: Knowledge of organizational standards, procedures and policies in manufacturing activities; ability to plan, guide, and monitor manufacturing processes for compliance.
Level Extensive Experience:

  • Ability to read engineering drawings

Supplier Manufacturing Management: Knowledge of processes and methods to effectively manage business relationships and transactions with suppliers of raw materials or product components; ability to apply related knowledge, experience and skills into real practice.
Level Extensive Experience:

Supplier Evaluations and Certification: Knowledge of supplier evaluations and certification; ability to identify the methods, tools and documentation for evaluating, selecting and certifying vendors, suppliers and partners.
Level Extensive Experience:

Top Candidates will demonstrate

  • Experience working with suppliers.

  • Project management experience.

  • Material metallurgical experience

  • Experience of working with high volume electronic manufactures

  • Measurement techniques

Additional information

  • When not travelling to supplier facilities, you will be based in the office full time.

  • This role can be based from Peterborough, Stafford or Peterlee

About Caterpillar

Caterpillar Inc. is the world’s leading manufacturer of construction and mining equipment, off-highway diesel and natural gas engines, industrial gas turbines and diesel-electric locomotives. For over 100 years, we’ve been helping customers build a better, more sustainable world and are committed and contributing to a reduced-carbon future. Our innovative products and services, backed by our global dealer network, provide exceptional value that helps customers succeed.

title: Technical Product Manager
description:
Job Description:

About Rakuten TV

Rakuten TV is one of Europe's leading video streaming platforms, offering premium transactional (TVOD) and advertising-based (AVOD/FAST) content to millions of users across more than 40 countries. Backed by Rakuten Group — one of the world's largest internet services companies — we operate a cutting-edge B2B2C model, partnering with leading device manufacturers, broadcasters, and advertising networks to deliver premium entertainment experiences.

Headquartered in Barcelona, our international team combines deep expertise in technology, content, sales, and finance to drive continued growth across EMEA. We are a data-driven, fast-paced organization that values intellectual curiosity, ownership, and collaboration.

Role Overview
We are looking for a Product Manager to lead the evolution of our web and Connected TV (CTV) applications. The role will act as the bridge between design, engineering, and business teams, ensuring our frontend experience is both intuitive and performant. The role owns the product roadmap, translates requirements into clear documentation, and leverages AI tools to optimize the daily product management tasks.

  • Communication: Strong stakeholder management skills; you can effectively translate business goals into technical requirements.

  • Autonomy: A self-starter who thrives in a fast-paced environment.

  • AI Usage: Proven comfort using AI tools to increase efficiency in product management tasks.

Base salary range for this role: 45.000 - 55.000 euros gross /year.

Rakuten Shugi Principles

title: Senior Applications Engineer – Cryogenic Test & Measurement
description:
Forming Our Future together

FormFactor, Inc. (NASDAQ: FORM), is a leading provider of essential test and measurement technologies along the full semiconductor product life cycle — from characterization, modeling, reliability, and design de-bug, to qualification and production test. Semiconductor companies rely upon FormFactor’s products and services to accelerate profitability by optimizing device performance and advancing yield knowledge. The company serves customers through its network of facilities in Asia, Europe, and North America.

Rooted in our core values — Focus on the Customer, Ownership & Accountability, Respectfully & Effectively Communicate, and Motivate & Develop People — we foster an environment where diverse perspectives are not only welcomed but celebrated. Everyone can make an impact here. Whether it's improving products, supporting customers, or positively influencing peers and the community, the contributions of our people matter.

Shift:

The regular hours for this position are day shift.

Job Description:

We are seeking a highly motivated Senior Applications Engineer- Cryogenic Test & Measurement to support customers using advanced cryogenic wafer probing systems for semiconductor, quantum computing, superconducting electronics, and other low-temperature device applications.

The successful candidate will serve as the technical bridge between customers and engineering teams, helping customers install, configure, and optimize custom measurement solutions while operating state-of-the-art cryogenic wafer probers. This role requires a strong background in RF and low-noise electrical measurements, semiconductor device characterization, and customer-facing technical support.

The ideal candidate combines hands-on laboratory expertise with excellent communication skills and a passion for helping customers achieve successful technical outcomes.

Key Responsibilities:

Customer Application Support

  • Work directly with customers to understand measurement objectives and technical requirements.

  • Develop and deploy customized measurement solutions using cryogenic wafer probing platforms.

  • Provide on-site and remote support during system installation, startup, acceptance testing, and training.

  • Troubleshoot customer test systems and measurement challenges.

  • Serve as the primary technical interface between customers and internal engineering teams.

Test & Measurement Engineering

  • Configure, operate, and maintain cryogenic wafer probing systems and associated instrumentation.

  • Develop and execute measurement plans for semiconductor and superconducting devices.

  • Perform RF, microwave, DC, low-current, and low-noise electrical characterization.

  • Integrate test equipment including Vector Network Analyzers (VNAs), Spectrum Analyzers, Signal Generators, Source Measure Units (SMUs), Lock-in Amplifiers, Low-Noise Amplifiers, and Cryogenic instrumentation and temperature controllers.

  • Analyze measurement results and provide recommendations to customers and engineering teams.

Product Improvement & Development

  • Collaborate with product development teams on new applications, features, and customer requirements.

  • Generate application notes, technical reports, training materials, and best-practice guides.

  • Evaluate emerging measurement techniques and industry trends.

  • Provide feedback from customer engagements to influence future product development.

Demonstrations & Training

  • Conduct customer demonstrations and proof-of-concept testing.

  • Support sales with technical experience

  • Travel to customer sites to perform application support

  • Provide training on tool usage, measurement methodologies, instrumentation, and software workflows.

  • Represent the company at conferences, technical workshops, and customer technology reviews.

Preferred Qualifications & Experiences:

  • Bachelor's degree in electrical engineering, Physics, Applied Physics, or related technical field.

  • 5+ years of experience in semiconductor test, RF measurement, cryogenic systems, or related instrumentation.

  • Strong understanding of semiconductor device physics and electrical characterization techniques.

  • Experience with RF and microwave measurements through at least 18 GHz.

  • Experience performing sensitive low-noise and low-current measurements.

  • Hands-on experience with automated test systems and data acquisition.

  • Strong troubleshooting and analytical skills.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

  • Experience operating cryogenic systems below 4 K.

  • Experience with superconducting devices, quantum computing hardware, or cryogenic CMOS technologies.

  • Familiarity with wafer probing systems and probe card technologies.

  • Knowledge of S-parameter measurements, Noise characterization, Time-domain measurements, Device reliability testing, and Cryogenic RF techniques.

  • Experience developing automated measurement software using Python, LabVIEW, MATLAB, or similar tools.

  • Customer-facing experience in applications engineering, field engineering, or technical consulting.

Travel Requirements:

  • Approximately 25% travel, including domestic and international customer installations, training, and support engagements.

Skills:

Cryogenic Systems, Customer Technical Support, Device Characterization, Electrical Characterization, Electrical Measurements, RF Instrumentation

Education & Experience:

Minimum of 8 years of related experience with a Bachelor’s degree; or 6 years and a Master’s degree; or a PhD with 3 years experience; or equivalent experience | Required

Pay Range:

$115,800.00 - $151,935.00

Pay Range Explained:

This role in Boulder, Colorado pays between $115,800.00 and $151,935.00 per year, depending on your experience, skills, and background. Pay may vary in other locations. We offer a full benefits package, including medical, dental, vision, life insurance, disability coverage, a 401(k) with company match, employee stock purchase plan (ESPP), and paid time off. You’ll also be eligible for quarterly profit-sharing bonuses and flexible spending or savings accounts.

Job Category

Job Details

About Salesforce

Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.

Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.

We’re Salesforce, the Customer Company, inspiring the future of business with AI+ Data +CRM. Leading with our core values, we help companies across every industry blaze new trails and connect with customers in a whole new way. And, we empower you to be a Trailblazer, too — driving your performance and career growth, charting new paths, and improving the state of the world. As an Account Solution Engineer (also known as a "Presales Consultant" or "Sales Engineer"), you are the visionary who transforms customer experiences. You aren’t just a technical expert; you are a strategic partner to Sales, owning the solutioning throughout the entire sales cycle.   • The "Bottom Line" Mentality: You understand that technology is only as good as the business outcome it creates. You are excited by the challenge of connecting high-level business strategy to technical execution.

Strategic Sales Partner: You thrive on the "win." You act as a co-pilot to the sales team, bringing a strategic lens to every deal to ensure we aren't just selling software, but building a long-term partnership.


The Ideal Profile: Passion & Mindset

Demonstrated Passion for Technology & AI

  • The "First to Know": You are a true technophile. You don't just wait for training; you are already experimenting with the latest in Generative AI, LLMs, and Agentic workflows.

  • AI Visionary: You have a clear passion for how AI is transforming the workforce. You are eager to show customers how Agentforce and autonomous agents can augment human productivity.

  • SaaS & Cloud Fluency: Deep familiarity with the SaaS (Software as a Service) landscape, including an understanding of subscription-based business models and cloud architecture.

Required Skills & Qualifications

The Foundations

  • Strategic Partnering: Experience acting as a strategic partner to sales or business units, helping to steer the direction of a deal or project.

  • Demonstrated Passion: A visible passion for Technology, Business, and AI. You are curious about the latest trends and eager to learn how they apply to customer success.

  • Problem-Solving: Exceptional ability to find creative, pragmatic solutions to unique and complex business challenges.

Experience & Adaptability

Unleash Your Potential

When you join Salesforce, you’ll be limitless in all areas of your life. Our benefits and resources support you to find balance and be your best, and our AI agents accelerate your impact so you can do your best. title: Solution Architect
description:
We are looking for a hands-on Solution Architect who both builds and designs. In this role you will spend a significant portion of your time as a working engineer — writing code, shipping features, and solving problems directly alongside the team — while also owning the technical direction of core product platforms: designing and reviewing solutions end-to-end, guarding the health and longevity of our technology stack, and acting as the technical bridge between engineering, QA, DevOps, and the business. You will also lead our adoption of AI-assisted development and AI-powered product capabilities, helping the organization move fast without compromising reliability, security, or maintainability.

This is a senior individual-contributor role with strong architectural authority — you won't manage people, but you will set technical direction, review designs, and be accountable for the platform's technical roadmap, all while remaining an active contributor in the codebase.

Role Evolution: This role is intentionally weighted toward hands-on engineering delivery early on, with architectural responsibilities growing over time. As you establish credibility, build platform knowledge, and demonstrate architectural judgment, the balance is expected to shift — increasing time on design, roadmap, and cross-team architecture leadership, and decreasing time on direct feature delivery. The exact balance will be discussed and adjusted with your manager as you grow in the role.

What You'll Do

Hands-on Engineering & Delivery

  • Actively design, build, and ship production code as part of the engineering team — this is not a design-only or review-only role.
  • Take ownership of complex features or technical initiatives end-to-end, from design through implementation, testing, and deployment.
  • Lead by example on code quality, testing discipline, and engineering best practices through your own delivery work.
  • Stay close enough to the codebase to make architecture decisions that are grounded in real implementation constraints, not just theory.
  • Balance delivery work with architectural responsibilities, with the expectation that this balance shifts toward architecture as you grow in the role (see Role Evolution above).

Architecture & Design

  • Own end-to-end solution architecture for web/cloud applications, including system design, integration patterns, data flow, and non-functional requirements (performance, security, scalability, availability).
  • Review technical designs and pull requests from a design-integrity standpoint; provide constructive, actionable feedback to engineering teams.
  • Produce and maintain architecture diagrams, decision records (ADRs), and technical documentation that keep the system understandable as it grows.
  • Define and enforce coding, integration, and API standards across services.

Technology Stack & Lifecycle Management

  • Maintain a living inventory of the platform's tech stack (languages, frameworks, libraries, databases, middleware, cloud services) and their support/EOL timelines.
  • Proactively plan and lead upgrades for components approaching end-of-support or end-of-life, minimizing disruption and technical debt.
  • Evaluate new tools, frameworks, and platform services; make build-vs-buy and adopt-vs-avoid recommendations backed by clear trade-off analysis.
  • Define and drive a rolling technical roadmap (6–18 months) covering modernization, deprecation, and risk reduction.

Cloud & Infrastructure

  • Architect and guide the use of AWS services (compute, storage, networking, managed databases, messaging/queueing, identity/IAM) with a focus on cost efficiency, security, and resilience.
  • Own CI/CD design and standards using GitHub Actions, partnering with DevOps on pipeline structure, environment promotion, secrets management, and deployment automation.
  • Partner with DevOps on infrastructure-as-code practices, observability (CloudWatch, Datadog, or equivalent), and environment strategy.
  • Ensure architecture decisions account for compliance and data-security requirements relevant to the industry (e.g., healthcare data handling, access controls, audit trails) within the AWS environment.

Performance & Optimization

  • Identify performance bottlenecks (application, database, network) and drive remediation plans — including direct implementation of fixes where appropriate.
  • Establish and monitor architectural quality metrics (latency, error rates, scalability limits, technical debt indicators).
  • Champion refactoring and modernization efforts that reduce complexity and operating cost over time.

Cross-Team Collaboration

  • Act as the technical liaison between engineering, QA, DevOps, product/business stakeholders, and leadership — translating business requirements into technical solutions and vice versa.
  • Facilitate design and architecture review sessions; align stakeholders on trade-offs, timelines, and risk.
  • Support QA in defining testability and non-functional test strategy for new architecture (performance, security, resilience testing).
  • Mentor engineers on architectural thinking, design patterns, and best practices — reinforced through pairing and shared delivery work.

AI Adoption & Innovation

  • Lead the evaluation and rollout of AI-assisted development tools (e.g., AI coding assistants, automated code review/testing tools) across engineering teams.
  • Identify and prioritize opportunities to embed AI/ML capabilities into the product where they add genuine user or business value.
  • Define guardrails for responsible AI use — data privacy, model reliability, human oversight — in collaboration with security/compliance stakeholders.
  • Stay current on the AI tooling landscape and bring pragmatic, ROI-driven recommendations rather than hype-driven adoption.
What We're Looking For

Required

  • 5–10 years of experience in software engineering, with recent, active hands-on coding experience — this role requires you to remain a practicing engineer, not just an architect who reviews from a distance.
  • At least 2–3 years operating in a Solution Architect, Technical Lead, or equivalent architectural capacity, ideally in a role that combined delivery and design responsibilities.
  • Proven experience designing and delivering production-grade applications on AWS — hands-on with core services such as EC2/ECS/Lambda (compute), S3 (storage), RDS/Aurora (relational data), IAM (identity/access), VPC/networking, and CloudWatch (observability). [Confirm exact AWS services in use once stack details are available.]
  • Strong grasp of modern application architecture patterns: microservices/modular monoliths, event-driven design, REST/GraphQL APIs, caching strategies, and database design (relational and/or NoSQL).
  • Track record of planning and executing technology upgrades or migrations (framework version upgrades, EOL software replacement, AWS service migrations) with minimal business disruption.
  • Hands-on experience with GitHub Actions for CI/CD — building and maintaining build, test, and deployment workflows, managing secrets/environments, and integrating automated quality gates.
  • Experience working directly with DevOps on infrastructure-as-code (e.g., Terraform or AWS CloudFormation/CDK) and monitoring/observability tooling (e.g., Datadog).
  • Comfortable both writing and reviewing code across multiple languages/frameworks.
  • Strong communication skills; able to explain technical trade-offs to non-technical stakeholders and align cross-functional teams.
  • Practical experience integrating or piloting AI-assisted development tools or AI-driven features in a production environment.

Nice to Have

  • Experience in healthcare, life sciences, or another regulated industry (HIPAA, HITRUST, SOC 2, or similar compliance frameworks).
  • Familiarity with security architecture principles (identity/access management, encryption, secure API design).
  • Experience with performance/load testing tools and capacity planning.
  • Certifications in cloud architecture (e.g., AWS Certified Solutions Architect, Azure Solutions Architect Expert).
  • Prior experience mentoring engineers or leading a Center of Excellence / architecture guild.
Success Looks Like
  • Consistent delivery of shipped features/technical initiatives alongside architectural output — this role is measured on both.
  • A documented, current technology roadmap with clear ownership of upgrade and deprecation timelines.
  • Design review process that consistently catches architectural risk before it reaches production.
  • Measurable improvements in system performance, scalability, observability etc.
  • At least one AI-adoption initiative (tooling or product feature) piloted and scaled based on demonstrated value.
  • Strong working relationships across dev, QA, DevOps, and business stakeholders, reflected in smoother cross-team delivery.
  • Over time, a visible shift from primarily hands-on delivery toward architecture and technical leadership, tracked as part of career growth conversations.

title: Budget & Programming Associate SC-6
description:
DEADLINE FOR APPLICATIONS

30 August 2026-23:59-GMT+02:00 Eastern European Time (Kyiv)

WFP celebrates and embraces diversity. It is committed to the principle of equal employment opportunity for all its employees and encourages qualified candidates to apply irrespective of race, colour, national origin, ethnic or social background, genetic information, gender, gender identity and/or expression, sexual orientation, religion or belief, HIV status or disability.


ABOUT WFP

The World Food Programme is the world’s largest humanitarian organization saving lives in emergencies and using food assistance to build a pathway to peace, stability and prosperity, for people recovering from conflict, disasters and the impact of climate change.


At WFP, people are at the heart of everything we do and the vision of the future WFP workforce is one of diverse, committed, skilled, and high performing teams, selected on merit, operating in a healthy and inclusive work environment, living WFP's values (Integrity, Collaboration, Commitment, Humanity, and Inclusion) and working with partners to save and change the lives of those WFP serves.

To learn more about WFP, visit our website: and follow us on social media to keep up with our latest news: YouTube, LinkedIn, Instagram, Facebook, Twitter, TikTok.

WHY JOIN WFP?

  • WFP is a 2020 Nobel Peace Prize Laureate.

  • WFP offers a highly inclusive, diverse, and multicultural working environment.

  • WFP invests in the personal & professional development of its employees through a range of training, accreditation, coaching, mentorship, and other programs as well as through internal mobility opportunities.

  • A career path in WFP provides an exciting opportunity to work across the various country, regional and global offices around the world, and with passionate colleagues who work tirelessly to ensure that effective humanitarian assistance reaches millions of people across the globe.

  • We offer an attractive compensation package (please refer to the Terms and Conditions section of this vacancy announcement).

📌 Type of Contract: Service Contract

➡️ Unit / Division: Budget and Programming Unit / WFP Ukraine

📍 Duty Station: Kyiv

➡️ Duration: 12 months (renewable)

🇺🇦 The position is only open to Ukrainian nationals or residents of Ukraine, with a legal work permit.

What will you do in this position?

The incumbent will provide a range of specialized support for the efficient planning, monitoring and analysis of project financial performance to enhance optimal use of financial resources

The position will have a particular focus on data analysis, process improvement and development of analytical and visualization tools to enable timely, accurate and user-friendly information for operational and management decision-making.

Why work with WFP Ukraine?

The war in Ukraine has had drastic consequences, both for people inside the country and for those around the world who depend on its food supplies. The war has caused immense suffering for civilians, displaced families, and disrupted supply chains and food production. It has caused one of the fastest forced population movements since the Second World War. Close to 6 million Ukrainians are still living as refugees across Europe, and almost 3.6 million are internally displaced. Many have lost their homes and livelihoods. As food production and supply lines are disrupted by fighting, many families in the east and south of Ukraine do not have reliable access to nutritious food.

WFP uses a combination of food and cash assistance to support communities affected by the war. This includes working with local partners to distribute food boxes in areas near the frontline and providing cash transfers in locations where people have access to banks and markets to buy food. Since March 2022, WFP has distributed food and cash assistance equivalent to 3.7 billion meals to people displaced and affected by the war.

At WFP Ukraine, we offer a wide range of benefits and entitlements and favorable working conditions for Service Contract holders. Some of them are:

✅ Competitive salaries per job level

✅ Pension contribution added to net salary

✅ Medical insurance with the possibility to enroll eligible dependents

✅ Applicable danger pay (revised on quarterly basis)

✅ Annual leave - 30 days per year

✅ 18 weeks of parental leave for birth mothers and 4 weeks of parental leave for non-birth parent

✅ 1 day per week remote working option within the duty station (subject to conditions)

✅ Accessible premises & reasonable accommodation

✅ Learning & development opportunities

How can you make a difference?

In this position, you will have to:

  • Review budget plans, monitor and analyze project financial performance, identify trends and emerging issues, and provide evidence-based recommendations in compliance with WFP financial policies, procedures and best practices, supporting effective resource allocation.
  • Provide comprehensive analysis of fund and grant balances, identifying surpluses, deficits, funding constraints and opportunities for resource optimization, and recommend corrective actions to support correct fund utilization and informed decision-making.
  • Support pipeline monitoring and analysis, including consolidation and interpretation of financial and operational data, identifying emerging risks and potential pipeline breaks and supporting timely action to maximize operational effectiveness.
  • Contribute to the continuous improvement of BPU analytical and reporting processes by identifying opportunities to simplify, standardize and automate recurring activities; develop and maintain efficient analytical tools and solutions using Excel, Power Query, Power BI and/or other appropriate technologies; and support their integration into regular BPU workflows.
  • Maintain and review budget and planning information in relevant corporate systems and tools, ensuring timely and accurate data capture; extract, reconcile and validate information from multiple sources and contribute to maintaining reliable datasets for planning, monitoring and analysis.
  • Compile, analyze and interpret financial and operational data and prepare periodic and ad hoc analytical products, dashboards, reports and visualizations; translate complex information into concise, accurate and user-friendly insights tailored to management and other internal and external stakeholders.
  • Liaise with relevant units and stakeholders on budget, resource and data-related matters, clarify discrepancies, gather analytical requirements and ensure consistency and accuracy of information used for planning and decision-making.
  • Share knowledge and provide guidance to BPU colleagues on analytical tools, data management and efficient working methods; contribute to the development of common templates, methodologies and good practices to strengthen consistency, sustainability and efficiency across the Unit.
  • Follow standard emergency preparedness practices, to ensure WFP can quickly respond and deploy the resources needed to affected areas at the onset of the crisis.

To join us in saving lives, changing lives, you will have:

Education: Completion of secondary school education with a post-secondary certificate in a related area.

A university degree in finance, economics, business administration, statistics, data analytics, information management or another relevant field is desirable.

Additional training or certification in data analytics, business intelligence, advanced Excel, Power BI or related areas is an advantage.

Experience: Six or more years of progressively responsible relevant work experience in one of related areas.

Post-secondary education can compensate for some years of experience. For example, you will be considered as eligible if you have:

  • Three (3) years of work experience in combination with a Master’s Degree;

  • Four (4) years of work experience in combination with a Bachelor’s Degree.

Knowledge & Skills:

  • Demonstrated experience in data analysis and development of analytical tools, preferably within budget, finance, resource management, programme or operational functions.
  • Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel and experience with data management and automation tools such as Power Query and/or VBA/macros, including the ability to structure, analyse and streamline large or complex datasets and recurring processes.
  • Experience using Power BI or comparable business intelligence and data visualization tools to develop clear, user-friendly dashboards and analytical products for management and non-technical audiences.
  • Demonstrated ability to integrate, reconcile and validate data from multiple sources and translate complex information into concise, accurate and actionable analysis to support decision-making.
  • Experience supporting budget preparation, financial analysis, forecasting, resource management, pipeline monitoring and/or operational planning, preferably using ERP or corporate financial systems.
  • Demonstrated ability to identify inefficiencies and develop practical, sustainable solutions through process simplification, automation and standardization, including documentation and knowledge sharing with colleagues.

Language: Fluency (level C) in both in English and Ukrainian languages.

title: Servicetekniker i Zinkgruvan
description:
Xylem is a Fortune 500 global water solutions company dedicated to advancing sustainable impact and empowering the people who make water work every day. As a leading water technology company with 23,000 employees operating in over 150 countries, Xylem is at the forefront of addressing the world's most critical water challenges. We invite passionate individuals to join our team, dedicated to exceeding customer expectations through innovative and sustainable solutions.


Vill du arbeta med att tillhandahålla våra kunder med lösningar inom pump- och vatteninstallationer? Vill du hitta ett företag som du kan utvecklas tillsammans med? Nu söker vi dig som är teknikintresserad, har en erfarenhet av rörmontage och el-kunskap och vill fortsätta utvecklas tillsammans med oss.

Vi söker nu en Servicetekniker med erfarenhet av VA-och/eller Markentreprenad till vår pumpverkstad i Zinkgruvan. Som Servicetekniker arbetar du med att utföra allt från service och underhåll av befintliga pumpstationer, installation av nya pumpstationer och installation av tillfälliga lösningar. Du ingår i serviceteamet i Norrköping men utgår ifrån vår pumpverkstad som är belägen på 800 meters nivå i Zinkgruvan.

I arbetsuppgifterna ingår även rondering och skötsel av gruvans pumpstationer samt reparation av dränkpumpar.

Man han ha sin hemort omkring Zinkgruvans plats.

Vad kan vi erbjuda dig

  • En gedigen introduktion och interna utbildningar för att lära känna företaget och våra produkter

  • Kompetensutveckling för alla och god möjlighet till vidareutbildning. Du behöver inte kunna allt från start utan vi utbildar dig gärna!

  • En trevlig och schysst arbetsmiljö med olika kompetenser där du snabbt känner dig hemma

  • God ersättning och förmåner, exempelvis lunchförmån

  • Välutrustad servicebil med alla nödvändiga verktyg och utrustning som behövs

  • Tillgång till personliga IT hjälpmedel (PC, Smartphone och IPad)

Vad du kan bidra till oss

Vi söker dig som är serviceinriktad och trivs i en roll där du hjälper kunder. Du vågar att ta egna initiativ, gillar problemlösning och tar ansvar för ditt arbete. God samarbetsförmåga är en annan egenskap som utmärker dig.

Vi söker dig som har:

  • Tekniskt/mekaniskt intresse

  • Erfarenhet av VA- och/eller Markentreprenader

  • B-körkort

Meriterande är även om du har:

  • BE-körkort

  • C-körkort

Om oss

Vi är ett globalt team på 23 000 personer som är enade runt ett gemensamt mål; att skapa lösningar för världens vattenutmaningar. Visste du att vi levererar produkter till de Olympiska spelen? Visste du att de spektakulära minnesfontänerna vid Ground Zero i New York drivs av våra produkter? Visste du att våra produkter hjälper flera av Kinas största städer att ta vara på de stora mängder vatten som regnar ner under tyfonsäsongen? Visste du att Flumrider och Colorado på Liseberg är byggda på våra produkter? Vårt arbete är inriktat på att utveckla nya tekniker som förbättrar hur vatten används, bevaras och återanvänds i framtiden. Våra produkter och tjänster förflyttar, behandlar, analyserar, övervakar och återför vatten till miljön för allmännyttiga företag, industri, bostäder och kommersiella byggnader.

Serviceorganisationen finns på 12 platser i Sverige, från Gällivare i norr till Malmö i söder. Tillsammans med våra kvalitetsprodukter ger vår serviceorganisation våra kunder en garanterat långsiktig lösning för deras pumpbehov. Vi hjälper kunderna med bland annat: Reparationer av produkter, installationer, idriftsättningar, montage, svetsjobb samt el & automatik.


Information

Arbetstiden är vardagar 7-16 och jourtjänster på kvällen/helgen kan förekomma.

Vid frågor eller för mer information så är du välkommen att kontakta Leila Sayyad, leila.sayyad@xylem.com.

Ansökan sker via länken.

Fackrepresentant är Mikael Lövås, Unionen, och Rocio Piazuelo-Carrasco , Sveriges Ingenjörer, tel: + 46 8 475 60 00.

Join the global Xylem team to be a part of innovative technology solutions transforming water usage, conservation, and re-use. Our products impact public utilities, industrial sectors, residential areas, and commercial buildings, with a commitment to providing smart metering, network technologies, and advanced analytics for water, electric, and gas utilities. Partner with us in creating a world where water challenges are met with ingenuity and dedication; where we recognize the power of inclusion and belonging in driving innovation and allowing us to compete more effectively around the world.

title: Senior Business Analyst
description:
Entity:

Technology


Job Family Group:

IT&S Group


Job Description:

We are seeking a Senior Business Analyst who combines deep technical expertise with strong business analysis and business partner engagement skills. This role is ideal for someone who has a background in software development, database engineering, data analysis, or systems integration and is passionate about working directly with users to solve business problems.

The successful candidate will act as the bridge between business teams and technical delivery teams, translating business needs into practical, scalable solutions while bringing hands-on technical insight to the design, analysis, validation, and delivery of digital products and services.

This role requires the ability to independently analyse data, write queries, investigate system behaviour, validate technical designs, and support delivery teams with a detailed understanding of applications, integrations, APIs and databases.

About bp Shipping Assurance:

The Shipping Assurance function within BP Supply, Trading & Shipping (ST&S) is responsible for helping ensure that vessels, marine operations and associated marine entities meet BP's safety, risk management and operational standards before being approved to support BP business activities. The function operates as a key component of BP's marine assurance and licence-to-operate framework.

Role Responsibilities:

Business Analysis and User Engagement

  • Lead business discovery activities to understand business objectives, user needs and operational challenges.

  • Facilitate workshops and requirements gathering sessions with business and technical partners.

  • Build strong relationships with users, product teams and technical delivery teams.

  • Translate business needs into clear, structured and testable requirements.

  • Facilitate requirements prioritisation, scope management and solution alignment.

  • Identify assumptions, dependencies, risks and constraints early in the delivery process.

  • Influence senior partners through evidence-based recommendations and structured decision-making.

Technical Analysis & Solution Design

  • Analyse existing applications, data flows, databases and system integrations.

  • Collaborate with architects, engineers and product teams to design fit-for-purpose solutions.

  • Support API and integration design discussions.

  • Produce process maps, data models, workflow diagrams and solution documentation.

  • Assess technical feasibility, dependencies, risks and implementation options.

  • Act as a trusted advisor to both business and technical partners.

Data & Database Analysis

  • Perform sophisticated data analysis using SQL and other analytical tools.

  • Investigate data quality issues and identify root causes of business problems.

  • Validate data migrations, transformations and integrations.

  • Create queries, reports and analytical outputs to support decision-making.

  • Understand relational database design, data models and data governance principles.

  • Work directly with development and data engineering teams to solve issues.

Agile Delivery and Solution Support

  • Partner with Product Managers, Architects and Engineers to shape and refine solutions.

  • Support backlog management, prioritisation and sprint planning activities.

  • Review technical solutions and challenge assumptions where required.

  • Support testing strategy, UAT planning and defect triage.

  • Facilitate solution demonstrations and customer reviews.

  • Support business readiness, deployment planning and adoption activities.

Testing and Validation

  • Define business test scenarios and acceptance criteria.

  • Support User Acceptance Testing (UAT) activities.

  • Validate delivered solutions against business requirements and intended outcomes.

  • Support defect management and resolution activities.

Data and Insight

  • Use business and operational data to support analysis and decision-making.

  • Define and monitor key performance indicators.

  • Identify trends, opportunities and areas for improvement through data analysis.

  • Present findings in clear and actionable formats for interested parties.

Continuous Improvement & Innovation

  • Find opportunities for automation and process optimisation.

  • Leverage technical knowledge to simplify workflows and reduce manual effort.

  • Support adoption of AI, analytics and digital technologies.

  • Promote best practices in business analysis, requirements management and solution delivery.

Essential Experience and Qualifications:

Business Analysis

  • Significant experience working as a Business Analyst or Technical Business Analyst in complex technology environments.

  • Strong requirements elicitation, documentation and business partner management skills.

  • Experience working within Agile delivery frameworks.

  • Strong workshop facilitation and communication capabilities.

  • Ability to influence business partners at all levels of an organisation.

Technical Capability

  • Hands-on experience with SQL and relational databases.

  • Practical coding or scripting experience (e.g., Python, JavaScript, C# or similar).

  • Experience analysing APIs, integrations and system interfaces.

  • Understanding of software development lifecycle and engineering practices.

  • Experience working with Azure DevOps, Jira or equivalent delivery tools.

  • Ability to solve technical issues through data and system analysis.

Analytical Skills

  • Strong problem-solving and root-cause analysis abilities.

  • Ability to work with large datasets and draw meaningful business insights.

  • Experience producing process documentation, data models and solution diagrams.

  • Solid attention to detail combined with the ability to see the wider business context.

Desirable Experience:

  • Experience working within digital product or platform delivery teams.

  • Experience supporting business transformation, organisational change or operational improvement initiatives.
