title: Translational Science Lead
description:
Job Title: Translational Science Lead

Location: Cambridge

Salary: Competitive

Introduction to role:

Are you ready to convert human biology into decisive clinical evidence that transforms how we treat respiratory disease? Can you see yourself shaping biomarker strategies that define who benefits most from our medicines?

Based in Cambridge and reporting to the Senior Group Director, Translational Science, you will lead translational strategy from target selection through early clinical development for respiratory programs. You will connect mechanistic insight to patient impact, delivering clear proof-of-mechanism, target engagement, and precision medicine strategies that guide development decisions and position assets for differentiation and lifecycle opportunities.

Working at the intersection of discovery, clinical development and data science, you will design integrated plans, build external collaborations and patient cohorts, and champion the scientific narrative through governance. Your leadership will ensure biomarker assays are fit-for-purpose in the clinic, translational readouts are robust, and the right patients are identified sooner—accelerating the path from mechanism to medicine.

Accountabilities:

Translational Strategy Leadership: Own and integrate end-to-end translational strategies for respiratory projects and clinical studies, spanning human target validation, target engagement and precision medicine, to drive program decision-making.

Human Target Validation: Define human validation plans at target selection, leveraging public and proprietary biobanks to understand biology, responding subpopulations and biomarkers.

Mechanistic Insight and Experimental Design: Design and lead innovative experimental approaches and technologies to deepen understanding of disease pathways and drug mechanisms.

External Cohorts and Collaborations: Establish and drive collaborations and patient cohorts to enhance disease understanding and identify clinically relevant biomarkers.

Data Integration and AI/ML Partnership: Integrate clinical, biomarker and multi-omics data; partner with data science to apply AI/ML for mechanism discovery, biomarker identification and patient phenotyping.

Proof-of-Mechanism and Target Engagement: Identify and enable PoM biomarkers and target engagement assays for First-Time-in-Human studies to generate early clinical confidence.

Precision Medicine and Patient Stratification: Deliver precision strategies, including early planning for molecular biomarker assay development when clinical features alone are insufficient for patient selection.

Clinical Trial Enablement: Develop and execute biomarker sampling strategies; facilitate assay transfer and execution within clinical trials to generate high-quality translational readouts.

Governance and Investment Influence: Represent translational strategy in governance and investment forums; enable cross-functional communication for accurate execution.

Clinical Document Integration: Embed translational strategy into key clinical documents, including protocols, consent forms, sample lifecycle plans, case report forms, regulatory applications and study reports.

Regulatory and Health Authority Interactions: Contribute to responses and author submission sections on mode of action, PK/PD and precision medicine.

Scientific Communications: Prepare and review scientific publications to support the scientific and marketing narrative for assets.

Essential Skills/Experience:

  • PhD with a strong experimental drive and background in Respiratory field

  • Post-doc experience or otherwise relevant scientific research experience

  • 3+ years of experience in a Biomedical or Pharmaceutical role

  • Strong publication record

  • Proven ability to deliver translational readouts and human target validation and their application to drug discovery.

  • Understanding of the Respiratory therapy area including but not limited to COPD, Asthma, NCFBE and IPF, and disease biology, including related molecular pathways and mechanisms.

  • Experience and knowledge of the biological basis for target engagement biomarkers and familiar with PoM and patient selectin biomarkers

  • Broad understanding of relevant technologies and methodologies along with excellent scientific skills and ability to design experiments to address key scientific questions.

  • Excellent skills in hypothesis forming and testing and able to draw conclusions and suggest next steps based on the experimental data.

  • Understanding of pharmacology, translational medicine and clinical sciences as well as clinical development with pre-eminence in at least one of these areas.

  • Demonstrated leadership skills, ability to be a self-starter.

  • Strong team working skills with a proven track record of working collaboratively to ensure scientific excellence and robust delivery to projects.

  • Excellent written, oral, presentation and interpersonal skills.

Desirable Skills/Experience:

  • prior experience in a Scientific role within the Biomedical or Pharmaceutical Industry

  • Experience from clinical trials

Why AstraZeneca:

Here, you are empowered to follow the science with curiosity and courage, digging deep into the biology of complex disease while harnessing digital, data science and AI to uncover new insights. Unexpected teams often find themselves in the same room, unleashing bold thinking that advances the next generation of therapeutics and improves the odds of clinical success. You will be trusted to explore, supported with the tools and pipeline of a leading R&D organization, and surrounded by collaborators across academia, biotechs and industry—all united by a shared purpose to move faster for patients. We value kindness alongside ambition, balancing big goals with the openness and resilience needed to navigate uncertainty and create meaningful impact.

What is next!

We look forward to receiving your application not later than 28th August 2026

If you are ready to turn mechanism into medicine and define how translational science accelerates life-changing respiratory therapies, bring your expertise to Cambridge and make your impact today!

title: Identity and Access Management Expert
description:
At ING we are looking for an expert in Identity and Access Management Expert

Your role and work environment:

We are looking for a talented and enthusiastic Identity and Access Management Expert to join our IAM Center of Excellence within the CISO office.

The responsibility of this team isto safeguard ING’s digital identities by defining, managing and monitoring roles, access privileges and identity lifecycle processes, ensuring that users have the right access at the right time and under the right conditions; and our way of working is collaborative, risk-based and improvement-oriented: we partner with stakeholders across the organization, provide expert guidance, challenge complexity, and continuously look for better ways to strengthen IAM controls, compliance and user understanding.

Your key responsibilities:

As an Identity and Access Management Expert, you will:

Support the review, analysis and remediation of digital identity and access management issues, helping ensure that IAM activities are executed in line with internal procedures, policies and regulatory expectations.

Participate in the implementation and maintenance of IAM local policies, procedures and guidelines, working together with internal teams to ensure that requirements are understood and consistently applied.

Contribute to IAM control execution and follow-up activities, including evidence collection, access review support, issue tracking and coordination with stakeholders to ensure timely resolution.

Provide advice and support to users and internal stakeholders on IAM-related topics, helping translate operational questions into clear guidance and escalating complex cases when needed.

Collaborate with different technology, risk and business teams to support IAM initiatives, identify improvement opportunities and contribute to a stronger access control environment.

What are we looking for?

Want to know if this job is made for you? These are some of the qualities that we value the most for this role. And if the shoe fits… don’t hesitate to apply!

  • You have at least 3 years of experience in a similar role related to Identity and Access Management, cyber security, access controls, operational compliance or technology risk management.
  • You have a good understanding of IAM concepts such as user lifecycle management, access requests, access reviews, privileged access, authentication and segregation of duties.
  • You are comfortable working with procedures, evidence, controls and operational documentation, and you are able to follow up on actions with rigor and attention to detail.
  • You enjoy working with people: you communicate clearly, ask the right questions and collaborate naturally with stakeholders from different teams.
  • You are analytical and organized, able to understand issues, identify root causes and help define practical remediation actions.
  • You are willing to learn, open to change and motivated to grow your expertise in IAM, cyber security and control environments.
  • You show ownership, good judgement and adaptability, especially when dealing with non-routine situations or topics requiring alignment across teams.

What do we offer?

The time you spend at work, the challenges you face or the lessons you get are very important, but… What about your personal life? At ING we want your work to fulfill you in every way, and that is why we take care of even the smallest details.

Check out what is waiting for you!

Balance That Works.

We put balance to work, so you can do it too. With our customers’ needs first, the team´s and your own, we agree when to come to ING MAD and when to work best from home. More time together when it matters, more freedom when you need it.

Restaurant card.

So that thinking about what to have for lunch doesn’t take up your time or your cravings.

Our house will be your home.

In our offices you can find electric mobility solutions, doctor, hairdresser, gym, The Good Service (to help you with your errands) and much more!

Health insurance.

For you and all your family (spouse/partner and children).

Life insurance.

We help you protect what matters most to you.

Flexible remuneration.

In addition, you will enjoy our flexible remuneration model, through a more tax-advantaged way, you will be able to access other services such as nursery, transport card, training aids…

Free company shuttle.

It doesn't matter where you live. We have 6 routes (North, Central, South, A5, A42 and A6) to get you to our ING office in Madrid comfortably.

Banking benefits.

Special loans with more beneficial conditions.

Special mortgage conditions after 6 months working at the bank.

And you can benefit from our pension plan after 1 month with us!

More vitality and more belonging

360º care of the employee (physical, mental, social connection & purpose).

Physiotherapy service on site.

Clinics with professional, world-class athletes.

Gympass service.

Employee Networks: Rainbow Lions (LGBTQI+), Leonas & RIÑG.

International Remote work program.

Get to know Us

We are a team of more than 1800 people sharing one idea: doing our bit in helping our clients create a better future for themselves, by providing them with the tools they need to get where they want to go.

A fully online bank where technology, innovation, simplicity and transparency are the main ingredients, and the first one to work with agile methodologies.

And although we are based in Spain, we are lucky to work in an international bank with presence in more than 40 countries.

We are proud to have a diverse team, and we are committed to continue developing a culture of Diversity, Inclusion and Belonging to foster a culture of collaboration and innovation that represents all collectives in the society.

And even though we look orange on the outside, we are green on the inside. Our ambition in Sustainability is Empowering (y)our Sustainability journey. We are embarking on our path, for us, but we are also there for when our clients decide to embark on this journey.

Making things happen, helping others be successful, always being one step ahead—that’s our DNA. If you look at yourself in the mirror and your reflection matches our way of being and working…we are looking forward to meeting you!

At ING, you belong just as you are. We hire and support people for their talent and potential — and we know that when you can be yourself, you do your best work.

Job Application Safety Reminder

We’re seeing an increase in fraudulent job offers. To protect yourself, please follow these key guidelines when applying for roles at ING:

•Apply only via official ING platforms: ING uses Workday and LinkedIn as its internal recruitment system. Applications should be submitted only via our official career site or via ING job postings on LinkedIn.

•Check the sender’s email carefully: Legitimate communication will always come from @ing.com and/or @myworkday.com.

•No payments or banking details will ever be requested: If someone asks for this information, it’s a scam.

title: Transplant Quality and Compliance Coordinator
description:
Job Profile Summary

​This role focuses on developing and implementing programs to establish, maintain, and improve patient quality care standards. In addition, this role focuses on performing the following Performance Improvement/Quality duties: Identifies and executes performance improvement and quality opportunities across the enterprise, enabling successful transformations and driving cost savings, process and product quality, and achievement of business goals. Responsibilities also include partnering with business leaders to provide expert insight on existing processes and procedures, applies process improvement methodologies to achieve PI/Quality objectives, and builds process improvement capabilities. A professional individual contributor role that may direct the work of other lower level professionals or manage processes and programs. The majority of time is spent overseeing the design, implementation or delivery of processes, programs and policies using specialized knowledge and skills typically acquired through advanced education. An experienced level role that applies practical knowledge of job area typically obtained through advanced education and work experience. Works independently with general supervision, problems faced are difficult but typically not complex, and may influence others within the job area through explanation of facts, policies and practices.

Job Overview

This position develops, maintains, and oversees the Quality Management Plan for an assigned department and is responsible for all quality assurance, quality improvement, and regulatory compliance. This position will work directly with the Medical Director, Quality Management Director, and other clinical staff to ensure the highest quality of care and optimal patient outcomes.

Job Description

Minimum Qualifications:

1. Bachelor of Science in Nursing (BSN) or another healthcare related field.

2. Six (6) years of healthcare experience.

3. Four (4) years of extensive work with healthcare technology and databases.

Preferred Qualifications:

1. Graduate degree.

2. Eight (8) years of healthcare experience.

3. Six (6) years of extensive work with healthcare technology and databases.

4. Experience in quality/performance improvement.

5. Experience in data analysis.

Duties and Responsibilities: The duties and responsibilities listed below are intended to describe the general nature of work and are not intended to be an all-inclusive list. Other duties and responsibilities may be assigned.

1. Ensures compliance with all applicable state and federal regulations and accreditations including the Foundation for the Accreditation of Cellular Therapy (FACT) and Joint Commission.

2. Maintains, revises, and implements the Quality Management Plan (QMP) which provides the principles and tools for quality assurance, control, assessment, and improvement activities for the Program.

3. Manages and maintains the document control system for the creation, review, revision, and implementation of standard operation policies and procedures

4. Conducts, reviews, and reports audits of program clinical activities to verify compliance with and effectiveness of the Quality Management Plan.

5. Collaborates with clinical staff to respond to audit findings and implement approved recommendations.

6. Monitors and reviews error and accident reports, complaints and adverse events.

7. Prepares agendas for QM meetings and coordinate activities related to the QMP in the clinical, apheresis and processing facilities of the Program to assure compliance with accreditation standards.

8. Develops and maintains a system to document all staff qualifications, training, competencies, annual evaluations and CME activities

9. Assists the Medical Director and FACT coordinator in preparing for FACT inspection and to maintain inspection readiness.

10. Oversees the Program database and provides data management including data input, retrieval, and analysis.

11. Prepares quality management and outcome reports for the assigned department.

12. Completes and submits outcomes reporting forms to research databases.

13. Assists with the completion of Request for Information (RFIs) for insurance providers.

14. Supports the onboarding of new therapies and products for use in the department.

15. Maintains meeting minutes.

Physical Requirements:

1. This is largely a sedentary role, which involves sitting most of the time, but may involve movements such as walking, standing, reaching, ascending/descending stairs, and operating office equipment.

2. Frequently required to speak, hear, communicate, and exchange information.

3. Ability to see and read computer displays, read fine print, and/or normal type size print and distinguish letters, numbers and symbols.

4. Requires manual dexterity using fine hand manipulation to operate computer keyboard.

Skills & Abilities:

1. Willingness to continue professional development through participation in relevant conferences, training and educational activities.

2. Excellent written and oral communication skills.

3. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

4. Ability to conduct quality review, develop, and execute action plans.

5. Proficiency with Microsoft Office.

6. Eager to work in a high-performance environment.

At Tufts Medicine, we want every individual to feel valued for the skills and experience they bring. Our compensation philosophy is designed to offer fair, competitive pay that attracts, retains, and motivates highly talented individuals, while rewarding the important work you do every day.

The base pay ranges reflect the minimum qualifications for the role. title: Lab Quality Assurance Specialist

The Laboratory Quality Assurance Specialist develops, maintains, and monitors the quality management system for Laboratory Services. Responsibilities include evaluating/implementing patient safety initiatives, regulatory and accreditation compliance, risk management, and performance improvement. Works with other ancillary and patient care departments to develop plans and policies for improved quality outcomes throughout all phases of testing. Manages external proficiency program. Coordinates/Prepares reports for the department and performs activities that promote compliance within the laboratory and point of care testing sites. Facilitates an annual assessment of the Quality Assurance program for the laboratory.

Exempt

EDUCATION
  • Bachelor degree in related field

EXPERIENCE

LICENSES AND CERTIFICATIONS
Required

  • Ability to effectively communicate with patients, physicians, family members and co-workers in a manner consistent with a customer service focus and application of positive language principles

PEOPLE ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS

Collaborates with all members of the patient care team by actively communicating and reporting pertinent patient care information and data in a comprehensive manner.

title: DNA Technician
description:
Work Schedule

7 1/2 hr shift

Environmental Conditions

Able to lift 40 lbs. without assistance, Adherence to all Good Manufacturing Practices (GMP) Safety Standards, Laboratory Setting, Loud Noises (Equipment/Machinery), Some degree of PPE (Personal Protective Equipment) required (safety glasses, gowning, gloves, lab coat, ear plugs etc.), Strong Odors (chemical, lubricants, biological products etc.), Will work with hazardous/toxic materials

Job Description

As part of the Thermo Fisher Scientific team, you’ll discover meaningful work that makes a positive impact on a global scale. Join our colleagues in bringing our Mission to life every single day to enable our customers to make the world healthier, cleaner and safer. We provide our global teams with the resources needed to achieve individual career goals while helping to take science a step beyond by developing solutions for some of the world’s toughest challenges, like protecting the environment, making sure our food is safe or helping find cures for cancer.

Position Objective:

Work in a team-based environment to manufacture high quality custom oligonucleotides in a high throughput, fast paced setting.

As a formulation technician, you will learn the basics of oligonucleotide synthesis, processing, and purification. This outstanding role allows an insight into mainstream oligonucleotide production. The role requires the ability to exercise judgement within generally defined practises, policies, and procedures.

Essential Functions:

Manufacture custom primers/oligonucleotides for use in the biotechnology industry by following established protocols and standard operating procedures

Operate semi-automated and automated equipment to ensure orders are fulfilled on time

Understand scientific principles to problem solve, troubleshoot test results, evaluate alternative choices and exercise good judgement in selecting the best solution. Proactively identify production issues and give ideas/suggestions.

Perform in-process testing to assure batches meet specification. With the assistance of team members, trouble shoot processes, procedures and product issues.

Regularly evaluate non-routine test results and either fail product or allow to continue through the production cycle.

Balance multiple tasks and prioritise critical tasks. Demonstrate knowledge in the use of basic lab techniques and basic computer knowledge.

Ensure compliance with our ISO13485 standard

Thoroughly and accurately complete documentation (completes batch records with compliance with GDP, document problems, bring deviations to the attention of the Team Leader/Supervisors). Identify and communicate errors in documentation.

Update various Production/QC reports and spreadsheets. (Basic knowledge of Microsoft word/Excel)

Demonstrate good time management resulting in efficiency of the manufacturing process. Support cost improvement initiatives by reducing failures, improving capacity and using supplies wisely.

Be prepared to carry out tasks in safe manner and follow all the departments EHS initiatives including wearing full PPE. Identify, fix or escalate any hazards within the department. Be familiar with COSHH and Risk Assessments.

Give and receive constructive feedback

Demonstrate a good work ethic.

Demonstrate good listening and social skills.

Support the department’s annual goals and objectives to ensure custom orders are delivered right and on time.

May be required to perform other related duties as required and/or assigned.

Education:

BSc, HNC, HND in biology, chemistry, or equivalent. However will consider outstanding internal or external candidates without degree qualifications.

Experience:

Minimum 1 year laboratory or manufacturing experience preferred.

Ability to work in a fast paced environment and willing to cross train in multiple areas within the manufacturing environment.

Contacts:

Has contact with equivalent levels of company employees, higher level employees and external vendors.

The Team:

The EMEA GTMO Senior Leadership Team is a diverse and highly experienced group of leaders located across Europe, united by a shared commitment to operational excellence, innovation and developing great talent. The team leads critical strategic priorities across client onboarding, servicing, transformation, client advocacy and business growth, working closely with partners across Operations, Product, Technology, Sales and Global Banking. This role offers significant exposure to senior leaders and provides a unique opportunity to influence key business strategies and help shape the future direction of the organisation.

What truly sets this team apart is its people-first culture. We are passionate about creating an environment where you can grow, thrive and perform at your best. Through mentoring, leadership development, stretch opportunities and open, visible leadership, we invest heavily in our people and future leaders. We are proud of the inclusive, collaborative and high-performing culture we have built, one that balances delivering meaningful transformation with making EMEA GTMO a great place to work.

Role Description:

Due to the continued growth and strategic expansion of our Global Payments Solutions business, we are seeking an accomplished leader to drive operational transformation, building high-performing teams, leveraging data-led insights, and influencing strategic outcomes across multi-layered global organisations.

This role is responsible for leading large-scale strategic projects and highly-detailed transformational programmes across Operations and Lines of Business. You will provide leadership and direction across multiple workstreams, driving the assessment, redesign and optimisation of operating models, processes, products and services to deliver sustainable business outcomes.

Key responsibilities include overseeing the evaluation of operational performance, identifying opportunities for improvement, and developing business cases supported by robust data, risk assessments and cost-benefit analysis. You require end-to-end accountability for programme delivery, including strategic planning, execution, governance, risk management, stakeholder engagement and benefits realisation.

You will partner closely with senior executives and business leaders to define strategic priorities, influence decision-making, and ensure successful execution of critical initiatives. Extensive leadership, organisational influence and change management capabilities are essential, along with experience leading high-performing teams, driving operational transformation and delivering results in multi-faceted, matrixed environments.

  • Influence and partner with senior executives, business leaders and key stakeholders to define priorities, manage dependencies, and deliver critical organisational change.

  • Establish robust governance frameworks, executive reporting routines and performance measures to monitor programme health, monitor risk and drive accountability.

  • Lead cross-functional teams and external partners in the development and execution of key programme deliverables, ensuring quality, consistency and timely delivery.

  • Drive issue resolution, remove organisational roadblocks and mitigate risks to maintain programme momentum and achieve strategic outcomes.

  • Build high-performing teams and foster a culture of continuous improvement, operational excellence and disciplined execution across complex, matrixed environments.

  • Considerable workforce management and analytics expertise, leveraging data to optimise performance, capacity and business outcomes.

  • Deep experience in process design, performance management and continuous improvement.

  • Exceptional stakeholder management and influencing skills, with the ability to build trusted partnerships across all levels of the organisation.

  • Experience operating within a robust risk and control environment, including governance, policies and procedures.

Bank of America:

title: Tech Specialist- APC
description:

Job Description:

What’s the role

As an Advanced Process Control (APC) Engineer, you will be responsible for developing, implementing, and sustaining APC applications that enhance process stability, reliability, energy efficiency, and profitability across Shell's refining and petrochemical assets. Working within the Process Automation, Control and Optimization (PACO) team at the Shell Chennai Centre, India, you will collaborate with operations, process engineering, and control systems teams to identify optimization opportunities and deliver advanced control solutions.

The ideal candidate will possess strong expertise in process control systems, multivariable predictive control, and process optimization methodologies, with the ability to independently execute APC projects from design through commissioning and performance monitoring.

What you’ll be doing

  • Develop and implement Advanced Process Control strategies to optimize plant performance and reduce costs.

  • Work with plant personnel to identify opportunities for process improvements.

  • Estimate benefit from APC implementation by performing Scoping Study.

  • Perform Site Survey and Pretest to identify key areas and constraints for APC implementation and understand plant dynamics and time to steady state.

  • Should be able to tune Base Layer Controls and identify issues and suggest strategies for improvement.

  • Develop Functional Design defining strategies for Control and Optimization.

  • Perform Step Test and Model Identification.

  • Develop Inferential Model to estimate properties of key process parameters.

  • Perform APC Pre Commissioning activities to enable handshake between APC and DCS systems, implement Watchdog logics, develop APC graphics and deploy APC Web Interface on Operator Panel Stations.

  • Test shed logics for various scenarios of communication break between APC and DCS systems.

  • Commission APC controllers and fine tune them to achieve desired control and optimization objectives.

  • Perform post implementation Benefit Audit to identify actual benefit achieved by APC.

  • Develop and maintain process control documentation, including control narratives, P&IDs, and control system configuration files.

  • Provide technical support to plant personnel for process control issues.

  • Develop and maintain process control training materials for plant personnel.

  • Participate in the development and implementation of plant-wide automation projects.

  • Support team members on projects to enhance their technical knowledge.

What you bring

  • Bachelor’s degree in chemical engineering or equivalent qualifications

  • Have 8-12 years of experience in implementing APC from start to end, i.e., Scoping Study to Post Implementation Benefit Audit

  • Experience in designing, developing, implementing, and commissioning Advanced Process control and Base layer control strategies.

  • Experience with Shell PACE, SMOC, Aspen DMC3, DMC plus, Honeywell Profit Suite, etc.

  • Experience of troubleshooting and solving problems with controllers and other process related issues in process control.

  • Good communication, presentation and interpersonal skills

  • Good coaching and mentoring skills

  • The ability to prioritize and multi-task the miscellaneous projects.

What we offer

You bring your skills and experience to Shell and in return you work with talented, committed people on one of the most important challenges facing our planet. You’ll have the opportunity to develop the skills you need to grow in an environment where we value honesty, integrity, and respect for one another. You’ll be able to balance your priorities as you become the best version of yourself.

  • Progress as a person as we work on the energy transition together.

  • Continuously grow the transferable skills you need to get ahead.

  • Work at the forefront of technology, trends, and practices.

  • Collaborate with experienced colleagues with unique expertise.

  • Achieve your balance in a values-led culture that encourages you to be the best version of yourself.

title: Senior Physiotherapist
description:
Your role at St John of God Midland Private Hospital

Be part of something exceptional from the very beginning. As we prepare to open a brand-new state-of-the-art private hospital this August, we are seeking an experienced and motivated Senior Physiotherapist to join our multidisciplinary team to play a key role in shaping high quality physiotherapy services from the ground up.

The Senior Physiotherapist works alongside the multi-disciplinary team to provide senior clinical physiotherapy services to clients/patients. Ensures practice is in accordance with Australian Physiotherapy Association Code of Conduct and SJGHC policies and guidelines.

The Senior Physiotherapist is expected to work independently and demonstrate a depth of experience. The Senior Physiotherapist is expected to initiate and participate in teaching, training, research and quality activities, to supervise students and supervise and mentor junior caregivers.

The Position

  • Provide high quality evidence based senior Physiotherapy services to patients/clients within the clinical specialty area/s including hydrotherapy where applicable.

  • Provide physiotherapy assessment, intervention and evaluation at a senior practice level for complex and general caseload/s.

  • Ensure that direct working relationships are established and maintained with colleagues and internal/external customers.

  • Use of Evidence Based Patient treatment outcome measures and use of patient feedback - satisfaction measures and quality assurance activities

  • Ensure prioritisation and delegation of duties of Physiotherapy caseloads for self and supervised staff.

  • Participate in evidence based clinical research activities, where applicable.

  • Active participation in the multidisciplinary team including clinical meetings

  • Document in the patient/client’s healthcare record in accordance with the SJGHC policies and procedure

  • Maintain statistical data in accordance with departmental and professional clinical guidelines.

  • Attend staff meetings and present at professional development sessions as required.

  • Liaise with other staff and educate staff about patient care.

  • Maintain effective communication with patients, their families, staff and external health professionals and agencies to ensure quality patient management.

  • Participate in the physiotherapy department weekend roster if required.

You will hold current registration with the Physiotherapy Board of Australia (AHPRA) and have demonstrated senior clinical experience and leadership in clinical practice as a physiotherapist within a healthcare and disability service setting.

To succeed you will have the ability to undertake professional supervision and/or mentor junior staff and develop evidence based and innovative clinical practices. Experience with patients in ICU/Critical Care is highly desirable.

Above all, people will be at the core of everything you do committing to and supporting our Mission and Values.

  • An Angiography Suite

Lähetäthän hakemuksen rekrytointijärjestelmämme kautta 30.8.2026 mennessä.

Vastaava hoitaja

Jutta.Koponen@mehilainen.fi

Me mehiläiset rakennamme yhdessä parasta paikkaa ammattilaiselle. Teemme sen johtamalla reilusti ja suhtautumalla laatuun tinkimättömästi. title: Section Lead, Information Technology
description:
OFS Malaysia is a subsidiary of Offshore Frontier Solutions Pte. Ltd. (OFS), a MODEC Group company in Malaysia. Being part of Modec means being the protagonist of a challenging career and being in touch with the latest deep-water production systems, knowing that your career begins in Malaysia, but your talent can take you anywhere in the world.

If you want to be one of the greatest in the market, this is your opportunity!

We are currently looking for talented individuals to join us for below role

Section Lead, Information Technology

We are currently based at KL Eco City, Malaysia.

Overview

The Section Lead, Information Technology (IT) is responsible for leading a multidisciplinary regional team - spanning service desk, infrastructure, network, cyber security and IT for FPSO project execution - to deliver secure, reliable and scalable technology services across Malaysia, Singapore and related regional locations. This role owns the end-to-end delivery, governance and financial performance of the regional IT function, ensuring consistent execution across FPSO / EPCI projects, offices and operating sites.

You will work closely with local management, HODs, Global IT under the CIO, EPCI project teams and technology vendors to translate Global IT direction into regional execution — strengthening service quality, security posture and delivery capability, and enabling the business to operate on trusted, well-governed technology.

Key Responsibilities

Leadership & Team Management

  • Lead, mentor and develop the regional IT leadership layer and members — Support & Operation, Infrastructure, Network & Cyber Security, FPSO project execution — setting clear goals and owning performance reviews, 1:1s and career development.

  • Build depth and succession within the section; close capability gaps through recruitment, development and targeted use of third-party resources.

  • Allocate resources and manage capacity across operations, projects and multiple locations, balancing run and change demand.

IT Strategy, Governance & Compliance

  • Own the regional IT roadmap, aligning local priorities with Global IT direction and business objectives.

  • Apply Global IT policies, standards, internal controls and HSSEQ requirements consistently across all regional locations.

  • Act as regional owner for internal and external IT audits — coordinating responses, driving remediation and tracking findings to closure.

Infrastructure, Network & Cyber Security

  • Own the availability, performance and continuity of regional infrastructure, network and end-user services against agreed service levels.

  • Champion a defense-in-depth security posture across the region; serve as escalation point for cyber security incidents and ensure risk assessments and secure design reviews are completed.

  • Drive vulnerability remediation and security improvement to closure, maintaining regional accountability for the risk position.

Internal IT Project Management

  • Act as focal point for regional IT projects across infrastructure, network, cyber security, cloud and applications; manage scope, dependencies, risk and change through to handover.

  • Decide on escalations raised by leads and coordinators — resource reallocation, vendor escalation, schedule negotiation or risk acceptance — and escalate to HOD, Global IT or the CIO where the decision sits above regional authority.

FPSO Project Delivery

  • Own IT delivery for FPSO EPCI projects through the IT Project Coordinators, ensuring IT scope, schedule and readiness align with project milestones, commissioning activities and sail-away requirements.

Financial & Commercial Management

  • Own the regional IT budget end to end: budget development and planning, Capex and Opex control, forecasting, budget-versus-actual analysis and variance explanation.

  • Own regional IT end to end procurement; from requirement definition and RFQ / RFP through vendor selection, negotiation, raising POs, tracking delivery, and goods receiving.

  • Manage vendor and service-provider performance against contracted commitments.

  • Own asset lifecycle and renewal planning.

Requirements

  • Bachelor's or master's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering or a related field.

  • 10+ years of experience in enterprise IT, with 5+ years in team leadership or section / function management.

  • Proven accountability for a multi-country or multi-site IT function, including matrixed and third-party resources (preferably FPSO, offshore, oil & gas, or other project-based industries).

  • Strong understanding across enterprise infrastructure, networking, cloud (AWS / Azure), Microsoft 365, identity and endpoint management, and enterprise applications

  • Demonstrated expertise in cyber security governance, risk management, audit and compliance within a global operating model.

  • Ownership of an IT budget of comparable scale, covering Capex / Opex planning, forecasting and variance management, alongside IT procurement and vendor negotiation.

  • Experience in EPCI or major project environments, including contractor oversight, design and readiness reviews, and multi-stakeholder management.

  • Excellent communication, stakeholder engagement and documentation skills; ability to work across cultures and time zones, including with global stakeholders outside standard working hours.

  • Fluent in English (written and spoken).

title: Platform Engineer - Content Protection
description:
Platform Engineer - Content Protection


About the Springer Nature Group

Springer Nature opens the doors to discovery for researchers, educators, clinicians, and other professionals. Every day, around the globe, our imprints, books, journals, platforms, and technology solutions reach millions of people. For over 175 years our brands and imprints have been a trusted source of knowledge to these communities. As AI, machine intelligence and agentic technologies reshape how research is discovered and consumed, we have a responsibility to ensure knowledge remains both discoverable and protected.

About the role

The way academic research is communicated is changing rapidly. Increasingly, Springer Nature content is being accessed through search engines, discovery platforms, AI-powered services, machine agents and content aggregation ecosystems. This creates significant opportunities to extend the reach and impact of research, but also introduces new challenges around content extraction, automated access, platform stability and commercial value protection.

The Platform Engineer - Content Protection role sits within the Off-platform Discovery and Content Protection team and is responsible for turning analytical insight and content protection strategy into operational controls. Working closely with the Data Analyst, Product Manager, Managed Security Services, SEO teams, Product teams and Platform Engineering teams, this role owns the design, implementation and operation of traffic management and content protection controls.

The role is responsible for ensuring Springer Nature can maximise discoverability while protecting content, platform performance and future business models. You will continuously evolve controls and responses to address emerging forms of automated access, including AI-driven and agentic technologies, while ensuring legitimate users retain access to our platforms and content.

Responsibilities

Content Protection Execution & Operational Ownership

  • Build, operate and continuously improve WAF signals, policies and rules that detect and mitigate automated scraping, content extraction and abusive traffic.
  • Own the lifecycle of traffic protection controls including design, testing, deployment, tuning, validation and retirement.
  • Implement rate-limiting, bot-management and traffic-shaping strategies aligned to business objectives and platform requirements.
  • Ensure protection controls are effective without negatively impacting legitimate discoverability, accessibility or customer experience.
  • Turn analytical signals and intelligence into practical enforcement controls and measurable operational outcomes.

Incident Management & Response

  • Lead response activities relating to scraping, automated abuse, enumeration and traffic-related incidents.
  • Maintain operational playbooks and runbooks for detection, escalation, mitigation and recovery.
  • Implement controls using staged rollout approaches, balancing risk reduction with customer impact.
  • Monitor effectiveness of controls and continually improve protection capabilities.


Fastly Partnership & Vendor Management

  • Own the day-to-day technical relationship with Fastly MSS and associated content protection tooling.
  • Review, validate and operationalise Fastly recommendations and outputs.
  • Work with Fastly to maximise value from platform capabilities and identify future improvement opportunities.
  • Coordinate changes with stakeholders and communicate impacts, dependencies and implementation plans.

Cross-functional Collaboration & Future Capability Development

  • Partner closely with the Data Analyst to operationalise detection signals and validate outcomes.
  • Work with SEO teams to ensure legitimate crawlers and discovery services remain appropriately supported.
  • Support Product and Platform teams with traffic-aware architectural decisions.
  • Help define organisational policies relating to acceptable, non-desirable and malicious automated access.
  • Contribute to future approaches for managing AI agents, machine access and emerging content consumption models.

What's Expected
In 1–3 Months:

  • Build strong relationships with Managed Services vendor, Product, Platform Engineering, SEO and Analytics stakeholders.
  • Develop an understanding of existing WAF configurations, controls and operating processes.
  • Review recent incidents and identify immediate improvement opportunities.
  • Begin establishing operational playbooks and governance processes.


By 3–6 Months you will:

  • Establish repeatable workflows for traffic anomaly detection and response.
  • Create clear ownership and decision-making processes for content protection activities.
  • Reduce engineering involvement in reactive mitigation activities.
  • Deliver measurable improvements in response capability and operational readiness.


By 6–12 Months you will:

  • Operate a mature content protection capability integrated into platform operations.
  • Develop trusted partnerships with Fastly and internal stakeholders.
  • Improve protection against both high-volume and slow accumulation content extraction techniques.
  • Lay the foundations for managing AI-driven and agentic access patterns at scale.
  • Help Springer Nature balance discoverability, content protection and future commercial opportunities.


Essential Skills & Experience

  • Hands-on WAF engineering experience, ideally with Fastly Next-Gen WAF (Signal Sciences) or equivalent platforms.
  • Experience implementing bot management, rate limiting and traffic management controls.
  • Experience responding to scraping, DDoS, automated abuse or similar traffic-management incidents.
  • Strong understanding of HTTP, TLS, CDN and edge technologies.
  • Ability to balance security, operational and business considerations when designing controls.
  • Strong stakeholder management and communication skills.

Desirable

  • Experience with Fastly, Signal Sciences, edge compute or similar technologies.
  • Experience working alongside security operations or managed security services teams.
  • Experience with entitlement, identity or access-management systems.
  • Understanding of SEO, crawler behaviour and digital discoverability ecosystems.
  • Experience in academic publishing, research platforms or content-rich digital businesses.
  • Experience working with emerging AI, agentic or machine-access use cases.

Our Company

Changing the world through digital experiences is what Adobe's all about. We give everyone — from emerging artists to global brands — everything they need to design and deliver exceptional digital experiences! We're passionate about empowering people to create beautiful and powerful images, videos, and apps, and transform how companies interact with customers across every screen.

The Challenge

We're on a mission to hire the very best and are committed to creating exceptional employee experiences where everyone is respected and has access to equal opportunity. We realize that new ideas can come from everywhere in the organization, and we know the next big idea could be yours!

Our team builds AI solutions that directly move Adobe's business — from GenAI-powered business intelligence agents and RAG-based AI assistants, to ML models for payment optimization, next-best-action personalization, customer lifetime value prediction, and in-app monetization. We partner with 10+ business units across the organization to turn data into decisions and models into revenue.

You will demonstrate AI — including AI-assisted coding and rapid prototyping — to build end-to-end products that solve real business problems fast. From LLM-powered agents and AI assistants to personalization services based on machine learning, you will manage the entire lifecycle. You will identify the opportunity with partners, build the solution including frontend, backend, data pipeline, and model, deploy it to production, and measure business impact. We move quickly, and we expect you to use every modern AI tool at your disposal to ship faster.

Ideal candidates are strong engineers who use AI to multiply their output. You're as comfortable vibe-coding a working prototype in a day as you are designing a scalable production system. You can build a RAG pipeline, stand up a web app, write a data pipeline in Spark, and deploy services on cloud infrastructure — and you use AI coding tools to do it all at 10x speed.

What you’ll do

  • Rapidly build end-to-end AI products — from idea to deployed application — using AI-assisted coding tools to accelerate development across the full stack (frontend, backend, data, infrastructure)
  • Build and deploy GenAI applications — including LLM-powered agents, RAG systems, and AI assistants — to solve real business problems such as business intelligence, workflow automation, and Q&A over structured and unstructured data
  • Build and maintain scalable ML/AI pipelines on cloud infrastructure (Azure, Databricks) that process large-scale user behavioral data
  • Collaborate directly with business collaborators across Adobe to identify high-impact AI opportunities, prototype solutions quickly, and deliver measurable results
  • Own end-to-end delivery of AI services — from data ingestion and model training to API development, UI, deployment, monitoring, and business impact measurement

What you need to succeed

  • MS or PhD in Computer Science, Statistics, Machine Learning, or related fields, or equivalent experience; or BS with equivalent practical experience

title: Payroll System Administrator
description:
Join GN as our Payroll System Administrator and help us bring people closer through reliable, compliant, and efficient payroll systems and processes.

In the role of Payroll System Administrator, you will contribute to our purpose of Bringing People Closer. You will ensure stable payroll system operations, accurate data flows, and quality outcomes that enable timely payroll and financial reporting.

The Team you will be part of:
At our global HQ, located in Ballerup, Denmark, you will join the Payroll Team – part of Group Accounting - which handles payroll processing for the entire GN Group’s workforce in Denmark.

Reporting to Senior Manager, Head of Group Accounting, you will be the go-to person for the daily administration, configuration, and continuous improvement of our payroll system landscape.

We are a skilled, engaged, and supportive team characterized by solid expertise, knowledge sharing, and an open, light-hearted tone. We aspire to continuously optimize and improve how we work, while delivering quality outcomes together. We collaborate closely with Group Accounting, Finance, P&C (i.e. HR), and DDI (i.e.IT).

Your contribution is appreciated, and you will:

  • Take ownership of payroll processing for approximately 900 employees in Denmark

  • Manage financial posting in D365 and reconciliations in Excel

  • Administrate employee absence registration in Workday and Lessor Løn

  • Manage industrial collective agreements

  • Work with various projects within the payroll area

  • Manage sickness and maternity/parental leave reimbursements, including posting of these, and advising employees on our parental leave processes

To perform well in the role, we imagine that you:

  • Bring solid relevant experience administering payroll or HR systems in a medium-sized or larger organisation; it is beneficial to have experience with Workday, Lessor Løn, and D365 Finance

  • Have experience with payroll for a larger workforce — e.g. across multiple subsidiaries - covering payroll practices, collective agreements, and absence processes, and are proficient with Excel or similar tools

  • Work with high standards for quality, planning, organizing, and ensure clear documentation

  • Are service-minded and can navigate easily among many stakeholders - and proactively seek clarification and sparring when needed

  • Collaborate well across Accounting, Finance, HR, IT, and external vendors, and are proficient in Danish and English

As part of our Global Group Accounting team, it is important that you can adapt to a changing global work environment with shifting priorities. This also means that our monthly-, quarterly-, and year-end payroll, accounting-, and financial cycles are our peak work periods.

At GN we pride ourselves on encouraging flexible work whenever possible. We trust our people to fulfill their responsibilities, to know when in-person collaboration is better than hybrid, and to be present when it's needed most.

We encourage you to apply
Even if you don’t match all the above-mentioned skills, we welcome your application if you think you have transferable skills. We highly value a mindset and motivation that align with our core values, to not only ensure growth for you, but for your team and the wider GN organization as well.

We are focused on an inclusive recruitment process
All applicants will receive equal consideration for employment. As such, we encourage you to submit your CV without a photo to ensure an equal and fair application process.

Should you have any special requirements for the interview, please let the Hiring Manager know upon accepting the invitation to the interview.

How to apply?
Use the ‘APPLY’ link no later than 31st of August 2026. Applications are assessed continuously, so don’t wait to send yours.

On a time crunch? Feel free to only submit your up-to-date CV, including a few sentences outlining your motivation for applying – quick and easy.

If you want to know more about the position, please contact Senior Manager, Head of Group Accounting, Shabi Ul Hassan at +45 70 27 31 30.

Join us in bringing people closer
GN brings people closer through our advanced intelligent hearing, audio, video, and gaming solutions. Inspired by people and motivated by innovation, we deliver technology that enhances the senses of hearing and sight. We enable people with hearing loss to overcome real-life problems, improve communication and collaboration for businesses, and provide great experiences for audio and gaming users.

GN Store Nord A/S has entered into a definitive agreement for the sale of GN’s Hearing business to Amplifon S.p.A. to create a global leader in audiology. For GN Group, this creates an opportunity to expand our position in the large audio and video peripherals markets. Read more about the announcement here.

We hope you will join us on this journey and look forward to receiving your application.

Hitachi Rail is a global provider of rail solutions. In Sweden, we deliver advanced railway signalling systems that meet the highest safety, reliability, and performance standards.

We are a small and growing local team based in Solna. Our size gives everyone the opportunity to make a visible impact, take ownership, and gain experience across different aspects of project delivery. Small Local Team

You will be joining a compact team in Solna where your contribution is highly visible. You will gain broad hands-on experience and play an important role in project delivery.

Site-Based Activities

The role combines laboratory testing with periods of work on customer sites across Sweden. This provides exposure to real railway systems, customer environments, and project delivery activities.

International Collaboration

Much of our engineering support and development comes from Italy and other international locations. Strong communication skills and an ability to work effectively across cultures are important for success.

Career Development

This role offers a clear opportunity to grow. As you gain experience with site activities and customer interactions, you can develop toward taking greater ownership of site testing activities and potentially evolve into a Site Test Lead or Site Leader role.

  • Build broad technical knowledge within signalling and rail systems.

description:
If you’re passionate about being part of a dynamic organization that enables a Fortune 100 company with nearly $70 billion in annual sales to drive innovation and adopt new technologies that deliver business results, then Nationwide’s Technology team could be the place for you! At Nationwide®, “on your side” goes beyond just words. Our customers are at the center of everything we do and we’re looking for associates who are passionate about delivering extraordinary care.

The Consultant Software Engineer will support Nationwide’s Excess & Specialty Surplus BSA within the Order of the Phoenix team, supporting the Wholesale ExpressConnect 2.0 application. ExpressConnect 2.0 is built on Guidewire InsuranceNow and provides core contract-underwriting capabilities, including submission, rating, quoting, binding, policy issuance, and policy maintenance. The role will partner closely with business analysts, technology analysts, quality engineers, architects, product leaders, Guidewire, and dependent data and integration teams to deliver secure, reliable solutions for Excess, CPP, and related commercial products.

This is an attractive opportunity for an engineer who wants meaningful ownership of a highly visible, business-critical insurance platform. The OOTP team delivers product enhancements, rating and form changes, API capabilities, technical-debt remediation, security improvements, cloud and Guidewire upgrades, and production support.

The team’s work directly supports Nationwide’s Excess & Specialty business and has contributed to more than $1.4 billion in direct written premium. Candidates will also join a collaborative agile team that actively uses modern engineering practices and emerging tools, including GitHub Copilot and Glean for unit-test development, requirements analysis, test-case generation, API security reviews, and developer productivity.


The most important technical competencies for this role are hands-on experience with Guidewire InsuranceNow or a comparable property and casualty policy-administration platform; strong Java and object-oriented software-development skills; experience designing, developing, testing, and troubleshooting REST APIs and system integrations; practical knowledge of DevSecOps, Git-based version control, CI/CD pipelines, secure coding, and vulnerability remediation; and strong diagnostic and testing skills across user-interface, API, integration, rating, forms, and policy-lifecycle functionality. These skills will be applied to configure and extend Guidewire functionality, implement rating and underwriting rules, support API consumers and integrations, improve automated and unit-test coverage, troubleshoot production and test-environment issues, and help prepare the application for Guidewire Cloud Platform modernization.

On a typical day, the Consultant Software Engineer will participate in agile ceremonies, backlog refinement, three-amigo discussions, and technical design sessions; analyze business requirements and translate them into maintainable code or configuration; develop, test, debug, document, and deploy software changes; review code and collaborate with developers, quality engineers, analysts, and business partners; investigate defects, incidents, vulnerabilities, and integration issues; and support release preparation, deployment validation, change management, and post-release monitoring. The engineer will also contribute to technical-debt reduction, API and application documentation, continuous-improvement efforts, knowledge sharing, and mentoring other team members while managing assigned priorities, dependencies, deadlines, and deliverables.

Preferred Skills:

Guidewire Insurance Now; extensive experience in API development and apigee; experience in code and configuration management of multiple development branches; extensive experience with DevOps Tools like GitHubActions (and GitHubCopilot) and Harness

title: Product Manager, AI and Data - Trade / Channel
description:
Who are we?

At Finastra, we’re a global leader in financial services software, dedicated to expanding access to financial services and shaping what’s next for the industry. Our technology powers mission‑critical solutions across Lending, Payments and Universal Banking, supporting over 7,000 customers, including 80% of the world’s top 50 banks, in more than 110 countries.

Who are we?

At Finastra, we are a global leader in financial services software, committed to broadening access to financial services and shaping the future of banking. Our solutions support over 7,000 customers, including 80% of the world’s top 50 banks, across more than 110 countries, powering mission-critical capabilities in Universal Banking, Payments, and Lending.

We are looking for a Product Manager, AI & Data – Trade & Channels to join our Product Management organisation in London on a hybrid basis. This is a high-impact role reporting to the Head of AI & Data Products, focused on shaping the strategy, roadmap, and execution of AI, data, and integration capabilities across Finastra’s Trade and Channels solutions.

This is an exciting opportunity for someone who can combine strong product management discipline with a passion for data, automation, analytics, and emerging AI technologies, and who thrives at the intersection of customer needs, technical delivery, and commercial outcomes.

About the Role

In this role, you will manage the full product lifecycle from concept through launch, ensuring solutions align with customer needs, market opportunities, regulatory requirements, and business priorities. You will identify opportunities to use data, AI, analytics, automation, and integration capabilities to improve customer outcomes, streamline operations, and accelerate business growth.

You will act as a connector across Product, Engineering, Data & Analytics, Architecture, Commercial, Client, and Implementation teams, bringing clarity and structure to cross-functional initiatives. You will help enhance product value, improve interoperability, and support Finastra’s broader AI and platform modernisation strategy across Trade and Channels solutions.

Key Responsibilities

  • Own and manage the product roadmap for AI, data, and integration capabilities within Trade and Channels products.
  • Manage the full product lifecycle from market assessment and business case development through go-to-market execution, adoption, and continuous enhancement.
  • Develop product strategies that support customer growth, operational efficiency, revenue objectives, and broader platform modernisation priorities.
  • Identify market opportunities through customer feedback, market research, competitive analysis, advisory forums, workshops, and industry trends.
  • Translate business requirements into prioritised product features, user stories, product enhancements, and measurable success metrics.
  • Identify and evaluate AI, machine learning, automation, analytics, and data-led use cases that improve customer experiences, risk management, decision-making, and operational efficiency.
  • Partner with Data & Analytics, Engineering, and Architecture teams to define data requirements, integration requirements, APIs, workflows, interoperability standards, and AI model deployment needs.
  • Ensure AI and data capabilities are scalable, secure, and aligned with responsible AI standards, governance requirements, regulatory expectations, and enterprise architecture standards.
  • Support cross-product integration initiatives that connect Trade and Channels solutions with other Lending and Banking products.
  • Serve as a key product contact for customers, sales teams, implementation teams, and industry stakeholders, supporting product positioning, messaging, demonstrations, collateral, and sales enablement.
  • Lead complex cross-functional initiatives involving Product Strategy, Engineering, Architecture, Commercial, Client Services, Marketing, and customer-facing teams.
  • Provide ongoing reporting and executive updates on roadmap progress, risks, dependencies, product performance, adoption, customer value realisation, and business outcomes.
  • Develop documentation, release plans, feature specifications, business cases, and operational processes that support product delivery and continuous improvement.
  • Support vendor evaluation and strategic technology partnerships where appropriate.

What You Bring

  • Significant experience in Product Management, Product Strategy, Data Products, AI/ML solutions, or related technology disciplines.
  • Experience within financial services, fintech, transaction banking, trade finance, corporate banking, banking channels, payments, or enterprise software environments.
  • Strong understanding of product management principles, Agile methodologies, software development lifecycles, roadmap management, requirements definition, and customer-facing product launches.
  • Experience building business cases, defining success metrics, using data to drive decision-making, and leading product initiatives from concept through execution and adoption.
  • Familiarity with APIs, integrations, cloud platforms, analytics solutions, data architectures, enterprise SaaS platforms, and platform-based product delivery.
  • Experience working cross-functionally with engineering, architecture, data, commercial, sales, implementation, and client-facing teams.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, communication, and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to turn complex requirements into clear product priorities.
  • Exposure to AI/ML technologies, generative AI, workflow automation, analytics platforms, or data-driven product development would be highly beneficial.
  • Knowledge of Trade Finance, Trade Processing, Corporate Banking, Payments, Channels, Supply Chain Finance, Treasury solutions, or banking regulatory and compliance requirements would be advantageous.

We are proud to offer a range of incentives to our employees worldwide. These benefits are available to everyone, regardless of grade, and reflect the values we stand for:

Flexibility: Enjoy unlimited vacation, subject to local regulations and business priorities. Benefit from hybrid working arrangements and inclusive policies such as paid time off for voting, bereavement, and sick leave.

Well‑being: Access confidential one‑to‑one support through our Employee Assistance Program, connect with our network of Wellbeing Champions and Gather Groups, and take part in monthly events and initiatives designed to help you thrive—inside and outside of work.

Health & Financial Security: Medical, life and disability insurance, retirement plans, lifestyle, and other benefits.*

Sustainability: Paid time off for volunteering and donation‑matching opportunities to support causes that matter to you.

Inclusion: Get involved in our inclusion communities, such as Count Me In, Culture@Finastra, Proud@Finastra, Disabilities@Finastra, and Women@Finastra—open to everyone who wants to participate and contribute.

Career Development: Access online learning and accredited courses through our Skills & Career Navigator tool.

Recognition: Take part in our global recognition program, Finastra Celebrates, and share your voice through regular employee surveys that help shape our culture and ways of working.

*Specific benefits may vary by location.

At Finastra, each individual is unique—bringing their own ideas, perspectives, cultural backgrounds, and experiences. We learn from one another, value what makes us different, and create an environment where everyone feels included, supported, and able to be their authentic selves.

Be unique. Be exceptional. Help us make a difference at Finastra.

title: Senior C++ Software Developer (Real-time Market Data)
description:
The Real-time Market Data department is part of the Algorithmic Trading Super Department. It is responsible for developing, engineering, deploying and maintaining applications to disseminate and enhance the value of the market data that comes into the firm, which drive the Firm's Sales and Trading platforms across Equity, FX and Rates. These systems supply data to Morgan Stanley's smart order router, risk control, and algorithmic trading engines. title: Senior Project Manager
description:
Not just a job, but a career

Yokogawa, award winner for ‘Best Asset Monitoring Technology’ and ‘Best Digital Twin Technology’ at the HP Awards, is a leading provider of industrial automation, test and measurement, information systems and industrial services in several industries.

Our aim is to shape a better future for our planet through supporting the energy transition, (bio)technology, artificial intelligence, industrial cybersecurity, etc. We are committed to the United Nations sustainable development goals by utilizing our ability to measure and connect.

About the Team
Our 18,000 employees work in over 60 countries with one corporate mission, to "co-innovate tomorrow". We are looking for dynamic colleagues who share our passion for technology and care for our planet. In return, we offer you great career opportunities to grow yourself in a truly global culture where respect, value creation, collaboration, integrity, and gratitude are highly valued and exhibited in everything we do.

RESPONSIBILITIES

◆ Innovation Implementation and Pipeline Management

Develop complex innovations of critical products or services, running pilots and testing through fast-paced launches, managing project schedules, identifying risks, and communicating to project stakeholders and external partners.

◆ Project Management

Manage a portfolio of projects while reporting to senior colleagues.

◆ Project Planning

Produce workstream or project plans, ensuring that all activities are identified, are appropriately organized to deliver project objectives, and comply with the organization's project management framework.

◆ Digital Strategy/Transformational Projects Execution

Execute and deliver elements of the digital road map, leveraging agile and design-thinking principles to drive sustainable implementation.

◆ Databases Installation

◆ Work Scheduling and Allocation

Develop short- or medium-term work schedules in order to achieve planned commitments. Approve overtime or use additional resources as needed.

◆ Operational Compliance

Maintain and renew a deep knowledge and understanding of the organization's policies and procedures and of relevant regulatory codes and codes of conduct, and ensure own work adheres to required standards. OR Identify, within the team, patterns of non-compliance with the organization's policies and procedures, and with relevant regulatory codes and codes of conduct, taking appropriate action to report and resolve these and escalating issues as appropriate.

◆ Digital Vision and Strategy

◆ Performance Management

Develop and propose own performance objectives; take appropriate actions to ensure achievement of agreed objectives, using the organization's performance management systems to improve personal performance. OR Manage and report on team performance; set appropriate performance objectives for direct reports or project / account team members and hold them accountable for achieving these, taking appropriate corrective action where necessary to ensure the achievement of team / personal objectives.

◆ Organizational Capability Building

Use the organization's formal development framework to identify the team's individual development needs. Plan and implement actions to build their capabilities. Provide training or coaching to others throughout the organization in own area of expertise to enable others to improve performance and fulfill personal potential.

Behavioral Competencies

◆ Drives Results

Consistently achieves results, even under tough circumstances. For example, holds self to high standards of performance; sets some challenging goals; wants to achieve meaningful results; pursues initiatives/efforts to successful completion and closure. Focuses on key goals, even during setbacks and obstacles.

◆ Business Insight

Applies knowledge of business and the marketplace to advance the organization's goals. For example, clearly understands how own activities relate to critical business drivers. Monitors business news and market changes for impact on the business or on own expertise area; uses this to shape decisions.

◆ Drives Engagement

Creates a climate where people are motivated to do their best to help the organization achieve its objectives. For example, shares insight into the purpose of the work, involves others appropriately and gives them credit for their contributions. Praises the successes of others.

◆ Cultivates Innovation

Creates new and better ways for the organization to be successful. For example, motivates others to find new and better ways to address challenges; provides support and resources for promising ideas. Encourages people to incorporate varied perspectives to strengthen the innovation process.

◆ Manages Complexity

Makes sense of complex, high quantity, and sometimes contradictory information to effectively solve problems. For example, consistently looks at complex issues from many angles; obtains a rich and deep understanding; swiftly cuts to the core issue; skillfully separates root causes from symptoms.

◆ Collaborates

Builds partnerships and works collaboratively with others to meet shared objectives. For example, readily involves others to accomplish goals; stays in touch and shares information; discourages "us versus them" thinking; shows appreciation for others' ideas and input.

◆ Strategic Mindset

Sees ahead to future possibilities and translates them into breakthrough strategies. For example, articulates how own actions contribute to the organization's success and prioritizes actions that will help reach the goals. Sees important trends and starts discussion about how these may impact own work, the industry, or customers.

◆ Tech Savvy

title: Senior Electrical Project Engineer
description:
Job Title

Senior Electrical Project Engineer

Job Description

Are you passionate about electrical design and eager to work on advanced material handling systems for international projects? Vanderlande is looking for an Electrical Project Engineer to join our Project Engineering Department in Veghel.

As an Electrical Project Engineer, you play a key role in the complete electrical design process, from power distribution to detailed control systems. You will design, specify, and document all required electrical components, ensuring that every system is built to the highest technical and safety standards. A major part of your role involves producing control diagrams and system schematics using advanced industrial network technologies such as Industrial Ethernet, PROFINET, PROFIBUS, and AS-i bus.

You will prepare full design and drawing packages for the manufacturing of electrical enclosures, including cabling specifications, installation drawings, and assembly instructions. Your clear and detailed designs ensure smooth communication with installers and flawless system commissioning: from first connections to testing of the last I/O. To achieve this, you will work with powerful CAD tools such as EPLAN and AutoCAD, using all available functionalities to ensure accuracy and efficiency. You’ll also contribute to the development of engineering tools and methods to optimize design workflows.

Your responsibilities

  • Design and document complete electrical systems, from power distribution to control diagrams.

  • Prepare bills of materials and detailed documentation for manufacturing and installation.

  • Create and maintain control and network layouts using Industrial Ethernet, PROFINET, PROFIBUS, and AS-i bus.

  • Collaborate with mechanical and controls engineers within a multidisciplinary project team.

  • Support commissioning teams with testing and validation of the electrical installation.

  • Contribute to the continuous improvement of CAD tools and engineering processes.

Your profile

  • Vocational (MBO-4) or Bachelor’s (HBO) degree in Electrical Engineering or a related technical field.

  • 5+ years of experience in electrical system design and knowledge of industrial networks (PROFIBUS, PROFINET, AS-i bus, Industrial Ethernet).

  • Solid understanding of power distribution systems.

  • Proficiency in CAD tools such as EPLAN and AutoCAD.

  • Good command of the English language.

  • Structured, accurate, and proactive approach with strong communication skills.

For senior candidates, we additionally look for:

  • Strong domain knowledge within Airport projects

  • Experience with VI WoW (electrical engineering process)

  • High attention to detail and a proactive “doer” mentality (BLUE profile)

  • A methodical and structured approach to tasks

  • Strong communication skills and team-oriented mindset

  • Motivation for long-term commitment in the role

What do we offer?

This position offers a competitive salary range of €5.600,00 to €6.900,00 per month (excluding 8% holiday allowance). On top of your fixed salary you’ll receive the following secondary benefits:

  • 40 vacation days (20 statutory days and a flexible budget worth 20 days).

  • Flexible working hours.

  • A hybrid workplace (40% working from home and 60% in the office).

  • A Health & Wellbeing budget worth €300,- per calendar year.

  • Commuting allowance, including full reimbursement of travel by public transport.

  • Working from home allowance.

  • Collective pension scheme and discount on additional health insurance.

  • On-site company health centres with a gym, physiotherapists and occupational therapists.

  • Vanderlande Academy and training facilities to boost your skills.

  • A variety in Vanderlande Network communities and initiatives.

  • And a great company restaurant and coffee bar with barista.

Contact

If this opportunity aligns with your expertise and ambitions, we invite you to apply by submitting your CV and cover letter. For further information, please contact Fleur van den Brule, fleur.van.den.brule@vanderlande.com.

PS: Due to process compliance, we cannot process email applications. Kindly use the correct vacancy link to apply for this vacancy.

Diversity & Inclusion

Vanderlande embraces diversity in all its forms. We welcome qualified applicants regardless of race, religion, gender, sexual orientation, age, or disability status.

title: Principal Programmer Analyst
description:

Second Shift (Afternoons)
