Job Description

Join Us as a Principal Programmer Analyst – Make an Impact at the Forefront of Innovation
We have successfully supported the top 50 pharmaceutical companies and more than 750 biotechs, spanning 2,700 clinical trials across 100+ countries in the last 5 years.

As part of our expert team, you’ll have the opportunity to ensure operational excellence that makes a real difference in clinical trials. As a Principal Programmer Analyst, you will act as the lead programmer, project lead, or project oversight lead on multiple projects, overseeing the statistical and bioinformatics programming aspects of clinical trials from design through analysis and reporting. You will organize teams and implement study strategies to ensure process and programming efficiencies, and the creation and maintenance of programs for statistical report generation and program validation. You will represent the department within the company and in interactions with client companies and regulatory agencies. Additionally, you will provide training, guidance, and project leadership to junior team members.

What You’ll Do:

• Serves as a lead programmer or project lead on studies or drug programs of all complexities and size scales. Works directly with project team leaders and client representatives to conduct team meetings, develop and maintain project timelines, assess and forecast resources, and ensure adherence to study budgets and any relevant contractual obligations or limits with clients.
• Suggests, plans and provides developments to tools and techniques for improving process efficiencies. Actively contributes to process or tool improvement efforts including leadership of solution teams. Represents the department to clients on study matters, bid defenses or submission or review of clinical data to regulatory authorities, directly contributing to proposals and bids.
• May serve as company project manager on projects limited to only biometrics services.
• Provides general infrastructure support to the department, including representing the company at industry conferences, presenting/teaching at department meetings, assisting in establishing training materials, contributing to other general department documents or policies, and contributing to process improvement and department initiatives.
• Increases knowledge base and professional skills for self and junior team members if applicable, in areas including programming technology and techniques, clinical trials, and developments in the pharmaceutical industry.
• Provides feedback to managers on employee performance for employee development, performance reviews and training.
• Works to increase the visibility of the company by encouraging the publication of articles in industry journals and presentations at conferences.
• Contributes to the department recruitment/candidate interview process


Education and Experience Requirements:
• MS/MA degree in computer science, statistics, biostatistics, mathematics or related field and at least 6 years of experience that provides the knowledge, skills, and abilities to perform the job requirements, or Bachelor's degree in computer science, statistics, biostatistics, mathematics or related field or equivalent and relevant formal academic / vocational qualification, and at least 8 years of experience that provides the knowledge, skills, and abilities to perform the job requirements.
In some cases an equivalency, consisting of a combination of appropriate education, training and/or directly related experience, will be considered sufficient for an individual to meet the requirements of the role.

Knowledge, Skills and Abilities:
• Strong SAS® programming skills
• Great understanding of database structures and working with complex data structures
• Demonstrated great attention to detail
• Excellent problem solving and innovative skills
• Excellent written and verbal communication skills to facilitate communications with clients, project teams, departments and staff, including proficiency in the English language
• Capable of independently organizing, adapting and adjusting to changing priorities across multiple assignments
• Capable of working and leading in a multidisciplinary team setting
• Demonstrated positive attitude and the ability to work well with others
• Capable of coaching and mentoring others, as shown by leadership of projects
• Good understanding clinical trials, ICH Statistical and reporting guidelines and GCP
• Excellent knowledge of statistical principles applied to the design and analysis of clinical trials
• Good understanding of the requirements involved in the submission of clinical data to regulatory authorities
• Excellent project management skills, such as project budget creation, including modifying for project updates, and managing project budgets and risks
• Capable of interpreting and contributing to company policies
• Delivery and quality driven

Working Conditions and Environment:
• Work is performed in an office environment with exposure to electrical office equipment.
• Occasional drives to site locations with occasional travel both domestic and international.


Why Join Us?

When you join Thermo Fisher Scientific, you become part of a global team that values passion, innovation, and a commitment to scientific excellence. You’ll work in an environment where collaboration and development are part of the everyday experience—and where your contributions truly make a difference.
Apply today to help us deliver tomorrow’s breakthroughs.

title: Engineer, Engineering - Process (Fixed Term)
description:
Lonza is looking to hire a Process Engineer (12 months fixed term contract) to join our Process Engineering team. This is a fully site‑based role at Singapore Tuas. You will be responsible for process engineering activities that support the successful manufacture of biologics products in Lonza Singapore. As subject matter experts, maintain the interface across all supporting functions (MSAT, Automation, QA, Maintenance, OPEX, EHS) and Manufacturing to ensure seamless manufacturing of product through fit for purpose, reliable equipment design, continuous improvement of process and successful Technical Transfers.

What you will get:

  • Compensation programs that recognize high performance.

The full list of our global benefits can be found here: .

What you will do:

  • Develop and implement best practices and play a key role in improving manufacturing success rates, maintaining compliance, providing for a safe work environment and controlling costs of the manufacturing operations.

  • Supervise outside contractors to develop and implement Capital projects and plant modification.
  • Involve in new customer tech transfer and risk assessment as process SME and develop, plan & execute work necessary to ensure a successful tech transfer.
  • Perform technical review as a process SME during the revision of GMP controlled documents (e.g. SOPs, batch records, commissioning or qualification protocols).

What we are looking for:

  • Degree in Engineering disciplines or Diploma with Process Engineering experience.
  • Relevant experience in the operation and maintenance of manufacturing equipment, preferably in Biopharmaceutical or Petrochemical facilities.
  • Good understanding in process equipment design and operation.
  • Strong problem solving ability, troubleshooting and analytical skills.

title: Internal Auditor - Application Control Reviews
description:
Job Description

To conduct internal audits of moderate complexity to evaluate the effectiveness of internal controls and ensure compliance with policies and regulations. Identify risks and control gaps, provide practical recommendations to enhance operational efficiency and strengthen governance.
  • Identify development needs and address these through training and continuous professional development.
  • Proactively seek and embrace formal and informal peer coaching opportunities.
  • Execute the audit assignment within the agreed budget and timelines.
  • Ensure the constant delivery of superb value and a 'memorable' customer experience.
  • Establish and maintain collaborative partnerships and a wide relationship network across business units and within Internal Audit.
  • Respond to client needs and queries professionally and within agreed turn-around times.
  • Communicate professionally in all communication forms. Listens actively to others.
  • Negotiate with management as appropriate in order to ensure key findings and follow up actions are agreed upon.
  • Obtain a good understanding of the control environment being audited (including information technology, internal financial control and risk management related aspects), and the interdependencies linked to this.
  • Plan audit assignments based on key process and business risks identified and design the audit program in line with risks and key controls to be tested.
  • Incorporate data analytics (DA) to enhance audit planning and create efficiencies in audit fieldwork.
  • Execute audit field work in compliance with quality standards by following and completing prepared work programs. Assess the adequacy and effectiveness of governance, risk management practices and internal controls.
  • Provide clear and sufficient audit evidence to support recommendations and audit opinion.
  • Express an opinion based on the results of the work performed.
  • Identify opportunities to improve internal controls, including internal financial controls.
  • Identify and clearly articulate the root cause of issues identified and impact thereof and recommend changes to business processes that will address the control weaknesses.
  • Prepare a quality and balanced audit report to specified standards, encapsulating the control weaknesses identified and results of audit work performed, with minimal editorial changes.
  • Incorporate fundamental principles, key issues and control themes emanating from other functional areas and assurance providers to ensure relevant and appropriate audit findings.
  • Assist the Head of Internal Audit / Senior Audit Manager / Audit Manager with other operational and reporting activities as required.
  • Identify opportunities for innovation in audit as well as client processes and develop practical solutions to implement innovative practices.
  • Effective communication with the audit team, audit management and key stakeholders.
  • Is aware of the resources available and is able to utilise them to best effect with guidance from senior audit staff.
  • Keep abreast of emerging industry standards, best practices, industry challenges, upcoming legislation, operational requirements and technology changes related to the internal audit environment.
  • Participate in internal departmental work and key standing tasks such as Board, Risk and Audit Committee reporting, as requested.

title: AI Studio - Content Operations Lead (GenStudio & Firefly)
description:
Content Operations Lead, AI Studio

Job Description

The Opportunity

Adobe’s AI Studio is where the world’s leading brands bring their campaigns to life through generative AI; and behind every great campaign is an equally great production engine. As Content Operations Lead, you’ll be the operational backbone of that engine, working side by side with Creative Designers to keep projects on track, customers unblocked, and nothing falling through the cracks.

This role is for someone who can walk into an unorganized customer situation, quickly make sense of what’s needed, and get the team delivering. You’re deeply comfortable with data (like wrangling CSVs, building Excel trackers, turning raw inputs into structured outputs), and you bring the kind of can-do energy that keeps teams moving even when timelines are tight.

What You’ll Do

Drive Programs and Unblock the Team

  • Quickly assess what’s needed from a customer brief or request — even when information is incomplete or unorganized — and get the team moving.
  • Organize complex inputs from customers into clear, structured briefs and action plans that creative partners can complete immediately.
  • Proactively identify and remove blockers so Creative Designers can stay focused on the work, not the logistics.
  • Coordinate handoffs between Creative Designers, copywriters, and engagement managers to keep production on schedule.
  • Drive the team to on-time delivery, flagging risks early and pushing for resolution before they become problems.

Own Data, Workflow, and Tooling

  • Work extensively in Excel and with CSV data to manage asset tracking, reporting, and production operations at scale. Strong spreadsheet fluency is essential in this role.
  • Build, refine, and document production workflows and processes that increase team efficiency and reduce manual effort. Additionally, you will make sure they’re clearly defined and repeatable.
  • Leverage project management platforms and AI-assisted workflows to streamline operations and keep interested parties informed.
  • Find opportunities to automate repetitive production tasks and contribute to a growing library of team guidelines.

Support Creative Quality and Output

  • Partner closely with Creative Designers to organize and prepare assets, manage file structures, and ensure outputs are formatted correctly for each channel and format.
  • Bring a creative eye to production — catching inconsistencies, flagging quality issues, and helping maintain brand standards across deliverables.
  • Manage variant tracking and asset organization at scale across formats, channels, and campaign phases.

Be the Team’s Connective Tissue

  • Serve as a reliable point of contact for internal coordination, keeping interested parties informed and aligned.
  • Maintain a positive, resourceful presence that helps the team navigate competing priorities and shifting deadlines.
  • Contribute to a collaborative team culture where people feel supported and set up to do their best work.

What We’re Looking For

  • 5+ years of experience in program management, marketing operations, creative production, or a related role. Agency, in-house, or studio environments all translate well.
  • Demonstrated ability to quickly understand deliverables needed, organize ambiguous or incomplete information, and drive a team to execution.
  • Strong data fluency: you’re deeply comfortable working in Excel and with CSV files, building and maintaining complex spreadsheets, and using data to drive clarity and decisions.
  • Proven ability to define, document, and improve processes: you don’t just follow workflows, you build them.
  • A track record of unblocking teams and ensuring timely delivery in fast paced, time-sensitive environments.
  • Demonstrated ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously with strong attention to detail and follow-through.
  • A creative eye and genuine appreciation for design quality, even if you’re not the one pushing pixels.
  • Familiarity with generative AI tools and an openness to integrating them into daily work.
  • Strong communication skills: you keep people informed without over-communicating, and you know when to flag something versus just handle it.
  • A can-do attitude and the kind of steady, positive energy that makes teams want to work with you.
  • Experience in digital marketing, advertising production, or campaign operations is a plus.
  • Comfortable operating in a fast-moving environment where priorities can shift and timelines are rarely forgiving.

About Adobe

Adobe empowers everyone to create through innovative platforms and tools that unleash creativity, productivity and personalized customer experiences. Adobe’s industry-leading offerings including Adobe Acrobat Studio, Adobe Express, Adobe Firefly, Creative Cloud, Adobe Experience Platform, Adobe Experience Manager, and GenStudio enable people and businesses to turn ideas into impact, powered by AI and driven by human ingenuity.

Our 30,000+ employees worldwide are creating the future and raising the bar as we drive the next decade of growth. We’re on a mission to hire the very best and believe in creating a company culture where all employees are empowered to make an impact. At Adobe, we believe that great ideas can come from anywhere in the organization. The next big idea could be yours.


Let’s Adobe together

At Adobe, we believe in creating a company culture where all employees are empowered to make an impact. Learn more about Adobe life, including our values and culture, focus on people, purpose and community, Adobe for All, comprehensive benefits programs, the stories we tell, the customers we serve, and how you can help us advance our mission of empowering everyone to create.

Adobe is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity employer. We do not discriminate based on gender, race or color, ethnicity or national origin, age, disability, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic. Learn more.

description:

Haemme tulevaisuuden sahateollisuuden ammattilaisia toistaiseksi voimassa olevaan työsuhteeseen Alholman sahalle Pietarsaareen. Työsuhteen alussa suoritetaan kaksivuotinen oppisopimusohjelma, jolla varmistetaan työssä tarvittava osaaminen. Ohjelma käynnistyy marraskuussa 2026.

Lue lisää UPM:n oppisopimuksesta

Terveiset oppisopimusohjelmasta valmistuneelta

”Oppisopimuskoulutuksessa parasta oli hyvä yhdistelmä teoriaopintoja ja käytännön tekemistä. Oppisopimusohjelman aikana käytiin laajasti läpi sahateollisuuden työvaiheet taimen istutuksesta valmiiseen sahatavaraan. Teoriaopinnot syvensivät hyvin työssäoppimista ja ammattitaitoinen porukka teki oppimisesta helppoa ja työstä viihtyisää. Minulle oppisopimus oli selkeä ratkaisu, koska pystyin yhdistämään opiskelun ja työnteon.” – Tino, OPS-valmistunut 2024

Mitä teet

Koulutuksessa kehityt sahateollisuuden moniosaajaksi ja saat mahdollisuuden työskennellä erilaisissa tuotantotehtävissä Pietarsaaressa Alholman sahalla. Koulutus yhdistää käytännön työssäoppimisen ja lähiopetusjaksot. Koulutuksen aikana työskentelet sahateollisuuden tuotantotehtävissä ja suoritat samalla puuteollisuuden ammattitutkinnon sahateollisuuden osaamisalalta. Koulutuksen ja tutkinnon järjestää Gradia.

Oppimisen pääpaino on tuotannon sekä käyttäjäkunnossapidon tehtävissä ja työtehtävät vaihtelevat työpisteestä riippuen.

Työajat

Tuotannon moniosaajan työ on lähtökohtaisesti vuorotyötä. Sitä tehdään niin valvomoissa kuin sahan eri osastoilla kiertäen ja tuotantoprosessista huolehtien.

Kuka olet

  • Olet täysi-ikäinen ja halukas oppimaan uutta
  • Sinulla on jonkin teknisen alan ammatillinen perustutkinto tai olet hankkinut vastaavat tiedot ja taidot muulla tavoin
  • Olet aktiivinen ja haluat kehittää omaa ammattitaitoasi
  • Oma-aloitteisuus, positiivinen asenne ja vastuunottokyky ovat vahvuuksiasi
  • Teet päätöksiä sujuvasti vaihtuvissa tilanteissa ja työskentelet mielelläsi osana tiimiä

Palkka

Työtehtävän palkkaus määräytyy työtehtävän vaativuuden, henkilökohtaisen osaamisen sekä työsuorituksen mukaan. Oppisopimusopiskelijan palkkaus perustuu paikalliseen palkkausjärjestelmäsopimukseen ja kehittyy osaamisen mukaan. Tämän lisäksi henkilöstö on UPM:n kannustepalkkiojärjestelmän piirissä.

Mitä tarjoamme sinulle?

  • Turvallisuus ja hyvinvointi: Turvallisuus ja hyvinvointi ovat meille ensisijaisen tärkeitä. Välitämme jokaisesta työntekijästä ja heidän hyvinvoinnistaan. Asetamme etusijalle kaikkien työntekijöidemme turvallisuuden niin, että jokainen pääsee töistä kotiin turvallisesti.
  • Merkityksellinen työ: Teemme työmme ammattitaitoisesti ja ylpeydellä, tuottaen korkealaatuisia ja kestäviä tuotteita asiakkaillemme maailmanlaajuisesti. Yhteisömme perustuu vahvaan tiimihenkeen ja sitoutumiseen.
  • Kehittymismahdollisuudet: Tarjoamme sinulle mahdollisuuksia oppia ja kasvaa urasi aikana.
  • Huolenpito ihmisistä ja ympäristöstä: Vastuullisuus on kaiken toimintamme ytimessä. Olemme sitoutuneita kunnianhimoisiin kestävän kehityksen tavoitteisiin, ja jatkamme riman nostamista korkeammalle. Uudistetaan yhdessä arkea fossiilittoman tulevaisuuden puolesta!

title: Doctoral Researcher, Strategy and emotions
description:
At Aalto University, science and art meet technology and business. We build a sustainable future by achieving breakthroughs in our key areas and at their intersections. At the same time, we inspire the change-makers of the future and create solutions to the world’s grand challenges. Our university community comprises 16,000 students, 446 professors, and over 5,000 employees representing more than 120 nationalities. Our campus is located in Otaniemi, Espoo. Diversity is part of who we are, and we work continuously to ensure diversity and non-discrimination in our community. We therefore encourage qualified applicants from all backgrounds to join us.

Doctoral Researcher position in research on strategy and emotions

We are looking for an ambitious researcher to join a research project examining the role of emotions in strategic decision-making, strategy work, and strategy implementation.

The research group operates at the Department of Industrial Engineering and Management. The position is full-time and based in Finland. The project involves field research in both Finnish and international companies.

Students of Industrial Engineering and Management (IEM) are particularly well suited for the role. Studies in IEM and an understanding of corporate strategy, management, and operations are considered an asset.

You might be a great fit if you

  • are genuinely interested in the relationship between strategy and emotions
  • have strong qualitative research skills or motivation to develop them
  • enjoy demanding intellectual discussion and constructive critique
  • aim to publish in leading international journals in management and organization studies
  • want to work closely in a research group committed to collaboration
  • work independently, proactively, and with perseverance.

We require excellent command of English, strong communication skills, and the ability to work both independently and as part of a research team. Proficiency in Finnish is an advantage but not a requirement.

The Doctoral Researcher position

The position is particularly suitable for IEM students in the final stage of their studies as well as recent graduates.

Your Master’s thesis does not need to be completed at the time of application. However, you must have a clear and credible plan for finishing the thesis and graduating. In your application, please describe the current status of your thesis, remaining work, and your planned graduation timetable.

Applicants must hold a relevant higher university degree or be able to complete the degree before starting the position. The degree may be, for example, in Industrial Engineering and Management, strategy, organization studies, management, or another relevant field.

Previous publication experience is not required for the Doctoral Researcher position. Key selection criteria include research potential, analytical thinking, academic ambition, study performance, and the ability to carry out demanding research work over the long term.

Salary is determined according to the Finnish university salary system. The starting salary for Doctoral Researchers is 3263,32 EUR/month.

The preferred starting date is as soon as possible during 2026. The initial contract period is two years, with a mandatory mid-term evaluation during the second year. Upon a successful evaluation, the contract will be extended for a second two-year period.

Level of research ambition

The project’s academic ambition is very high. Our aim is to produce internationally excellent and genuinely novel research and to publish it in the field’s leading journals.

This requires full commitment to research, patience, and sustained effort. Research inevitably involves uncertainty, critical feedback, rejections, and the need to develop the work through multiple rounds. Acceptance rates at leading journals are often below five percent.

The research topics are closely connected to prior work on strategy and emotions. The goal is not merely to apply existing research but to significantly advance our understanding of the emotional dynamics of strategy. The research should push the frontier beyond what has already been published, for example, in Administrative Science Quarterly, Academy of Management Journal, Strategic Management Journal, and other leading journals.

Applicants are encouraged to familiarize themselves with this body of literature before preparing their application.

What we value in applicants

We particularly value a proactive approach. A strong application shows that the applicant is familiar with prior research and is able to present well-founded ideas, for example, on

  • what current research does not yet explain
  • how existing theories or research designs could be developed
  • what new research questions could be formed in the domain
  • how the applicant’s expertise could strengthen the research project.

Applicants are expected to be able to independently identify the core prior literature.

Evidence of academic excellence is also important. For Doctoral Researcher applicants, such evidence may include, for example, excellent study performance, a demanding Master’s thesis or strong indications based on a thesis in progress, experience as a research assistant, a conference presentation, an award, or other proof of research potential.

How to apply and required application materials

Apply by submitting your application through our recruitment system (“Apply now!” link) no later than 28 August 2026. Applications sent by email will not be accepted. We encourage early submission, as candidates may be invited to interviews during the application period and the position may be filled before the deadline. Please note that the position may remain unfilled if a suitable candidate is not found.

title: Senior Director, Nike Direct Digital Commerce (NDDC) Japan
description:
WHO YOU’LL WORK WITH

The Senior Director, Nike Direct Digital Commerce (NDDC), Japan sits at the center of Nike Japan’s digital offense, partnering closely with marketplace leadership, brand, merchandising, planning, finance, analytics, and digital product and creative teams. This role leads a multidisciplinary organization, reports into territory leadership, and serves as the critical bridge between global strategy and local execution—ensuring alignment while unlocking market-specific opportunity.

WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR

Nike is seeking a senior digital leader with deep expertise in the Japan market and the ability to operate with confidence on a global stage. This leader brings a clear point of view on digital commerce, marketplace management, and premium consumer experiences, paired with the discipline to translate global direction into locally resonant action. They understand the pace, scale, and cultural nuance of Japan and can influence across a complex matrix while keeping the consumer at the center of every decision.

This leader balances brand and business—elevating Nike Digital as the pinnacle expression of the brand while delivering sustained commercial performance. With a proven record of leading transformation, owning financial outcomes, and building inclusive, high-performing teams, they move fluidly between strategy and execution. Clear communication, cultural fluency, and credibility with senior stakeholders are essential for success in this role.

  • Minimum 15 years of relevant experience across digital commerce, retail, marketplace, or related leadership roles.
  • Bachelor’s degree in business, marketing, digital, or a related field.
  • Significant local market experience in Japan, with a strong understanding of Japan consumers, partners, and the operating environment.
  • Proven experience leading large, cross-functional teams and complex business transformation with full financial accountability.
  • Strong people leadership experience, including building, developing, and leading high-performing teams through coaching, talent development, succession planning, and organizational growth.
  • Demonstrated ability to coach and develop senior leaders and teams, fostering a culture of accountability, collaboration, continuous learning, and high performance.
  • Proven track record of leading large-scale organizational and business transformation efforts, with the ability to articulate and demonstrate tangible impact, change leadership, and sustainable capability building.
  • Proven experience building consumer membership ecosystems, driving acquisition, engagement, retention, and lifetime value through digital channels.
  • Champion a data-driven culture by leveraging consumer insights, experimentation, and performance analytics to drive growth and operational excellence.
  • Deep understanding of marketplace ecosystems, including owned platforms, digital partners, and omnichannel consumer journeys.
  • Bilingual proficiency in English and Japanese is preferred but not essential. In lieu of language proficiency, demonstrated knowledge of Japanese consumer insights, cultural nuances, and business environments would be considered a valuable asset.

WHAT YOU’LL WORK ON

You will lead Nike’s Digital Sport Offense in Japan, shaping how consumers experience the brand across owned and partner digital platforms. You will set the vision, drive growth, and build the capabilities that position Nike Digital as the premium consumer experience in the marketplace.

  • Set and drive the end-to-end digital commercial and engagement strategy across Nike.com, Nike App, SNKRS, and digital partners in Japan.
  • Elevate Nike Digital as the pinnacle brand expression by balancing storytelling, assortment, and service excellence.
  • Lead digital expansion, online-to-offline integration, and business-to-business digital solutions across digital platforms, stores, and partners.
  • Influence digital marketing transformation across owned communications, consumer lifecycle management, and performance media capabilities.
  • Build modern, scalable digital operations that unlock speed, efficiency, and new retail operating models.
  • Lead the evolution of the Sports Offense operating model by establishing clear accountabilities, elevating ways of working, and strengthening cross-functional operational excellence to deliver sustainable business performance and organizational effectiveness.
  • Own financial performance, including revenue growth, efficiency, market share, and contribution margin.
  • Build, lead, and develop a diverse team while fostering an inclusive culture and a strong leadership pipeline.
  • Lead Nike's Digital Sport Offense in Japan, translating consumer and sport insights into differentiated digital experiences that deepen brand engagement and accelerate growth

title: Product Enablement Lead
description:
About HUB24


At HUB24, we’re rethinking the way wealth management works, combining platform, technology and data to create better outcomes for financial professionals and their clients.

Our purpose is simple: Empower better financial futures, together.

What sets us apart is how we work. We back bold thinking, move with pace, and turn ideas into action. You’ll have the opportunity to make a real impact across your team, the business, and for the clients we support every day.

HUB24 Limited is an ASX-listed company (ASX: HUB) and part of the ASX100. We have over 1,100 employees across Australia, with offices in Sydney, Melbourne, Brisbane, Perth and the Gold Coast.


Why you’ll enjoy working here


We create an environment where you can do your best work and see the impact of it.

  • Work with smart, collaborative people who get things done.
  • Your ideas won’t sit in a backlog, they’ll be heard, tested and actioned.
  • Grow your career your way, with support to learn, stretch and explore new opportunities.

We also offer benefits to support you inside and outside of work:

  • Genuinely flexible and hybrid ways of working.
  • Employee Share Scheme.
  • Additional leave and wellbeing support.
  • Enhanced parental leave and support through different life stages.
  • Everyday benefits, including discounts and financial wellbeing support.


Why this is an exciting opportunity


We’re looking for a permanent Product Enablement Lead to help shape how our product teams work, collaborate and deliver across myhub, Engage and myprosperity. This role sits at the heart of product success, creating the frameworks, documentation, reporting rhythms and shared ways of working that help teams move with greater clarity and confidence.

You’ll be ideal for this role if you love bringing structure to complexity, creating practical tools that people actually use, and finding smarter ways for teams to share knowledge, reduce admin and turn product strategy into meaningful outcomes.

What you’ll be doing


  • Create and maintain shared templates, reporting rhythms and reusable assets that help the product team work more consistently and support a sustainable operating model.
  • Own and improve the documentation framework across the portfolio, including product guides, discovery artefacts, release updates, content standards and user-facing materials.
  • Partner with Product Managers to design reusable templates and standards for discovery, documentation, stakeholder reporting, roadmap updates and product communications.
  • Support roadmap hygiene and consistency in Productboard, ensuring opportunities, priorities and updates are clear, current and easy for different audiences to understand.
  • Help ensure important context, including product intent, trade-offs and decision rationale, is captured and carried through from discovery into delivery.
  • Contribute to a repeatable discovery practice across framing, research, synthesis and validation as the product portfolio continues to grow.
  • Improve workflows, tool use and shared artefacts to reduce avoidable coordination and administrative effort across Product, UX and delivery teams.
  • Help optimise product enablement tools such as Figma, Dovetail, Confluence and Productboard to support speed, consistency and shared understanding.
  • Coach and enable Product Managers, designers and engineers to adopt templates, standards and tools that improve the way the team works.
  • Work with the CX Designer, SMEs and Customer Success team to ensure product copy, collateral and support materials are consistent, scalable and customer-focused.


What you bring


You don’t need to tick every box, but experience in the below will set you up for success.


Experience & Skills


  • At least 5 years’ experience in Product Operations, Product Enablement, Product Management, Customer Experience, Knowledge Management or a similar discipline.
  • Experience building scalable frameworks for documentation, knowledge systems, reporting and ways of working that teams genuinely value and use.
  • Strong written communication and information design skills, with the ability to create documentation that is clear, engaging, visually intuitive and easy to navigate.
  • A customer experience mindset, with the ability to design solutions that support both internal teams and end customers.
  • A pragmatic approach to process, knowing when structure adds value and when simplicity is the better solution.
  • Confidence working across cross-functional teams and influencing stakeholders at different levels of the organisation.
  • A keen interest in how AI can improve knowledge sharing, reduce administrative overhead, surface insights and help teams work smarter.
  • Curiosity about emerging product enablement practices, tools and technologies, with a willingness to experiment and find better ways of working.
  • Strong attention to detail, balanced with a commercial and outcome-focused mindset.
  • A natural ability to bring order to complexity and create clarity in fast-moving, evolving environments.


Our process


We aim to keep the process simple and respectful of your time:

  • You’ll receive an acknowledgement after applying.
  • Our Talent team will review your application and keep you updated.
  • If shortlisted, we’ll connect to learn more about you.
  • Interviews may be virtual or in person.
  • You’ll receive an outcome and feedback.

If you need any adjustments, please let us know - we’re here to support you.


Our commitment

We’re committed to building an inclusive environment where everyone feels valued and supported to do their best work. We welcome applications from people of all backgrounds, identities and experiences.

Agencies, we work with a panel of preferred suppliers and are not accepting any unsolicited CVs.

Job Description:

III Armored Corps Hub and Spoke MTCs provide individual and collective training on Army Mission Command Systems, using a variety of tools and Army fielded systems. These systems are used to support Small Unit Training for Squads through Company, Medium Unit Training for Battalion through Brigade, and Large Unit Training for Divisions and Corps in training environments in Large Scale Combat Operations (LSCO).

  • Vendors print review.
  • Provide technical leadership to ensure that applicable procedures and standards (client, KBR and international) are correctly applied.

title: Temporary Qualitative Research Associate, Evidence for Justice Lab - McCourt School of Public Policy - Georgetown University
description:
Georgetown University comprises two unique campuses in the nation’s capital. With the Hilltop Campus located in the heart of the historic Georgetown neighborhood, and the Capitol Campus, just minutes from the U.S. Capitol and U.S. Supreme Court, Georgetown University offers rigorous academic programs, a global perspective, and unparalleled opportunities to engage with Washington, D.C. Our community is a close-knit group of remarkable individuals driven by intellectual inquiry, a commitment to social justice, and a shared dedication to making a difference in the world.

Requirements

Job Overview

The Qualitative Research Associate in the Evidence for Justice Lab at the McCourt School of Public Policy, Georgetown University supports the Lab's mission to advance the use of empirical evidence in the criminal justice system and public safety writ large. The Lab conducts interdisciplinary research on how data and evidence can be mobilized to inform more fair outcomes in criminal justice.

The Qualitative Research Associate — in a temporary role — supports the work of the Lab, with primary responsibility to provide qualitative research and administrative support across various initiatives. One key area of research is the Lab's Justice and Tech portfolio, which examines how emerging technologies (like artificial intelligence) are being deployed across the U.S. criminal justice system — including a national tracking platform mapping AI adoption across jurisdictions and a multi-city interview study exploring how communities and practitioners perceive and experience these technologies.

Duties include but are not limited to:

  • Collaborating with faculty, staff, students and community partners, and execute qualitative research activities to measure the impact of public safety-related programs and interventions.

  • Supporting qualitative research, including carrying out data collection and data analyses as well as the management of research projects.

  • Drafting qualitative research protocols and data analysis presentations, and assist in developing presentations of research findings for diverse audiences, including donors, policymakers, journalists, and academics, through reports, data visualizations, and other publications.

  • Working on programming and strategic outreach efforts as needed.

Work Interactions

The Qualitative Research Associate position reports directly to the Faculty Director of the Evidence for Justice Lab and collaborates extensively with Fellows, the Lab Manager, as well as with other Research Assistants as needed.

Requirements and Qualifications

  • Master's degree in public policy, sociology, criminology, political science, or a related social science discipline strongly preferred; bachelor's degree with significant research experience considered

  • Experience contributing to qualitative research projects, including data collection, coding, and analysis, ideally within an academic or policy research setting

  • Familiarity with qualitative data analysis software (e.g., MAXQDA, Dedoose, or NVivo); experience with qualitative coding is a plus

  • Prior experience supporting or participating in social science research, particularly qualitative studies such as interview-based or mixed-methods projects

  • Ability to read, interpret, and summarize social science research; comfort engaging with academic and policy literature

  • Familiarity with human subjects research and IRB protocols; experience working with confidential or sensitive research data is a plus

  • Strong written communication skills, including the ability to draft clear research summaries, memos, and reports for diverse audiences

  • Strong organizational and interpersonal skills; High attention to detail; ability to manage assigned tasks independently and meet deadlines in a fast-paced research environment

  • Background or demonstrated interest in criminal justice, public safety, social justice or technology policy

This position has been designated as Hybrid. Please note that work mode designations are regularly reviewed in order to meet the evolving needs of the University. Such review may necessitate a change to a position’s mode of work designation. title: Manufacturing Team Lead
description:
Job Description:

Your Impact

Leonardo is seeking an experienced and motivated Manufacturing Team Leader to provide senior leadership across manufacturing operations, compliance, and capability development within our manufacturing environment.

This is a pivotal leadership role responsible for driving operational excellence, governance, audit readiness, workforce capability, and continuous improvement. The successful candidate will play a key role in developing future manufacturing capability while ensuring compliance, performance, and operational readiness across the manufacturing hall.

If you are passionate about people leadership, lean manufacturing, continuous improvement, and delivering sustainable operational performance, we would like to hear from you.

What You'll Be Doing

Strategic & Operational Leadership

  • Lead manufacturing compliance, governance, audit readiness, documentation control, and cleanroom behavioural standards.
  • Develop and implement manufacturing strategies aligned to business objectives.
  • Act as the senior authority for Hall Compliance, ensuring adherence to PRD063 and related procedures.
  • Drive operational performance through effective leadership, governance, and execution.

People Leadership & Capability Development

  • Lead, coach and develop manufacturing teams, building a culture of accountability and continuous improvement.
  • Manage training, performance management, succession planning, and recruitment activities.
  • Develop future capability through skills planning and workforce development initiatives.
  • Promote lean manufacturing principles and high-performance behaviours.

Governance & Risk Management

  • Ensure robust governance, risk identification, and mitigation processes are embedded within operations.
  • Lead internal, customer, and regulatory audit activities.
  • Drive effective closure of audit findings and sustain audit readiness.

New Product Introduction (NPI)

  • Provide manufacturing leadership and shop-floor input into NPI programmes.
  • Support the introduction of new products, processes, facilities, and equipment.
  • Collaborate with Manufacturing Engineering, Project Management, and wider stakeholders to ensure readiness and successful implementation.

Continuous Improvement & Operational Excellence

  • Act as the Manufacturing Hall Continuous Improvement and Operational Excellence focal point.
  • Lead cross-functional improvement initiatives delivering measurable business benefits.
  • Drive Lean Manufacturing deployment across integrated project teams and operational areas.
  • Deliver improvements in Safety, Quality, Cost, Delivery and People metrics.

Financial & Capital Management

  • Support capital investment planning and delivery.
  • Manage budgets and ensure effective utilisation of resources.
  • Work with engineering and project teams to ensure investments deliver predicted capability, capacity and business benefits.

What you will bring

  • Strong understanding of manufacturing processes, principles, and operational management.
  • Proven experience leading and developing teams within a manufacturing environment.
  • Demonstrable experience within regulated manufacturing environments.
  • Strong understanding of governance, compliance, documentation control, and audit requirements.
  • Experience leading audit preparation and driving corrective and preventive actions.
  • Ability to influence and drive change across multiple functions.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with a data-driven approach.
  • Experience delivering process improvements and embedding sustainable ways of working.
  • Broad understanding of product lifecycle and manufacturing processes.
  • HND or higher qualification in an Engineering, Manufacturing, or related discipline, or equivalent relevant experience.
  • Lean Manufacturing qualification (Green Belt or equivalent).
  • Continuous Improvement or Operational Excellence accreditation.
  • Experience within aerospace, defence, electronics, or other highly regulated industries would be good but not essential

The Pima County Department of Environmental Quality is seeking an Environmental Planner to assist with moderately complex environmental planning and rules analysis. This position will assist with the Department's rule writing and rule making process including drafting environmental rules through synthesizing information provided by the respective environmental program(s) into effective and concise proposed rules language. This role will also assist Department leadership with planning rule development and implementation strategies for the Department. The Environmental Planner is expected to have the ability to conduct formal rulemakings that include meaningful public processes (i.e. stakeholder meetings, public hearings, etc.). Additionally, the selected candidate must have the ability to understand and apply environmental rules and statutes; to follow guidance documents, standard operating procedures, and other technical instructions in performance of tasks; and to summarize completed tasks and/or monitoring data orally and in written communication.

Essential Functions:

As defined under the Americans with Disabilities Act, this classification may include any of the following tasks, knowledge, skills, and other characteristics. This list is ILLUSTRATIVE ONLY and is not a comprehensive listing of all functions and tasks performed by incumbents of this class. Work assignments may vary depending on the department’s need and will be communicated to the applicant or incumbent by the supervisor.

  • Manages and supervises field operations for environmental monitoring programs, ensuring proper site maintenance, staff oversight, and adherence to safety protocols;

  • Leads and executes environmental planning and regulatory rulemaking processes to ensure compliance with federal, state, and local environmental laws;

  • Interprets and applies federal regulations, particularly EPA QA requirements under 40 CFR Parts 50, 53, and 58, to align organizational practices with compliance standards;

  • Implements and maintains quality assurance systems, including QAPPs, SOPs, and Quality Management Plans, to ensure the integrity and defensibility of environmental data;

  • Conducts data validation and assessment, performing Level II reviews, statistical analysis, and certification audits to uphold the accuracy and usability of monitoring data;

  • Provides QA oversight and guidance, reviewing operations, issuing quality control directives, and coordinating corrective actions to resolve data or procedural deficiencies;

  • Manages program logistics and resources, including procurement, equipment tracking, permitting workflows, and budgeting processes;

  • Supports staff development, overseeing training programs and offering technical assistance to promote consistent understanding and implementation of QA practices;

  • Coordinates with stakeholders, engaging public water systems, agencies, and community representatives to foster collaboration, resolve issues, and facilitate access to resources;

  • Conducts regulatory reviews and field inspections, including well siting, septic system evaluations, water sampling, and sewage investigations to protect public health;

  • Manages administrative and reporting duties, from fee invoicing and CCR reviews to system activations, exemption determinations, and participation in regional work groups and meetings.

Minimum Qualifications:

Bachelor’s degree from an accredited college or university with a major in environmental science, biology, engineering or another program-related field, as defined by the department head at the time of recruitment AND four years of professional level experience in coordinating, monitoring, administering or managing program or specialized work unit activities.


(Relevant professional level experience and/or education from an accredited college or university may be substituted.)

OR:

Two years of experience with Pima County as a Program Coordinator or other related position as determined by the department head at the time of recruitment.

Qualifying education and experience must be clearly documented in the "Education" and "Work Experience" sections of the application. Do not substitute a resume for your application or write "see resume" on your application.

Preferred Qualifications: (Be specific in describing your experience in your application. Ensure the descriptions provided illustrate your competencies, specifically addressing the required and preferred qualifications.):

  • Experience in research, evaluation and/or interpretation of federal, state and/or local environmental regulations necessary for an environmental rule making process.

  • Experience in professional writing to effectively communicate and document rule changes.

  • Experience in coordinating and hosting public meetings, hearings, and presentations for the regulated community and general public with the objective of achieving effective rulemaking changes.

  • Experience in collaborating with technical staff and/or various environmental programs to ensure proposed rules and regulations contain accurate and applicable information.

  • Experience in professional planning in environmental and/or technical programs.

Selection Procedure:
Pima County Human Resources Department reserves the right to admit to the selection process only those candidates that meet the minimum qualifications. All applications will be assessed based on an evaluation of the listed education and experience. Candidates meeting the minimum qualifications may be further evaluated/scored against any advertised Preferred Qualifications. The hiring authority will interview and select the successful candidate from a referral list provided by Human Resources. Additional assessments/testing may be required as part of the selection process.

Supplemental Information:

Licenses and Certificates: Valid driver license is required at time of application. Valid AZ driver license is required at time of appointment. The successful applicant will be subject to a 39-month DOT Motor Vehicle Record review to determine applicant’s suitability to operate county vehicles in accordance with Pima County administrative procedures. Failure to obtain and maintain the required licenses and certifications shall be grounds for termination. Any offer of employment resulting from this recruitment is contingent upon Fleet Services’ review and approval of the candidate’s driving record.

Special Notice Items: The County requires pre-employment background checks. Successful candidates will receive a post-offer, pre-employment background screening to include verification of work history, education, and criminal conviction history. A prior criminal conviction will not automatically disqualify a candidate from employment with the County.

Physical/Sensory Requirements: Physical and sensory abilities will be determined by position. Action Activity - bending, reaching, stooping; Motion Activity - grasping; Speaking Activity - in person and on the phone; Vision - operate motor vehicle, distinguish colors, have depth perception, peripheral vision.

Working Conditions: Working conditions will be determined by the position.

We are committed to an inclusive and diverse workforce and will not discriminate in employment opportunities or practices on the basis of race, color, religion, national origin, age, disability, gender, sexual orientation, kinship, political interest, or any other characteristic protected by law.

title: RF Systems Lead Engineer
description:
At MBDA, we are continuing to grow our Data Link Systems organisation, providing a world leading missile data link capability. A fantastic opportunity has arisen for an RF Systems Lead Engineer. You will be responsible for leading data link systems engineering work on a new weapons system programme, interfacing with both suppliers and customers, and providing technical leadership for junior RF systems engineers.

Salary: Circa £57,500 depending on experience

Dynamic (hybrid) working: typically 3 days per week on-site due to workload classification

Restrictions and/or limitations relating to nationality and/or rights to work may apply. As a minimum and after offer stage, all successful candidates will need to undergo HMG Basic Personnel Security Standard checks (BPSS), which are managed by the MBDA Personnel Security Team.

What we can offer you:

  • Company bonus: Up to £2,500 (based on company performance and will vary year to year)
  • Pension: maximum total (employer and employee) contribution of up to 14%
  • Overtime: opportunity for paid overtime
  • Flexi Leave: Up to 15 additional days
  • Flexible working: We welcome applicants who are looking for flexible working arrangements
  • Enhanced parental leave: offers up to 26 weeks for maternity, adoption and shared parental leave -enhancements are available for paternity leave, neonatal leave and fertility testing and treatments
  • Facilities: Fantastic site facilities including subsidised meals, free car parking and much more…
  • Healthcare Cash Plan: The Healthcare Cash Plan benefit provides the option to claim cash back on everyday healthcare expenses such as optical, dental, health and wellbeing and more.

The opportunity:

As RF system lead engineer, you will be the main Data Links technical point of contact for a weapon system project. You will be responsible for coordinating the systems engineering aspects of the project, including supporting bids, defining the system architecture, and managing development activities such as requirements management, system modelling management, and system proving plans (V&V). You will lead a small team of RF systems engineers.

What we're looking for from you:

You will have an understanding of RF technologies, and system level design considerations for RF communication system. Ideally, you will be degree qualified in a STEM subject. You will have a strong background in systems engineering across the full product life cycle together with experience of managing suppliers. Customer facing skills are also highly desirable.

We’re looking for you to have an ability to work autonomously within a multi-skilled team with a good understanding and commitment to achieving project goals. You should also be able to perform technical investigations, provide problem assessments, and propose design solutions within a culture of innovative thinking.

We are looking for some of the following skills:

  • Managing internal suppliers, and external suppliers
  • Work package management
  • Technical leadership of junior engineers
  • Systems design methodologies
  • Requirements definition and management
  • Leading design reviews across the product lifecycle
  • Overseeing the transition of development hardware into production
  • Leading technical investigations
  • Experience with proving and validation
  • Configuration management
  • Awareness of simulation tools: Architecture (SysML) / performance modelling (MATLAB)
  • Experience working within an international team
  • Understanding of RF communication principals and design

TJX is a Fortune 100 global off-price retailer with some of the world’s most recognized retail brands. Our technology teams power the systems that support stores, supply chain, digital experiences, and enterprise operations across multiple geographies.   • The opportunity to lead engineering for enterprise integration platforms that support global retail operations at scale.

Role Overview

As the IT Engineering Manager – Integration Platform Engineering Services, you will play a key leadership role in building and scaling TJX India’s integration engineering capability. You will lead talented engineers, influence enterprise integration strategy, and partner with global teams to modernize critical platforms that connect applications, data, services, and business processes across TJX. This is an opportunity for a hands-on engineering leader who enjoys developing people, solving complex technical problems, and driving reliable outcomes in a large-scale global environment.

Why This Role Matters

Integration platforms are critical to how TJX connects systems, moves data, enables business processes, and supports global retail operations. In this role, you will help shape the engineering foundation for these platforms while building a team that can deliver secure, resilient, and modern technology solutions at enterprise scale.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead, coach, and develop a team of engineers across varying levels of experience, creating an environment where people can grow, contribute, and deliver with confidence.

  • Build a strong engineering culture focused on ownership, collaboration, technical excellence, reliability, and continuous improvement.

  • Drive execution across integration platforms and modernization initiatives that support enterprise-scale business capabilities.

  • Partner with product, architecture, security, networking, store operations, and platform engineering teams to align priorities, manage dependencies, and deliver outcomes.

  • Strengthen engineering practices including secure coding, peer reviews, CI/CD quality gates, infrastructure-as-code, Definition of Done, and operational readiness.

  • Champion platform reliability through observability, staged rollouts, feature flags, rollback readiness, incident preparedness, and post-incident learning.

  • Provide technical leadership across code, Test automation, pipelines, integration patterns,, infrastructure-as-code, and distributed troubleshooting to help teams move faster.

  • Support hiring, onboarding, mentoring, and retention of strong engineering talent for TJX India’s growing technology organization.

  • Represent the platform team within the Engineering Community of Practice and contribute to broader engineering standards and reusable practices.

  • Communicate progress, risks, decisions, and outcomes clearly with engineering teams, product partners, and senior stakeholders.

Minimum Qualifications

  • 15+ years of overall technology experience, including 5+ years of people management experience.

  • Demonstrated experience leading engineering teams in integration platform, application integration, or data integration environments.

  • Strong understanding of application integration, data integration platforms, enterprise delivery practices, and modern engineering ways of working.

  • Proven ability to lead complex modernization initiatives with cross-functional dependencies, production impact, and aggressive timelines.

  • Strong communication, stakeholder management, coaching, and decision-making skills.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with integration technology stacks such as Azure APIM and Fivetran CDC ,Boomi, Apigee, Kafka, Managed File Transfer, IBM ACE, WebSphere Application Server, and DataStage.

  • Experience with SLOs, error budgets, incident management, on-call leadership, and operational readiness practices.

  • Experience with observability, monitoring, OpenTelemetry, secure enterprise delivery patterns, and high-reliability systems.

  • Exposure to cloud-native engineering, Azure, Test automation, DevOps, CI/CD, infrastructure-as-code, and platform modernization practices.

Success Measures

  • High-performing and engaged engineering team with strong ownership and delivery discipline.

  • Improved engineering consistency, reliability, automation, and modernization velocity across integration platforms.

  • Clear alignment across product, platform, architecture, security, and operations stakeholders.

description:
About this role:

Wells Fargo is seeking a Financial Control Analyst


In this role, you will:

  • Consult with the line of business and enterprise functions on financial reporting or information technology governance, and controls and oversight matters

  • Identify compliance and risk management requirements for supported area

  • Provide oversight for testing and monitoring involving moderate to complex subject matter or control areas

  • Communicate and provide consultation regularly with stakeholders throughout the enterprise

  • Implement, operate, and report results of certain elements of the company's policy, governance and oversight framework

  • Support implementation of moderate to complex projects and initiatives

  • Collaborate and consult with peers, colleagues and managers to resolve issues and achieve goals


Required Qualifications:

  • 2+ years of Finance, Accounting, Analytics, Reporting or Business and Technology Audit experience, or equivalent demonstrated through one or a combination of the following: work experience, training, military experience, education

Job Expectation:

  • Providing meaningful assessments of IT control environments impacted by financial, risk, and regulatory reporting.
  • Assessing adherence to Well Fargo & Company’s COSO based policies for IT controls impacted by internal controls over financial reporting (SEC and Regulatory Reporting) and strategic planning for ongoing IT control adherence to COSO policies (proactive anticipation of internal control related matters.
  • Monitoring new and emerging internal control related guidance and issues and assist with facilitating group-wide training to interested and impacted stakeholders.
  • Providing consultation and subject matter expertise for process and IT control related matters including evaluating severity of control deficiencies and related remediation efforts.
  • Providing process and control support and thought leadership for projects and interfacing with external auditors, regulators and others on control related matters.
  • Acting as a change agent for continual improvement of the control environment.
  • Individual will be responsible Leading the IT General Controls (ITGCs) COSO test work.
  • Partnering with IT and business Process Owners/Control Owners to document significant in-scope processes according to corporate COSO policy (both process narratives and process flow diagrams). Additionally, assessing the appropriateness and completeness of key risk and key application controls identified.
  • Performing walkthroughs of significant processes and ensure required COSO documentation is accurate and reflects relevant business risk and key application controls.
  • Partnering with IT and business Process Owners/Control Owners in the creation of process risk assessments (RAM) as well as validating and challenging risk assessment conclusions.
  • Validating and providing credible challenge to identified shared services, third party service providers, and significant applications.
  • Performing COSO testing of key IT controls, including design effectiveness assessments and operating effectiveness testing.
  • Validating and challenging documentation of application control deficiencies, including issue description, root cause, unmitigated impact and corrective actions.
  • Analyzing the severity of application control deficiencies, and their impact to internal control over financial reporting.
  • Validating corrective actions and building relationships and collaborating with key stakeholders in the applicable line of business and IT functions related to assigned process areas.
  • Assisting with projects impacting the team.

Desired Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s/ Postgraduate in Accounting, Finance or Business Administration.
  • Experience in one or a combination of the following: Finance, Accounting, Analytics, Reporting.
  • Knowledge and understanding of regulatory agencies: Federal Reserve and OCC.
  • Minimum two years at Big Four/super regional public accounting firm with experience in IT audit and/or IT SoX advisory/consulting service.
  • Prefer one or more of the following certifications: CISA, CISM, CISSP.
  • Practical experience performing IT audit/IT COSO application control testing.
  • Strong critical thinking skills with ability to credibly challenge status quo experience with continuous improvement of application control testing processes and results.
  • Strong relationship management skills; ability to negotiate difficult positions without harming relationships.

Desired Qualifications

  • Intermediate Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, Outlook, and PowerPoint) skills
  • Intermediate Microsoft Visio skills
  • A Master of Business Administration (MBA) or a Certified Public Accountant (CPA) Designation
  • Ability to prioritize, meet deadlines, and achieve goals and work under pressure in a dynamic and complex environment
  • Excellent verbal, written, and interpersonal communication skills
  • Ability to take on a high level of responsibility, initiative, and accountability.

description:

Brasil (modelo de trabalho a definir)

Por que fazer parte da equipe?

Esta é uma excelente oportunidade para profissionais analíticos que desejam transformar dados em decisões estratégicas. Você terá um papel fundamental no monitoramento e aprimoramento do desempenho dos serviços técnicos, colaborando com equipes multifuncionais e participando de iniciativas de automação, inteligência de negócios e melhoria contínua.
Nesta posição, você contribuirá diretamente para a excelência operacional, apoiando a tomada de decisão por meio de análises robustas, indicadores de desempenho e insights que geram impacto real para o negócio e para a experiência dos clientes.

O que você fará

  • Coletar, integrar e analisar dados de desempenho provenientes de diversas fontes operacionais e administrativas.

  • Desenvolver, manter e otimizar relatórios, dashboards e indicadores utilizando ferramentas de análise e visualização de dados.
  • Gerar insights e recomendações baseadas em dados para apoiar decisões operacionais e táticas.

  • Garantir a qualidade, consistência, rastreabilidade e confiabilidade das informações utilizadas em análises e relatórios.
  • Trabalhar em parceria com áreas multifuncionais para entender necessidades de negócio e transformá-las em soluções analíticas.
  • Apoiar iniciativas de melhoria contínua, eficiência operacional e automação de processos.
  • Contribuir para a implementação e adoção de novas ferramentas, metodologias e práticas de Business Intelligence.

O que você traz?

Requisitos obrigatórios

  • Graduação completa ou experiência profissional equivalente.

Além da oportunidade de atuar em um ambiente colaborativo e orientado por dados, esta função oferece a possibilidade de:
  • Participar de projetos de transformação operacional e automação.

title: Senior Scrum Master
description:
Total Number of Openings

1

The Chevron Engineering and Innovation Excellence Center (ENGINE) in Bengaluru India brings together the resources and expertise of the Chevron global network with talent in India to enhance agility and technological innovation to optimize solutions for the world’s current and future energy challenges. As one of the leading energy providers worldwide, Chevron is involved in the production of crude oil and natural gas, manufacturing of transportation fuels, lubricants, petrochemicals, and additives, and the development of enabling technologies.

Chevron's vision is to be the global energy company most admired for its people, partnerships, and performance. With a clear purpose to develop affordable, reliable, ever-cleaner energy that enables human progress, we believe human ingenuity has the power to solve any challenge and overcome any obstacle. Meeting the world’s growing energy needs requires the pursuit of innovations and advancements that deliver a better future for all.

About the position:

Role Summary

The Senior Scrum Master is responsible for leading one or more Agile teams in delivering business value through the effective application of Scrum, Agile, Lean, and SAFe principles. The role acts as a servant leader, Agile coach, facilitator, and change agent who enables teams to achieve high performance, remove impediments, improve predictability, and continuously enhance delivery outcomes. The Senior Scrum Master partners closely with Product Owners, Engineering Leads, Solution Architects, Release Train Engineers (RTEs), and business stakeholders to ensure successful program execution.

Key Responsibilities

Agile Delivery Leadership

  • Facilitate all Agile ceremonies including Sprint Planning, Daily Stand-ups, Sprint Reviews, Retrospectives, Backlog Refinement, and PI Planning.

  • Ensure Agile and SAFe practices are consistently applied across teams.

  • Enable teams to deliver committed business value within agreed timelines.

  • Support release planning and delivery governance activities.

Agile Coaching & Continuous Improvement

  • Coach teams, Product Owners, and stakeholders on Scrum, Kanban, Lean, and SAFe frameworks.

  • Drive Agile maturity and foster a culture of continuous improvement.

  • Promote team self-organization, accountability, and cross-functional collaboration.

  • Mentor junior Scrum Masters and contribute to Agile transformation initiatives.

Impediment & Dependency Management

  • Identify, track, escalate, and remove delivery blockers and impediments.

  • Facilitate dependency management across teams, programs, and Agile Release Trains (ARTs).

  • Lead Scrum of Scrums and support cross-team coordination.

  • Mitigate risks that could impact delivery commitments.

Stakeholder & Program Coordination

  • Collaborate with Product Owners to maintain a healthy and prioritized backlog.

  • Partner with Architecture, Engineering, QA, and Product teams to align priorities.

  • Ensure transparency of work through Agile management tools and reporting.

  • Communicate delivery progress, risks, and key metrics to stakeholders.

Metrics & Team Performance

  • Track and analyze team velocity, throughput, predictability, cycle time, and other Agile KPIs.

  • Drive improvements in delivery performance and team effectiveness.

  • Ensure all work is visible through Azure DevOps, Jira, or equivalent tools.

  • Monitor team health and engagement metrics.

Mandatory Skills:

  • Strong Agile, Scrum, and SAFe expertise

  • Agile coaching, facilitation, and servant leadership

  • Stakeholder management and cross-team coordination

  • Risk, dependency, and impediment management

  • Delivery metrics and Agile reporting

  • Azure DevOps, Jira, and Confluence proficiency

Experience

  • 8 -12 years of overall IT delivery experience.

  • 8+ years of Scrum Master experience supporting Agile teams.

  • Experience working with distributed and cross-functional teams.

  • Experience leading multiple Agile teams and supporting large-scale Agile programs.

Certifications

  • Certified Scrum Master (CSM) or Professional Scrum Master (PSM)

  • SAFe Scrum Master (SSM) preferred

  • SAFe Advanced Scrum Master (SASM) desirable

Preferred Technical Knowledge

  • Azure DevOps

  • Jira & Confluence

  • CI/CD and DevOps practices

  • Cloud technologies (Azure preferred)

  • Agile Reporting and Dashboarding

What we can offer you

Everything we do at Chevron is guided by our values and our commitment to The Chevron Way.

Have the opportunity to take part in world-leading energy projects, advance your professional development and expand your career within an inclusive and collaborative workplace.

  • Join a workplace where innovation, collaboration and safety are at the core of how we work.

  • Work in thoughtfully designed environments that support focus, well-being, and innovation enhanced by digital tools that enable seamless collaboration.

  • Grow through structured learning, mentorship, and opportunities to contribute to impactful projects that align with Chevron’s values and business priorities.

  • Access comprehensive benefits that support your health, well-being, and work-life balance.

  • Engage with emerging technologies and digital solutions that are shaping the future of energy and enterprise.

How to apply

To be a part of our success, click APPLY to submit your application. Chevron regrets that it is unable to sponsor employment Visas or consider individuals on time-limited Visa status for this position.

Privacy and Terms and Conditions

We respect the privacy of candidates for employment. This Privacy Notice sets forth how we will use the information we obtain when you apply for a position through this career site. If you do not consent to the terms of this Privacy Notice, please do not submit information to us.

Please access the Global Application Statements, select the country where you are applying for employment. By applying, you acknowledge that you have read and agree to the country specific statement.

Terms of Use

“ENGINE” refers to the Chevron Engineering and Innovation Excellence Center, which operates under Chevron Global Technology and Services Private Limited, an affiliate of Chevron Corporation. References to ENGINE in this document are for convenience only and do not denote a separate legal entity.

This job advertisement is intended to provide a general overview of the role and workplace environment. Role details and outcomes may vary based on business needs and individual performance.


Chevron ENGINE supports global operations, supporting business requirements across the world. Accordingly, the work hours for employees will be aligned to support business requirements. The standard work week will be Monday to Friday. Working hours are 8:00am to 5:00pm or 1.30pm to 10.30pm.
