For us, impact isn't a perk. It's the driver of our work. We are guided and rewarded by a shared desire to make the world a better place, one innovative solution at a time. Our colleagues make it their job to do impactful things and they love doing it in good company. Do you?

The Mission

The NFR Hubs Romania team is an integral part of ING’s Non-Financial Risk domain. The team is responsible for ensuring consistent implementation of NFR frameworks, policies, and procedures, while fostering a collaborative and high-performing environment within the hubs.

The Data Risk NFR Specialist is part of the Center of Expertise (CoE) Data Management Risk team within the Non-Financial Risk (NFR) domain. This team focuses on identifying, managing, and mitigating risks related to data governance, data risk, data quality, data integrity, and data privacy, guiding policy setting and RAS metrics for data-related risks, supporting ING’s global risk management objectives.

The role will report hierarchically to the Lead of Information & Technology Risk in Hubs Romania and functionally to Global Lead of ITR Team II located in Amsterdam, The Netherlands.

Your day to day

  • Helps identify, measure, and reduce risks connected to data management and related technologies;

  • Assists in analyzing events and incidents to find weaknesses in how data is managed and in IT systems;

  • Supports the creation and review of data management policies to help ensure compliance with regulations;

  • Monitors the implementation of controls and remediation plans, and helps challenge risk acceptance decisions;

  • Participates in independent risk assessments and reviews how effective controls are;

  • Helps review incident response reports and root cause analysis findings;

  • Assists in reviewing and reporting Key Risk Indicators (KRIs);

  • Supports NFR teams with data risk analysis, oversight, and reporting activities;

  • Provides input to senior management on data management risks and possible mitigation steps;

  • Keeps up to date with new data risk regulations and industry best practices.

Specific Tasks

  • Assist with analyzing data management events and incidents to help identify risks and improvement areas;

  • Support the development and review of data management policies to ensure they meet regulatory requirements;

  • Help monitor risk controls and track the progress of remediation plans;

  • Participate in independent risk assessments and help review the effectiveness of controls;

  • Contribute to the review of incident response reports and root cause analysis findings;

  • Help review and update Key Risk Indicators (KRIs) for data management;

  • Provide support to NFR teams with oversight and reporting activities related to data risk;

  • Offer input to senior management and 1LoD teams regarding potential data risk mitigation steps.

What you’ll bring to the team

  • University/Post Graduate (Master’s) Degree;

  • 3+ years’ experience in data management risk roles, ideally within CDO, CISO or 2LoD departments;

  • Knowledge of data management frameworks, methods, and data protection;

  • Affinity with data management technologies, platforms, and tools;

  • Basic understanding of relevant regulations (e.g. BCBS239, GDPR).

description:
Drivs du av att se dina idéer bli verklighet? Välkommen till vår spännande och teknikintensiva värld.

Din roll

Vi söker en Cloud Site Reliability Engineer som vill kombinera mjukvaruutveckling, automatisering och systemdrift för att skapa robusta och skalbara molnplattformar. Här får du arbeta med teknik som är central för våra digitala lösningar och bidra till att våra plattformar är stabila, säkra och tillgängliga över tid.

Som Cloud Site Reliability Engineer blir du en del av Cloud & Infrastructure inom Core Development Platform. Teamet utvecklar och förvaltar gemensamma moln- och IT-plattformstjänster inom Saab Surveillance.

I rollen arbetar du i gränslandet mellan utveckling och drift med fokus på stabilitet, automation och kontinuerliga förbättringar. Du arbetar med våra hybrida molnmiljöer och bidrar till att minska manuellt arbete genom automatisering, samtidigt som du säkerställer hög tillgänglighet, prestanda och säkerhet.

Dina huvudsakliga arbetsuppgifter inkluderar:

• Utveckla, driftsätta och vidareutveckla plattformar baserade på Kubernetes, OpenStack och Ceph

• Automatisera infrastruktur och deployment med Infrastructure as Code och CI/CD

• Utveckla och övervaka robusta och skalbara nätverkslösningar

• Arbeta med incidenthantering, analys, post-mortems och kapacitetsplanering

• Administrera och vidareutveckla Linux-baserade system, exempelvis OpenStack-kontrollplan, worker-noder och Ceph-kluster

• Bidra till observability, monitorering och kontinuerliga förbättringar av plattformens stabilitet och prestanda

Din profil

Vi söker dig som har erfarenhet av Site Reliability Engineering, Platform Engineering eller liknande roller och som trivs med att arbeta nära både utveckling och drift. Du har en bred teknisk förståelse och är van vid att arbeta med komplexa plattformsmiljöer där automatisering, säkerhet och stabilitet står i fokus.

Du har ett genuint intresse för AI och ny teknik, och drivs av att utforska hur dessa verktyg kan användas för att utveckla både våra lösningar och våra arbetssätt. Du är nyfiken, lösningsorienterad och initiativtagande, tycker om att samarbeta och dela kunskap.

Vi tror att du har erfarenhet av flera av följande områden:

• Kubernetes, OpenStack och Ceph

• AWS och hybrida molnmiljöer

• Linux och nätverk

• Infrastructure as Code och CI/CD

• Observability och monitorering

• DevSecOps och automatiserad säkerhetsskanning

• Security hardening av infrastruktur och plattformar

Det är meriterande om du har erfarenhet av att ta ett tekniskt ledarskap och driva frågor tillsammans med tvärfunktionella team.

Befattningen kräver att du genomgår och godkänns enligt vid var tid gällande bestämmelser för säkerhetsskydd. För befattningar där Saab har krav på säkerhetsklassinplacering kan, i förekommande fall, medföra krav på visst medborgarskap.

Vad du blir en del av

Upptäck oändliga möjligheter. Anta utmaningar, skapa smarta innovationer och uppgradera dina förmågor. Det här är en plats för kluriga tänkare, modiga pionjärer och alla däremellan. Tillsammans uppnår vi det extraordinära, var och en tar med sitt unika perspektiv. Varje bidrag räknas.

Saab är ett ledande försvars- och säkerhetsföretag med uppdrag att hjälpa nationer att skydda sin befolkning och bidrar till trygghet för människor och samhällen. Med 26,100 talangfulla medarbetare utvecklar Saab teknik och lösningar för en säkrare och mer hållbar värld.

Saab utvecklar, tillverkar och underhåller avancerade system inom flygteknik, vapen, ledningssystem, sensorer och undervattenssystem. Saab har sitt huvudkontor i Sverige men en global verksamhet där Saab är en del av många nationers försvarsförmåga. Läs mer om oss här

Department - Information Technology

Job Description

OPEN TO CURRENT PIMA COUNTY EMPLOYEES ONLY

Pay Range

The Information Technology Department(ITD) is seeking a Senior Business Systems Analyst (BSA II) to be a member of our Customer Service Delivery Model and join a team of BSAs supporting Public Works departments of Pima County. This role involves close cooperation and coordination across the entire IT Department, with particular focus working with technical and non-technical resources in the analysis of processes, communication across IT and to non-technical users and leadership in the implementation of processes or applications.

The successful candidate will be:

  • Self-motivated

  • Thorough, with attention to detail

  • Enthusiastic

  • Always learning

  • Able to work effectively with technical specialists, business specialists, and customers.

ITD offers an opportunity to utilize your skills, grow new ones, work in a team environment and advance your career. You bring energy, enthusiasm, professionalism and a desire to get better every day, as well as to make a difference in your community by supporting the mission of Pima County government.

This is an in-office position located in Tucson, AZ, and cannot be remote. The Information Technology Department is unable to provide visa sponsorship for this position.

Essential Functions:

  • As defined under the Americans with Disabilities Act, this classification may include any of the following tasks, knowledge, skills, and other characteristics. This list is ILLUSTRATIVE ONLY and is not a comprehensive listing of all functions and tasks performed by incumbents of this class. Work assignments may vary depending on the department’s need and will be communicated to the applicant or incumbent by the supervisor.

  • Researches and documents the technical tools (hardware and software) that enable business operations for multiple departments and/or elected officials;

  • Serves as a team member to deliver technical solutions on larger projects and/or for multiple departments.


Minimum Qualifications:


Four (4) years of experience in business process analysis or computer hardware, software or database development, maintenance, or testing.


(Relevant professional level experience and/or education from an accredited college or university may be substituted.)


OR:


One (1) year of experience in a Pima County Business Systems Analyst I or related classification as determined by the department head at the time of recruitment.

Qualifying education and experience must be clearly documented in the "Education" and "Work Experience" sections of the application. Do not substitute a resume for your application or write "see resume" on your application.

  • Experience gathering and documenting requirements.

  • Experience with/knowledge of the analysis of current business processes, development and documentation of new business processes, gaining acceptance of the new or modified business process, and implementing revised and new business processes.

  • Experience working in an environment with multiple customers, both internal and external to their organization, who have a wide range of complex business requirements in an IT context.

Candidates meeting the minimum qualifications may be further evaluated/scored against any advertised Preferred Qualifications. Additional assessments/testing may be required as part of the selection process.

Failure to obtain and maintain the required licenses and certifications shall be grounds for termination. Any offer of employment resulting from this recruitment is contingent upon Fleet Services’ review and approval of the candidate’s driving record.

Now, Domain has joined forces with CoStar Group (NASDAQ: CSGP), a global leader in real estate information, analytics, and online marketplaces to take the next big leap in property technology and data innovation.

# Job Title: CI/CD Engineer / DevOps Engineer

## Job Summary

We are seeking a highly motivated CI/CD Engineer to design, develop, and maintain scalable automation frameworks and continuous integration/continuous deployment (CI/CD) pipelines. The ideal candidate will have strong expertise in build systems, automation, source code management, artifact repositories, and software quality/security scanning tools. This role requires close collaboration with development, QA, and release teams to streamline software delivery processes and improve engineering productivity.

* Integrate artifact management solutions using JFrog Artifactory.

* Experience working with C++ build environments.

* Hands-on experience with CMake and Conan.

* Exposure to Rust build ecosystem and package management.

* Ability to understand, debug, and optimize complex build systems.

### Artifact & Package Management

* Experience with JFrog Artifactory or similar artifact repository solutions.

* Knowledge of package management and artifact lifecycle management.

### Code Quality & Security Scanning

Experience with one or more of the following tools:

* Coverity

* SonarQube

* Black Duck

* Trivy

Responsibilities include:

* Static code analysis

* Open-source vulnerability scanning

* Container image scanning

* Software composition analysis (SCA)

* Security and compliance enforcement within CI/CD pipelines

### Version Control

* Strong knowledge of Git and GitHub.

* Understanding of branching strategies, pull request workflows, and release management.

## Preferred Qualifications

* Experience working in Agile/Scrum development environments.

* Familiarity with Linux administration and troubleshooting.

* Experience with containerization technologies such as Docker.

* Knowledge of cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP) is a plus.

title: CNC Programmer
description:
CNC Programmer

Location - Isando
Work Arrangement - Onsite

What we do at Weir
We are a global leader in mining technology for a sustainable future. We help our customers extract the resources the world needs more efficiently and more sustainably. Our planet’s future depends on the transition to renewable energy, and that transition can only happen with the metals and minerals our customers deliver. So, we work side by side with mines across the globe to move less rock, use less energy, use water wisely, and create less waste. Together, we drive the shift to smart, efficient, and more sustainable mining.

Make your impact
You’ll play a key role in solving real-world challenges. You’ll apply your skills to deliver results that matter whether that’s through engineering, planning or customer support. You’ll work with purpose, learn every day and help shape a more sustainable future.

What you’ll do
• Programming and Production:Ensure day-to-day programming of CNC machines including new parts, projects, and cost per component initiatives. Develop and improve machining methods and set up sheets to optimize production efficiency. Assist machinists with troubleshooting on the shop floor.
• Quality Assurance:Maintain built-in quality and standards within the machine shop by programming and set ups with error-proofing in mind. Investigate quality issues and implement improvements to enhance machine shop quality and on-time delivery.
• Lean Manufacturing and Cost Reduction:Support lean management initiatives by reviewing tooling usage and collaborating with tooling suppliers to achieve the best cost per component. Optimize programs to improve equipment effectiveness and reduce costs.
• Industrialization and Innovation:Lead industrialization of new parts and involvement in smart manufacturing initiatives. Drive innovation and continuous improvement within the machine shop to reduce delays and improve overall performance.
• Safety First:Demonstrate 100% commitment to our zero harm behaviors in support of our drive towards developing a world-class safety culture. Maintain safety of all systems and processes, follow health and environmental procedures, and ensure safe handling of materials.
• Travel Requirements:Minimal travel expected; primarily onsite presence required to support machine shop operations and supplier collaboration.

What you’ll bring


Must-haves:
• 3-5 years CNC programming experience on Fanuc and Mazatrol, including up to 5 axis programming
• Experience with horizontal and vertical CNC boring mill machines and CNC lathes
• Qualified Fitter and Turner / Tool and Die Maker with advanced CNC programming course completion
• Proficiency in CAD/CAM software such as NX CAM, Edge CAM, MasterCAM, and Mazak CAM

Nice-to-haves:
• Exposure to and implementation of lean manufacturing principles
• Experience with OHSAS 18001 and ISO 14001 standards
• Strong computer literacy including MS Office Suite
• Experience in smart manufacturing and digital tooling systems

Why join Weir?
We live our values we think safety first, do the right thing, respect each other, aim high, and delight our customers. We encourage our people to lead by example and celebrate our successes.
We’re passionate about our purpose to help deliver the natural resources that are essential to create a better future for the world. We do this by combining our deep customer insights, world-class engineering, materials science expertise, and intelligent automation to deliver innovative end-to-end solutions incorporating our signature technologies.
We believe your voice matters and your ideas make a difference. We’re working hard to nurture a diverse culture where our people feel like they belong and can do the best work of their lives. You can help shape our unique culture through our inclusion networks and safety initiatives.

Benefits
• Competitive pay
• Career development and learning support
• Access to global inclusion networks
• Regional and team-specific benefits
• Sharebuilder scheme
• Wellness support for you and your family
• Collaboration with global teams
• Study support

description:

About the Opportunity

We employ the UK's most experienced and skilled technical services professionals and has grown to over 8,000 people in locations across the UK - we provide the resources to turn great ideas into reality, and we offer capable and committed individuals the opportunity to shape their careers how they wish.

We are recruiting for an experienced Project Manager to join our Nuclear Power Engineering and Technical Services team supporting our key client EDF Energy Nuclear Generation with their nuclear fleet in the UK.

This is a key role within our project and engineering portfolio which is spread across our UK network at all UK sites and stations. You will be supported and mentored by experienced project engineering management professionals within the team and given the training and opportunities you need to develop and expand your project engineering management and leadership skills with larger and more complex projects.

This role will be based at EDFs Heysham Power Station location, since 1988 Heysham has generated 295TWh of zero carbon electricity which is the equivalent of enough power to every home in Lancashire for 144 years, or like taking every car off the UK's roads for 18 months.

You will be accountable to the client Project Manager, Programme Manager and/or Construction Manager. Flexible working arrangements between office and home may be possible, however the role will predominantly be based at the Power Station.

Key responsibilities will be:

  • Project Managers are accountable to the client PPM for successful delivery of all aspects of their assigned projects. The Project Manager sets the project execution strategy in agreement with the client PPM and uses a cross-functional project team to deliver the project safely in line with company policies and procedures, achieving established goals and objectives within the agreed baseline. This role has no direct reports.
  • The role will be based at EDF Heysham Power Station and will require occasional business travel to other UK sites/stations. In this role you will report to our company Operations Manager but be accountable for project delivery directly to the client.
  • Everyone working in our team will have a proven track record of working within highly regulated environments with high safety standards and culture.
  • Good communication and organisational skills are a must with the ability to develop relationships and maintain effective networks and be results-focused tempered with a team-centred approach.

Education, Experience and Skills:

  • Degree educated, ideally in engineering or a related subject.
  • APMP formal project management qualification or equivalent and versed in modern project management techniques within complex, multi-functional organisations; have a thorough understanding and knowledge of engineering, design, procurement, safety case, construction and installation/commissioning management and commercial contracting.
  • Able to demonstrate an understanding of Safety Cases including how they are developed and implemented, relevant Health and Safety and Environment legislation including CDM and the actions required to achieve compliance
  • Good understanding of the needs of quality and how quality is assured and controlled along with relevant experience of commercial, contractual, and financial project drivers.
  • Demonstrable experience of managing projects throughout the full project lifecycle, ideally across a range of complex multi-discipline projects and environments, and management of an integrated project team including staff, agency and assigned functional support.
  • Experience of estimating, cost control, planning and commercial awareness including the preparation of business cases and sanction/ funding papers.
  • Experienced in the preparation of reports and information using packages such as Word, Excel and PowerPoint, be proficient in the use of estimating, scheduling, programming and risk tools and in the use of Earned Value tools. Analytical approach with high-level problem-solving ability.

Our Culture

Our values stand on a foundation of safety, integrity, inclusion and diversity. We put people at the heart of our business, and we genuinely believe that we all succeed by supporting one another through our culture of caring. We value positive mental health and a sense of belonging for all employees.

We aim to embed inclusion and diversity in everything we do. We know that if we are inclusive, we’re more connected, and if we are diverse, we’re more creative. We accept people for who they are, regardless of age, disability, gender identity, gender expression, marital status, mental health, race, faith or belief, sexual orientation, socioeconomic background, and whether you’re pregnant or on family leave. This is reflected in our wide range of Global Employee Networks centered on inclusion and diversity.

description:
Job Summary:

JOB DESCRIPTION – Call Centre Agent (Part-time)

Location: Athens, Greece

Division: Ticketermaster

Line Manager: Angeliki Armatolou

Contract Terms: Part-time, permanent

THE TEAM

The Call Centre team is responsible for delivering a high-quality, timely and helpful experience for Ticketmaster customers. The team supports fans across a range of channels, including phone, email, help desk and social media, assisting with ticket purchases, event information, account queries and issue resolution.

THE JOB

The call centre agent answers incoming calls from customers to complete orders/selling tickets, answer inquiries and questions, handle complaints, troubleshoot problems and provide information. Satisfying customers' needs and at the same time maintaining the good reputation of the company are the major call center agent’s responsibilities.

WHAT YOU WILL BE DOING

  • Managing large amounts of inbound calls in a timely manner
  • Following call center “scripts” when handling different topics
  • Handling customer inquiries both by telephone and email
  • Responding in writing to requests from help desk (Zendesk) & social media
  • Researching required information using available resources (websites, manuals etc) etc.
  • Managing and resolving customer complaints
  • Providing customers with information
  • Entering new customer data into system
  • Updating existing customer data in order to maintain call centre (Call Center) database
  • Processing orders
  • Identifying and promoting priority issues to the Account Management team
  • Routing calls to appropriate resource
  • Following up customer calls where is necessary
  • Documenting all call information according to standard operating procedures
  • Other tasks as may be directed by the Line Manager or Supervisor

WHAT YOU NEED TO KNOW (or TECHNICAL SKILLS)

  • 1 year experience on Call Center/Customer Service
  • Deep knowledge of Ticketmaster (Tickethour) technology to enable support customers
  • Proficient in MS Office products and call centre (Call Center) equipment/software programs
  • Strong attention to detail
  • Flexibility and adaptability as you will be dealing every day with different personalities
  • Customer Focus, Customer Service, Data Entry Skills, Listening, Phone Skills, Problem Solving
  • Bachelor's degree in Customer Service or a related field (desired)

YOU (BEHAVIOURAL SKILLS)

  • Outstanding verbal communication skills along with active listening
  • Ability to multi-task, set priorities and manage time effectively


LIFE AT TICKETMASTER

We are proud to be a part of Live Nation Entertainment, the world’s largest live entertainment company.

Our vision at Ticketmaster is to connect people around the world to the live events they love. As the world’s largest ticket marketplace and the leading global provider of enterprise tools and services for the live entertainment business, we are uniquely positioned to successfully deliver on that vision.

We do it all with an intense passion for Live and an inspiring and diverse culture driven by accessible leaders, attentive managers, and enthusiastic teams. If you’re passionate about live entertainment like we are, and you want to work at a company dedicated to helping millions of fans experience it, we want to hear from you.

Our work is guided by our values:

Reliability - We understand that fans and clients rely on us to power their live event experiences, and we rely on each other to make it happen.

Teamwork - We believe individual achievement pales in comparison to the level of success that can be achieved by a team

Integrity - We are committed to the highest moral and ethical standards on behalf of the countless partners and stakeholders we represent

Belonging - We are committed to building a culture in which all people can be their authentic selves, have an equal voice and opportunities to thrive

EQUAL OPPORTUNITIES

We are passionate and committed to our people and go beyond the rhetoric of diversity and inclusion. You will be working in an inclusive environment and be encouraged to bring your whole self to work. We will do all that we can to help you successfully balance your work and homelife. As a growing business we will encourage you to develop your professional and personal aspirations, enjoy new experiences, and learn from the talented people you will be working with. It's talent that matters to us and we encourage applications from people irrespective of their gender, race, sexual orientation, religion, age, disability status or caring responsibilities.

HIRING PRACTICES

description:

title: Senior Desktop Engineer
description:
It's fun to work in a company where people truly BELIEVE in what they're doing!

The Senior Desktop Engineer is a senior, hands‑on EUC specialist responsible for the stability, standardisation, and on‑site delivery of end‑user workspace services. The role provides advanced 2nd/3rd line desktop support, executes workstation build and IMACD activities, and delivers site‑level operational support including printing, meeting rooms, endpoint compliance, and CMDB accuracy. It also performs network and server room upkeep and provides local hands‑and‑feet support to Network Engineers to accelerate fault resolution and device replacement.

WHAT YOU WILL DO:

Desktop & Endpoint Engineering

•Act as 2nd/3rd line escalation for desktop and endpoint incidents and requests.

•Maintain and restore devices to the approved standard configuration following incidents or rebuilds.

•Support OS upgrades, OEM driver and firmware updates, and endpoint compliance activities.

•Perform preventative maintenance during support interactions and reduce repeat incidents.

Workstation Build, IMACD & Data Handling

•Execute physical and logical workstation installs and replacements.

•Deliver IMACD activities (install, move, add, change, decommission) as part of BAU.

•Perform user data transfers during device replacement and rebuilds.

•Enforce data storage policy and correct network drive mappings before risky activities.

Printing, Meeting Rooms & Peripheral Support

•Provide 1st line printing support (including label printers and MFP user support) and coordinate vendor escalations.

•Deliver 1st line meeting room and AV/VC support, including proactive checks where required.

•Provide first line support for handheld scanning devices where deployed.

Connectivity, Mobility & VDI (Endpoint Side)

•Support workstation related connectivity (Wi Fi, VPN, broadband up to wall socket level).

•Support VDI / thin client environments from an endpoint perspective.

Endpoint Security – Hands & Feet

•Ensure endpoint protection is present during builds, reinstalls, and imaging.

•Provide hands and feet support for workstation security issues (AV failures, encryption, WMI repair) where remote remediation fails.

CMDB & Documentation

•Update CMDB records during commissioning, decommissioning, and incident restoration (including required scan inputs).

•Maintain site level documentation and runbooks to support auditability and repeatability.

Network & Server Room Support

•Perform basic upkeep and inspections of network and server rooms at assigned sites.

•Provide local hands and feet support to Network Engineers, including:

•On site troubleshooting assistance

•Replacement of switches, routers, and Wi Fi devices

•Physical checks, racking, patching, and post swap validation

WHAT YOU WILL BRING TO THE TABLE:

Key attributes and competencies

·Strong hands‑on expertise in enterprise desktop and endpoint environments.

·Proven experience with workstation builds, IMACD, and user data migration.

·Practical understanding of site infrastructure operations and network device handling.

·Ability to operate independently as a site senior EUC authority.

·High operational discipline, strong documentation skills, and customer focus.

·Windows OS, Microsoft 365, Active Directory, Group Policy

·Endpoint management tooling (SCCM, Intune, MDM)

·Hardware support (laptops, docking stations, peripherals)

·Networking fundamentals (DNS, DHCP, VPN, Wi‑Fi)

·Solid practical knowledge of:

·Windows desktop operating systems

·Enterprise endpoint environments

·Site infrastructure basics (network rooms, cabling, power)

Experience and Qualifications

·Relevant IT Diploma or Degree (preferred).

·Microsoft desktop / endpoint certifications

·Microsoft (MD‑102, MS‑102, legacy MCSA)

·ITIL Foundation

Endpoint or mobility certifications (optional but preferred)

title: Product Manager – Savings Transformation
description:
Help simplify and future-proof ING’s Savings landscape. As Product Manager, you drive the controlled decommissioning of a legacy employee-facing Savings application and related integration services, while enabling the move towards modern APIs and target-state solutions. This is a role for a Product Manager who can turn complexity into clarity: protecting critical assisted Savings journeys today while helping build a cleaner, more resilient architecture for tomorrow.

The team

You work at the intersection of business, IT, architecture, operations, risk and dependent domains within the Savings area. The team focuses on keeping key customer journeys reliable while phasing out legacy components that support assisted Savings flows such as opening, changing, closing and managing savings agreements. You act as the linking pin across teams, aligning priorities, dependencies and decisions so migration work progresses in a controlled, compliant and value-driven way.

Roles and responsibilities

In this role, you translate business priorities and target architecture into a clear roadmap and backlog, while safeguarding continuity during migration.

  • Own and manage the backlog for decommissioning the legacy assisted-channel Savings application and migrating integration services to modern APIs.
  • Define a roadmap aligned with business priorities, IT capacity, architecture direction and regulatory timelines.
  • Translate complex business and technical requirements into epics, features and user stories that teams can deliver.
  • Prioritise work based on customer impact, business value, risk reduction, dependencies and decommissioning timelines.
  • Drive the phased migration towards target APIs and future-proof solutions, including redesign of impacted customer journeys and business flows.
  • Coordinate analysis of impacted services, queues, consumers, processes and operational dependencies, ensuring they are assessed and migrated where needed.
  • Align with architects and engineers to move from current-state analysis to approved target designs and forward engineering.
  • Manage stakeholders by communicating progress, risks, dependencies, decisions and required support clearly.
  • Support sprint planning, refinement, acceptance, release preparation, testing and decommissioning readiness.
  • Identify delivery, operational, customer, compliance and security risks early and define practical mitigation actions.

How to succeed

We hire smart people like you for your potential. Our biggest expectation is that you’ll stay curious. Keep learning. Take on responsibility. In return, we’ll back you to develop into an even more awesome version of yourself.

  • You bring 5+ years of experience as a Product Manager, Business Product Owner, Customer Journey Expert or similar role, helping teams deliver change in a complex IT environment.
  • You have experience with legacy system decommissioning, API migration, platform transformation or large-scale technology change, so you can guide migration choices with confidence.
  • You understand customer journeys, business processes, system integrations, APIs and enterprise architecture, enabling you to connect business impact with IT delivery.
  • You create clarity in complex environments by defining scope, ownership, decisions and next steps across multiple teams and domains.
  • You communicate clearly with senior stakeholders, architects, engineers, operations and risk partners, translating technical topics into business language.
  • You combine analytical thinking with pragmatism, helping teams balance migration momentum with operational stability, compliance and security.
  • You are fluent in English; Dutch language skills are an advantage.
  • Experience in banking, financial services, regulated environments, assisted-channel banking or decommissioning governance is a plus.

Rewards and benefits

We want to make sure that it’s possible for you to strike the right balance between your career and your private life. Find out more about our employment conditions. The benefits of working with us at ING include:

  • 25-28 vacation days depending on contract
  • Pension scheme
  • 13th month salary
  • 8% Holiday payment
  • Hybrid working
  • Personal growth and challenging work with endless possibilities
  • An informal working environment with innovative colleagues

Discover what we do and what we can offer you.

Questions?

Please visit our Frequently Asked Questions section to find some answers on questions you might have.

title: Business Analyst
description:
Job Description:

Business analyst

Bliv business analyst i DXC. Hos os vil du blive en del af et stærkt hold, der sammen finder løsningerne. Teamet er stærkest, når der bliver løftet i flok, også selv om vi hver især har ansvaret for bestemte opgaver og delsystemer.

DXC har ansvaret for at understøtte årsopgørelsen. Sammen sørger vi for, at beregningerne i systemerne stemmer, og har øje for de detaljer og data, der udgør grundlaget i skattelovgivningen. Vi skal sikre, at årsopgørelsen er til at forstå og bliver vist på en tilgængelig måde.


Som business analyst hos DXC skal du blandt andet:

  • Implementere ny lovgivning, der ligger bag slutskatten på årsopgørelsen.

  • Beskrive forretningens krav ned i it-systemer og deltage i test af løsningerne. Vi stikker en finger i jorden hos forretningen og analyserer os sammen frem til den bedste løsning. Vi tester systemet løbende for at sikre, at systemet fungerer optimalt og beregner korrekt.

  • Kortlægge processer og udarbejde procesdokumentation, som løbende vedligeholdes.

  • Deltage i interne og tværgående forretningsudviklingsprojekter, hvor vi fx arbejder med forenkling af skatteberegningsområdet.

  • Besvare henvendelser om skatteberegninger. Give bidrag til systemoptimering og lovforberedende arbejde. Nogle af spørgsmålene er ret tricky, og vi skal holde tungen lige i munden, når vi svarer.

Man skal kunne meget som business analyst, og det kan ingen fra begyndelsen. Derfor skal du som person have en stor mængde tålmodighed, nysgerrighed og være parat til at lytte aktivt.

Hvem er du?

Du er struktureret, har analytisk sans og er nysgerrig. Frem for alt er du engageret, vedholdende, selvstændig og kan få noget fra hånden – og er også en kollega, der får tingene til at glide med godt humør. Du kan have en skattemæssig forståelse, men din analytiske tilgang er den vigtigste, da vi ofte arbejder med spidsfindige skattemæssige problemstillinger.

Din uddannelsesmæssige baggrund kan spænde bredt, men vi går mere op i indholdet af dine kvalifikationer og dine erfaringer end titlen på din uddannelse. Det er vigtigt at du har teknisk forståelse, uden dog nødvendigvis at være udvikler, men du formår at bygge bro mellem både kunde og kolleger, så der er en fælles forståelse. Det er vigtigt at du er omstillingsparat i forhold til kunden, kollegaer og opgaver i dagligdagen – på den måde sikrer vi at komme ”hele vejen rundt” om en given opgave eller problemstilling.

Vi forventer at du:

  • har erfaring som business analyst, evt. fra arbejde med et økonomisk system

  • har en teknisk forståelse så du kan omsætte kundens krav til et mere teknisk ”sprog”, som udviklere og testere kan arbejde videre med

  • at du er parat til at indgå i opgaven med test af systemløsninger

  • det er en klar fordel hvis du har erfaring med udarbejdelse af procesdokumentation eller kravspecifikation

  • gerne har erfaring med Jira, Confluence og SQL

  • taler og skriver flydende dansk og engelsk.

Du bliver motiveret af at finde løsninger på opgaver, også selv om de er svære at gå til og komplekse at forstå. Det er dejligt, hvis du både mestrer at bevare overblikket over opgaver og roen når det går stærkt. Og finder fornøjelse i at dykke ned i detaljer.

Har du lyst til og motiveres af at arbejde med et af Danmarks absolut mest samfundskritiske systemer, hvor du kan være med til at sikre detaljerne, så er dette job noget for dig!

Ansøgning og kontakt

Så send os dit CV med en kort motivation for, hvorfor du søger ind hos os, via knappen nedenfor. Vi afholder løbende samtaler, så søg hellere i dag end i morgen.

Der vil forud for ansættelse blive indhentet reference og straffeattest.

At DXC Technology, we believe strong connections and community are key to our success. Our work model prioritizes in-person collaboration while offering flexibility to support wellbeing, productivity, individual work styles, and life circumstances. We’re committed to fostering an inclusive environment where everyone can thrive.

description:
At Amentum, we're not just solving problems; we're engineering the future. Our team is driven by an unyielding commitment to innovation, integrity, and collaboration, tackling some of the most significant challenges in science, security, and sustainability. If you're passionate about making a real impact and want to be part of a community that values ethical excellence, this is the place where your ambition can thrive.

Here, we believe that success comes from continuously pushing boundaries and working together to deliver on our promises. We embrace challenges with confidence and are dedicated to creating a secure and vibrant future for all.

We’ll inspire and empower you to deliver your best work so you can evolve, grow and succeed – today and into tomorrow. We offer an exciting range of opportunities to develop your career within a supportive team who always strive to do the right thing for our people, clients and communities.

People are our greatest asset, and we offer a competitive package to retain and attract the best talent.

In addition to the benefits you’d expect, UK employees also receive free single medical cover and digital GP service, family-friendly benefits such as enhanced parental leave pay and free membership of employee assistance and parental programmes, plus reimbursement towards relevant professional development and memberships.

Work-life balance and flexibility is a key focus area for us. We’re happy to discuss hybrid, part-time and flexible working hours, patterns and locations to suit you and our business.

About the Opportunity

The announcement of a planned 20-year lifetime extension for Sizewell B is much more than an energy story. It is a significant investment in people, skills, local communities and the UK's long-term energy resilience. Sizewell B will continue generating electricity until 2055, extending its original operating life by two decades. For Suffolk and the wider East of England, this represents a major opportunity to build on an already strong nuclear legacy while creating lasting economic and social value for generations to come.

Since entering service in 1995, Sizewell B has been one of the UK's most reliable sources of low carbon electricity. Today, the station generates enough power for around 2.5 million homes.

At a time when energy security remains a national priority, extending the life of an existing nuclear plant makes strategic sense. Nuclear generation provides stable, around-the-clock electricity regardless of weather conditions, complementing the growing contribution from renewable energy sources.

To support this significant project Amentum are recruiting for a number of experienced Project Manager to join our Nuclear Power Engineering and Technical Services team supporting our key client EDF Energy Nuclear Generation with their nuclear fleet in the UK.

These are key role's within our project and engineering portfolio which is spread across our UK network at all UK sites and stations. You will be supported and mentored by experienced project engineering management professionals within the business and given the training and opportunities you need to develop and expand your project engineering management and leadership skills with larger and more complex projects.

You will be part of a large client-led team at Sizewell B Power Station and will be accountable to the client Project Manager, Programme Manager and/or Construction Manager. Flexible working arrangements between office and home may be possible, however the role will predominantly be based at the Power Station.

Key responsibilities will be:

  • Project Managers are accountable to the client PPM for successful delivery of all aspects of their assigned projects. The Project Manager sets the project execution strategy in agreement with the client PPM and uses a cross-functional project team to deliver the project safely in line with company policies and procedures, achieving established goals and objectives within the agreed baseline. This role has no direct reports
  • The role will be based at the EDF Sizewell B Power Station and will require occasional business travel to other UK sites/stations. In this role you will report to the business Operations Manager but be accountable for project delivery directly to the client
  • Everyone working in our team will have a proven track record of working within highly regulated environments with high safety standards and culture
  • Strong communication and organisational skills are a must with the ability to develop relationships and maintain effective networks and be results-focused tempered with a team-centred approach.


Qualification, Skills & Experience

  • Degree educated, ideally in engineering or a related subject, with preferred Chartership
  • APMP formal project management qualification or equivalent and versed in modern project management techniques within complex, multi-functional organisations; have a thorough understanding and knowledge of engineering, design, procurement, safety case, construction and iinstallation / commissioning management and commercial contracting
  • Able to demonstrate an understanding of Safety Cases including how they are developed and implemented, relevant Health and Safety and Environment legislation including CDM and the actions required to achieve compliance
  • Good understanding of the needs of quality and how quality is assured and controlled along with relevant experience of commercial, contractual, and financial project drivers
  • Demonstrable experience of managing projects throughout the full project lifecycle, ideally across a range of complex multi-discipline projects and environments, and management of an integrated project team including staff, agency and assigned functional support
  • Experience of estimating, cost control, planning and commercial awareness including the preparation of business cases and sanction/ funding papers
  • Experienced in the preparation of reports and information using packages such as Word, Excel and PowerPoint, be proficient in the use of estimating, scheduling, programming and risk tools and in the use of Earned Value tools. Analytical approach with high-level problem-solving ability
  • Experience of working at Power Stations and Nuclear Licensed Sites is preferred but not essential

Our Culture
Our values are built on a strong foundation of safety, integrity, and respect for every individual. People are at the heart of our mission, and we believe in supporting one another through a culture of care and collaboration.

We strive to create a workplace where everyone feels they belong and can thrive. Supporting mental wellbeing and fostering a sense of connection are essential to how we work.

When we embrace different perspectives and work together, we become more innovative, more agile, and more successful.

description:
Job Description

Perfil del Puesto: Asistente de Maestro(a) de Preescolar ISP

Propósito del Puesto

El Asistente de Maestro(a) de Preescolar apoya al docente titular en la creación de un entorno de aprendizaje seguro, enriquecedor y estimulante para los niños pequeños. Este puesto implica colaborar en la gestión del aula, preparar materiales didácticos, supervisar a los niños durante las actividades y promover un desarrollo social, emocional y cognitivo positivo. El asistente ayuda a garantizar que se satisfagan las necesidades de cada niño de acuerdo con el currículo y los objetivos educativos del preescolar.

Principios ISP

Comenzamos con nuestros niños y estudiantes

Nuestros niños y estudiantes son el centro de todo lo que hacemos. Simplemente, su éxito es nuestro éxito. El bienestar y la seguridad son esenciales tanto para los estudiantes como para el aprendizaje. Por ello, identificamos de manera constante posibles riesgos relacionados con la protección infantil (safeguarding), la salud y la seguridad, actuando y dando seguimiento adecuado a cualquier inquietud o situación detectada.

Tratamos a todos con cuidado y respeto

Nos apoyamos mutuamente, valoramos tanto nuestras similitudes como nuestras diferencias y promovemos el bienestar propio y de los demás.

Operamos de manera eficaz

Nos enfocamos continuamente en aquello que es más importante y que generará el mayor impacto. Aplicamos las políticas y procedimientos de la escuela y representamos los valores compartidos de nuestra comunidad.

Somos financieramente responsables

Tomamos decisiones financieras cuidadosamente, considerando las necesidades de los niños, los estudiantes y nuestras escuelas.

Aprendemos continuamente

La mejora constante es lo que nos impulsa. Participamos activamente en nuestro desarrollo personal y profesional, así como en la mejora continua de la escuela.

Responsabilidades Principales

1. Apoyar la enseñanza en el aula

Asistir al docente titular en la implementación de los planes de clase diarios, actividades de aprendizaje y juegos educativos alineados con el currículo del preescolar.

2. Supervisar e involucrar a los niños

Monitorear a los niños durante las actividades en el aula, el tiempo de juego, las comidas y las actividades al aire libre para garantizar su seguridad y fomentar comportamientos positivos.

3. Apoyar la gestión del comportamiento

Reforzar las normas del aula y ayudar a guiar a los niños en el desarrollo de habilidades sociales y emocionales apropiadas.

4. Preparar materiales de aprendizaje

Ayudar en la preparación y organización de materiales, recursos y exhibiciones del aula para promover el aprendizaje práctico y la creatividad.

5. Mantener un entorno seguro y limpio

Garantizar que los espacios del aula estén limpios, organizados y libres de riesgos; colaborar en la sanitización de juguetes, superficies y equipos.

6. Brindar apoyo individualizado

Proporcionar apoyo individual o en pequeños grupos a los niños que necesiten ayuda adicional con actividades o apoyo emocional.

7. Observar y reportar

Observar el desarrollo y comportamiento de los niños, comunicando al docente titular cualquier inquietud o progreso relevante.

8. Apoyar rutinas y transiciones

Ayudar a los niños con las rutinas diarias, tales como llegada y salida, uso del baño, comidas y tiempo de descanso, fomentando la independencia y la consistencia.

9. Fomentar la interacción positiva

Modelar comportamientos respetuosos, inclusivos y colaborativos para promover una cultura positiva dentro del aula.

10. Colaborar con los miembros del equipo

Trabajar en estrecha colaboración con el docente titular y otros miembros del personal para garantizar la consistencia en las prácticas de enseñanza y el cuidado infantil.

Habilidades

  • Paciencia y empatía: Capacidad para responder de manera tranquila y amable a los niños pequeños.
  • Fuertes habilidades de comunicación: Tanto con niños como con adultos (docentes y padres de familia).
  • Trabajo en equipo: Mentalidad colaborativa y disposición para seguir orientaciones.
  • Capacidad de observación: Habilidad para identificar hitos del desarrollo o posibles áreas de preocupación.
  • Creatividad y entusiasmo: Capacidad para involucrar a los niños mediante el juego y el aprendizaje.
  • Habilidades organizativas: Gestión eficiente de materiales, rutinas y tareas.
  • Adaptabilidad: Comodidad para ajustarse a cambios en los horarios o necesidades de los niños.
  • Sensibilidad cultural: Actitud respetuosa e inclusiva hacia todas las culturas, antecedentes y capacidades.

Requisitos Académicos

  • Licenciatura en Educación Preescolar o equivalente (obligatorio).
  • Curso de Capacitación TKT (Teaching Knowledge Test).

Experiencia

  • Experiencia previa trabajando con niños pequeños en entornos educativos o de cuidado infantil (deseable).

ISP Principles


Begin with our children and students. Our children and students are at the heart of what we do. Simply, their success is our success. Wellbeing and safety are both essential for learners and learning. Therefore, we are consistent in identifying potential safeguarding

and Health & Safety issues and acting and following up on all concerns appropriately.


Treat everyone with care and respect. We look after one another, embrace similarities and differences and promote the well-being of self and others.


Operate effectively. We focus relentlessly on the things that are most important and will make the most difference. We apply school policies and procedures and embody the shared ideas of our community.


Are financially responsible. We make financial choices carefully based on the needs of the children, students and our schools.


Learn continuously. Getting better is what drives us. We positively engage with personal and professional development and school improvement.

ISP Commitment to Safeguarding Principles

ISP is committed to safeguarding and promoting the welfare of children and young people and expects all staff and volunteers to share this commitment. All post holders are subject to appropriate vetting procedures, including an online due diligence search, references and satisfactory Criminal Background Checks or equivalent covering the previous 10 years’ employment history.

ISP Commitment to Diversity, Equity, Inclusion, and Belonging

ISP is committed to strengthening our inclusive culture by identifying, hiring, developing, and retaining high-performing teammates regardless of gender, ethnicity, sexual orientation and gender expression, age, disability status, neurodivergence, socio-economic background or other demographic characteristics. Candidates who share our vision and principles and are interested in contributing to the success of ISP through this role are strongly encouraged to apply.

title: Packaging & Labelling Engineer
description:
At Alcon, we are driven by the meaningful work we do to help people see brilliantly. We innovate boldly, champion progress, and act with speed as the global leader in eye care. Here, you’ll be recognized for your commitment and contributions and see your career like never before. Together, we go above and beyond to make an impact in the lives of our patients and customers. We foster an inclusive culture and are looking for diverse, talented people to join Alcon.

Packaging and Labeling Engineer to lead the development, validation, and execution of packaging and labeling solutions for our products. This role involves working with vendors to build and validating packaging machines, ensuring compliance with regulatory requirements, and optimizing packaging processes to improve efficiency and sustainability. The ideal candidate will bring expertise in packaging design, material selection, labeling systems, and packaging machinery validation, particularly in industries such as medical devices and pharmaceuticals.

Manage related equipment and process validations as required under the Quality system change control process. Coordinate the integration of new products and processes into the manufacturing systems and processes.

Packaging Design & Development

  • Design, develop, and optimize packaging systems (pouches, blister trays, cartons, labels, boxes, shrink wraps, etc.) to meet functional, quality, and regulatory requirements.

  • Conduct material evaluation, testing, and selection with consideration for compatibility, sustainability, manufacturability, durability, and cost.

  • Lead or support root‑cause investigations and implement improvements for packaging-related performance issues.

Prototyping & Process Development

  • Lead or contribute to prototype design, assembly, testing, and line trials to validate new packaging concepts.

  • Develop and refine packaging manufacturing processes, including equipment specification, qualification, and validation.

  • Collaborate closely with Engineering, Operations, Quality, Regulatory, and Supply Chain to ensure smooth technology transfer to production.

Equipment, Systems & Automation

  • Oversee installation, commissioning, operation, and maintenance readiness of packaging machinery and inspection systems (e.g., vision systems, inline verification).

  • Troubleshoot equipment or system performance and drive corrective and preventive actions to maintain efficiency and quality.

Quality, Compliance & Risk Management

  • Integrate quality assurance and control requirements into packaging and process design.

  • Ensure adherence to technical standards, regulatory guidelines, and global packaging/labelling regulations.

  • Perform or support risk assessments (pFMEA, QRA) for packaging components and processes.

  • Follow GxP, SOPs, and documentation requirements to ensure full traceability and audit readiness.

Artwork & Labelling

  • Create, review, and manage product artwork within the Artwork Management System.

  • Ensure labelling accuracy and regulatory compliance across all markets.

  • Support change control processes related to artwork, packaging, and labelling updates.

Continuous Improvement & Leadership

  • Identify and implement improvements in packaging robustness, sustainability, cost, and manufacturability.

  • Make informed technical decisions within your area and contribute to broader project and organizational objectives.

WHAT YOU’LL BRING TO ALCON:

  • Bachelor’s degree or higher in Packaging Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Materials Science, Industrial Engineering, or related technical field.

  • 2+ years of experience in packaging engineering, ideally within medical device, pharmaceutical, or other regulated manufacturing environments.

  • Strong understanding of packaging materials (plastics, films, foils, paperboard, adhesives) and their performance characteristics.

  • Hands‑on experience with packaging equipment, automation systems, and vision/inspection systems (preferred).

  • Working knowledge of equipment qualification and process validation (IQ/OQ/PQ), as well as design controls.

  • Experience with CAD tools and engineering documentation (drawings, specifications, BOMs).

  • Familiarity with Artwork Management Systems and labelling compliance requirements.

  • Knowledge of GxP, ISO 11607, FDA 21 CFR Part 820, EU MDR, and other relevant regulatory frameworks.

  • Ability to perform risk assessments (FMEA, QRA) and apply quality control methodologies.

  • Proficiency with statistical tools (e.g., Minitab) is a plus. Excellent communication skills, with the ability to explain technical concepts to diverse stakeholders.

  • Detail‑oriented, proactive, and committed to high standards of quality and compliance.

Why Join Us:

  • Opportunity to work with a leading global medical device company.

  • Collaborate with a diverse and talented team in a supportive work environment.

  • Competitive compensation package and comprehensive benefits.

  • Continuous learning and development opportunities.

title: Field Service Engineer
description:
We offer you an Ocean of Possibilities. Join our family.

Over Damen Marine Components
Damen Marine Components (DMC), onderdeel van DAMEN, ontwerpt en produceert hoogwaardige systemen voor de voortstuwing en manoeuvreerbaarheid van schepen. Onze producten worden wereldwijd ingezet in onder meer de binnenvaart, zeevaart, offshore, marine en superjachtbouw. Met een wereldwijd 24/7 servicenetwerk zorgen we ervoor dat installaties van klanten in topconditie blijven. DMC is onderdeel van de Damen Shipyards Group.

De functie

Voor onze serviceafdeling zijn wij op zoek naar een Field Service Engineer / allround servicemonteur met een passie voor techniek. In deze rol werk je aan uiteenlopende werktuigkundige installaties aan boord van schepen, met de nadruk op hydraulische en mechanische systemen.

Deze functie is nadrukkelijk ook interessant voor technici buiten de maritieme sector. Werk je bijvoorbeeld als vrachtwagenmonteur, automonteur, hydrauliekmonteur of in een andere technische servicefunctie, en lijkt het je mooi om aan grote, complexe installaties te werken? Dan maken we graag kennis met je.

Wat deze rol aantrekkelijk maakt, is de afwisseling. De ene dag werk je aan een geplande inbouw op een nieuwbouwschip, de andere dag los je een storing op aan boord van een schip dat ergens in de haven ligt. Je bent bezig met techniek in de praktijk: inspecteren, repareren, afstellen, testen en storingen oplossen.

Wat ga je doen?

Als Field Service Engineer houd je je onder andere bezig met:

  • Het installeren, onderhouden en repareren van hydraulische, mechanische en deels elektrische installaties aan boord van schepen;

  • Het uitvoeren van inspecties aan onder andere stuurmachines en roerinstallaties, onder meer conform relevante richtlijnen;

  • Het zelfstandig oplossen van storingen en uitvoeren van reparaties op locatie;

  • Het testen, afstellen en inregelen van installaties in de werkplaats en aan boord;

  • Het voorbereiden van werkzaamheden en verzamelen van benodigde onderdelen;

  • Het opstellen van service- en inspectierapportages na afloop van een klus;

  • Het bieden van eerstelijnsondersteuning bij storingen;

  • Af en toe werkzaamheden in de werkplaats voor service of productie.


Wie zoeken wij?

Wij zoeken een monteur of service engineer die graag zelfstandig werkt, technisch sterk is en energie krijgt van afwisselend werk op locatie.

Je herkent jezelf in het volgende:

  • Je hebt een technische achtergrond, bijvoorbeeld in werktuigbouw, voertuigen, hydrauliek, mechanica of service;

  • Je hebt ervaring als servicemonteur, storingsmonteur, automonteur, vrachtwagenmonteur, hydrauliekmonteur of in een vergelijkbare technische functie;

  • Ervaring in de maritieme sector is mooi meegenomen, maar zeker geen must;

  • Je kunt zelfstandig storingen analyseren en technische reparaties uitvoeren;

  • Je bent praktisch ingesteld en vindt het leuk om op verschillende locaties te werken;

  • Je communiceert prettig en werkt zorgvuldig;

  • Je hebt een redelijke beheersing van Nederlands en bij voorkeur ook Engels;

  • Je hebt oog voor veiligheid en werkt volgens geldende veiligheids- en milieuregels;

  • Je bent bereid om mee te draaien in de storingsdienst.


Wat bieden wij?

Deze rol biedt veel vrijheid, verantwoordelijkheid en variatie. Je werkt op verschillende locaties, aan verschillende installaties en geen week is hetzelfde. Daarbij krijg je de ruimte om je werk op een praktische en zelfstandige manier uit te voeren. Je kunt rekenen op:

  • Een goed salaris!

  • 25 vakantiedagen en 13 ADV-dagen, met de mogelijkheid om ADV deels te verkopen;

  • Standaard werktijden van 07:45 tot 16:30, met flexibiliteit waar mogelijk;

  • Reiskostenvergoeding en bij voldoende ervaring de beschikking over een eigen servicebus, die je ook mee naar huis kunt nemen;

  • De mogelijkheid om af en toe in het buitenland te werken. Dit is een kans, geen verplichting;

  • 1 week per 6 weken storingsdienst, gemiddeld genomen niet extreem druk;

  • Een standby-vergoeding van € 200 per storingsweek;

  • Overwerkvergoedingen van 140% en 170%;

  • Veel afwisseling tussen geplande werkzaamheden en acute serviceklussen;

  • Een prettige, informele werksfeer binnen een groeiende organisatie;

  • Volop aandacht voor professionele en persoonlijke ontwikkeling via de Damen Academy.

Over Damen Marine Components

Damen Marine Components (DMC), onderdeel van DAMEN, ontwerpt en produceert hoogwaardige systemen voor de voortstuwing en manoeuvreerbaarheid van schepen. Onze producten worden wereldwijd ingezet in onder meer de binnenvaart, zeevaart, offshore, marine en superjachtbouw. Met een wereldwijd 24/7 servicenetwerk zorgen we ervoor dat installaties van klanten in topconditie blijven. DMC is onderdeel van de Damen Shipyards Group.

Interesse?

Ben jij een technisch monteur die toe is aan meer afwisseling, meer zelfstandigheid en uitdagende werkzaamheden op bijzondere locaties? En spreekt het je aan om te werken aan installaties aan boord van schepen, ook als je nu nog in een andere technische sector werkt? Dan komen we graag met je in contact.

Job Description

About Thermo Fisher Scientific

As part of the Thermo Fisher Scientific team, you’ll discover meaningful work that makes a positive impact on a global scale. Join our colleagues in bringing our Mission to life every single day by enabling our customers to make the world healthier, cleaner and safer.

We provide our global teams with the resources and opportunities needed to achieve individual career goals while helping to take science a step beyond. Our solutions address some of the world’s toughest challenges, including protecting the environment, ensuring food safety and supporting the development of life-saving treatments.

Position Summary

As a Senior Field Service Engineer, you will provide advanced technical service and support for sophisticated analytical and scientific instruments across customer sites.

You will independently manage complex installation, maintenance, troubleshooting and repair activities while serving as a key technical resource for customers and internal teams. The role requires strong diagnostic capability, sound technical judgement and the ability to resolve challenging equipment and system issues with limited supervision.

In addition to delivering field service activities, you will support technical escalations, contribute to continuous improvement initiatives, share technical knowledge with other engineers and help strengthen overall service capability within the team.

Key Responsibilities

  • Independently install, commission, qualify and verify the performance of sophisticated analytical and scientific instruments.
  • Perform preventive maintenance, corrective maintenance, upgrades and complex equipment repairs in accordance with established service procedures and quality standards.
  • Diagnose and resolve complex hardware, software, electrical, electronic, mechanical and system-level issues.
  • Apply structured troubleshooting and root-cause analysis techniques to identify recurring or difficult technical problems.
  • Serve as a technical escalation point for selected product, application or customer issues within the assigned territory.
  • Provide advanced on-site and remote technical support to customers and field service colleagues.
  • Take ownership of complex customer service cases from initial diagnosis through resolution and closure.
  • Coordinate with Technical Support, Product Support, Applications, Quality, Sales and other functions to resolve complex customer issues.
  • Escalate significant product, safety, quality or reliability concerns through the appropriate internal processes.
  • Provide clear technical recommendations and communicate service findings effectively to customers and internal stakeholders.
  • Support major installations, system upgrades, relocations and other technically challenging field projects.
  • Assist with planning and execution of service activities for key or strategically important customers.
  • Ensure all service activities are completed safely and in compliance with Thermo Fisher Scientific quality, regulatory and Environmental, Health and Safety requirements.
  • Maintain accurate and timely service documentation, including technical findings, corrective actions, parts usage and customer communications.
  • Review recurring technical issues and contribute recommendations to improve equipment reliability, service procedures and customer experience.
  • Share technical knowledge, service best practices and troubleshooting methods with other Field Service Engineers.
  • Provide informal coaching, technical guidance and on-the-job support to less experienced engineers when appropriate.
  • Support the onboarding and technical development of new field service team members.
  • Participate in technical training, product updates and knowledge-sharing activities to maintain a high level of technical competency.
  • Identify opportunities to improve field service efficiency, first-time-fix performance, equipment uptime and customer satisfaction.
  • Support implementation of service process improvements and local operational initiatives.
  • Maintain appropriate tools, test equipment, spare parts and technical documentation required for field service activities.

Qualifications and Experience

  • Diploma or Degree in Engineering, or a related technical discipline.
  • Typically 5 or more years of hands-on technical experience in the installation, maintenance, troubleshooting and repair of analytical, scientific or other sophisticated technical instrumentation.
  • Demonstrated experience independently diagnosing and resolving complex technical issues.
  • Candidates with strong and relevant field service experience from authorized dealers, distributors, service partners or competitors may also be considered.
  • Experience supporting sophisticated electrical, electronic, mechanical, computer-controlled or integrated instrumentation systems is preferred.
  • Strong customer-facing field service experience within research, industrial, laboratory, healthcare or related environments.
  • Experience supporting technical escalations, major installations or complex customer cases is desirable.

Technical and Professional Competencies

  • Advanced troubleshooting and diagnostic capability.
  • Strong understanding of electrical, electronic, mechanical and system-level troubleshooting principles relevant to supported products.
  • Ability to interpret technical documentation, service manuals, schematics, diagnostic data and system information.
  • Strong analytical thinking and structured problem-solving capability.
  • Ability to make sound technical decisions independently within established procedures and guidelines.
  • Strong ownership and accountability for customer issues through resolution.
  • Ability to manage technically complex service cases involving multiple stakeholders.
  • Strong customer service orientation and professional service mindset.
  • Effective written and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to explain complex technical information clearly to customers and internal stakeholders.
  • Strong interpersonal skills and ability to build credibility with customers.
  • Ability to collaborate effectively across Service, Technical Support, Applications, Commercial, Quality and other functions.
  • Ability to coach and provide technical guidance to less experienced team members.
  • Strong organizational and time-management capabilities.
  • Ability to prioritize multiple customer requirements and service activities in a dynamic environment.
  • High attention to detail and commitment to service quality.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications and service management or field service software.

Travel Requirements

  • Ability and willingness to travel approximately 25–50%, or as required, within the assigned territory, depending on customer and business requirements.

title: Head of Data Engineering, Corporate & Enterprise
description:
Position Overview:

The Head of Data Engineering, Corp & Enterprise is a mid-leadership role accountable for the end-to-end data engineering lifecycle across Guardian's Corporate and business unit and Enterprise, from source data acquisition, ingestion, and transformation through the delivery of trusted, production-ready data products that power AI, machine learning, reporting, analytics, and business applications. This leader owns the strategy, architecture direction, engineering execution, and operational health of the data supply chain that downstream teams depend on every day.

This is a player-coach role. The Head of Data Engineering leads a team of US FTEs and provides direction to an extended indirect engineering team in India, building a high-performing, globally distributed delivery model with clear standards, strong engineering discipline, and a culture of ownership. While the role is primarily a leadership position, the leader is expected to stay technically current and go hands-on when needed reviewing designs, unblocking complex engineering problems, and setting the bar for quality through example.

A core mandate of this role is ownership and maturing Guardian's Master Data Management (MDM) practice. The leader will manage MDM operations and evolve the practice from foundational capability to enterprise-grade discipline - strengthening match and merge rules, survivorship, golden record quality, data stewardship workflows, and domain expansion. Deep, practical knowledge of Reltio is essential, including its data model, match engine, workflows, integrations, and APIs.

Equally important, this leader carries a transformation mandate: to take data engineering to its next level using AI agents and agentic AI. This means reimagining how pipelines are built, tested, monitored, and healed: embedding AI-assisted development, autonomous data quality and observability agents, and agentic workflows across the engineering lifecycle to dramatically increase speed, reliability, and scale. The right candidate sees agentic AI not as a tool to adopt, but as a new operating model for data engineering and has the vision and pragmatism to lead the organization and the new operating model.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Own end-to-end data engineering for the Corporate business units and Enterprise - source data acquisition, ingestion, integration, transformation, curation, and publication of production-ready data products for AI, ML, reporting, analytics, and application consumption

  • Define and execute the data engineering strategy and multi-year roadmap, aligned to business unit priorities and Guardian's enterprise data and AI strategy

  • Lead, coach, and develop a team of FTE data engineers; provide direction, standards, and delivery oversight to an indirect engineering team in India, operating a seamless follow-the-sun global delivery model

  • Operate as a player-coach, remain hands-on as needed with solution design, code and pipeline reviews, complex troubleshooting, and critical delivery moments

  • Own and manage the MDM platform and operations on Reltio, including data modeling, match/merge rules, survivorship, workflows, integrations, and API-based consumption

  • Mature the MDM practice into an enterprise-grade discipline, improve golden record quality, expand mastered domains, strengthen data stewardship and governance workflows, and measure and communicate MDM business value

  • Lead the transformation of data engineering using agentic AI, deploy AI agents for pipeline development, code generation, testing, documentation, data quality monitoring, anomaly detection, and self-healing operations

  • Champion AI-assisted engineering practices across the team, redefining team workflows, productivity expectations, and engineering roles for an agentic future

  • Deliver governed, discoverable, reusable data products with clear contracts, SLAs, lineage, and ownership, treating data as a product with defined consumers and measurable quality

  • Partner closely with AI/ML, analytics, reporting, and application teams to ensure data products are AI-ready, supporting feature pipelines, model training data, and retrieval-ready datasets for GenAI use cases

  • Establish and enforce engineering standards, reusable patterns, CI/CD, DataOps automation, and observability across all pipelines and platforms

  • Build reusable tools, libraries, frameworks, and shared services that productize and scale engineering best practices, and actively drive their adoption across Data Engineering to accelerate delivery, raise quality, and eliminate duplicated effort

  • Drive data quality, reliability, and operational excellence - define SLAs/SLOs, reduce incidents, and ensure resilient, cost-optimized cloud data platform operations

  • Embed data governance, privacy, security, and regulatory compliance requirements into all data engineering and MDM solutions in partnership with Data Governance, Cybersecurity, and Risk

  • Manage vendor relationships and platform economics, including Reltio and cloud data platform spend, with a focus on value and FinOps discipline

  • Influence and align senior business and technology stakeholders; translate business needs into engineering priorities and communicate progress, risks, and outcomes with clarity

  • Recruit, retain, and grow top engineering talent; build succession depth and elevate the technical maturity of both onshore and offshore teams

  • Available for production incidents with major impact to business operations

You Have:

  • 12+ years of progressive data engineering experience, including 5+ years leading data engineering teams and delivery at scale in a large enterprise and have experience in Finance, actuaries, HR related data and workflows.

  • Proven experience leading globally distributed teams, including direct FTE leadership and indirect/offshore teams in India, within a matrixed organization

  • Demonstrated ability to operate as a player-coach - setting strategy and leading people while staying hands-on with architecture, design, and engineering when needed

  • Deep expertise across the end-to-end data engineering lifecycle: data acquisition, batch and streaming ingestion, ELT/ETL, data modeling, curation, and productionization of data products

  • Strong hands-on knowledge of the modern data stack including cloud data platforms (e.g., Fivetran, Databricks), orchestration (e.g., Databricks, Airflow), transformation frameworks (e.g., Spark, dbt), streaming (e.g., Kafka), and CI/CD-driven DataOps

  • A strong software engineering mindset and execution skills, with a proven track record of designing and building reusable tools, libraries, and frameworks, applying sound software design principles, testing, and documentation, and driving their adoption across engineering teams to multiply productivity and impact

  • Strong Master Data Management expertise with deep, practical knowledge of Reltio - data modeling, match/merge and survivorship configuration, workflows, integrations, and APIs and a track record of maturing an MDM practice

  • Forward-leaning experience with AI-assisted and agentic engineering using LLMs and AI agents for code generation, testing, data quality, observability, and autonomous operations and a compelling vision for agent-driven data engineering

  • Experience delivering AI/ML-ready data and GenAI/retrieval-ready data foundations

  • Strong grounding in data governance, data quality, metadata, lineage, and privacy/security practices, ideally in a regulated industry such as insurance or financial services

  • A data-as-a-product mindset with experience defining data contracts, SLAs, and consumer-driven design

  • Excellent leadership and communication skills, with the ability to influence senior stakeholders and convey complex technical concepts to business audiences

  • Experience with Agile / product-based delivery models and managing delivery across onshore/offshore teams

  • A bias for action, high standards, and the ability to balance transformation ambition with operational stability

Location:

  • Three days a week at a Guardian location on Holmdel, NJ, New York, NY, or Bethlehem, PA

Salary Range:

$152,290.00 - $250,195.00

The salary for this position ultimately will be determined based on the education, experience, knowledge, and abilities of the successful candidate.
