title: Radar Software Engineer C++ (SMU)
description:
Location: Hengelo, Netherlands

C/C++ RADAR SOFTWARE ENGINEER

Voor het SMU Team zijn wij op zoek naar een analytisch sterke en communicatief vaardige software engineer (C/C++). Je bent niet alleen een ontwikkelaar die software gaat schrijven, maar ook betrokken bij inetegraties en trouble shooting. Waarbij het vooral gaat om het werkend maken van de software in diverse radars. In deze rol ben je een verbinder met andere disciplines en kom je te werken in een hecht team.

Over Thales

Thales ontwerpt uiterst moderne radarsystemen en optische sensoren die deel uitmaken van een compleet en geïntegreerd verdedigingssysteem. De productportefeuille varieert van kleine draagbare radars voor bijvoorbeeld grens- of objectbewaking tot complexe vierdimensionale radars die kleine objecten kunnen detecteren op honderden tot duizenden kilometers afstand.

Binnen de softwareafdeling is de Sensor processing groep verantwoordelijk voor de softwareontwikkeling van de optimale besturing en de digitale processingfuncties in de sensoren. Hierbij wordt in multidisciplinaire teams gewerkt samen met specialisten op het gebied van system engineering, functioneel sensorontwerp en ontwerp en realisatie van real-time systemen.

About the job
Binnen deze Sensor processing groep wordt de complete radar software ontwikkeld. Dit omvat diverse domeinen waaronder de aansturing van de radarsystemen, het organiseren van de radaruitzendingen en het verwerken van de digitale informatiestroom. Het uiteindelijke doel is specifieke objecten, zoals bijvoorbeeld vliegtuigen en drones te detecteren en te classificeren, deze te volgen en in beeld te brengen op een operatorconsole.

De software architectuur is zeer modulair opgezet en ondersteund de ontwikkeling van robuuste en evolutionaire systemen. De ontwikkeling gebeurt in Agile teams die ondersteund worden door een moderne ontwikkelstraat. De verdere ontwikkeling en onderhoud van de architectuur, de ontwikkelstraat en het Agile proces wordt door de teams zelf uitgevoerd.

About you
Heb je een passie voor techniek en lijkt het je leuk te werken aan radar aansturingen of complexe algoritmes? Dan ben jij misschien wel de persoon die wij zoeken. Wij willen jou graag de mogelijkheid bieden om carrière te maken in de internationale hightech omgeving van Thales.
De voorwaarde hiervoor is een afgeronde HBO of WO opleiding op het gebied van (technische) informatica of computer science. We verwachten een ruime ervaring met de programmeertalen C en C++ en met het ontwikkelen van real-time software. Ervaring met andere programmeertalen zoals Java is een pré.


Je bent creatief, open en flexibel en je kunt opereren als een teamspeler. Daarnaast ben je resultaatgericht, toon je initiatief en communiceer je op heldere wijze. Een goede beheersing van de Nederlandse en Engelse taal is noodzakelijk voor een goede functie-invulling.

What’s in it for you

  • Positie is op basis van vakgroep 55 (AS)/ vakgroep 60, conform cao Metalektro-HP
  • Je maakt deel uit van een leuk team in een high tech, innovatieve, internationale omgeving
  • De mogelijkheid om te groeien binnen de organisatie, bijvoorbeeld op technisch-/management-/commercieel- of internationaal vlak
  • Ruimte voor persoonlijke ontwikkeling en eigen initiatief
  • Een fijne werkplek in een modern gebouw, met aandacht voor een goede work-life balance en flexibiliteit
  • 40 vakantiedagen per jaar, reiskostenvergoeding en de mogelijkheid jouw arbeidsvoorwaarden te personaliseren; aankoop/ verkoop van uren, internetkosten, fietsenplan, bedrijfsfitness, vakbondscontributie of verhuiskosten

title: Parks Technician I -  Conservation Lands & Resources
description:
Job Description Summary

Department - Conservation Lands & Resources

Job Description

Job Type: Classified


Job Classification: 5884 - Parks Technician I

Salary Grade: 3

Pay Range

Hiring Range: $18.79 - $22.09 Per Hour

Pay Range: $18.79 - $25.38 Per Hour

Range Explanation:

  • Hiring Range is an estimate of where you can receive an offer. The actual salary offer will carefully consider a wide range of factors, including your skills, qualifications, experience, education, licenses, training, and internal equity.

Pima County’s Conservation Lands & Resources Department is seeking highly motivated and hard-working individual to fill a position as Park Technician I. This position is part of the Parks and Trails Division of Conservation Lands & Resources, supporting Pima County’s conservation efforts. It will involve assisting with maintenance, construction, campground operations, and restoration projects at Tucson Mountain Park and its trails.

This role is field-oriented, often in remote areas, with exposure to extreme temperatures in both summer and winter and requires the candidate to be in excellent physical condition. This is primarily a manual labor position requiring the ability to lift heavy loads; safely operate assigned vehicles and other powered equipment; work in extremes of heat, humidity, dust, and cold; safely wear required safety clothing and equipment; and ascend and descend ladders and stairs to reach and work upon elevated or below-grade work platforms and job sites. On assigned projects, the extended use of hand tools such as shovels, pickaxes, digging bars, and rakes is required. Invasive species work requires the candidate to mechanically remove or apply chemicals to combat invasive species and work where venomous animals may be encountered.

Essential Functions:

As defined under the Americans with Disabilities Act, this classification may include any of the following tasks, knowledge, skills, and other characteristics. This list is ILLUSTRATIVE ONLY and is not a comprehensive listing of all functions and tasks performed by incumbents of this class. Work assignments may vary depending on the department’s need and will be communicated to the applicant or incumbent by the supervisor.

  • Cuts, trims, edges, seeds, fertilizes, stripes ball field and leisure turf;

  • Structurally prunes, shapes and maintains urban forest and ground vegetation;

  • Performs minor repairs and adjustments to plumbing and irrigation systems;

  • Operates ride-on equipment and utilizes powered maintenance and construction equipment/tools ;

  • Performs operator-level inspections, servicing, maintenance and security of assigned tools, equipment and vehicles;

  • Applies paints, varnish, stains, and other finishes to interior and exterior surfaces, trimmings and fixtures;

  • Stores, handles, applies and disposes of hazardous materials required to complete work or generated by work assignments;

  • Collection and disposal of trash;

  • Maintains and uses safety and personal protective equipment;

  • Explains rules, regulations or procedures to the public and/or vendors;

  • Some positions may be assigned to a natural resource park setting, whereby, maintenance may include wildlife drinkers, ponds, equestrian, camp facilities, trails, habitat restoration, erosion control and invasive species.

Minimum Qualifications:

Six months of experience performing duties in landscape, grounds maintenance, arborist, equipment operator, general handyman or similar duties in a specific skill, craft, vocation, trade or operational area of employment.

(Relevant experience and/or education from an accredited college or university may be substituted.)

OR:

Three months of experience within Pima County as a Parks Helper or other helper level position.

Qualifying education and experience must be clearly documented in the "Education" and "Work Experience" sections of the application. Do not substitute a resume for your application or write "see resume" on your application.

Preferred Qualifications: (Be specific in describing your experience in your application. Ensure the descriptions provided illustrate your competencies, specifically addressing the required and preferred qualifications.):

  • Minimum one (1) year experience performing duties in landscape, grounds maintenance, arborist, equipment operator, general handyman or similar duties in a specific skill, craft, vocation, trade or operational area of employment.

  • Minimum six (6) months experience in a customer service setting responding to customer inquiries.

  • Minimum six (6) months experience with the loading, securing, transport, and field use of equipment, UTVs/ATVs, and a variety of trailers.

  • Minimum six (6) months experience working near roadways.

Selection Procedure:
Pima County Human Resources Department reserves the right to admit to the selection process only those candidates that meet the minimum qualifications. All applications will be assessed based on an evaluation of the listed education and experience. Candidates meeting the minimum qualifications may be further evaluated/scored against any advertised Preferred Qualifications. The hiring authority will interview and select the successful candidate from a referral list provided by Human Resources. Additional assessments/testing may be required as part of the selection process.

Supplemental Information:


Licenses and Certificates: Valid driver license is required at time of application. Valid AZ driver license is required at time of appointment. The successful applicant will be subject to a 39-month DOT Motor Vehicle Record review to determine applicant’s suitability to operate county vehicles in accordance with Pima County administrative procedures. Failure to obtain and maintain the required licenses and certifications shall be grounds for termination. Any offer of employment resulting from this recruitment is contingent upon Fleet Services’ review and approval of the candidate’s driving record.

Special Notice Items: The County requires pre-employment background checks. Successful candidates will receive a post-offer, pre-employment background screening to include verification of work history, education, and criminal conviction history. A prior criminal conviction will not automatically disqualify a candidate from employment with the County. The County requires pre-employment background checks. Successful candidates will receive a post-offer, pre-employment background screening to include verification of work history, education, and criminal conviction history. A prior criminal conviction will not automatically disqualify a candidate from employment with the County. This position will require a post-job offer physical and/or drug screen. This position will require post-job offer proof of immunization(s) or immunization(s) and/or a TB screening.


Physical/Sensory Requirements: Lifting heavy objects, operating machinery and equipment, and performing repetitive tasks such as mowing, pruning, and planting. Action Activity - bending, climbing, kneeling, reaching, squatting and stooping; Motion Activity - grasping; Hearing Activity - in noisy areas, on a radio, behind themselves, and fine movement; Speaking Activity - in person, on the phone, on a radio; Vision - must be able operate motor vehicle, operate machinery, operate forklift/power industrial equipment; distinguish colors, depth perception and peripheral vision. Frequently required to lift, push or pull objects weighing up to 100 pounds.

Working Conditions: Various weather conditions, including heat, cold, and rain.

Jesteśmy zespołem ekspertów w obszarze threat huntingu, pentestów i reagowania na incydenty cybersecurity. Dołącz do nas i zanurz się w świat pozyskiwania informacji o zagrożeniach. W naszym zespole będziesz miał_a okazję reagować na incydenty i oceniać ryzyko związane z ich wystąpieniem oraz uczestniczyć w podnoszeniu poziomu zabezpieczeń IT w banku.

  • analiza alertów z systemów bezpieczeństwa IT

  • znajomość narzędzi umożliwiających analizę i przetwarzanie ruchu sieciowego

  • umiejętności analitycznego myślenia oraz pracy w zespole

Mile widziane

title: Director, Brand Creative, Running & ACG
description:
WHO WILL YOU WORK WITH

This role primarily partners with Designers, Narratives, Producers, and the Brand Experience, the Retail Design and the Digital Brand Studio teams. The role maintains a close connection with the Global counterpart team to ensure creative consistency and alignment across the brand. The Brand Creative Director will also partner with and report to the Sr. Creative Director.

Outside of Brand Creative, key partners include Brand Marketing teams, who are shaping the brand strategy for Nike Running and ACG, as well as Digital Marketing, (Social) Media, and Retail Brand teams.

The role also leads external agencies, artists, and creative partners to elevate the craft and execution of projects.The team is based in the Netherlands within the Nike EMEA Brand Creative Studio.

WHO ARE WE LOOKING FOR

Nike is looking for a visionary creative leader who combines strong conceptual thinking with proven leadership capabilities to shape and drive the creative direction of Nike Running and ACG across EMEA. This person brings a deep understanding of sport, performance culture, and contemporary consumer behavior, with relevance to running and/or outdoor communities.

Over the course of their career, they have led the end-to-end creative development of international brand campaigns and brand experiences, having translated strategy into compelling narratives and impactful brand expressions. Their background spans creative direction, art direction, design, storytelling, and experience creation, with a strong understanding of how to extend global concepts while creating meaningful regional relevance.

Equally important, they are deeply connected to the creative industry and continuously seek inspiration from emerging cultural movements, technologies, and creative practices. They stay curious, embrace innovation, and bring fresh thinking to every challenge while maintaining alignment with Nike Marketing strategies and Brand Creative standards.

Creative

  • Extensive experience in leading end-to-end creative development covering creative direction, creative strategy, design, experience design, image making, and storytelling with a strong focus on sport and sport culture.
  • Advanced knowledge of Adobe Creative Cloud, Figma, Keynote, AI-enabled creative tools, and contemporary design practices, including motion and 3D design.
  • Demonstrated expertise in concept development, art direction, visual storytelling, graphic design & typography, design systems, color theory, environmental design, and presentation development.

Leadership

  • Proven experience leading and developing diverse creative teams while fostering an inclusive, high-performing culture.
  • Ability to create clarity, align stakeholders around a compelling creative vision, and influence across complex cross-functional environments.
  • Brings a progressive mindset that challenges convention, elevates craft, and drives new ways of thinking, with a strong commitment to understanding the worlds of running and outdoor sport

Foundational

  • Brings a genuine passion for sport, sport lifestyle, and the communities that shape culture.
  • Demonstrates a strong understanding of EMEA youth and consumer behavior.
  • Able to travel up to 40% within Europe.
  • Being a great collaborator and having a positive, and problem-solving attitude.

WHAT WILL YOU WORK ON

You will lead the development of high-quality creative work from strategy through execution, communicating compelling concepts to internal and external audiences throughout the creative process. You will play a key role in shaping and guiding work across the Nike Running and ACG portfolio.

  • Extend Global Creative Concepts or originate EMEA-specific Creative Concepts.
  • Lead the creation of product campaigns, brand campaign, consumer experiences, brand events, toolkits and retail installations.
  • Develop and deliver full-funnel creative solutions spanning strategy, concept development, and execution.
  • Move across varied projects while maintaining clear communication, strong alignment, and creative momentum.
  • Oversee territory executions to ensure brand standards are met through the whole EMEA region.

You will also lead a team of Designers and Narratives. Together, the Brand Creative squad delivers sharper, more impactful end-to-end creative work that serves consumers and athletes*, drives premium brand experiences at scale, and shapes the future of the Nike brand.

title: Quality Assurance Associate
description:
APM Terminals

Position – Quality Assurance Associate (On site)

Location - Maersk CFS, Ground Floor No 78, Anuppam pattu village, Minjur, Ponneri Taluka, Thiruvalluvar dist, Chennai- 601204

Description -Responsible for ensuring quality, food safety, regulatory compliance, cold-chain integrity, and QMS implementation across the warehousing and cold storage facility.

Work closely with Operations, Engineering/Maintenance, Safety, Commercial and customers to ensure that products are stored and handled in accordance with customer requirements, approved SOPs, food safety standards, statutory regulations and company policies. Act as the key quality interface for customer audits, regulatory inspections, complaints, CAPA, HACCP/FSMS implementation, temperature management and continuous improvement initiatives.

Key Responsibilities:

Operational Management -

  • Ensure operations are optimized and warehousing services are delivered under the highest service quality possible in the area.
  • Ensure maintenance and renewal of applicable licenses, registrations and statutory approvals, including FSSAI, EIC, MPEDA and other applicable regulatory requirements, depending on the products handled.
  • Participation in internal and external audits (Food safety audits, ISO audits, customer audit, third party certification audits, etc)
  • Review temperature records, deviations and corrective actions on a regular basis.
  • Ensure proper functioning, calibration and validation of temperature monitoring devices, data loggers, sensors and measuring equipment.
  • Develop, review and implement SOPs, work instructions, quality manuals, checklists and formats for warehouse and cold storage operations.
  • Ensure effective implementation of GMP, GHP, hygiene, sanitation and food safety practices across the facility.
  • Ensure timely customer complaints handling with effective root cause analysis.
  • Keeping records and manual in the QMS documentation updated with revision as per standards.
  • Prepare the facility for planned and unplanned audits and inspections. Ensure closure of audit observations within agreed timelines.
  • Handling of government officials visiting facility.
  • Ensuring effective pest control program for site.
  • Prepare quality manuals for various categories of products stored in the facility.
  • Assist in implementing various business excellence projects and initiatives at the site.
  • Conduct quality, food safety, GMP/GHP, HACCP, hygiene, QMS and SOP-related training for warehouse employees.
  • Monitor quality trends and provide recommendations to Site Management.

Client Relationship Management -

  • Client audits.
  • Product sampling.
  • Quality Dashboard.

Accountable For

  • Effective implementation of QMS, FSMS, HACCP and PRPs at the facility.
  • Addressing all complaints / queries within timelines as per escalation matrix.
  • Leading all quality audits for the facility.
  • Quality documentation and record control.
  • Training and awareness of warehouse personnel on quality and food safety requirements.

Critical Competencies

  • Strong knowledge of QMS, FSMS, HACCP, GMP, GHP and PRPs.
  • Understanding of ISO 9001 and ISO 22000 standards.
  • Strong knowledge of SOP preparation and implementation.
  • Ability to perform Root Cause Analysis and CAPA.
  • Strong audit management and documentation skills.
  • Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.

Key Metrics

  • Handling Customer complaints & ensuring high customer satisfaction Score.
  • QMS implementation and standardization.
  • Regulatory license and statutory compliance.
  • Successful completion of certification audits and observations closed within timelines.

Education Qualification & Experience:

  • B.E. Food Tech/ Science Graduate (microbiology/Biotech/Food Technology)
  • 3-4 Experience in Food manufacturing/handling (specially frozen food)
  • Certification/training in ISO 9001:2015, ISO 22000, HACCP will be preferred.
  • Experience in handling customer audits, food safety audits and regulatory inspections will be preferred.

The Pima County Public Library is looking for a Librarian I to join our team! You will also create and lead engaging library programs for adults. The Librarian I will serve as the librarian in charge of the building at times. Streamlining how CEP engages customers across products and services while cultivating strategic vendor partnerships that span multiple technology domains.

Accelerating delivery on critical outcomes.

Streamline engagement to reduce repeated asks and fragmented input across initiatives.

Influencer stewardship, specialized onboarding bootcamps/spark zones for infra.

title: D&T Project Manager (Supply Chain)
description:
Welcome to Haleon. We’re a purpose-driven, world-class consumer company putting everyday health in the hands of millions. In just three years since our launch, we’ve grown, evolved and are now entering an exciting new chapter – one filled with bold ambitions and enormous opportunity.

Our trusted portfolio of brands – including Sensodyne®, Panadol®, Advil®, Voltaren®, Theraflu®, Otrivin®, and Centrum® – lead in resilient and growing categories. What sets us apart is our unique blend of deep human understanding and trusted science.

Now it’s time to fully realise the full potential of our business and our people. We do this through our Win as One strategy. It puts our purpose – to deliver better everyday health with humanity – at the heart of everything we do. It unites us, inspires us, and challenges us to be better every day, driven by our agile, performance-focused culture.

About the role

The D&T Project Manager is responsible for the end‑to‑end delivery of technology projects within Haleon’s Digital & Technology (D&T) organisation.

The role ensures projects are delivered with discipline, transparency and predictability, operating within established delivery frameworks, governance standards and portfolio processes. Working closely with business stakeholders, delivery partners and cross‑functional D&T teams, the Project Manager maintains clear ownership of scope, plans, risks and outcomes.

This role is suited to an experienced delivery professional who is comfortable operating in structured, enterprise delivery environments, managing multiple stakeholders and suppliers, and providing clear, reliable insight throughout the project lifecycle.

Role purpose

To deliver D&T projects safely and predictably, ensuring agreed outcomes are achieved by applying standard delivery frameworks, managing risks and dependencies proactively, and maintaining clear communication with stakeholders and leadership.

Key accountabilities

  • The D&T Project Manager is accountable for:

  • Successful end‑to‑end delivery of assigned D&T projects

  • Consistent application of D&T delivery frameworks and governance

  • Effective management of scope, plans, risks, issues and dependencies

  • Clear, timely reporting of project status, risks and decisions

  • Strong stakeholder and supplier management

  • Maintaining focus on agreed business outcomes

Domain Expertise & Preferred Background

The ideal candidate will bring experience in one or more of the following areas:

  • SAP IBP

  • Kinaxis

  • O9 Solutions

  • Blue Yonder

  • Demand Planning

  • Supply Planning

  • Integrated Business Planning

  • Inventory Optimisation

  • Logistics and Distribution Technology

  • Supply Chain Transformation Programmes

Preferred experience delivering Supply Chain technology programmes within FMCG, Consumer Goods, Manufacturing or Consulting organisations.

Key responsibilities

1. Project Delivery & Execution

  • Own the delivery of assigned projects from initiation through to closure.

  • Ensure projects deliver agreed scope, timelines, quality standards and outcomes.

  • Apply standard D&T delivery approaches (Waterfall or hybrid as appropriate).

2. Planning & Control

  • Develop and maintain robust project plans, including milestones, dependencies and critical paths.

  • Track progress against plan and take corrective action where deviations occur.

  • Manage change in a controlled and transparent way.

3. Risk, Issue & Dependency Management

  • Proactively identify, manage and escalate project risks, issues and dependencies.

  • Ensure mitigation actions are clearly defined, owned and tracked to closure.

  • Maintain an accurate view of project health and delivery confidence at all times.

4. Stakeholder Management & Communication

  • Act as the primary point of contact for project stakeholders across business, D&T and suppliers.

  • Provide clear, honest and timely communication on progress, risks, decisions and impacts.

  • Manage expectations and maintain alignment throughout the project lifecycle.

5. Financial & Resource Management (Project Level)

  • Manage project budgets, forecasts and financial controls within delegated authority.

  • Work with Finance partners to provide accurate financial reporting and early visibility of variances.

  • Ensure project resources and capacity are planned and used effectively.

6. Supplier & Third‑Party Management

  • Manage delivery contributions from third‑party suppliers within the project scope.

  • Ensure suppliers deliver to agreed timelines, quality and contractual expectations.

  • Escalate supplier performance or dependency issues through appropriate governance forums.

7. Governance & Reporting

  • Operate within established delivery governance, ensuring all required artefacts and controls are maintained.

  • Provide accurate, decision‑oriented reporting into portfolio, performance and assurance forums.

  • Support reviews, stage gates and audits as required.

8. Outcomes, Adoption & Handover

  • Maintain focus on agreed business outcomes throughout delivery.

  • Support transition, handover and closure activities to enable successful adoption and ongoing ownership.

  • Contribute to benefits realisation tracking where applicable.

9. Continuous Improvement & Professional Standards

  • Apply lessons learned and best practice to improve delivery effectiveness.

  • Contribute positively to D&T delivery standards, ways of working and capability maturity.

  • Demonstrate accountability, professionalism and strong delivery discipline.

What good looks like

  • Projects are delivered with few surprises and clear delivery confidence

  • Risks and issues are identified early and managed proactively

  • Stakeholders have a clear understanding of progress, decisions and next steps

  • Delivery governance is followed consistently and professionally

  • Outcomes are achieved and transitions are well managed

  • The Project Manager is seen as reliable, organised and accountable

Qualifications & skills

Essential

  • Demonstrated experience delivering projects in Digital, Technology or Change environments

  • 8- 12 years of experience in relevant filed.

  • Strong understanding of structured delivery approaches (Waterfall or hybrid)

  • Experience managing risks, dependencies and stakeholder expectations

  • Strong planning, organisational and communication skills

  • Comfortable working in complex, matrixed environments

Preferred

  • Experience operating within enterprise portfolio and governance frameworks

  • Exposure to regulated, operational or large‑scale environments

  • Experience managing third‑party suppliers

  • Relevant delivery certifications (e.g. PRINCE2, PMP or equivalent)

2026-08-29

Haleon are committed to mobilising our purpose in a way that represents the diverse consumers and communities who rely on our brands every day. It guides us in creating an inclusive culture, where different backgrounds and views are valued and respected – all in support of understanding and best serving the needs of our consumers and unleashing the full potential of our people. About CARIAD (Car, I Am Digital)


The automotive industry is in disruption. As a company, CARIAD is playing a part in multiple large trends at the same time: electrification, automation, and digitalization. The new name builds on changing customer needs. Automotive customers are demanding more comfort, more safety, more sustainability, and more connectivity. title: Tencent Cloud - Senior Solution Architect, Big Data (Singapore)
description:
Business Unit

Cloud & Smart Industries Group (CSIG) is responsible for promoting the company's cloud and industry Internet strategy. CSIG explores the interactions between users and industries to create innovative solutions for smart industries via technological advancements such as cloud, AI, and network security. While driving the digitalization of retail, medical, education, transportation and other industries, CSIG helps companies serve users in smarter ways, building a new ecosystem of intelligent industries that connect users and businesses.

What the Role Entails

As a key member of the Tencent Cloud Big Data team, the Senior Solution Architect will provide technical consulting and deliver end-to-end data solutions for strategic enterprise customers across international markets. This role combines deep big data expertise, customer-facing solution leadership, and global market insight to help organisations address complex data challenges, modernise their architectures, and realise the differentiated value of Tencent Cloud.

  • Engage enterprise customers to understand their requirements across big data architecture, real-time processing, data lakes, analytics, and data governance, and design scalable end-to-end solutions for industries such as e-commerce, gaming, and fintech.
  • Lead technical workshops, architecture discussions, solution demonstrations, and Proofs of Concept (PoCs), supporting customers throughout cloud migration, platform modernisation, and architecture upgrade initiatives.
  • Articulate the technical and business value of Tencent Cloud’s big data portfolio and develop competitive differentiation strategies against platforms such as AWS, Microsoft Azure, Google Cloud, Snowflake, and Databricks.
  • Serve as the technical bridge between international customer-facing teams and Tencent Cloud’s R&D headquarters, collaborating with product, engineering, sales, and post-sales teams to ensure effective solution implementation and issue resolution.
  • Identify recurring international market requirements, including data compliance, localisation, interoperability, and multi-cloud deployment, and translate these insights into recommendations for product roadmap and globalisation initiatives.

Who We Look For

  • Bachelor’s degree or above in Computer Science, Information Technology, Communications Engineering, or a related discipline
  • At least five years of relevant experience in big data architecture, technical consulting, solution design, or platform implementation with strong technical knowledge of the Hadoop ecosystem and relevant technologies, including Spark, Flink, Elasticsearch, Apache Doris, ClickHouse, and Trino.
  • Demonstrated understanding of modern data architectures, including data lakes, lakehouse platforms, real-time data processing, serverless data services, and open table formats such as Apache Iceberg and Apache Hudi.
  • Familiarity with leading cloud data and analytics platforms, including AWS EMR and Redshift, Google BigQuery, Snowflake, and Databricks, with the ability to conduct technical comparisons and develop differentiated solution strategies.
  • Professional proficiency in English and Chinese, both written and verbal, is required to independently deliver technical presentations and solution proposals to international customers in English and Chinese Mandarin, and to collaborate effectively with Chinese-speaking product and R&D stakeholders at Tencent China headquarters.

Equal Employment Opportunity at Tencent

As an equal opportunity employer, we firmly believe that diverse voices fuel our innovation and allow us to better serve our users and the community. We foster an environment where every employee of Tencent feels supported and inspired to achieve individual and common goals.

title: Field Service Engineer
description:
Work Schedule

Standard (Mon-Fri)

Environmental Conditions

Office

Job Description

About Thermo Fisher Scientific

As part of the Thermo Fisher Scientific team, you’ll discover meaningful work that makes a positive impact on a global scale. Join our colleagues in bringing our Mission to life every single day by enabling our customers to make the world healthier, cleaner and safer.

We provide our global teams with the resources and opportunities needed to achieve individual career goals while helping to take science a step beyond. Our solutions address some of the world’s toughest challenges, including protecting the environment, ensuring food safety and supporting the development of life-saving treatments.

Position Summary

As a Field Service Engineer, you will be responsible for providing high-quality technical service and support for sophisticated analytical and scientific instruments at customer sites.

You will perform installation, preventive maintenance, troubleshooting, repair and other field service activities while ensuring a high level of customer satisfaction. The role requires strong technical capability, effective customer communication and the ability to work independently within an assigned territory.

You will work with customers across research, industrial and healthcare environments and collaborate with internal technical, commercial and support teams to resolve service issues efficiently.

Key Responsibilities

  • Install, commission and verify the performance of analytical and scientific instruments at customer sites.
  • Perform scheduled preventive maintenance, corrective maintenance and equipment repairs in accordance with established service procedures.
  • Diagnose and troubleshoot instrument hardware, software and system-related issues.
  • Identify root causes of equipment problems and implement appropriate corrective actions.
  • Provide timely and professional on-site and remote technical support to customers.
  • Ensure service activities are completed safely, accurately and in compliance with Thermo Fisher Scientific quality and service standards.
  • Document service activities, technical findings, parts usage and customer interactions accurately in the service management system.
  • Manage assigned service calls and customer commitments efficiently to meet service response and completion targets.
  • Maintain appropriate tools and test equipment required to support field service activities.
  • Communicate clearly with customers regarding equipment condition, service activities and recommended follow-up actions.
  • Escalate complex technical issues to the appropriate technical support or specialist teams when required.
  • Collaborate effectively with all cross-functional teams.
  • Identify opportunities to improve equipment reliability, service delivery and overall customer experience.
  • Maintain up-to-date technical knowledge through product training, technical documentation and hands-on experience.
  • Comply with all applicable Environmental, Health and Safety requirements and company policies.

Qualifications and Experience

  • Diploma in Engineering or a related technical discipline.
  • Minimum 3 years of hands-on technical experience in the installation, maintenance, troubleshooting and repair of analytical, scientific or comparable sophisticated instrumentation.
  • Candidates with relevant field service experience from authorized dealers, distributors or competitors may also be considered.
  • Practical experience diagnosing electrical, electronic, mechanical and/or instrument system issues is preferred.
  • Experience working directly with customers in a technical service environment is an advantage.

Skills and Competencies

  • Strong hands-on troubleshooting and problem-solving capability.
  • Good customer service orientation with a professional and positive service mindset.
  • Good written and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to communicate technical information clearly to customers and internal stakeholders.
  • Ability to work independently with limited supervision while following established procedures and escalation processes.
  • Ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional and multi-functional teams.
  • Strong attention to detail and commitment to service quality.
  • Good organizational and time-management skills.
  • Ability to prioritize and manage multiple service activities simultaneously in a dynamic field environment.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications and familiarity with service management or field service software.
  • Willingness and ability to continuously develop technical knowledge and skills.

Travel Requirements

  • Ability and willingness to travel approximately 25–50% within the assigned territory, depending on customer and business requirements.

title: Vyr. gamybos technikas (-ė)
description:
Work Schedule

Standard (Mon-Fri)

Environmental Conditions

Adherence to all Good Manufacturing Practices (GMP) Safety Standards, Cleanroom: no hair products, jewelry, makeup, nail polish, perfume, exposed piercings, facial hair etc... allowed, Cold Room/Freezers -22degreesF/-6degrees C, Laboratory Setting, Some degree of PPE (Personal Protective Equipment) required (safety glasses, gowning, gloves, lab coat, ear plugs etc.)

Job Description

„Thermo Fisher Scientific“ kuriame sprendimus, padedančius žmonėms gyventi sveikesniame, švaresniame ir saugesniame pasaulyje. Tai daugiau nei mūsų misija – tai kasdienis darbas, kuriantis vertę pacientams, mokslui ir visuomenei.

Vilniaus padalinyje kuriame ir gaminame inovatyvias gyvybės mokslų bei diagnostikos technologijas, naudojamas mokslininkų, klinikų ir laboratorijų visame pasaulyje. Mūsų komandos dirba su modernia gamybine ir laboratorine įranga, automatizuotomis sistemomis bei pažangiais procesais, kurie padeda užtikrinti aukštą produktų kokybę ir patikimą veiklą.

Prisijunkite prie komandos, kurioje technologijos, kokybė ir Geros gamybos praktikos (GGP) procesai susijungia kuriant sprendimus pasaulinei gyvybės mokslų rinkai.

Pareigų aprašymas

Ieškome vyr. gamybos techniko (-ės), kuris (-i) prisijungs prie mūsų produktų fasavimo ir komplektavimo komandos bei prisidės prie aukščiausių kokybės standartų užtikrinimo.

Šioje pozicijoje būsite atsakingas (-a) už produktų fasavimą, liofilizavimą, ženklinimą, komplektavimą ir vizualinę patikrą pagal nustatytas standartines darbo procedūras bei Geros gamybos praktikos (GGP) reikalavimus. Taip pat užtikrinsite tvarkingą darbo aplinką ir prisidėsite prie kokybiško produktų tiekimo laboratorijoms bei sveikatos priežiūros įstaigoms visame pasaulyje.

Pozicija puikiai tinka kandidatams, turintiems gamybos, laboratorinės ar operacijų srities patirties. Svarbiausia – kruopštumas, atsakingumas, gebėjimas laikytis nustatytų procedūrų ir orientacija į kokybę.

Pagrindinės atsakomybės

  • Atlikti produktų fasavimą, liofilizavimą ir vizualinę produktų patikrą pagal standartines darbo procedūras

  • Komplektuoti galutinius produktus ir atlikti kokybės patikras

  • Užtikrinti, kad produktai atitiktų nustatytus kokybės standartus

  • Palaikyti švarią ir tvarkingą darbo aplinką laikantis GGP reikalavimų

  • Tiksliai vykdyti gamybos dokumentaciją ir laikytis nustatytų darbo procedūrų

  • Laikytis kokybės, saugos ir taršos kontrolės reikalavimų

Patirtis ir kvalifikacijos

  • Vidurinis išsilavinimas

Įgūdžiai ir kompetencijos

  • Gebėjimas skaityti ir suprasti gamybos dokumentaciją bei standartines darbo procedūras (SOP)

  • Geri darbo kompiuteriu įgūdžiai dirbant su dokumentavimo sistemomis

  • Gebėjimas dirbti savarankiškai ir komandoje

  • Kruopštumas, tikslumas ir dėmesys detalėms

  • Gebėjimas laikytis kokybės standartų ir nustatytų darbo procedūrų

  • Orientacija į kokybę ir atsakingas požiūris į darbą

Vertinsime kaip privalumą

  • Patirtį dirbant Geros gamybos praktikos (GGP) aplinkoje

  • Patirtį dirbant švariose patalpose

  • Patirtį gamybos arba laboratorinėje aplinkoje

Darbo sąlygos

  • Darbas vietoje, švariose gamybinėse patalpose

  • Darbas laikantis Geros gamybos praktikos (GGP) ir griežtų taršos kontrolės reikalavimų

  • Privalomas asmeninių apsaugos priemonių naudojimas pagal saugos ir kokybės reikalavimus

  • Darbo laikas I-V, 8-16:45

Atlyginimas

€1,291–€1,941 bruto/mėn.

Galutinis atlyginimas priklausys nuo pasirinkto kandidato (-ės) patirties, įgūdžių ir kompetencijų.

Ką siūlome

  • Metinį priedą už rezultatus ir papildomas finansines naudas

  • Išsamų sveikatos paketą: privatus sveikatos, gyvybės ir nelaimingų atsitikimų draudimas

  • Darbuotojų ir jų šeimos narių gerovės programą: psichologinės konsultacijos, sveikatos patikros, skiepai bei sveikatingumo iniciatyvos

  • Profesinio augimo galimybes: vidiniai mokymai, prieiga prie „Thermo Fisher e-University“ ir nuolatinis tobulėjimas

  • Galimybę dirbti globalioje, inovacijas skatinančioje organizacijoje ir bendradarbiauti su tarptautinėmis komandomis

  • Galimybę prisidėti prie aukštos kokybės analitinių kolonėlių gamybos ir procesų tobulinimo

  • Modernią darbo aplinką ir palaikančią komandą

  • Kasdienes naudas: dalinai kompensuojamą maitinimą, sporto salę ir transporto išlaidų kompensaciją

  • Įtraukią ir palaikančią darbo kultūrą, komandos renginius bei bendruomenės iniciatyvas

  • 2 papildomas apmokamas savanorystės dienas per metus

Job Description:

SOC Cyber Security Manager
Location: Fairview Park, Falls Church, VA
Schedule: M–F, 0700–1500 | Onsite | <10% travel

At GDIT, we secure and support some of the most challenging government, defense, and intelligence missions. Your work will help make today safer and tomorrow smarter in a culture that values autonomy, collaboration, and high performance.

GDIT has an opening for a SOC Cyber Security Manager supporting the Army National Guard (ARNG) on an IT Service Management contract that operates within the ITIL framework. This program delivers and protects ARNG’s global IT services across networking, compute, storage, infrastructure, cybersecurity, applications, hosting, and program management. This role leads the team that defends those services.

As the SOC Cyber Security Manager, you’ll combine hands-on technical leadership with people management—overseeing SOC operations, mentoring analysts, and ensuring alignment with ARNG and DoW cybersecurity standards and mission requirements.

MEANINGFUL WORK AND PERSONAL IMPACT

Lead SOC Operations & Team Management

  • Manage day-to-day SOC operations: monitoring, incident triage, response, and escalation.

  • Lead, coach, and develop SOC analysts, including feedback, performance management, and career development in line with GDIT people manager requirements and training.

  • Maintain SOC procedures, playbooks, and SOPs for consistent, high-quality event response.

  • Set priorities, assign work, and ensure coverage across shifts.

  • Serve as the primary SOC point of contact for ARNG stakeholders and GDIT teams.

Technical Cyber Defense & Forensics

  • Oversee and, as needed, perform forensic analysis to identify intrusion indicators and threat actors.

  • Use data from tools such as IDS, firewalls, SIEM, network logs, and endpoint security to analyze events and lead mitigation.

  • Interpret and report events and anomalies per network defense directives, ensuring timely response and reporting.

  • Direct evaluation, testing, recommendation, and maintenance of cybersecurity tools, policies, procedures, and access management.

Policy, Standards & Risk Management

  • Ensure SOC plans, controls, and procedures align with DoW, Army, NIST, and ARNG cybersecurity standards.

  • Identify risks and exposures, determine root causes, and drive corrective and preventive actions.

  • Refine techniques for risk assessments, compliance audits, and incident investigations.

  • Oversee data correlation and SIEM content design to enable effective threat detection and mapping to users, systems, and threat actors.

Stakeholder Coordination & Governance

  • Coordinate cybersecurity inspections, tests, and reviews with all stakeholders.

  • Oversee ARNG support for eMASS structure and workflow.

  • Coordinate cybersecurity papers and plans with partners such as CYBERCOM, ARCYBER, Air National Guard Cyber, NSA, FBI, DOJ, and DHS.

  • Support enforcement of DoW Cyberspace Workforce Framework and certification programs across the SOC team.

  • Assist ARNG with streamlined processes for eMASS access requests in support of RMF.

Architecture, Vulnerability Management & Authorization Support

  • Lead security architecture and vulnerability reviews with system owners and admins, including scans, configuration reviews, and documentation analysis.

  • Oversee dissemination of approved policy and process documentation for system authorization (DoW, Army, NIST guidance).

  • Collaborate with engineering and operations to recommend hardening and architectural improvements based on SOC findings.

WHAT YOU’LL NEED TO SUCCEED

Education

  • Preferred: Bachelor’s in cybersecurity, information assurance, computer science, or related field; or equivalent combination of education, certifications/training, and experience.

Experience

  • Typically 7+ years in cybersecurity, information assurance, or related fields.

  • 2+ years leading or managing a cyber or SOC team (formal or informal leadership).

Skills & Attributes

  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making skills.

  • Proven experience with enterprise security tools (SIEM, IDS/IPS, firewalls, endpoint protection, vulnerability scanners).

  • Demonstrated ability to manage and mentor staff, conduct reviews, and support career development; willingness to complete all required GDIT people manager training.

  • Organized, reliable, able to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced SOC.

  • Strong customer-service orientation; comfortable with senior military and government stakeholders.

  • Clear verbal and written communication in meetings, briefings, and incident reports.

  • Preferred familiarity with DoW 2875, ACTCS, RMF, and eMASS.

  • Self-motivated, quick learner, committed to staying current with threats, best practices, and certifications.

  • Able to work under pressure, adapt to changing priorities, and drive continuous improvement.

  • Performs other duties as assigned in support of the mission.

Certifications

  • Must hold a baseline certification meeting DoW 8570.01-M IAT Level II (e.g., CompTIA Security+ CE) prior to start.

  • Must obtain a computing environment / CSSP-related certification (e.g., CEH, CCNA-Security, CND) within six months of hire, based on role designation.

  • Higher-level certifications (e.g., CISSP, CASP+, CISM) are highly desired.

Clearance

  • Active Secret clearance required at time of interview; must be maintained.

GDIT IS YOUR PLACE

  • Growth: AI-powered career tools that identify next steps and learning paths.

  • Support: Dedicated internal mobility team focused on your career goals.

  • Rewards: Comprehensive benefits and wellness programs, 401(k) with company match, competitive pay, and paid time off.

  • Community: Award-winning culture of innovation and a military-friendly workplace.

OWN YOUR OPPORTUNITY
Step into a cybersecurity leadership role at GDIT and guide mission-critical work that protects national security—while growing alongside colleagues who share your commitment to delivering results.

The likely salary range for this position is $153,000 - $207,000. This is not, however, a guarantee of compensation or salary. Rather, salary will be set based on experience, geographic location and possibly contractual requirements and could fall outside of this range.

Our benefits package for all US-based employees includes a variety of medical plan options, some with Health Savings Accounts, dental plan options, a vision plan, and a 401(k) plan offering the ability to contribute both pre and post-tax dollars up to the IRS annual limits and receive a company match. To encourage work/life balance, GDIT offers employees full flex work weeks where possible and a variety of paid time off plans, including vacation, sick and personal time, holidays, paid parental, military, bereavement and jury duty leave. title: Electrical Technician
description:
Welcome to ConocoPhillips, where innovation and excellence create a platform for opportunity and growth. Come realize your full potential here.

Who We Are

We are one of the world’s largest independent exploration and production companies, based on proved reserves and production of liquids and natural gas. With operations and activities in 13 countries, we explore for, develop, and produce crude oil and natural gas globally. We are challenged with an important job to safely find and deliver energy to the world. Our employees are critical to our success, and with them we power civilization.

We’re grounded by our SPIRIT Values – safety, people, integrity, responsibility, innovation, and teamwork. These values position us to deliver strong performance in a dynamic business – but not at all costs. We believe it’s not just what we do – it’s how we do it – that sets us apart.

Fostering an Inclusive Work Environment

To deliver superior performance, we create an environment that respects the contributions and differences of every individual. Wherever possible, we use these differences to drive competitive business advantage, personal growth and, ultimately, create business success.

Job Summary

Teesside Operations

The ConocoPhillips Norsea Terminal, located in Teesside at the mouth of the river Tees, is a crude oil reception, processing, storage, and trans-shipment installation. The terminal also fractionates natural gas liquids into ethane, propane, and butane.

The terminal’s success is built on its high performing workforce and can provide opportunities throughout your career to progress and continually develop. With ongoing production from Ekofisk and Eldfisk, other redeveloped fields and new exploration projects in the works, the future looks bright as we prepare for a lifetime to 2050.

Reporting to the Electrical Supervisor, the Electrical Technician will work as part of the Operations and Maintenance team to deliver planned and reactive maintenance activities, support compliance with safety and regulatory requirements, and contribute to continuous improvement across plant reliability, availability and performance. They will support the safe, reliable and efficient operation of the Teesside site by installing, maintaining, fault-finding and repairing electrical equipment, systems and associated components.

The ideal candidate will be a qualified Electrical Technician with strong practical maintenance experience, ideally gained within a process, oil and gas, or COMAH-regulated environment. They will have a sound understanding of electrical equipment, safe systems of work and relevant standards, with the ability to fault-find, repair and maintain plant equipment safely and effectively. A call-out rota is in place for this post.

Position Overview

Main Duties & Responsibilities

  • Actively support the Electrical Maintenance Function
  • To interpret job requirements from preventative maintenance instruction, specifications and / or other documentation
  • Install electrical equipment in accordance with established standards, limits, fits, tolerances, procedures and guideline
  • To maintain and repair electrical equipment with established standards, limits, fits, tolerances, with established PM routines, procedures and guidelines
  • Support the ENABLON process and adopt the role of Permit Acceptor as appropriate
  • Provide feedback on all maintenance tasks to allow collation of asset history, whether that be written, electronic or verbal
  • Diagnose physical cause of electrical equipment breakdown / failure and propose / complete repairs to the site standards and engage technical resources as needed to support operations
  • Generate SAP Material Requisition for work orders and projects
  • Create / Close SAP notifications for defects
  • Assisting in reviews and development of relevant section procedures, PM routines and risk assessments
  • Respond to any out of hours call out
  • Assist the planning department in the planning of PM01 and PM02 jobs as directed by the supervisor, as part of fall-back work
  • Prepare jobs for execution in support of the schedule under direction of the supervisor, as part of fall-back work including but not limited to checking scaffold, withdrawing spares, preparing tools etc
  • As part of a team, undertake and record After Action Reviews to improve job planning and execution

Competency Requirements

Basic Requirements

  • Relevant approved apprenticeship/NVQ level 3 or equivalent
  • Minimum City & Guilds/ ONC certificate in Electrical Engineering or equivalent
  • Strong knowledge of electrical equipment
  • Knowledge of DSEAR and ATEX legislation
  • Extensive experience in a maintenance role within the oil and gas industry
  • Hold a Full UK driving licence and to drive company vehicles where appropriate
  • Ability to use Microsoft packages and SAP
  • Appropriate Physical and Mental Capability to undertake the role (Work at Height, Work in Confined Spaces, Ability to wear Breathing Apparatus)

title: Assistant VP, Credit Risk Model Validation
description:
Company: 1011 United Overseas Bank Ltd

About UOB

United Overseas Bank Limited (UOB) is a leading bank in Asia with a global network of more than 500 branches and offices in 19 countries and territories in Asia Pacific, Europe and North America. In Asia, we operate through our head office in Singapore and banking subsidiaries in China, Indonesia, Malaysia and Thailand, as well as branches and offices. Our history spans more than 80 years. Over this time, we have been guided by our values – Honorable, Enterprising, United and Committed. This means we always strive to do what is right, build for the future, work as one team and pursue long-term success. It is how we work, consistently, be it towards the company, our colleagues or our customers.

Job Description

Job Responsibilities

* Conduct independent validation of a wide range of credit risk models, including PD, LGD, EAD, stress testing, and IFRS 9 models, across various portfolios (retail, corporate, wholesale).

* Provide effective challenges to all model aspects including theoretical / conceptual soundness, model assumptions, model design, data inputs, modeling process, and model outcomes

* Develop and implement comprehensive validation plans, including quantitative and qualitative analyses, backtesting, sensitivity analysis, and benchmark comparisons.

* Document validation findings, limitations, and recommendations clearly and concisely in validation reports.

* Effectively communicate validation results and recommendations effectively to model developers, model owners, senior management, and internal/external auditors.

* Stay abreast of industry best practices, regulatory requirements (e.g., Basel, IFRS 9, MAS), and emerging trends in model risk management and quantitative finance.

* Collaborate with model development teams to understand model methodologies and provide constructive feedback for model enhancements.

* Contribute to the continuous improvement of the model validation framework, policies, and procedures.

* Participate in ad-hoc projects related to model risk management and quantitative analysis as required.

Job Qualifications

* Undergraduate, Master's or Ph.D. in a quantitative field such as Financial Engineering, Mathematics, Statistics, Physics, Economics, or Computer Science.

* Minimum of 2-5 years of experience in credit risk model validation, model development, or quantitative risk management within a financial institution.

* Strong understanding of credit risk modeling techniques, statistical methods, and quantitative analysis.

* Proficiency in programming languages such as Python, R, SAS or Excel VBA.

* Familiarity with regulatory requirements related to model risk management (e.g., Basel III, IFRS 9, MAS guidelines).

* Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and critical thinking skills.

* Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to articulate complex technical concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences.

* Ability to work independently and as part of a team in a fast-paced environment.

* High level of attention to detail and commitment to accuracy.

Additional Requirements

title: Customer Journey Expert - Cashbacks & Loyalty
description:
Shape the future of customer loyalty at ING

At ING, we're building the next generation of banking experiences. We believe banking should not only help customers manage their finances but also create value in their everyday lives. That's why we're investing in innovative cashback and loyalty propositions that reward our customers and deepen their relationship with ING.

We're looking for a Customer Journey Expert – Cashbacks & Loyalty who is passionate about customer engagement, proposition development, and creating meaningful customer experiences. In this role, you'll have the opportunity to shape how millions of customers discover, activate, and engage with ING's rewards ecosystem.

If you're excited about combining customer insights, commercial thinking, data, and innovation to create propositions customers genuinely value, we'd love to hear from you.

Your role and work environment

You'll join the Customer Acquisition & Growth Domain within the Daily Banking & Client First Tribe.

Our mission is simple: attract new customers, strengthen relationships with existing customers, and create experiences that keep customers engaged throughout their lifecycle with ING.

As part of a multidisciplinary squad, you'll work alongside product managers, marketers, analysts, UX designers, and partner management colleagues to deliver customer experiences that are simple, rewarding, and impactful.

You will also collaborate closely with a dedicated Partner Manager to translate partner opportunities and cashback benefits into compelling customer propositions that drive engagement and business growth.

Your impact

As Customer Journey Expert – Cashbacks & Loyalty, you will define and drive ING's cashback and loyalty proposition from strategy through execution.

You'll own the vision, roadmap, and customer experience, ensuring our proposition remains relevant, competitive, and valuable to our customers.

Your work will directly contribute to:

  • Increasing customer engagement and retention
  • Driving awareness and adoption of loyalty benefits
  • Creating innovative cashback and rewards experiences
  • Strengthening customer advocacy and loyalty towards ING
  • Supporting ING's strategic growth ambitions

This role sits at the intersection of customer experience, product management, commercial growth, partnerships, and marketing, giving you the opportunity to make a visible impact across multiple areas of the business.

What you'll be doing

Define the loyalty vision

  • Develop and own the cashback and loyalty strategy and roadmap
  • Identify customer needs, market trends, and growth opportunities
  • Translate customer insights into innovative features and benefits
  • Prioritize initiatives based on customer value and commercial impact

Build propositions customers love

  • Continuously evolve ING's cashback and loyalty proposition
  • Design reward structures, benefits, and engagement mechanisms
  • Create compelling value propositions for different customer segments
  • Ensure alignment with ING's broader customer strategy

Create seamless customer journeys

  • Own the end-to-end cashback and loyalty experience
  • Identify and remove friction points across customer journeys
  • Collaborate with UX, Digital, and Data teams to optimize experiences
  • Validate solutions through experimentation and customer feedback

Drive growth and engagement

  • Develop strategies to increase customer participation and usage
  • Partner with Marketing and CRM teams on campaigns and activations
  • Launch new propositions and capabilities successfully
  • Drive customer awareness and ongoing engagement

Measure and optimize performance

  • Define success metrics and KPIs
  • Monitor proposition performance and customer behaviour
  • Build business cases and evaluate commercial impact
  • Use data-driven insights to continuously improve outcomes

Who we're looking for

You're passionate about creating customer experiences that drive engagement and deliver real value. You combine a customer-first mindset with strong commercial awareness and enjoy turning insights into impactful propositions.

What you'll bring

  • Experience in product management, proposition management, CRM, loyalty, customer engagement, or growth marketing
  • A proven ability to translate customer needs into successful products and propositions
  • Strong commercial acumen combined with a customer-centric mindset
  • Confidence in using data, experimentation, and insights to drive decisions
  • The ability to balance strategic thinking with hands-on execution
  • Strong stakeholder management and influencing skills
  • Residency in Belgium and fluency in English. Dutch and/or French language skills are a strong plus.

Nice to have

  • Experience with cashback, rewards, or loyalty programs
  • Experience in banking, fintech, e-commerce, telecommunications, or subscription-based businesses
  • Knowledge of CRM, personalization, and customer analytics
  • Experience managing external partnerships or strategic alliances

Rewards and benefits
We want to make sure that it’s possible for you to strike the right balance between your career and your private life. Find out more about our employment conditions.


The benefits of working with us at ING include:

  • An attractive gross salary, depending on your job category and professional experience.
  • Flex Budget
  • 20 statutory holidays, plus an additional 9–11 days of annual leave, 1 regional public holiday, and 4 bank holidays
  • Profit Sharing
  • Reimbursement of your train or bus pass
  • Telephone subscription and internet allowance
  • Pension Plan
  • Hybrid working
  • Personal growth and challenging work with endless possibilities
  • An informal working environment with innovative colleagues


About us

This is a unique opportunity to build and scale one of ING's most important customer engagement propositions. You'll have end-to-end ownership, direct business impact, and the freedom to shape experiences that customers interact with every day.

Ready to redefine customer loyalty in banking? Join us and help customers stay one step ahead. Discover what we do and what we can offer you.

Questions or want to apply directly?

title: D&T Project Manager (Delivery)
description:
Welcome to Haleon. We’re a purpose-driven, world-class consumer company putting everyday health in the hands of millions. In just three years since our launch, we’ve grown, evolved and are now entering an exciting new chapter – one filled with bold ambitions and enormous opportunity.

Our trusted portfolio of brands – including Sensodyne®, Panadol®, Advil®, Voltaren®, Theraflu®, Otrivin®, and Centrum® – lead in resilient and growing categories. What sets us apart is our unique blend of deep human understanding and trusted science.

Now it’s time to fully realise the full potential of our business and our people. We do this through our Win as One strategy. It puts our purpose – to deliver better everyday health with humanity – at the heart of everything we do. It unites us, inspires us, and challenges us to be better every day, driven by our agile, performance-focused culture.

About the role

The D&T Project Manager is responsible for the end‑to‑end delivery of technology projects within Haleon’s Digital & Technology (D&T) organisation.

The role ensures projects are delivered with discipline, transparency and predictability, operating within established delivery frameworks, governance standards and portfolio processes. Working closely with business stakeholders, delivery partners and cross‑functional D&T teams, the Project Manager maintains clear ownership of scope, plans, risks and outcomes.

This role is suited to an experienced delivery professional who is comfortable operating in structured, enterprise delivery environments, managing multiple stakeholders and suppliers, and providing clear, reliable insight throughout the project lifecycle.

Role purpose

To deliver D&T projects safely and predictably, ensuring agreed outcomes are achieved by applying standard delivery frameworks, managing risks and dependencies proactively, and maintaining clear communication with stakeholders and leadership.

Key accountabilities

The D&T Project Manager is accountable for:

  • Successful end‑to‑end delivery of assigned D&T projects

  • Consistent application of D&T delivery frameworks and governance

  • Effective management of scope, plans, risks, issues and dependencies

  • Clear, timely reporting of project status, risks and decisions

  • Strong stakeholder and supplier management

  • Maintaining focus on agreed business outcomes

Key responsibilities

1. Project Delivery & Execution

  • Own the delivery of assigned projects from initiation through to closure.

  • Ensure projects deliver agreed scope, timelines, quality standards and outcomes.

  • Apply standard D&T delivery approaches (Waterfall or hybrid as appropriate).

2. Planning & Control

  • Develop and maintain robust project plans, including milestones, dependencies and critical paths.

  • Track progress against plan and take corrective action where deviations occur.

  • Manage change in a controlled and transparent way.

3. Risk, Issue & Dependency Management

  • Proactively identify, manage and escalate project risks, issues and dependencies.

  • Ensure mitigation actions are clearly defined, owned and tracked to closure.

  • Maintain an accurate view of project health and delivery confidence at all times.

4. Stakeholder Management & Communication

  • Act as the primary point of contact for project stakeholders across business, D&T and suppliers.

  • Provide clear, honest and timely communication on progress, risks, decisions and impacts.

  • Manage expectations and maintain alignment throughout the project lifecycle.

5. Financial & Resource Management (Project Level)

  • Manage project budgets, forecasts and financial controls within delegated authority.

  • Work with Finance partners to provide accurate financial reporting and early visibility of variances.

  • Ensure project resources and capacity are planned and used effectively.

6. Supplier & Third‑Party Management

  • Manage delivery contributions from third‑party suppliers within the project scope.

  • Ensure suppliers deliver to agreed timelines, quality and contractual expectations.

  • Escalate supplier performance or dependency issues through appropriate governance forums.

7. Governance & Reporting

  • Operate within established delivery governance, ensuring all required artefacts and controls are maintained.

  • Provide accurate, decision‑oriented reporting into portfolio, performance and assurance forums.

  • Support reviews, stage gates and audits as required.

8. Outcomes, Adoption & Handover

  • Maintain focus on agreed business outcomes throughout delivery.

  • Support transition, handover and closure activities to enable successful adoption and ongoing ownership.

  • Contribute to benefits realisation tracking where applicable.

9. Continuous Improvement & Professional Standards

  • Apply lessons learned and best practice to improve delivery effectiveness.

  • Contribute positively to D&T delivery standards, ways of working and capability maturity.

  • Demonstrate accountability, professionalism and strong delivery discipline.

What good looks like

  • Projects are delivered with few surprises and clear delivery confidence

  • Risks and issues are identified early and managed proactively

  • Stakeholders have a clear understanding of progress, decisions and next steps

  • Delivery governance is followed consistently and professionally

  • Outcomes are achieved and transitions are well managed

  • The Project Manager is seen as reliable, organized and accountable

Qualifications & skills

Essential

  • Demonstrated experience delivering projects in Digital, Technology or Change environments

  • 8- 12 years of experience in relevant field.

  • Strong understanding of structured delivery approaches (Waterfall or hybrid)

  • Experience managing risks, dependencies and stakeholder expectations

  • Strong planning, organisational and communication skills

  • Comfortable working in complex, matrixed environments

Preferred

  • Experience operating within enterprise portfolio and governance frameworks

  • Exposure to regulated, operational or large‑scale environments

  • Experience managing third‑party suppliers

  • Relevant delivery certifications (e.g. PRINCE2, PMP or equivalent)

Job Posting End Date

2026-08-29

Equal Opportunities

Haleon are committed to mobilising our purpose in a way that represents the diverse consumers and communities who rely on our brands every day. It guides us in creating an inclusive culture, where different backgrounds and views are valued and respected – all in support of understanding and best serving the needs of our consumers and unleashing the full potential of our people. It’s important to us that Haleon is a place where all our employees feel they truly belong.

During the application process, we may ask you to share some personal information, which is entirely voluntary. United Overseas Bank Limited (UOB) is a leading bank in Asia with a global network of more than 500 branches and offices in 19 countries and territories in Asia Pacific, Europe and North America. Job Description

The FVP, Funds Due Diligence Analyst is responsible for conducting in-depth due diligence on investment funds, ensuring compliance with internal policies and regulatory requirements. This role plays a critical part in assessing and mitigating risks associated with fund investments for United Overseas Bank Ltd.

Job Responsibilities:**

* Perform comprehensive due diligence on new and existing investment funds, including hedge funds, private equity funds, and traditional funds.
* Analyze fund offering documents, financial statements, investment strategies, risk disclosures, and operational processes.

* Monitor ongoing performance, compliance, and significant events of approved funds.
* Stay abreast of industry trends, regulatory changes, and best practices in fund due diligence.
* Collaborate with internal stakeholders, including investment teams, legal, compliance, and risk management, to ensure alignment on fund selection and monitoring.
* Participate in the development and enhancement of due diligence methodologies and tools.
* Present due diligence findings and recommendations to senior management and relevant committees.

* Bachelor's degree in Finance, Economics, Business Administration, or a related field. CFA designation is highly preferred.
* Minimum of 8-10 years of experience in fund due diligence, investment research, or a related role within the financial services industry, preferably in a banking or asset management environment.
* Strong understanding of various investment strategies, asset classes, and financial instruments.
* Proven ability to analyze complex financial data, identify key risks, and articulate findings clearly and concisely.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to present technical information effectively to diverse audiences.
* Strong analytical, critical thinking, and problem-solving abilities.
* Familiarity with regulatory requirements relevant to fund investments (e.g., UCITS, AIFMD, MAS regulations).
* High level of integrity, attention to detail, and ability to work independently and as part of a team.

Job Description:

Cyber Incident Response Team (CIRT) Lead
Location: Full-time onsite, Falls Church, VA
Clearance: Active SECRET (must be maintained)

At GDIT, we are passionate about securing and supporting some of the most challenging government, defense, and intelligence missions. As part of our team, your work will have meaning and impact, helping to make today safer and tomorrow smarter. Join a culture that values autonomy, collaboration, and delivering your best every day.

GDIT has an opening for a Cyber Incident Response Team (CIRT) Lead supporting the Army National Guard (ARNG). This position is part of an IT Service Management contract that includes the operation, modernization, expansion, and evolution of the ARNG’s global IT services. These services span networking, compute, storage, infrastructure, cybersecurity, applications, hosting, and program management. The program operates within the ITIL framework to deliver high-quality IT services to the ARNG, and this leadership role is critical to ensuring the security and success of that mission.

HOW A CIRT LEAD WILL MAKE AN IMPACT

As the CIRT Lead, you will combine hands-on incident response expertise with team leadership responsibilities to guide analysts and coordinate complex cyber operations in support of ARNG.

Lead and Manage the CIRT Team

  • Provide day-to-day leadership of CIRT analysts, including tasking, prioritization, and oversight of incident response activities.

  • Mentor, coach, and develop team members, including feedback, informal performance guidance, and support for career development.

  • Ensure consistent adherence to incident response procedures, quality standards, and timelines.

  • Coordinate shift coverage, on-call rotations, and escalation paths to meet mission requirements.

  • Serve as the primary point of contact for CIRT-related activities with ARNG stakeholders and other GDIT teams.

Incident Response Operations

  • Lead triage of cyber incidents, determining scope, urgency, impact, and recommended courses of action.

  • Guide and, when necessary, perform collection and analysis of network/host artifacts (logs, images, packet captures) to identify root cause and operational impact.

  • Oversee real-time cyber defense incident handling, ensuring rapid, coordinated response and remediation.

  • Direct proactive identification of vulnerabilities and recommend mitigations to reduce risk.

  • Demonstrate and validate effectiveness of defenses through coordination with Red Team activities and investigations.

  • Ensure cyber defense incidents are managed, documented, and tracked from detection through resolution, with clear, concise reporting.

Process, Documentation, and Training

  • Maintain and improve Incident Response tactics, techniques, procedures (TTPs), and training documentation.

  • Plan and oversee the delivery of incident response training courses (at least four per calendar year), delegating instruction and ensuring quality content.

  • Support efforts to maintain the customer’s CSSP accreditation, including documentation, technical writing, and audit support.

  • Drive continuous improvement in incident response workflows, tools usage, and reporting.

Stakeholder Communication and Collaboration

  • Provide timely briefings and written reports to ARNG leadership and other stakeholders on incident status, trends, and lessons learned.

  • Participate in and often lead cross-functional meetings to improve cybersecurity posture across the environment.

  • Coordinate closely with engineering, operations, and other cyber defense teams to ensure alignment and effective mitigation of threats.

  • Support on-call and after-hours activities as needed, and ensure the team is prepared to respond to time-sensitive events under tight deadlines.

WHAT YOU’LL NEED TO SUCCEED

Education / Equivalent Training

  • Bachelor’s degree in information technology, computer science, or a related technical discipline; or an equivalent combination of education, technical certifications/training, and relevant work experience.

Required Experience

  • 5+ years of practical experience in a cybersecurity, engineering, T&E, or A&A-related field.

  • Demonstrated prior experience with cyber incident response on DoW networks and digital forensics.

  • Experience in a lead or senior role guiding incident response activities or mentoring junior analysts is strongly preferred.

Technical and Leadership Skills

  • Proficiency in collecting and analyzing logs, system images, and other artifacts to investigate and resolve cybersecurity incidents.

  • Strong understanding of cybersecurity concepts, mitigation strategies, root cause analysis, and Red Team operations.

  • Familiarity with current cyber defense tools and technologies (e.g., SIEM, IDS/IPS, endpoint protection, packet capture tools).

  • Excellent oral and written communication skills for both technical and non-technical audiences, including incident reports and briefings.

  • Strong organizational skills for multitasking, meeting deadlines, and managing team workload.

  • Ability to work independently and lead a team in fast-paced environments, solving complex problems under pressure.

  • Collaborative mindset, strong customer service orientation, and ability to build trust and credibility with customers and team members.

  • Dependability, punctuality, responsiveness to management, and attention to detail.

Certification Requirements

  • Must possess the appropriate baseline certification(s) to achieve at least DoWD 8570.01-M IAT Level II (e.g., CompTIA Security+ CE) prior to start.

  • Must obtain an additional computing environment certification within six months of hire based on position designation (e.g., CEH, CCNA-Security, CND, etc.).

  • When DoW 8140 requirements are implemented on the program/contract, employees must conform to 8140 certification standards.

Security Clearance

  • Active SECRET security clearance required and must be maintained.

GDIT IS YOUR PLACE

At GDIT, the mission is our purpose, and our people are at the center of everything we do.

  • Growth: AI-powered career tools that identify career steps and learning opportunities.

  • Support: An internal mobility team focused on helping you achieve your career goals.

  • Rewards: Comprehensive benefits and wellness packages, 401(k) with company match, competitive pay, and paid time off.

  • Community: Award-winning culture of innovation and a military-friendly workplace.

OWN YOUR OPPORTUNITY
Explore a leadership role in cyber incident response at GDIT and you’ll find opportunities to guide mission-critical work while growing alongside colleagues who share your passion for the mission and delivering results.
