Terms of Reference

1. General Background

The Office of the United Nations High Commissioner for Refugees (UNHCR) was established on December 14, 1950 by the United Nations General Assembly. The UN Refugee Agency is mandated to lead and co- ordinate international action to protect refugees and resolve refugee problems worldwide. Its primary purpose is to safeguard the rights and well-being of refugees. It strives to ensure that everyone can exercise the right to seek asylum and find safe refuge in another State, with the option to return home voluntarily, integrate locally or to resettle in a third country.

UNHCR has helped millions of people to restart their lives. They include asylum seekers, refugees, returnees, stateless people and internally displaced persons. Its interventions in the areas of protection, shelter, health and education have been crucial, healing broken pasts and building brighter futures.

The UNHCR Office in China was established in 1979. Although China has been party to the 1951 Convention and 1967 Protocol since 1982. UNHCR registers asylum seekers, conducts individual refugee status determination under its mandate, and seeks durable solutions for refugees. UNHCR works with the government authorities to build domestic capacity and will continue working with all stakeholders in China to ensure refugees and asylum-seekers receive adequate protection and assistance.

UNHCR will continue to work with all stakeholders in China to ensure persons of concern receive adequate protection and assistance as well as to seek durable solutions for refugees.

The Private Sector Partnerships Service (PSP) sits within UNHCR’s Division of External Relations (DER) and is responsible for mobilizing resources and other forms of support from the private sector. In 2019, UNHCR China Office set up a new Private Sector Partnerships team to mobilize resources from the Chinese private sector to support our work globally. One of the key aspects in PSP’s work is to expand UNHCR’s engagement with the general public including UNHCR’s existing and potential supporters.


UNHCR is now looking for a highly motivated and dedicated PPH fundraiser, with expertise in philanthropy, high-net-worth individual (HNWI) engagement, donor relations, or related fields. The selected candidate will join the PPH team to cultivate relationships and enhance partnerships with philanthropists and major donors.

2. Purpose and Scope of Assignment

Work under the functional guidance of the Assistant PPH Officer, the incumbent will support the overall development of Private Philanthropy team and play a leading role in expanding the UNHCR’s Major Donor pool in China:
• Assisting in the formulation and execution of the PPH strategy specific to philanthropy and
HNWI engagement within the Chinese market.
• Lead the end-to-end development of the Major Donor programme in the China market, including donor acquisition strategies, pipeline building, and stewardship frameworks.
• Identify, qualify, and cultivate prospective Major Donors aligned with UNHCR priorities and the local philanthropic landscape.
• Take ownership of selected donor relationships across the full donor lifecycle, including prospecting, cultivation, conversion, and stewardship. Conducting market mapping and research to identify new donor segments, market intelligence, and fundraising oportunities. Provide insights and analysis to support strategic decision-making and refine donor development approaches.
• Facilitating effective information management and knowledge sharing by organizing and distributing relevant partnership and philanthropy documents and data.
• Assisting with the logistics of both internal and external events, including coordinating skill- sharing sessions.
• Assist in the development of pitches, presentations, proposals, reports, and other fundraising materials.
• Working alongside administrative staff to support procurement, administrative duties, and travel arrangements for the PPH team.
• Maintaining accurate and current records of partnerships and donor interactions, managing income tracking, updating internal schedules, and overseeing data management on platforms like Salesforce.
• Supporting the implementation of communication and visibility strategies for philanthropy and
HNWI donors, including organizing content collection and preparing communication materials.
• Ensuring compliance with UNHCR Due Diligence Procedures and preparing compliance reports for the global PSP team.
• Enhancing UNHCR’s visibility and positioning it as the preferred organization for individuals and entities interested in supporting issues related to forced displacement.
• Assisting in creating and distributing promotional materials for campaigns aimed at philanthropy and HNWI donors to ensure they align with overall objectives and timelines.
• Collaborating closely with broader PSP market strategies and initiatives, including working on non-direct cash contributions together with IG and MVD programs.


• Undertaking other related duties as needed to support the team’s overarching goals.

3. Monitoring and Progress Controls

The individual contractor will work in the UNHCR office under direct supervision of Assistant PPH Officer and will be assessed according to;

The Pima County Public Library is looking for a Librarian I to join our team! title: Network Security-NDR
description:
Calling all innovators - find your future at Fiserv.

We're Fiserv, a global leader in Fintech and payments, and we move money and information in a way that moves the world. We connect financial institutions, corporations, merchants and consumers to one another millions of times a day - quickly, reliably, and securely. Any time you swipe your credit card, pay through a mobile app, or withdraw money from the bank, we're involved. If you want to make an impact on a global scale, come make a difference at Fiserv.

Job Title

Network Security-NDR

About your role:

In this role, we will rely on you to engineer, implement and support network security controls that protect enterprise infrastructure across on-premises, cloud and hybrid environments. You will help strengthen network defenses, improve visibility into traffic and threats, and support secure, resilient connectivity across the organization.

This role requires strong hands-on experience in network security engineering, operational support and continuous improvement. The ideal candidate brings practical expertise with enterprise security technologies, strong troubleshooting ability and experience using ExtraHop to enhance network visibility and threat detection.

What you’ll do:

  • Engineer, implement, and support enterprise network security solutions while partnering with infrastructure, cloud, architecture, and security operations teams to maintain secure connectivity.
  • Develop custom applications, integrations, and automation services that enhance Network Detection and Response (NDR) capabilities, improve network visibility, and reduce analyst workload.
  • Build and continuously improve detection analytics, enrichment pipelines, and automated response workflows to identify anomalous and malicious network activity.
  • Create automated mechanisms to collect, normalize, enrich, and analyze network telemetry to improve detection fidelity and operational effectiveness.
  • Deploy, maintain, and scale security automation solutions using modern software engineering, DevOps, Infrastructure-as-Code, and CI/CD practices; Administer, optimize, and maintain security technologies including firewalls, VPNs, IDS/IPS, network segmentation controls, and secure access platforms.
  • Utilize ExtraHop and other monitoring tools to analyze network traffic, investigate anomalies, identify suspicious activity, and improve overall network visibility. Monitor and analyze network activity and security events to support threat detection, incident response, forensic investigations, and operational troubleshooting.
  • Support vulnerability management, risk assessments, audits, compliance activities, and remediation efforts related to network security controls; Develop engineering documentation, operational procedures, runbooks, and standards.

Experience you’ll need to have:

  • Hands-on expertise with enterprise firewalls (Palo Alto, Check Point, Cisco Firepower, Fortinet) including deployment, administration, and troubleshooting.
  • Strong network security engineering experience with firewall policy management, rule optimization, and network segmentation.
  • Hands-on experience with ExtraHop or NDR for network traffic analysis, anomaly detection, threat investigation, and operational visibility.
  • Proficiency in TCP/IP networking fundamentals, including routing, switching, DNS, DHCP, and load balancing.
  • Experience with VPN technologies supporting secure remote access and site-to-site connectivity.
  • Knowledge of IDS/IPS technologies, network threat detection, and traffic analysis methodologies.
  • Strong troubleshooting skills using packet capture and analysis tools to investigate network and security incidents.
  • Understanding security controls across on-premises, cloud, and hybrid environments, including segmentation and Zero Trust principles.

Experience that would be great to have:

  • 5+ years’ experience with AI coding tools such as GitHub Copilot, Microsoft Copilot, Cursor, or Claude Code.
  • Exposure to AI agents, workflow automation, and process orchestration.
  • Experience developing APIs, integrations, or automation solutions and familiarity with DevOps, CI/CD, Infrastructure-as-Code, and Git-based development.

About Domain and CoStar Group

Domain is one of Australia’s most trusted and loved property brands, helping millions of Australians find their dream home and stay informed about the property market.

Now, Domain has joined forces with CoStar Group, a global leader in real estate information, analytics, and online marketplaces to take the next big leap in property technology and data innovation.

Collect and verify critical on-site property and tenant data as a Field Research Associate, serving as the cornerstone of CoStar's industry-leading database.

You will be part of a highly motivated and versatile team, directly responsible for capturing the intelligence that powers all CoStar Group products. Your meticulous, on-the-ground work documenting new tenants, occupancy, available space, and building characteristics ensures our clients receive the most accurate and comprehensive market picture, driving significant value in the real estate industry.

This is your opportunity to play an essential role in shaping the future of real estate intelligence.

Job Description:

Join our team as our SOC Analyst Level 3

Farnborough (Onsite)
Full UK Driving Licence Required

Ready to Take Your Cyber Security Career to the Next Level?

At DXC Technology, we're trusted to protect some of the UK's most secure and critical environments. We're looking for a talented SOC Analyst Level 3 to join our high-performing Security Operations Centre in Farnborough.

Whether you're already operating at SOC Level 3 or you're an ambitious SOC Level 2 Analyst ready to step into your next challenge, this is an opportunity to accelerate your career while working on some of the most complex and rewarding cyber security challenges in the industry.

You'll be part of a highly skilled team at the forefront of cyber defence, leading investigations into sophisticated threats, developing advanced detection capabilities, and helping shape the future direction of our security monitoring services.

Why This Opportunity Stands Out

This isn't just another SOC role.

You'll have the opportunity to:

  • Lead investigations into advanced cyber threats within highly secure environments.
  • Drive threat hunting campaigns and uncover previously unseen attack techniques.
  • Influence how security monitoring services evolve and improve.
  • Mentor and develop junior analysts, helping shape the next generation of cyber talent.
  • Work directly with customers and stakeholders, becoming a trusted cyber security adviser.
  • Build expertise in threat intelligence, content engineering, incident response, and security operations strategy.

What You'll Be Doing

As a Tier 3 Security Analyst, you'll play a pivotal role in protecting customer environments by:

  • Developing innovative methods to detect threats and uncover anomalous behaviour.
  • Leading complex security investigations and coordinating response activities during incidents.
  • Driving proactive threat hunting activities across customer environments.
  • Producing actionable cyber threat intelligence and sharing key findings with stakeholders.
  • Acting as the technical escalation point for security incidents.
  • Engineering and enhancing detection content using Elastic Stack and related technologies.
  • Presenting findings and recommendations to both technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Supporting, mentoring and developing SOC team members.
  • Contributing to internal cyber security forums and customer workgroups.
  • Participating in an on-call rota and occasional travel to customer locations.

What We're Looking For

We're seeking passionate cyber security professionals with experience in:

  • Security Operations Centre (SOC) environments.
  • Cyber threat detection and incident response.
  • Networking fundamentals including protocols, traffic flows and IP addressing.
  • Windows and Linux operating systems.
  • Threat actor tactics, techniques and procedures (TTPs).
  • Indicators of Compromise (IOCs) and Indicators of Attack (IOAs).
  • Cyber Threat Intelligence (CTI).
  • Elastic Stack or other SIEM technologies.
  • Open-Source Intelligence (OSINT) methodologies.
  • Communicating technical information clearly to varied audiences.
  • Coaching, mentoring or supporting less experienced analysts.

Desirable Experience

  • CompTIA Security+, SecurityX, CISSP, CISM or similar certifications.
  • Experience working within highly secure or government environments.
  • Advanced SIEM engineering and detection content experience.

What You'll Gain

At DXC, you'll join a team where learning, innovation and career development are actively encouraged.

You'll benefit from:

  • Exposure to cutting-edge cyber security threats and technologies.
  • Structured career progression opportunities.
  • Ongoing training, mentoring and certification support.
  • The chance to work within some of the UK's most secure environments.
  • A collaborative culture where expertise is shared and valued.
  • Opportunities to influence security strategy rather than simply monitor alerts.

Interested?

If you're an experienced SOC Level 3 Analyst or a high-potential SOC Level 2 Analyst looking for the opportunity to step up, we want to hear from you.

Apply today and take your cyber security career to the next level while helping defend some of the UK's most critical systems from emerging cyber threats

title: Logistics Specialist TS/SCI
description:
Amentum is currently seeking a Logistics Specialist to join our dynamic team in the Winchester VA area. In this position you’ll directly support our customers’ warehouse operations and logistics life cycle to include shipping and receiving, inventory accountability, storage and distribution.

You will be responsible for the secure receipt, control, handling, storage and movement of customer equipment and supplies. Must hold a valid driver's license and be capable of operating a range of vehicles including box trucks, forklifts, and other material handling equipment. This position requires an active DoD TS/SCI security clearance that has been adjudicated in the last 5 years or designated CE and the ability to obtain and maintain special accesses.

Work Schedule:

Work is performed Monday – Friday in office. 8 hours per day.

Essential Responsibilities:

Execute logistics and warehousing activities:

  • Operate software programs designed specifically to manage logistical functions, such as procurement, inventory management, and other supply chain planning.
  • Material handling, including loading, unloading, moving, and sorting a variety of items, to ensure efficient workflow.
  • Ensure compliance with physical security guidelines, maintain security of customer information.
  • Maintain warehouse cleanliness, organization, and safety standards.
  • Assist with inventory management and reconciliation of inventory discrepancies.
  • Maintain and update inventories in Defense Property Accountability System (DPAS).
  • Use Microsoft Office suite applications to produce reports on logistics activities.
  • Receive incoming shipments and verify accuracy against purchase orders and packing lists.
  • Unload, unpack, and inspect materials for damage or discrepancies.
  • Responsible for the packaging and documentation for all materials. Ensure all items are labeled, stored and packed properly including the safe and efficient use of Material Handling Equipment (MHE) such as pallet jacks and forklifts.
  • Support additional warehouse and logistics tasks as assigned.
  • Transportation activities:
    • Receives local or nationwide trip assignment.
    • Performs safety inspection of vehicle and notes any needed repairs on vehicle condition report.
    • Perform routine vehicle checks ensuring vehicles are prepared for trips.
    • Assists with truck loading as necessary, ensuring that material is loaded in accordance with weight distribution guidelines and limitations.
    • Drive truck to designated local or nationwide delivery point(s); may be accompanied by another driver.
    • Assists in identifying items requiring special handling at delivery point.
    • Unloads truck using a variety of material handling equipment.
    • Assists crew with loading backhaul cargo, ensuring that material is loaded in accordance with weight distribution guidelines and limitations.
  • Travel as needed (20-30%).

Work Environment, Physical Demands, and Mental Demands:

  • Will be required to work in a warehouse where they may be exposed to fumes from vehicles, noise, and dust. Must be able to regularly lift a minimum of 50 lbs. and sustain physical activity throughout the day. Operate forklifts and other material handling equipment. Experience and comfort with a physical job that involves repetitive motions, climbing, stooping, crouching, bending, kneeling, pushing, reaching, and pulling. Use of computer terminals is required.

Minimum Requirements (Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities):

  • Active DoD TS/SCI security clearance is required with adjudication within the last 5 years or designated CE and the ability to obtain and maintain special accesses.
  • Basic computer skills and experience using MS- Office Suite including Word, Excel, Power Point.
  • Logistics, warehouse, distribution operations or supply chain related experience
  • Ability to operate a range of vehicles, including box trucks, forklifts, and other material handling equipment.
  • Demonstrated dependability, positive attitude, and eagerness to learn.
  • Ability to accurately follow established procedures and directions to locate proper delivery destinations.
  • Ability to work independently and as part of a team
  • Strong attention to detail and excellent organizational skills

LCL Operations Associate

Maersk is a global leader in integrated logistics and have been industry pioneers for over a century. Through innovation and transformation we are redefining the boundaries of possibility, continuously setting new standards for efficiency, sustainability, and excellence.

At Maersk, we believe in the power of diversity, collaboration, and continuous learning and we work hard to ensure that the people in our organization reflect and understand the customers we exist to serve.

With over 100,000 employees across 130 countries, we work together to shape the future of global trade and logistics.

Join us as we harness cutting-edge technologies and unlock opportunities on a global scale. Together, let's sail towards a brighter, more sustainable future with Maersk.

What we offer you

  • We offer an exciting job opportunity in an internationally growing business environment characterized by high pace.

  • You will work in a team with motivated and engaged people with a diverse background

  • An attractive compensation package including an annual bonus based on the company’s performance

Key responsibilities

Within shipping and logistics pro-active communication and information flow towards our customers is the key in ensuring end-to-end connectivity and transparency.

  • As our LCL Operations Associate, you will be responsible for ensuring a smooth end-to-end shipment process for both import and export shipments.

  • Manage and execute orders on a daily basis.

  • Own the order scope as delegated by the LCL & FCL Team Lead.

  • Monitor new order inflow and the assignment of transport plans by the Operations team.

  • Update revenue for ordered services at the time of booking and manage any accessorial costs – with customer approval (subject to the agreed SOP) – prior to billing, in accordance with the terms of the order.

  • Accrue costs for services delivered overseas within the Maersk network and ensure that ICB billing is closed and cleared in a timely manner.

  • Accrue vendor costs and work closely with our Finance teams to review incoming vendor invoices and dispute charges that are not in accordance with agreed contracts, as well as costs resulting from errors or handling deviations not caused by Maersk or the customer.

  • Close system files on time after carefully reviewing estimated and billed revenue and ensuring the proper accrual of costs.

  • Work closely with the Operations team to ensure clear communication and visibility of transport plans, including any changes resulting from cargo readiness or adjustments to the transport plan.

  • Apply process improvements and continuous learning to increase efficiency and effectiveness in daily work.

This is how you reach your goal

  • You are enthusiastic and a team player

  • You are solution oriented and will go out of your way to make customers happy

  • You have experience in a service-oriented environment

  • You can multitask and you learn fast.

Your profile

  • Previous experience working in a service company (B2B or B2C), preferably involving order management and/or order execution.

  • Relevant educational background supporting a career in the maritime industry, logistics and/or supply chain operations.

  • Experience in LCL and FCL operations would be an advantage but is not a requirement.

  • Experience working with order management systems, preferably within transportation services (e.g. CargoWise).

  • Strong communication skills and experience interacting directly with customers and third-party vendors, combined with a customer-focused mindset.

  • Ability to prioritize and structure work effectively when managing orders with timelines spanning several days or weeks.

  • Familiarity with shipment billing, cost accruals and related financial processes would be an advantage.

  • Full-time availability.

  • Ability to work both independently and as part of a team.

As a world leader in creating comfortable, sustainable, and efficient climate solutions for buildings, homes and transportation, it's our responsibility to put the planet first. We boldly go.

Where is the work:

Field-based: Work is conducted on-site at customer locations.

What’s in it for you:

The Chiller Technician role is the primary service and maintenance contact for Trane Technologies customers in a defined market with a diverse commercial base including Healthcare, Process Manufacturing Facilities, Education Institutions, and Office Complexes. As a Chiller Technician, you will be primarily responsible for repairing Chillers ranging from 50 Tons and up. Additionally, you will be responsible for scheduled and unscheduled Chiller preventative maintenance, inspections, and service requests including replacement, and modifications of Chiller equipment or systems as needed or requested by customers. You will be responsible for testing Chillers on our onsite test stand, point to point testing, starting up, commissioning, and servicing on assigned Chillers or HVAC equipment. This position affords you the opportunity to work with internal and external partners ranging from new facility set ups to existing facility retro fits. Trane affords you the opportunity to work directly for a leading manufacturer, giving you access to technical support, training on newest technology and comprehensive career paths with opportunity for growth.

What you will do:

  • Chiller repair and troubleshooting experience are essential for this role.

  • Responsible for servicing and assembling Chiller equipment, ranging from 50 Tons and up

  • Work is mostly performed onsite at hospitals, arenas, casinos, shopping malls as well as occasional assigned projects, and jobsites. Represents the company by serving as the direct customer contact and is responsible for servicing chiller products and chiller equipment on assigned projects, ensuring customer satisfaction by identifying, examining, diagnosing and repairing chiller equipment and systems at customer’s location.

  • Coordinates with team leader/project manager and customer to precisely understand requirements for all on-site installation and repairs by forecasting issues, gathering materials and synchronizing on-site work.

  • Uses cutting edge software and technology, along with a variety of hand-tools, following blueprints or engineering specifications, to diagnose and repair units.

Embitel Technologies is a Volkswagen AG (VW) Group Company. VW is a German multinational automotive manufacturing corporation headquartered in Wolfsburg, Germany. The group comprises of 12 brands from seven European Countries: Volkswagen, Audi, Lamborghini, Porsche, Bugatti, Bentley, Ducati (motorcycles), Skoda, SEAT, Scania, MAN and Volkswagen commercial vehicles.

About CARIAD (Car, I Am Digital)


The automotive industry is in disruption. As a company, CARIAD is playing a part in multiple large trends at the same time: electrification, automation, and digitalization. The new name builds on changing customer needs. Automotive customers are demanding more comfort, more safety, more sustainability, and more connectivity. With its software platforms and digital features, CARIAD is developing solutions and products that will turn the car into a smart companion to accompany customers into the future with continuous updates and new digital features, even years later. title: Process Automation & AI Solutions Specialist
description:
At U.S. Bank, we’re on a journey to do our best. Helping the customers and businesses we serve to make better and smarter financial decisions and enabling the communities we support to grow and succeed. We believe it takes all of us to bring our shared ambition to life, and each person is unique in their potential. A career with U.S. Bank gives you a wide, ever-growing range of opportunities to discover what makes you thrive at every stage of your career. Try new things, learn new skills and discover what you excel at—all from Day One.

Job Description

The Process, Transformation & Automation team is a central resource to support identification and evaluation of Artificial Intelligence & Machine Learning (AI/ML), Automation, and Process improvement opportunities. The team solves challenging and complex operational problems across various functions, providing a broad exposure across Operations. Simplification, speed, and efficiency is a critical part of our strategy, and as a Process Automation and AI Solutions Specialist, you will play a critical role in driving our strategy forward. You will collaborate closely with cross-functional teams and leadership to identify opportunities and translate them into actionable plans and ensure their effective execution. Your expertise in process analytics, AI/ML technologies, automation, and problem-solving will be essential to deliver results and achieve our business objectives. You will work in a collaborative fashion with a large cross section of stakeholders, partners and other SMEs. You must be able to combine a high-level strategic approach, with an ability for detailed and hands-on discovery work needed for the success of the business. Work includes analyzing and measuring the effectives of existing business processes and developing sustainable, repeatable, and quantifiable improvements.

This role does not support visa sponsorship/STEM OPT and requires working from one of the posted U.S. Bank locations three (3) or more days per week

RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Assessment, design, and execution planning of improvement initiatives, including data collection, quantitative and qualitative analysis, SME interviews, process mapping, and gap analyses to identify opportunities for AI/ML, process improvements, automation, and optimizations.

  • Synthesize insights, draw conclusions, and translate insights and recommendations into presentable slides and build a cohesive story.

  • Provide objective advice, expertise, and specialist skills with the aim of creating value, maximizing growth, or improving business performance.

  • Collaboration and partnership with Business Lines. Foster strong working relationships with various departments and SMEs.

  • Support to business line leaders to ensure adoption and integration of new processes while promoting standards and tools for ongoing use within the business. Provide guidance and support to teams in navigating through change and uncertainty.

  • Establish KPIs to measure effectiveness of improvement initiatives.

  • Prepare regular presentations for senior management, highlighting progress, challenges, and recommended actions.

  • Participate in the identification and assessment of potential new projects.

  • Build collaboration and partnerships with Finance & Risk Partners

Preferred Skills/Experience:

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to gather and interpret data to inform decision-making.

  • Experience with implementing Artificial Intelligence & Machine Learning (AI/ML) and Automation solutions

  • Effective verbal and written presentation and communication skills.

  • Exceptional leadership skills with the ability to motivate and inspire cross-functional teams and influence without authority.

  • Ability to multitask, prioritize effectively, manage competing priorities, and comfortable working through ambiguity.

  • Ability to work closely with colleagues at all levels, from senior business leaders to front line staff.

  • Ownership mindset and doer mindset.

  • Experience in management consulting.

  • Training/certification in Lean Management System, Lean Six Sigma, and Process improvement methodologies/tools.

Basic Qualifications
- Bachelor's degree, or equivalent work experience
- Eight to 10 years of related experience

title: QC Specialist
description:
Opella is the self-care challenger with the purest and third-largest portfolio in the Over-The-Counter (OTC) & Vitamins, Minerals & Supplements (VMS) market globally.​

Our mission: to bring health in people’s hands by making self-care as simple as it should be for over half a billion consumers worldwide.​

At the core of this mission is our 100+ loved brands, our 11,000-strong global team, our 13 best-in-class manufacturing sites and four specialized science and innovation development centers. ​

Headquartered in France, Opella is the proud maker of many of the world’s most loved brands, including Allegra, Buscopan, Doliprane, Dulcolax, Enterogermina, Essentiale and Mucosolvan.​ B Corp certified in multiple markets, we are active players in the journey towards healthier people and planet.​

Find out more about our mission to bring health in your hands at www.opella.com.

JOB PURPOSE

In charge of managing lab equipment, including qualification, calibration, maintenance, and all other activities related to the lab equipment according to GMP, GLP requirements and data integrity compliance.

Responsible for HSE-related activities in the lab, including monitoring actions from safety risk report (SRR), gemba, and other activities according to HSE requirements.

KEY ACCOUNTABILITIES

  • Plan calibration schedules, monitor, and carry out periodic equipment calibration
  • Troubleshoot technical issues related to QC equipment
  • Plan maintenance, monitor, and coordinate with suppliers to perform equipment maintenance
  • Manage consumables for equipment and plan purchases to ensure replacements when damaged
  • Create protocols and perform qualification for new and periodic equipment including IQ/OQ/PQ and CSV if applicable
  • Create and modify analytical methods on equipment as required
  • Conduct user reviews and periodic calibration results as needed
  • Perform data backup and recovery for equipment as required
  • Conduct assessments and requirements related to data integrity of laboratory equipment
  • Follow up on actions related to lab safety issues from SRR, gemba, etc.
  • Manage 5S activities in the laboratory
  • Perform tasks according to GLP/GMP requirements as assigned by site QC Lead and report monthly on the tasks
  • Support the QC manager on-the-job training for new employees.
  • Strictly follow standard operating procedures and factory regulations.
  • Participate in HSE activities as required by the company.

Education: Bachelor/ Chemical Engineer or University Pharmacist

Related experience: At least 1 years in management of QC lab equipment

Why us?

At Opella, you will enjoy doing challenging, purposeful work, empowered to develop consumer brands with passion and creativity. This is your chance to grow new skills and be part of a bold, collaborative, and inclusive culture where people can thrive and be at their best every day.

We Are Challengers.

We are dedicated to making self-care as simple as it should be. That starts with our culture. We are challengers by nature, and this is how we do things:

All In Together: We keep each other honest and have each other's backs.

Courageous: We break boundaries and take thoughtful risks with creativity.

Outcome-Obsessed: We are personally accountable, driving sustainable impact and results with integrity.

Radically Simple: We strive to make things simple for us and simple for consumers, as it should be.

Join us on our mission. Health. In your hands.

title: ERC Generalist

title: Programme Policy Officer NOA, Farchana, Chad
description:
DEADLINE FOR APPLICATIONS

28 August 2026-23:59-GMT+01:00 West Africa Standard Time (Ndjamena)

WFP celebrates and embraces diversity. It is committed to the principle of equal employment opportunity for all its employees and encourages qualified candidates to apply irrespective of race, colour, national origin, ethnic or social background, genetic information, gender, gender identity and/or expression, sexual orientation, religion or belief, HIV status or disability.


ABOUT WFP

The World Food Programme is the world’s largest humanitarian organization saving lives in emergencies and using food assistance to build a pathway to peace, stability and prosperity, for people recovering from conflict, disasters and the impact of climate change.


At WFP, people are at the heart of everything we do and the vision of the future WFP workforce is one of diverse, committed, skilled, and high performing teams, selected on merit, operating in a healthy and inclusive work environment, living WFP's values (Integrity, Collaboration, Commitment, Humanity, and Inclusion) and working with partners to save and change the lives of those WFP serves.

To learn more about WFP, visit our website: and follow us on social media to keep up with our latest news: YouTube, LinkedIn, Instagram, Facebook, Twitter, TikTok.

WHY JOIN WFP?

  • WFP is a 2020 Nobel Peace Prize Laureate.

  • WFP offers a highly inclusive, diverse, and multicultural working environment.

  • WFP invests in the personal & professional development of its employees through a range of training, accreditation, coaching, mentorship, and other programs as well as through internal mobility opportunities.

  • A career path in WFP provides an exciting opportunity to work across the various country, regional and global offices around the world, and with passionate colleagues who work tirelessly to ensure that effective humanitarian assistance reaches millions of people across the globe.

  • We offer an attractive compensation package (please refer to the Terms and Conditions section of this vacancy announcement).

ORGANIZATIONAL CONTEXT

This job is part of Chad Country Office (CO) and report to athe head of filed office, Farchana. The job holder is likely to be working under the close support and guidance of a more experienced professional staff member receiving guidance and regular feedback on work performed. He is typically involved in programme or policy activities or similar nature and analytical work of limited complexity.

JOB PURPOSE

To provide support to policy and programme activities that effectively meet food assistance needs.

KEY ACCOUNTABILITIES (not all-inclusive, within delegated authority):

  • Effectively manage the Programme team in the Farchana office, including ensuring effective communication with other units and stakeholders.

  • Strengthen the capacities of colleagues and partners, particularly regarding the use of WFP corporate systems and awareness of protection, PSEA (Protection from Sexual Exploitation and Abuse), as well as gender and nutrition.

  • Ensure that WFP operations under the responsibility of the Farchana office are implemented in accordance with corporate and country-specific guidelines, and that assistance reaches beneficiaries in a timely manner.

  • Contribute towards the development of a limited number of projects, plans and processes, ensuring alignment with wider programme policies and guidance.

  • Provide project management support to specific and defined programmes and projects of small to moderate size that are relatively straight forward in nature, ensuring a coordinated approach with wider programmes that complies with WFP standards and procedures.

  • Follow data gathering and monitoring systems ensuring that rigorous quality standards are maintained.

  • Research and analyse policy and operational issues to support senior colleagues in the development of policies, programmes and activities.

  • Contribute to the preparation of accurate and timely reporting on programmes and activities that enable informed decision making and consistency of information presented to stakeholders.

  • Liaise with internal counterparts to ensure effective collaboration, monitor ongoing projects.

  • Support the identification, development and management of potential partnerships to collaborative working leading to improved food assistance packages.

  • Support the capacity building of WFP staff, partners and national government to prepare for and respond to food assistance needs, e.g. through project management support of learning initiatives.

  • Provide guidance to support staff, acting as a point of referral and assisting them with analysis and queries.

  • Other as required.

QUALIFICATIONS AND EXPERIENCE

Education: Have an advanced University degree in International Affairs, Economics, Nutrition/Health, Agriculture, Environmental Science, Social Sciences or other field relevant to international development assistance, or First University Degree with additional years of related work experience and/or trainings/courses.

Language: Fluency (level C) in French and in English (Level B) is requested.

DESIRED EXPERIENCES FOR ENTRY INTO THE ROLE

  • Have one year of professional experience

  • Has gained experience in implementing technical programs (i.e. nutrition, etc.).

  • Has implemented programmes and provided input into designing operations.

  • Has provided input into policy discussions and decisions.

WFP LEADERSHIP FRAMEWORK

WFP Leadership Framework guides to the common standards of behavior that guide HOW we work together to accomplish our mission.

Click here to access WFP Leadership Framework

REASONABLE ACCOMMODATION

WFP is committed to supporting individuals with disabilities by providing reasonable accommodations throughout the recruitment process. If you require a reasonable accommodation, please contact: global.inclusion@wfp.org

NO FEE DISCLAIMER

The United Nations does not charge any application, processing, training, interviewing, testing or other fee in connection with the application or recruitment process. Should you receive a solicitation for the payment of a fee, please disregard it. Furthermore, please note that emblems, logos, names and addresses are easily copied and reproduced. Therefore, you are advised to apply particular care when submitting personal information on the web.

REMINDERS BEFORE YOU SUBMIT YOUR APPLICATION

  • All applications must be submitted exclusively through our online recruiting system. We do not consider CVs or applications sent by email, LinkedIn, or any other channel.

  • We strongly recommend that your Workday profile is accurate and complete, and that all sections are filled in, including your employment history, academic qualifications, language skills, and UN grade (if applicable). Once your profile is completed, please apply, and submit your application.

  • If you experience technical issues while submitting your application, you may contact us at global.hrerecruitment@wfp.org. Please note that this email is only for technical issues with an application - unsolicited applications or documents sent to this inbox will not receive a reply.

  • At the application stage, the only required documents are your CV and Cover Letter. Additional documents (passport, certificates, recommendation letters, etc.) may be requested later in the process.

  • Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted and invited to proceed to the next stage of the recruitment process.

All employment decisions are made on the basis of organizational needs, job requirements, merit, and individual qualifications. WFP is committed to providing an inclusive work environment free of sexual exploitation and abuse, all forms of discrimination, any kind of harassment, sexual harassment, and abuse of authority. Therefore, all selected candidates will undergo rigorous reference and background checks.


No appointment under any kind of contract will be offered to members of the UN Advisory Committee on Administrative and Budgetary Questions (ACABQ), International Civil Service Commission (ICSC), FAO Finance Committee, WFP External Auditor, WFP Audit Committee, Joint Inspection Unit (JIU) and other similar bodies within the United Nations system with oversight responsibilities over WFP, both during their service and within three years of ceasing that service.

description:
ACCIONA is a global company, leading in the development of regenerative infrastructure that creates a positive impact on society. Our workforce consists of more than 65,000 professionals, present in more than 40 countries across the five continents, all contributing in our mission to design a better planet. Are you a passionate individual who wants to make a difference, promote sustainable development, and find solutions to the biggest global challenges including climate change, overpopulation, and water scarcity? Come and join us in building the infrastructure our planet needs to achieve a sustainable future.

Job Description

ACCIONA is a global leader in sustainable infrastructure and renewable energy, committed to delivering innovative solutions that support the transition to a low-carbon economy. In Australia, ACCIONA is delivering the Alkimos Seawater Desalination Plant, a landmark project that will secure Perth’s water future and support long-term sustainability for the community.

The Opportunity

You will play a critical role in ensuring that all electrical and control system works are executed safely, efficiently, and in accordance with technical specifications, project schedules, and quality standards.

This is a unique opportunity to contribute to a major infrastructure project while advancing your expertise in complex industrial electrical and control systems.

  • Champion a strong safety culture, ensuring compliance with electrical safety standards, environmental requirements, and project procedures

  • Ensure compliance with design specifications, drawings, QA/QC requirements, and relevant standards (AS/NZS, IEC)
  • Monitor subcontractor performance across electrical and I&C packages, including switchboards, cabling, field instrumentation, and control systems

  • Apply digital engineering tools (BIM, 3D models, digital twins) to coordinate multidisciplinary interfaces
  • Provide technical support during FAT, SAT, commissioning, and start-up phases

Required Skills and Competencies

  • Degree in Electrical Engineering, Control Systems Engineering, or related discipline
  • Proven experience delivering Electrical and/or I&C packages on industrial or infrastructure projects (e.g., water treatment, mining, energy, utilities)
  • Strong understanding of: Instrumentation (measurement, control valves, analyzers), Control systems (PLC, SCADA, DCS), Electrical systems (LV/MV distribution, MCCs, drives)
  • Experience with installation, testing, and commissioning of E&I systems
  • Knowledge of QA/QC processes, inspection and test plans (ITPs), and relevant standards
  • Familiarity with project planning tools such as Primavera P6 (desirable)
  • Strong stakeholder coordination and interface management skills
  • Exposure to digital engineering tools (BIM, GIS, or similar platforms) is advantageous

Why Join ACCIONA?

  • Be part of a highly skilled, collaborative, and forward-thinking engineering team
  • Opportunities for career growth across major infrastructure and renewable energy projects
  • Competitive remuneration and benefits
  • Strong commitment to sustainability, innovation, and technical excellence

ACCIONA has been given the Top Employer 2022, 2023, 2024 & 2025 certification in Australia, which certifies the company's commitment to excellence in human resources management and those who focus on putting their people first through their exceptional HR policies. Since establishing a presence in Australia in 2002, ACCIONA has made significant investments in local opportunities and project development. Job Summary

Shape the future of food, health, and biotechnology.

Are you a Bachelor's or Master's student looking to apply your knowledge in a world-class research environment? Join IFF's Brabrand Innovation Center and gain hands-on experience working alongside leading scientists who are developing the next generation of food, feed, health, and bioscience solutions.

At IFF, science and innovation come together to create sustainable solutions that improve everyday life. As a global leader in flavors, fragrances, food ingredients, and health & biosciences, we empower our teams to solve some of today's most exciting challenges in nutrition, microbiome science, biotechnology, and ingredient development.

Located in Aarhus, Denmark, our Brabrand Innovation Center is one of IFF's three largest innovation hubs worldwide and home to more than 250 scientists and specialists. As an intern or thesis student, you'll become part of a collaborative, international environment where curiosity, creativity, and scientific excellence drive breakthrough innovations.

Whether your passion lies in fermentation, biotechnology, food science, microbiology, data science, or advanced biochemical research, this is your opportunity to contribute to meaningful projects while building valuable industry experience.

Your ideas matter. Your development matters. Your future starts here.

Where You'll Make a Difference

  • Contribute to cutting-edge research projects across R&D and Applications
  • Transform academic knowledge into real-world solutions
  • Work with advanced technologies shaping the future of food and health
  • Collaborate with experienced scientists and dedicated supervisors
  • Support the development of innovative ingredients and technologies
  • Gain insight into global innovation and commercialization processes
  • Contribute to sustainable solutions with worldwide impact

Who We’re Looking For

  • Current Bachelor’s or Master’s student in Bioscience, Biochemistry, Food Science, Biotechnology, Microbiology, or a related field
  • Passion for food, feed, health, or ingredient innovation
  • Curious mindset and eagerness to learn and develop
  • Ability to work both independently and as part of a team
  • Strong communication and organizational skills
  • Previous laboratory experience is an advantage
  • Motivation to take on a meaningful internship or thesis project

How You'll Stand Out

  • Previous experience within one or more of the listed project areas
  • Demonstrated interest in food science, biotechnology, or health-related research
  • Strong analytical thinking and problem-solving capabilities
  • Experience working with scientific methods, laboratory techniques, or data analysis

What You'll Gain

  • Hands-on experience at one of IFF’s leading global innovation hubs
  • Mentorship and collaboration with world-class scientists and experts
  • Exposure to advanced research technologies and methodologies
  • The opportunity to contribute to solutions that promote health, sustainability, and innovation
  • Insight into a global organization at the forefront of food and bioscience development
  • Valuable industry experience that strengthens your future career opportunities

Ready to join us? If you're excited about applying your knowledge in a real-world scientific environment, we'd love to hear from you.

Please submit:

  • Your CV/Resume
  • A short motivation letter describing your interests and why you'd like to complete your internship or thesis project with IFF
  • The expected ECTS scope of your internship or thesis
  • Your preferred internship period (e.g., Spring 2027 or Autumn 2027)

To help us match you with the right team, please indicate which of the listed scientific areas or application fields interests you the most. Applications will be reviewed on an ongoing basis and shared with relevant supervisors across the organization. If we identify a potential match, we'll invite you for further discussion.

Application deadline: 13 December 2026

Please note that internships are unpaid, and due to the large number of applications received, only candidates selected to continue in the process will be contacted individually.

title: Stagiair Adviseur Vermogen regio Nijmegen
description:
Stagiair Adviseur Vermogen

Heeft beleggen jouw interesse? En sta je open voor een carrière binnen de financiële sector? Deze meewerkstage voor de periode vanaf februari 2027 betekent dat je onder begeleiding van een persoonlijke coach binnen Adviesteam Vermogen in- en outbound werkzaamheden verricht die een Adviseur Vermogen dagelijks doet. Afgestemd op jouw kennis en ervaring doorloop je, samen met maximaal drie andere stagiaires, een leertraject en ga je aan de slag met het (verder) ontwikkelen van jouw gespreksvaardigheden, sales skills en het behalen van de benodigde vakdiploma’s. Het doel is om je zelfstandig, op een ING locatie en digitaal (vanuit huis), te laten werken en dagelijks contact te laten hebben met particuliere- en zakelijke klanten over beleggen bij ING.

Leertraject fase 1:

  • Je start tegelijkertijd met maximaal vier stagiaires en komt te werken binnen het Digitaal Vermogen Team (DVT). Een groot team van adviseurs die het 1e aanspreekpunt zijn voor bestaande klanten in het ‘Guided model’ (belegd vermogen van € 50.000 tot € 500.000) én verantwoordelijk zijn voor de centrale leadgeneratie vanuit outbound-, inbound- en online activiteiten richting de commerciële teams van Adviesteam Vermogen en Private Banking.
  • Je gaat onder begeleiding van een persoonlijke coach vrijwel direct starten met klantcontact via outbound bellen om je gespreksvaardigheden ‘on the job’ te ontwikkelen en de Way of Working te leren. Indien nodig behaal je onder werktijd de benodigde vakdiploma’s waardoor je meer verschillende type klantcontacten mag afhandelen.

Leertraject fase 2:

  • Na het succesvol afronden van fase 1 ga je ‘echt’ aan het werk. De nadruk in deze fase ligt op het verder ontwikkelen van je (sales) vaardigheden en gaat het tempo van klantcontact omhoog via outbound- en inbound belwerkzaamheden.
  • Je krijgt targets en gaat deelnemen aan performance dialogen met de andere stagiaires met als doel om van elkaar te leren. Een persoonlijke coach blijft je gedurende deze periode begeleiden.
  • Je krijg presentaties van collega’s die jou gaan uitleggen wat zij doen en gaat op locatie meekijken. Hiermee krijg je een beter beeld van mogelijke banen binnen ING.

Wat vraagt deze stage van je?

Je wilt graag tijd investeren in het verder ontwikkelen van jouw gespreksvaardigheden en je ervaring in klantcontact. Beleggen heeft je interesse, je bent een goede gesprekspartner en wilt klanten graag helpen bij het maken van de juiste keuzes. Je bent sales gedreven, resultaat gericht, neemt initiatief en kunt goed omgaan met feedback. Verder:

  • Je studeert aan een Hbo-opleiding en spreekt vloeiend Nederlands.
  • Je hebt WFT Basis in je bezit of bent bereid deze te halen voordat je bij ons start. Het liefst heb je ook WFT Vermogen en/of MiFID Informeren of ben je bereid deze te halen. Alle opleidingskosten worden vergoed door ING.
  • Je bent flexibel inzetbaar en combineert thuiswerken met werken vanuit één van de hub locaties Den Haag, Eindhoven, Leeuwarden, Zaandam en Zwolle of vanuit een ING-huis bij jou in de buurt.

Wat bieden wij?

  • Een meewerkstage vanaf februari 2027 afgestemd op de eisen vanuit jouw opleiding.
  • Een persoonlijke coach en leren onder werktijd.
  • Een uitdagende en leerzame omgeving met veel inzichten over mogelijke werkzaamheden binnen ING.

title: Senior Director, Medical Economics
description:
You could be the one who changes everything for our 28 million members. Centene is transforming the health of our communities, one person at a time. As a diversified, national organization, you’ll have access to competitive benefits including a fresh perspective on workplace flexibility.

Must be authorized to work in the U.S. without the need for employment-based visa sponsorship now or in the future. Sponsorship and future sponsorship are not available for this opportunity, including employment-based visa types H-1B, L-1, O-1, H-1B1, F-1, J-1, OPT, or CPT.

Position Purpose: The Senior Director, Medical Economics leads analytic service delivery by aligning strategic objectives with the development of tools and capabilities and appropriate deployment of supporting analytic teams. The director serves in a leadership function spanning the needs of multiple health plan and business partners and partners across functional areas to deliver best-in-class analytic services. This role supports enterprise value realization through healthcare analytics, financial modeling, savings validation, forecasting, performance monitoring, and executive reporting. The position partners closely with clinical, operational, and business leaders to identify opportunities, measure outcomes, and support data-informed decision making across strategic healthcare initiatives.

  • Prioritize and direct the planning and execution of enterprise-wide analytics projects and strategic initiatives, supporting the translation of business goals into actionable solutions, performance improvement opportunities, and value realization efforts.
  • Provide senior leadership support and partnership to development efforts between business and technical partners, translating complex analytical findings into actionable business recommendations and operational strategies.
  • Interface with leadership to ensure effective communication and visibility of strategic intent to analytic teams.
  • Prioritize team work and manage executive customer expectations and relationships.
  • Maintain alignment of team goals and resource deployment with strategic objectives and the business needs of multiple health plans and corporate stakeholders.
  • Serve as a primary domain contact as well as key point of escalation and accountability to ensure customer partnership and satisfaction.
  • Lead the realization of analytics strategy as set by executive governance and internal leadership teams, supporting forecasting, savings validation, KPI development, and measurement of business outcomes.
  • Guide and partner with leaders across analytic domains to ensure strong partnerships, align all business needs, leverage cross-functional skills, and co-develop valuable analytic solutions.
  • Mentor, manage, and ensure the continuous development of a team of leaders and analysts.

Education/Experience:

  • Bachelor’s degree in business, economics, statistics, mathematics, actuarial science, public health, health informatics, healthcare administration, finance or related field. Master's degree preferred.
  • 8+ years of experience in healthcare analytics experience leading an organization, creating strategic plans, and operationalizing functional teams in direct relation to meeting business needs or realizing goals tied to strategic objectives.
  • Direct experience in strategic planning, value realization, healthcare cost optimization initiatives, and solution development preferred.
  • Broad exposure and understanding of analytical techniques, financial modeling, forecasting, performance measurement, and appropriate application of these capabilities within a healthcare business environment preferred.
  • Working knowledge of SQL/querying languages.
  • Experience with table creation and indexing, query optimization, and utilization of stored procedures.
  • Preferred knowledge of programmatic coding languages such as Python and R, with the ability to effectively partner with technical teams and interpret complex analytical outputs.
  • Knowledge of statistical and analytical techniques including data modeling, trend analysis, root-cause analysis, forecasting, savings validation methodologies, and healthcare performance measurement preferred.
  • Experience leading change management initiatives, influencing cross-functional stakeholders, and supporting implementation of strategic business initiatives preferred.
  • Preferred knowledge of modern business intelligence and visualization tools including Microsoft PowerBI.
  • Demonstrated ability mentoring and training people leaders across multiple areas of focus.

By applying to this requisition, you acknowledge and understand that you may be considered for other job opportunities for which Centene believes you may be qualified.

Pay Range: $148,000.00 - $274,200.00 per year

Centene offers a comprehensive benefits package including: competitive pay, health insurance, 401K and stock purchase plans, tuition reimbursement, paid time off plus holidays, and a flexible approach to work with remote, hybrid, field or office work schedules. description:

You want more out of a career. A place to share your ideas freely — even if they’re daring or different. Where the true you can learn, grow, and thrive.   • Bachelor's degree or relevant work experience.

Within Maersk Project Logistics (MPL), that means delivering some of the industry's most complex logistics projects safely, consistently, and profitably. As our business continues to grow and evolve, we're looking for a Regional Head of MPL Operations - Europe to help shape the future of how we operate across the region.

This is a high-impact leadership role where you'll drive operational excellence, build organisational capability, and lead transformational change across Europe. You'll work at the intersection of strategy and execution, ensuring we deliver exceptional outcomes for our customers while creating a more standardised, scalable, and high-performing operating model.

​

As Regional Head of MPL Operations - Europe, you will lead the regional operational agenda for Maersk Project Logistics, partnering closely with Area leaders, Global Operations, Commercial teams, Product, Finance, and QHSE stakeholders.

Success in this role will come from your ability to lead through influence in a highly matrixed environment, bringing people together around shared priorities and driving meaningful change across countries, teams, and functions.

You will play a central role in strengthening operational performance, embedding consistent ways of working, and helping MPL Europe continue its transition to a future-ready operating model.

title: Stagiair Adviseur Vermogen regio Zwolle
description:
Stagiair Adviseur Vermogen

Heeft beleggen jouw interesse? En sta je open voor een carrière binnen de financiële sector? Deze meewerkstage voor de periode vanaf februari 2027 betekent dat je onder begeleiding van een persoonlijke coach binnen Adviesteam Vermogen in- en outbound werkzaamheden verricht die een Adviseur Vermogen dagelijks doet. Afgestemd op jouw kennis en ervaring doorloop je, samen met maximaal drie andere stagiaires, een leertraject en ga je aan de slag met het (verder) ontwikkelen van jouw gespreksvaardigheden, sales skills en het behalen van de benodigde vakdiploma’s. Het doel is om je zelfstandig, op een ING locatie en digitaal (vanuit huis), te laten werken en dagelijks contact te laten hebben met particuliere- en zakelijke klanten over beleggen bij ING.

Leertraject fase 1:

  • Je start tegelijkertijd met maximaal vier stagiaires en komt te werken binnen het Digitaal Vermogen Team (DVT). Een groot team van adviseurs die het 1e aanspreekpunt zijn voor bestaande klanten in het ‘Guided model’ (belegd vermogen van € 50.000 tot € 500.000) én verantwoordelijk zijn voor de centrale leadgeneratie vanuit outbound-, inbound- en online activiteiten richting de commerciële teams van Adviesteam Vermogen en Private Banking.
  • Je gaat onder begeleiding van een persoonlijke coach vrijwel direct starten met klantcontact via outbound bellen om je gespreksvaardigheden ‘on the job’ te ontwikkelen en de Way of Working te leren. Indien nodig behaal je onder werktijd de benodigde vakdiploma’s waardoor je meer verschillende type klantcontacten mag afhandelen.

Leertraject fase 2:

  • Na het succesvol afronden van fase 1 ga je ‘echt’ aan het werk. De nadruk in deze fase ligt op het verder ontwikkelen van je (sales) vaardigheden en gaat het tempo van klantcontact omhoog via outbound- en inbound belwerkzaamheden.
  • Je krijgt targets en gaat deelnemen aan performance dialogen met de andere stagiaires met als doel om van elkaar te leren. Een persoonlijke coach blijft je gedurende deze periode begeleiden.
  • Je krijg presentaties van collega’s die jou gaan uitleggen wat zij doen en gaat op locatie meekijken. Hiermee krijg je een beter beeld van mogelijke banen binnen ING.

Wat vraagt deze stage van je?

Je wilt graag tijd investeren in het verder ontwikkelen van jouw gespreksvaardigheden en je ervaring in klantcontact. Beleggen heeft je interesse, je bent een goede gesprekspartner en wilt klanten graag helpen bij het maken van de juiste keuzes. Je bent sales gedreven, resultaat gericht, neemt initiatief en kunt goed omgaan met feedback. Verder:

  • Je studeert aan een Hbo-opleiding en spreekt vloeiend Nederlands.
  • Je hebt WFT Basis in je bezit of bent bereid deze te halen voordat je bij ons start. Het liefst heb je ook WFT Vermogen en/of MiFID Informeren of ben je bereid deze te halen. Alle opleidingskosten worden vergoed door ING.
  • Je bent flexibel inzetbaar en combineert thuiswerken met werken vanuit één van de hub locaties Den Haag, Eindhoven, Leeuwarden, Zaandam en Zwolle of vanuit een ING-huis bij jou in de buurt.

Wat bieden wij?

  • Een meewerkstage vanaf februari 2027 afgestemd op de eisen vanuit jouw opleiding.
  • Een persoonlijke coach en leren onder werktijd.
  • Een uitdagende en leerzame omgeving met veel inzichten over mogelijke werkzaamheden binnen ING.
  • Een marktconforme stagevergoeding van EURO 700,- (bruto) bij een 36-urige werkweek.

Jouw sollicitatie

Stuur je CV voorzien van een motivatie waarin je uitlegt wie je bent, waarom jij de juiste kandidaat bent voor dit leertraject en op welke wijze je affiniteit met beleggen en/of de financiële markten hebt? Wij maken graag kennis met je.

Heb je vragen? Stuur dan een mail naar Bart Janssen, Digitaal Vermogen Team: Bart.Janssen1@ing.com.

title: Intern, Trading Risk Management
description:
Why ING?
The world of banking is changing faster than ever. That’s why we at ING are always broadening our horizons. Our people have a forward-thinking mentality and a strong can-do spirit, and they enjoy working in an agile environment.

ING in Asia Pacific

In Asia Pacific, ING offers wholesale banking services across 11 markets: Australia, China, Hong Kong SAR, India, Indonesia, Japan, the Philippines, Singapore, South Korea, Taiwan and Vietnam.

ING offers both retail and wholesale banking services in Australia. ING’s regional presence includes a 13% stake in Bank of Beijing in China and a 23% stake in TMB in Thailand.

Singapore is the regional headquarters for ING's Wholesale Banking (WB) business in Asia. This includes all WB business lines, such as Financial Markets, Strategic Products, Sectors, Lending and Transaction Services, as well as other support functions.

Function Overview

We offer a range of internship opportunities across different departments and locations within our Wholesale Bank. This vacancy focuses on positions within the TRM department.

The Trading Risk Management (TRM) team plays a critical role in safeguarding the bank’s financial health by identifying, measuring, monitoring, and controlling exposure to market-driven risks. The department works across asset classes and business lines to ensure that trading (Financial Markets) and banking books remain within the bank’s risk appetite and regulatory boundaries.

Duties and responsibilities

Singapore is ING’s regional hub, including for TRM activities. TRM oversees and supports Financial Markets (FM) desks—such as Rates, FX, Credit, Commodities and Non-Linear Trading—as well as Group Treasury (GT), which is primarily responsible for managing assets and liabilities, funding and liquidity needs, interest rate risk, and investment risk in the banking book.

The internship will involve exposure to the following areas across either the FM or GT/ALM desk:

  • Gaining an understanding of the desk’s business and how the risk framework is designed to govern and control its activities

  • Assisting with daily risk reporting and monitoring key market risk metrics, such as Value-at-Risk (VaR) and sensitivities in trading books, as well as interest rate risk, liquidity risk and FX exposures in banking books

  • Assisting with the preparation of management and regulatory reports covering trading risk or Treasury/ALM risk

  • Tracking macroeconomic events and market movements that may impact risk positions

  • Supporting system and process enhancement initiatives

  • Assisting the team in specific risk analyses as required


What do we ask of you? (Skills & Specifications)

  • Currently pursuing an undergraduate degree in finance, economics, statistics, quantitative finance or a related field

  • Strong analytical and quantitative skills, with attention to detail

  • A strong interest in understanding how banks manage financial risks

  • Good written and oral communication skills

  • Proficient in Excel; some VBA coding/programming knowledge is a plus

Need more information?
For information on ING Wholesale Bank, visit
For information on careers, visit

This is a six month full time Internship position starting from January 2027.

title: Parks Technician II
description:
Job Description Summary

Department - Parks & Recreations

Performs routine trades or craftsman duties above the Park Technician I level, maintaining and repairing park facilities, grounds, and equipment. Also, participates in construction or renovation activities in parks. The work requires manual labor and the use of hand and powered tools, equipment or vehicles and frequently involves repetitive individual tasks in a variety of work settings in an outdoor environment. This list is ILLUSTRATIVE ONLY and is not a comprehensive listing of all functions and tasks performed by incumbents of this class.   • Cuts, trims, edges, seeds, fertilizes, and stripes ball field and leisure turf;

  • Structurally prunes, shapes and maintains urban forest and ground vegetation;

  • Performs minor repairs and adjustments to plumbing and irrigation systems;

  • Operates ride-on equipment and utilizes powered maintenance and construction equipment/tools;

  • Performs operator-level inspections, servicing, maintenance and security of assigned tools, equipment and vehicles;

  • Applies paints, varnish, stains, and other finishes to interior and exterior surfaces, trimmings and fixtures;

  • Stores, handles, applies and disposes of hazardous materials required to complete work or generated by work assignments;

  • Collects and disposes of trash;

  • Maintains and uses safety and personal protective equipment;

  • Explains rules, regulations or procedures to the public and/or vendors;

  • May be assigned to a natural resource park setting, whereby maintenance may include wildlife drinkers, ponds, equestrian, camp facilities, trails, habitat restoration, erosion control, and invasive species;

  • Obtains and maintains AZ Department of Agriculture-Office of Pesticide Management – Certified Applicator license (Category #3-Ornamental and Turf and for some areas also Category 5 –Aquatic).

Minimum Qualifications:

Six months of experience performing duties in landscape, grounds maintenance, arborist, equipment operator, general handyman or similar duties in a specific skill, craft, vocation, trade or operational area of employment.

(Relevant training or education may substitute for up to six months of the aforementioned experience)

OR:

Six months of experience in a Pima County Parks Technician I, Parks Helper, or closely-related position as determined by the department head at the time of recruitment.

Qualifying education and experience must be clearly documented in the "Education" and "Work Experience" sections of the application. Do not substitute a resume for your application or write "see resume" on your application.

Preferred Qualifications: (Be specific in describing your experience in your application. Ensure the descriptions provided illustrate your competencies, specifically addressing the required and preferred qualifications.):

  • Minimum one (1) year experience performing landscape, grounds, and turf maintenance duties (structural pruning, turf amendments, fertilizer, mowing, sod, ball field preparation).

  • Minimum one (1) year experience performing irrigation drip/turf/sprinkler system installation, repair, and troubleshooting.

  • Minimum one (1) year experience operating landscape equipment (chainsaw, pole saw, line trimmer, mower, blower, tractor, trencher, chipper, utility cart).

  • Minimum six (6) months experience in masonry, painting, carpentry, plumbing, handyman, and/or general construction.

Pima County Human Resources Department reserves the right to admit to the selection process only those candidates that meet the minimum qualifications. All applications will be assessed based on an evaluation of the listed education and experience. Candidates meeting the minimum qualifications may be further evaluated/scored against any advertised Preferred Qualifications. The hiring authority will interview and select the successful candidate from a referral list provided by Human Resources. Additional assessments/testing may be required as part of the selection process.

Supplemental Information:

Licenses and Certificates: Valid driver license is required at time of application. Valid AZ driver license is required at time of appointment. All positions require AZ Department of Agriculture-Office of Pesticide Management – Certified Applicator license (Category #3-Ornamental and Turf) at the time of appointment or must obtain prior to completion of initial/promotional probation period (6-months). All positions must maintain the AZ Department of Agriculture-Office of Pesticide Management – Certified Applicator license while holding this position.

Special Notice Items: The County requires pre-employment background checks. Successful candidates will receive a post-offer, pre-employment background screening to include verification of work history, education, and criminal conviction history. A prior criminal conviction will not automatically disqualify a candidate from employment with the County. This position will require post-job offer proof of immunization(s) or immunization(s) and/or a TB screening. This position will require a post-job offer physical and/or drug screen.

Physical/Sensory Requirements: Lifting heavy objects, operating machinery and equipment, and performing repetitive tasks such as mowing, pruning, and planting. Action Activity - bending, climbing, crawling, kneeling, reaching, squatting, and stooping; Motion Activity - grasping; Hearing Activity - in noisy areas on a radio, behind themselves; Speaking Activity - in person, on a phone, on a radio; Vision - must be able to operate a motor vehicle, operate a commercial vehicle, operate machinery, operate forklift/power industrial equipment, distinguish color, have depth perception, have peripheral vision. Frequently required to lift, push or pull objects weighing up to 100 pounds.

Working Conditions: Various weather conditions, including heat, cold, and rain.

title: Sairaanhoitaja, Mainiokoti Kristallihovi, Riihimäki
description:
Sairaanhoitaja, Mainiokoti Kristallihovi, Riihimäki

Tule mukaan rakentamaan turvallista ja kodinomaista arkea ikääntyneille, Mainiokoti Kristallihoviin!

Haemme nyt sairaanhoitajaa kokoaikaiseen vakituiseen työsuhteeseen kauniiseen ja moderniin kotiimme

Mihin tulet töihin?

Mainiokoti Kristallihovi tarjoaa kodin 30:lle ikääntyneelle asukkaalle, jotka tarvitsevat ympärivuorokautista palveluasumista. Meillä on kauniit ja nykyaikaiset tilat, joissa on huomioitu erityisesti ikääntyneiden tarpeet. Kaunis ja turvallinen piha-alue tarjoaa mahdollisuuden asukkaiden säännölliseen ulkoiluun.


Mitä pääset tekemään?

Sairaanhoitajana työskentelet ikäihmisten parissa tarjoten heille yksilöllistä ja laadukasta hoivaa. Työtehtäviisi kuuluvat mm.:

- asukkaiden perushoito ja päivittäisissä toimissa tukeminen

- yhteistyö lääkärin, apteekin sekä omaisten ja muun yhteistyöverkoston kanssa

- tarvittavien näytteiden ottoa

- lääkehoitoon osallistumista

- hoitotyön asiantuntijana toimimista ja työyhteisön tukemista

Työkavereinasi toimii lähihoitajia, hoiva-avustajia sekä toinen sairaanhoitaja. Yksikössämme työskentelevät myös yksikönjohtaja, tiimivastaava, kokki sekä laitoshuoltaja.

Kuka sinä olet?

Olet koulutukseltasi sairaanhoitaja, jolla on aiempaa kokemusta ikäihmisten parissa työskentelystä. Olet vastuullinen ja oma-aloitteinen ihminen, jolla on aito halu työskennellä ikäihmisten parissa. Sinulla on positiivinen asenne ja olet joustava tiimipelaaja. Sinulla on hyvä paineensietokyky ja pystyt mukautumaan nopeasti muuttuvissa tilanteissa. Hoitotyön tehtävien hoitaminen edellyttää vähintään B1 ja avustavien tehtävien hoitaminen edellyttää vähintään A2 tai vastaavaa suomen kielen kielitaitotasoa, sekä sitoutumista kielitaidon ylläpitämiseen.

Miksi tulisit meille töihin?

Meillä pääset tekemään merkityksellistä työtä ikäihmisten hyvinvoinnin eteen hyvässä tiimissä, jossa työkaveria autetaan, kannustetaan ja arvostetaan. Mainiokotien työntekijänä saat käyttöösi Mehiläisen hyvät henkilöstöedut, kuten liikuntasaldon, työterveyshuollon ja digiklinikan palvelut 24/7. Sinulla on myös monipuoliset koulutus- ja kehittymismahdollisuudet.

Työ on kaksivuorotyötä. Työvuorot painottuvat pääasiassa arkiaamuihin, mutta tehtävään kuuluu myös satunnaisia ilta- ja viikonloppuvuoroja. Tehtävän palkkaus on yksityisen sosiaalialan TES:n mukainen sekä mahdollinen tehtäväkohtainen lisä.

Sosiaali- ja terveydenhuollon valvonnasta annetun lain mukaisesti tehtävään valittavien ikääntyvien tai vammaisten henkilöiden kanssa työskentelevien on esitettävä nähtäväksi rikosrekisterilain 6 §:n 2 momentissa tarkoitettu rikosrekisteriote.

Hae tehtävää rekrytointijärjestelmämme kautta mahdollisimman pian. Toimithan nopeasti, sillä täytämme paikan heti sopivan henkilön löytyessä. Työ alkaa sopimuksen mukaan.

Lisätietoja tehtävästä antaa:
Yksikönjohtaja Anniina Salonen

anniina.salonen@mainiokodit.fi

puh. 040 5029074 (arkisin klo 8–15)

Sen tuntee, kun tulee kotiin.


Mainiokotien missiona on luoda parempaa hoitoa Suomeen mahdollistamalla jokaiselle asukkaalle yksilöllinen ja hyvä elämä. Panostamme Mainiokodeissa laadukkaaseen hoivaan, hoitoon ja ohjaukseen, maukkaaseen ruokaan, turvallisuuteen, yhteisöllisyyteen sekä siihen, että jokaisella asiakkaalla on oma viihtyisä koti. Mainiokotien brändin symboli, räsymatto, kuvaa koko elämän kirjoa iloineen ja suruineen.

Mainiokodit on osa Mehiläistä. Mehiläisen sosiaali- ja terveyspalveluiden ammattilaiset työskentelevät joka päivä tinkimättömästi yksityis-, yritys- ja hyvinvointialueasiakkaidemme hyväksi. Tervetuloa mukaan vahvistamaan ammattilaistemme joukkoa!

title: Manufacturing (GMP) Chemist / Operative
description:

Bio-Techne is a world-leading developer and manufacturer of high-quality biological reagents, and we are seeking someone to join our ancillary materials manufacturing team in Bristol, which is undergoing significant investment and will shortly be expanding into a newly constructed, purpose-built manufacturing facility. We are looking to fill a predominantly lab-based, practical role where an eye for detail and commitment to meeting the high-quality requirements by being open to listening, learning and following instruction is crucial.

  • Knowledge of practical organic chemistry

  • Previous experience of working under principles of cGMP highly desirable but not essential

  • Knowledge of, and adherence to, required quality and safety guidelines.

Personal Qualities and attributes

title: Regional Regulatory Lead - APAC, LATAM, MEA, CIS, Adriatics and Partner Business
