description:
The Role

This a portfolio-level regulatory strategy role covering regions with diverse regulatory requirements and market dynamics: APAC, LATAM, MEA, CIS, Adriatics and Partner Business Regions. Working with the Therapeutic Area Lead, you'll set regional regulatory strategy for a defined product portfolio — not just chasing individual approvals, but shaping the pathway decisions, life cycle management, and health authority relationships that determine how well global strategy actually lands on the ground.

Location: Maidenhead/Hybrid, 3-days a week on-site

Why It Matters
A global regulatory strategy depends on strong regional insights across all markets. These regions do not follow the same dynamics as the US or EU — different evidentiary bars, different timelines, different risk calculus — and getting that wrong costs approval time and access. This role owns that judgment: turning global strategy into regionally credible submissions and pushing regional intelligence back up into global thinking before it becomes a problem rather than after.

What You'll Be Responsible For

You'll act as the regional regulatory strategist for your product portfolio, balancing scientific rigor with the practical realities of dozens of different regulatory systems, while building the relationships — internal and external — that make timely approval possible.

  • Develop and implement regional regulatory strategies aligned to global priorities, identifying the most efficient approval pathways with input from Local Regulatory Responsible (LRR) and Regulatory Partner Representative (RPR) colleagues
  • Contribute to Global Regulatory Strategy activities, including planning and responding to complex scientific questions requiring product expertise and cross-functional input
  • Provide strategic oversight of submissions — marketing applications, life cycle management, tender applications, and PSURs — anticipating regulatory risk before it becomes a delay
  • Ensure high-quality submission documentation and health authority responses, delivered on schedule and to regional requirements
  • Build and sustain strong working relationships with LRRs, RPRs, internal stakeholders, and regional health authorities themselves
  • Stay current on international legislation and guidance relevant to CSL's products and initiatives, including rare disease, orphan drug, toll manufacturing, and reliance pathway considerations

Experience Required

  • Substantial experience in regulatory affairs within pharma or biotech, with direct exposure to APAC, LATAM, or comparable emerging-market regulatory environments
  • A degree in Biological or Medical Science or Pharmacy, preferably with a post-graduate qualification
  • Demonstrated ability to develop and execute regional regulatory strategy in alignment with global product strategy
  • Strong working knowledge of marketing application, life cycle management, and PSUR/reporting requirements across multiple jurisdictions
  • Experience engaging directly with health authorities, with a track record of clear, credible communication that supports positive outcomes
  • Comfort operating as a subject matter expert — assessing regulatory impact, identifying risk, and advising cross-functional teams accordingly
  • A collaborative style suited to matrixed, multi-stakeholder environments, with the judgment to prioritize across a live portfolio
  • English is mandatory, while additional language skill would be an asset (e.g. Arabic, French, Spanish, Russian)

About CSL Seqirus

CSL Seqirus is part of CSL. As one of the largest influenza vaccine providers in the world, CSL Seqirus is a major contributor to the prevention of influenza globally and a transcontinental partner in pandemic preparedness. With state-of-the-art production facilities in the U.S., the U.K. and Australia, CSL Seqirus utilizes egg, cell and adjuvant technologies to offer a broad portfolio of differentiated influenza vaccines in more than 20 countries around the world.

title: Operational Quality Specialist
description:
Welcome to Haleon. We’re a purpose-driven, world-class consumer company putting everyday health in the hands of millions. In just three years since our launch, we’ve grown, evolved and are now entering an exciting new chapter – one filled with bold ambitions and enormous opportunity.

Our trusted portfolio of brands – including Sensodyne®, Panadol®, Advil®, Voltaren®, Theraflu®, Otrivin®, and Centrum® – lead in resilient and growing categories. What sets us apart is our unique blend of deep human understanding and trusted science.

Now it’s time to fully realise the full potential of our business and our people. We do this through our Win as One strategy. It puts our purpose – to deliver better everyday health with humanity – at the heart of everything we do. It unites us, inspires us, and challenges us to be better every day, driven by our agile, performance-focused culture.

Špecialista/Špecialistka operatívnej kvality (m/ž)

Zástup počas MD

Hľadáme človeka, ktorý bude zodpovedný za riadenie procesu deviácií (odchýlok od štandardu) v celom závode. Jeho úlohou bude koordinovať/zabezpečovať správne zaznamenanie, vyhodnotenie a investigáciu všetkých deviácií vrátane posúdenia ich vplyvu na kvalitu, bezpečnosť a súlad s legislatívnymi požiadavkami. Zároveň bude dohliadať na to, aby prijaté nápravné a preventívne opatrenia zodpovedali identifikovanému riziku.

Medzi Vaše hlavné zodpovednosti bude patriť:

  • Koordinovať proces riadenia deviácií a dohliadať na jeho efektívne fungovanie a neustále zlepšovanie v rámci celého závodu.
  • Dohliadať na správny priebeh investigácie deviácií vrátane kvality vypracovania RCA a efektivity nápravných a preventívnych opatrení.
  • Monitorovať stav jednotlivých prípadov, podporovať ich včasné uzatváranie a zabezpečovať správnosť procesu.
  • Vykonávať pravidelné analýzy trendov v rámci deviačného procesu a identifikovať oblasti na zlepšenie.
  • Poskytovať odbornú podporu, konzultácie a školenia v oblasti deviačného procesu.
  • Pôsobiť ako odborný partner a mentor pre kolegov pri riešení deviácií a implementácii nápravných opatrení.
  • Spolupracovať s rôznymi oddeleniami na odstraňovaní neštandardných situácií a zvyšovaní efektivity procesov.

Prečo Vy?

Hľadáme niekoho, kto bude disponovať nasledovnými požiadavkami:

  • Anglický jazyk – aktívna znalosť pre každodennú komunikáciu
  • Skúsenosti v oblasti kvality, výroby alebo inom technickom či podpornom prostredí – skúsenosti s riešením problémov, riadením procesov alebo neustálym zlepšovaním
  • Root Cause Analysis (RCA) – výhodou
  • Lean/Continuous Improvement – výhodou
  • Analytické myslenie – schopnosť pracovať s dátami, identifikovať trendy a hľadať skutočné príčiny problémov
  • Precíznosť a orientácia na detail – dôslednosť pri vyhodnocovaní informácií a kontrole procesu od začiatku až do konca
  • Organizačné schopnosti – schopnosť koordinovať viacero aktivít súčasne, sledovať termíny a udržať proces pod kontrolou
  • Komunikačné a prezentačné zručnosti – schopnosť efektívne komunikovať naprieč tímami a prezentovať odporúčania a výsledky
  • Mentorské schopnosti – schopnosť školiť, usmerňovať a podporovať kolegov pri riešení odchýlok
  • Zdravá asertivita – schopnosť konštruktívne vyzvať ostatných, trvať na dodržiavaní kvalitatívnych požiadaviek a obhájiť správne riešenie
  • Open mindset – otvorenosť voči novým riešeniam, zmenám a neustálemu zlepšovaniu

Zamestnanecké výhody, benefity:

  • Motivačný ročný bonus, 13.plat(DMP)

  • Príspevok na dochádzanie

  • Príspevok na doplnkové dôchodkové sporenie alebo životné poistenie

  • 2× ročne finančný príspevok na regeneráciu / oddych, Benefit Plus program, dentálny benefit a Employee Assistance Program (EAP) – psychologická, právna, sociálna a finančná podpora, Príspevok na rekreáciu po 2 rokoch zamestnania (v súlade so Zákonníkom práce)

  • 3 dni dovolenky navyše nad rámec Zákonníka práce nna základe interných pravidiel + ďalšie dni podľa odpracovaných rokov,Haleon Parental Leave, Global Haleon Caregiver Leave, extra voľno pri dôležitých životných udalostiach(svadba, narodenie dieťaťa, prvý školský deň, pohreb)

  • Rastúca finančná odmena pri každom 5‑ročnom jubileu, odstupné pri odchode do dôchodku nad rámec zákona

  • Jedáleň priamo v závode s príspevkom na stravovanie, kredit na snacky, čaj a kávu

  • Denný letný tábor pre deti zamestnancov

  • Relokačný príspevok, bonus za odporučenie kandidáta, odmeny pre darcov krvi, bezúročná pôžička (podľa kritérií), Balíčky zubných pást z nášho portfólia zdarma

title: Receiver
description:
Amherst has taken a leadership role among highly selective liberal arts colleges and universities in successfully diversifying the racial, socio-economic, and geographic profile of its student body. The College is similarly committed to enriching its educational experience and its culture through the diversity of its faculty, administration and staff.

Job Description:

Amherst College invites applications for the Receiver position. The Receiver is a full-time, academic-year (42 weeks per year) position. The expected salary range for this job opportunity is: $22.49-$23.50 per hour.


The salary offered will vary based on a number of factors, including but not limited to relevant education, training, and experience, tenure status, and other nondiscriminatory business considerations. Amherst College is pleased to provide a comprehensive, highly competitive benefits package that meets the needs of staff and faculty and their families. Click here for Benefits Information.


Amherst College invites applications for the position of Receiver in the Dining Services department. This role is essential to supporting the department's mission of providing high-quality service to a diverse campus community. The Receiving Assistant is responsible for coordinating the accurate and timely receipt, inspection, storage, and distribution of food and non-food deliveries across Dining Services. The position plays a critical role in maintaining inventory accuracy, supporting procurement operations, and upholding safety and cleanliness standards.


A key responsibility of this position includes operating a 14-foot refrigerated delivery truck to transport food, supplies, and equipment between campus dining locations and approved vendors as needed. Candidates must possess a valid driver’s license, maintain a clean driving record, and demonstrate the ability to obtain and maintain Department of Transportation (DOT) certification as a condition of employment. Safe vehicle operation and adherence to all applicable transportation and safety regulations are essential components of this role.


The ideal candidate will bring a strong work ethic, keen attention to detail, and a demonstrated ability to work effectively in a fast-paced, team-oriented environment that values inclusion, respect, and operational excellence.


Food Safety and Allergen Awareness


All Dining Services employees are responsible for understanding and implementing established food safety procedures and allergen prevention protocols. Team members must actively support and respond appropriately to individuals with food allergies to ensure a safe dining experience for all community members.


Employees are expected to apply the knowledge and procedures covered in mandatory training sessions in the course of their daily duties. Maintaining these safety standards is essential to protect the health and well-being of our students, guests, and colleagues.


Summary of Responsibilities:


Receiving & Inventory Management


- Accept and inspect all incoming deliveries, verifying accuracy, temperature compliance, and product integrity to minimize loss, spoilage and damage

- Responsible for maintaining the cleanliness and organization of storage areas for perishable and non-perishable items

- Assist with monthly inventory of over 1,500 stock items

- Handle inventory in a manner consistent with allergen awareness and safe food handling best practices


Storage & Distribution


- Accurately label and organize received goods into designated storage areas

- Collaborate with kitchen and production staff to ensure timely delivery of items to appropriate locations across campus using the refrigerated truck or vans

- Manage daily product transfers and deliveries to various dining venues across campus

- Maintain FIFO (First In, First Out) rotation to ensure freshness and minimize waste


Inventory & Data Entry


- Enter invoices and delivery records into inventory software with precision and up-to-date pricing

- Assist with maintaining accurate inventory counts and aid in monthly inventory checks

- Communicate effectively with the Purchasing and Receiving Manager regarding stock levels, vendor issues, and ordering needs


Facilities Organization & Maintenance


- Ensure the cleanliness, organization, and safety of all storage areas, including walk-ins, freezers, the loading dock, garbage, and recycling spaces

- Operate equipment such as pallet jacks and cardboard balers safely and effectively

- Follow and model food safety and sanitation procedures


Communication


- Regularly monitor Amherst College email for updates from procurement and receiving teams and broader college communications


Qualifications:


Required


  • High School Diploma or equivalent
  • 1 to 3 years of related experience
  • An equivalent combination of education/experience in lieu of the minimum education and related experience
  • 6 months to 1 year of experience in receiving, warehousing, or a similar role
  • Basic computer proficiency with Microsoft Office or willingness to learn
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills
  • Excellent organizational, time management, and customer service abilities
  • Capacity to manage multiple tasks and work efficiently in a high-paced environment
  • Ability to perform basic math functions and maintain accurate records
  • Demonstrated commitment to working with and supporting diverse populations
  • Exercises independent judgment within established procedures for daily operational tasks
  • Works under moderate supervision from the Manager of Purchasing and Receiving and/or the Receiving Specialist
  • This position does not have supervisory responsibilities
  • Successful completion of required reference and background checks
  • An acceptable criminal offender records information (CORI) check
  • Successful completion of pre-employment physical and lift test
  • Valid driver’s license and successful completion of Five College Risk Management driver credentialing program.
    (See:    )

Preferred


  • Prior experience in a food service, warehouse, or shipping/receiving setting
  • Familiarity with data entry systems and inventory management software
  • Experience operating a pallet jack or similar equipment

Interested candidates are asked to submit a resume and cover letter online at. Please be sure to upload all requested documents prior to clicking Submit. Applications cannot be revised once submitted. (Current employees and students should apply by clicking on the Jobs Hub icon from their Workday home screen.) title: Estagiário
description:
Job Description

ISP Preschool Teacher Assistant Role Profile

Purpose of Role

The Preschool Teacher Assistant supports the lead teacher in creating a safe, nurturing, and stimulating learning environment for young children. This role involves assisting with classroom management, preparing instructional materials, supervising children during activities, and promoting positive social, emotional, and cognitive development. The assistant helps ensure that each child’s needs are met in alignment with the curriculum and the preschool’s educational goals.

ISP Principles

Begin with our children and students. Our children and students are at the heart of what we do. Simply, their success is our success. Wellbeing and safety are both essential for learners and learning. Therefore, we are consistent in identifying potential safeguarding and Health & Safety issues and acting and following up on all concerns appropriately.

Treat everyone with care and respect. We look after one another, embrace similarities and differences and promote the well-being of self and others.

Operate effectively. We focus relentlessly on the things that are most important and will make the most difference. We apply school policies and procedures and embody the shared ideas of our community.

Are financially responsible. We make financial choices carefully based on the needs of the children, students and our schools.

Learn continuously. Getting better is what drives us. We positively engage with personal and professional development and school improvement.

Key Responsibilities

Support Classroom Instruction
Assist the lead teacher in implementing daily lesson plans, learning activities, and educational games that align with the preschool curriculum. Supervise and Engage Children
Monitor children during classroom activities, playtime, meals, and outdoor play to ensure safety and promote positive behavior. Assist with Behavior Management
Reinforce classroom rules and help guide children in developing appropriate social and emotional skills. Prepare Learning Materials
Help set up and organize classroom materials, resources, and displays to support hands-on learning and creativity. Maintain a Safe and Clean Environment
Ensure classroom spaces are clean, organized, and free from hazards; assist with sanitizing toys, surfaces, and equipment. Provide Individualized Support
Offer one-on-one or small group assistance to children who need extra help with activities or emotional support. Observe and Report
Observe children's development and behavior; communicate concerns or notable progress to the lead teacher. Support Routines and Transitions
Help children with daily routines such as arrivals, departures, toileting, meals, and rest time, fostering independence and consistency. Encourage Positive Interaction
Model respectful, inclusive, and cooperative behavior to promote a positive classroom culture. Collaborate with Team Members
Work closely with the lead teacher and other staff to ensure consistency in teaching practices and child care.

Skills:

  • Patience and empathy – Ability to respond calmly and kindly to young children
  • Strong communication skills – With both children and adults (teachers, parents)
  • Teamwork – Collaborative mindset and willingness to follow guidance
  • Observation skills – Able to recognize developmental milestones or concerns
  • Creativity and enthusiasm – Engaging children through play and learning
  • Organizational skills – Managing materials, routines, and tasks efficiently
  • Adaptability – Comfortable adjusting to changes in schedule or child needs
  • Cultural sensitivity – Respectful and inclusive of all backgrounds and abilities.

  • Bachelor´s Degree Lic. Educación Preescolar or equivalent (required)
  • TKT Training Course

ISP is committed to safeguarding and promoting the welfare of children and young people and expects all staff and volunteers to share this commitment. title: IP Architect
description:
Join our Team

ASIC IP Architect – Career Growth Opportunity for Experienced ASIC Designers

We are looking for a new member to join our Digital Development Team within the ASIC organisation in Lund, Sweden. As an ASIC IP Architect, you will play a key role in shaping our System-on-Chip (SoC) IP portfolio. You will take the architecture requirements and build a roadmap for critical IPs, and help define the direction for next-generation devices.


You will lead a team working on key SoC-specific IP designs, focusing on requirements and architectural decisions. The role includes responsibility for the long-term evolution of selected IPs and sub-systems, with a roadmap horizon of 2–3 years. In close collaboration with ASIC System Architects and cross-functional teams, you will drive requirement breakdown, systemisation, and technical direction. You will also support design, verification, and validation throughout the development lifecycle.


This role suits experienced ASIC designers who want to expand into architecture and technical leadership while staying hands-on with technology. You will have strong influence on long-term decisions and help shape future SoC solutions.


We are looking for someone with strong digital ASIC design experience, combined with leadership, collaboration, and communication skills. You should be comfortable working in a fast-paced Agile environment with close team interaction. If you enjoy solving complex system-level challenges and want to help define next-generation SoC IP, we encourage you to apply.

What you will do


• Act as one of the IP Architects within the SoC-specific IP Program, covering IPs owned by multiple cross-functional teams.
• Serve as the primary interface towards ASIC System Architects and drive requirement breakdown and systemization.
• Own and define requirements, architecture, and roadmap for IP blocks and subsystems.
• Support development teams throughout design, verification, and validation phases.
• Drive continuous improvements in design methodologies, workflows, and engineering practices.
• Create and maintain high-quality technical documentation.

Skills you bring


• MSc or PhD in Electronic Engineering or equivalent.
• 8+ years of experience in ASIC IP design and/or verification.
• Strong expertise in Digital ASIC Design.
• Good understanding of ARM processors and AMBA-based systems.
• Knowledge of UVM verification methodology.
• Proven ability to collaborate successfully across teams and geographical sites.
• Strong focus on quality and engineering excellence.

Preferred Qualifications


• Experience with clock/reset controllers and ASIC clocking architectures.
• Experience with low-speed interface IPs such as I3C, SPI, and QSPI.
• Familiarity with ARM CoreSight architectures.
• Experience with requirements management tools such as DOORS or Jama.
• Experience working in Agile development environments.

Who You Are


You are a collaborative and structured engineer who enjoys working across organizational boundaries to solve complex technical challenges. You communicate effectively, share knowledge openly, and are motivated by delivering high-quality solutions. With strong analytical skills and a continuous-improvement mindset, you are ready to take the next step in your career and help shape the architectural direction of future ASIC platforms.

title: Microbiology Engineer 2
description:
Microbiology Engineer 2

Life Unlimited. At Smith+Nephew we craft and manufacture technology that takes the limits off living.

Microbiology Engineer II supports microbiological and contamination control activities across manufacturing, quality, and validation operations in a medical device environment. The role is responsible for environmental monitoring, utility testing, sterilization and cleaning validations, investigations, and ensuring compliance with regulatory and quality requirements.

The position works closely with cross-functional teams and external laboratories to maintain effective microbiological controls, support product quality, lead investigations, contribute to risk assessments and change controls, and ensure inspection readiness.

What will you be doing?

  • Routine & Non-Routine Microbiological Operations (30%)
    Conduct microbiological testing, environmental monitoring, and data analysis to identify contamination risks, support investigations, and maintain laboratory compliance.

  • Validation & Sterilization Activities (27%)
    Support sterilization, cleaning, and process validations while ensuring microbiological controls, risk assessments, and regulatory compliance.

  • Project Leadership & Cross-Functional Support (20%)
    Lead and support contamination control, process improvement, and product transfer projects by providing microbiological expertise and ensuring project compliance.

  • Investigations, Risk Management & Change Control (10%)
    Drive microbiology-related investigations, root cause analyses, CAPA implementation, and risk assessments to maintain product and process quality.

  • Compliance, Documentation & Audit Support (13%)
    Maintain compliance with regulatory and quality standards through documentation management, audit support, data integrity, and continuous improvement initiatives.

  • Health, Safety & Environment (HSE)
    Comply with HSE, sustainability, and energy policies, promote a safe workplace, prevent environmental impact, and report incidents and improvement opportunities.

What will you need to be successful?

  • The ideal candidate holds a Bachelor’s degree in Microbiology, Biotechnology, Biological Sciences, or a related field, with 3–5 years of experience in microbiology, contamination control, or quality engineering within a regulated medical device, pharmaceutical, or manufacturing environment. Experience in environmental monitoring, cleanroom operations, microbiological testing, process validations, and knowledge of standards such as ISO 13485, ISO 11135, ISO 11137, and ISO 14644 is essential. Professional certifications in auditing, sterilization, GMP, or root cause analysis are an added advantage.

  • The role requires strong technical microbiology expertise, analytical and problem-solving skills, technical writing capability, and the ability to collaborate effectively across functions while maintaining a strong focus on quality and regulatory compliance. The candidate must be comfortable working in cleanroom environments, performing sampling and monitoring activities, supporting validation work outside normal business hours when required, and traveling occasionally (<10%) to external sterilization sites for validation or audit activities.

title: Category Buyer for Systems Engineering (m/f)
description:
Job Description:

Fully integrated in the Procurement organization, General Procurement (GP)’s mission is to procure goods and services on behalf of all Airbus Divisions. GP employs more than 500 professionals on around 40 sites in Europe as well as in China, India and the US. Engineering Procurement (PJE) is responsible for procuring services for Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering and Customer Services across all Airbus Divisions, managing a spend of €1.7B with over 60 team members in Europe.

This position is within the Engineering Non-Specific Design Sub-Commodity team (PJEP), with a focus on Engineering Subcontracting services for Avionics and Simulation Products. High-visibility role offering direct exposure to DDMS transformation and key cross-functional stakeholders.

Airbus Commercial Aircraft is looking for a Commodity Buyer (f/m) to join our Engineering Procurement department based in Toulouse, France.

Your working environment:

Global capital of aeronautics and European capital for space research, Toulouse is a dynamic city in the southwest of France served by an international airport. Ideally located between the Mediterranean sea and the Atlantic ocean and close to the Pyrenees mountains, it offers plenty of options for outdoor activities!

How we care for you:

  • Financial rewards: Attractive salary, agreements on success and profit sharing schemes, employee savings plan abounded by Airbus and employee stock purchase plan on a voluntary basis.

  • Work / Life Balance: Extra days-off for special occasions, holiday transfer option, a Staff council offering many social, cultural and sport activities and other services.

  • Wellbeing / Health: Complementary health insurance coverage (disability, invalidity, death). Depending on the site: health services center, concierge services, gym, carpooling application.

  • Individual development: Great upskilling opportunities and development prospects with unlimited access to +10,000 e-learning courses to develop your employability, certifications, expert career path, accelerated development programmes, national and international mobility.

At Airbus, we support you to work, connect and collaborate more easily and flexibly. Wherever possible, we foster flexible working arrangements to stimulate innovative thinking.

Your challenges:

  • Manage end-to-end calls for tenders and procurement projects with a multi-divisional and trans-national scope.

  • Maintain supplier relationships and perform Contract Review Meetings (CRM) to assess performance and mitigate risks.

  • Lead the Sub-MDT (Multi-Functional Team) for Systems across Airbus Commercial and Airbus Helicopters to ensure operational follow-up.

  • Deliver value and drive synergies by translating business needs into efficient sourcing strategies and cost structures.

  • Contribute to supplier development in terms of innovation, digitalization (DDMS), and sustainability.

Your boarding pass:

  • Degree in Engineering, Procurement, Supply Chain or equivalent.

  • Solid experience in Procurement or Engineering, with strong negotiation skills and contract management practice.

  • Financial acumen to build business cases, challenge supplier cost structures, and track key performance indicators (KPIs).

  • Proven ability to manage complex projects and communicate efficiently across multi-cultural and multi-divisional teams.

  • Mandatory fluency in English and French (both oral and written).

  • Commitment to act with integrity as a foundation for sustainable growth.

Not a 100% match? No worries! Airbus supports your personal growth with customized development solutions.

title: Litigation and Claims Specialist
description:
SUMMARY:
The role is responsible for managing, coordinating, and resolving claims and litigation matters involving the organization. The position involves working closely with internal stakeholders, external counsel, insurers, and other third party administrators to minimize risk exposure and ensure efficient resolution of disputes.

Job Title: Litigation and Claims Specialist
Department: Risk Management
Location: 1360 Portland Avenue Rochester, NY 14621
Hours Per Week: 40 hours per week
Schedule: Monday - Friday, 8am-4:30pm


KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Manage and monitor ongoing litigation and claims matters.
  • Conduct confidential investigations and draft investigation reports
  • Receives and reports on complaints, claims, and potential claims related to professional and general liability.

The Coordinator provides comprehensive administrative support to the Finance Central Office and the Controller's department. The Coordinator provides administrative support to the Office of the Vice President for Finance and Chief Financial Officer (CFO) and the Controller by managing executive calendars, coordinating meetings and events, arranging travel, preparing correspondence and meeting materials, and responding to inquiries as directed. title: Senior Technical Analyst
description:
Business Introduction
At GSK, we have bold ambitions for patients, aiming to positively impact the health of 2.5 billion people by the end of the decade. Our R&D focuses on discovering and delivering vaccines and medicines, combining our understanding of the immune system with cutting-edge technology to transform people’s lives. GSK fosters a culture ambitious for patients, accountable for impact, and committed to doing the right thing, making sure that we focus our efforts on accelerating significant assets that meet patients’ needs and have the highest probability of success. We’re uniting science, technology, and talent to get ahead of disease together.

Find out more: Our approach to R&D

Job Purpose

  • Serve as the accountable owner of one or more GxP-regulated business systems throughout their entire lifecycle — from initial validation through adoption, evolution, and decommission — ensuring each system is fit for purpose,ms compliant, and delivering measurable value to GSK.

  • Translate business direction and user needs into clear roadmap priorities, balancing change demand against capacity and making explicit, data-informed trade-offs in partnership with business and technology stakeholders.

  • Operate within SLS's evolving management system, contributing to a consistent, portfolio-wide view of system health, adoption, compliance posture, and business value using standard KPIs, OKRs, and scorecard frameworks.

  • Champion an assurance-first approach to validation, reducing calendar time and effort while maintaining inspection readiness, and act as an active contributor to the BSO community of practice.

Key Responsibilities

  • Strategic System Ownership: Maintain a deep understanding of the business processes your system supports. Map system roadmap priorities to business outcomes and proactively identify when a system should be invested in, fixed, consolidated, or decommissioned.

  • Release & Change Management: Own end-to-end release readiness: coordinate change control, manage validation evidence packaging, run stabilisation reviews post-release, and track release quality metrics. Minimise business disruption through predictable, well-communicated releases.

  • Validation & Compliance: Execute and maintain validation activities in accordance with DTMS and applicable regulatory standards (21 CFR Part 11, EU GMP Annex 11). Ensure PCRs, CAPAs, and access reviews are completed on time. Operate an assurance-first validation approach to reduce effort and calendar time without compromising compliance posture.

  • Adoption & User Experience: Drive measurable user adoption: develop training materials, coordinate change communications, monitor adoption curves, and act on System Usability Scale (SUS) data and user feedback to continuously improve the user experience.

  • Support & Continuous Improvement: Monitor and act on support signals — help desk data, repeat issues, Tier 1 resolution rates — converting them into roadmap improvements and stakeholder communications. Target measurable reductions in support friction over time.

  • Portfolio Scorecard & Reporting: Own your system's scorecard in Flight Deck: maintain current lifecycle phase, health RAG, top risks, and decisions needed. Contribute to the monthly ISS LT performance pack and quarterly system landscape reviews with decision-ready insight.

  • Stakeholder Engagement & Governance: Serve as the primary point of contact for your assigned business system(s). Build and maintain effective relationships with business owners, GPOs, QA, IT, and vendor partners. Represent system needs and priorities in governance forums.

  • Resource & Capacity Visibility: Track effort by system and work type to support ISS's capacity model. Proactively flag capacity constraints and contribute to quarterly prioritisation and trade-off discussions.

  • BSO Community & Mentorship: Participate actively in the BSO community of practice. Share best practices, contribute to playbook development, and support the onboarding and development of less experienced BSOs.

Education Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent; scientific, technical, or business discipline preferred.

  • Master's degree or equivalent experience advantageous.

Job Related Experience

Essential Experience

  • Experience in pharmaceutical, life sciences, or equivalent regulated industry.

  • Demonstrated experience with GxP system validation (DTMS, GAMP 5, or equivalent).

  • Track record of managing systems, projects, or products through full lifecycle.

  • Ability to translate business requirements into technical and process solutions.

  • Strong stakeholder management across cross-functional, global teams.

Preferred Experience

  • Experience operating KPI/OKR frameworks or scorecard-driven management systems.

  • Familiarity with 21 CFR Part 11, EU GMP Annex 11, ICH, or FDA data integrity requirements.

  • Exposure to system decommissioning, portfolio simplification, or vendor management.

  • Experience with helpdesk/support analytics and usability assessment (e.g. SUS).


What we value in you
We look for people who are curious, dependable and team-focused. You will communicate clearly, ask questions when needed, and keep activities on track. You will help create a supportive environment where colleagues feel heard and able to contribute. If you want to grow your technical and clinical systems skills, support high-quality clinical work, and work with people who share a common mission, we would love to hear from you.

Ready to apply?
If this role sounds like a good fit, please submit your application. We welcome candidates from all backgrounds and encourage you to apply even if you do not meet every preferred qualification. If you need adjustments during recruitment, please contact the recruitment team to discuss your needs.


Skills

Change Controls, Compliance Management, Computer System Validation (CSV), Requirements Gathering, Veeva

Why GSK?

Uniting science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together.

GSK is a global biopharma company with a purpose to unite science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together. We aim to positively impact the health of 2.5 billion people by the end of the decade, as a successful, growing company where people can thrive. We get ahead of disease by preventing and treating it with innovation in specialty medicines and vaccines. We focus on four therapeutic areas: respiratory, immunology and inflammation; oncology; HIV; and infectious diseases – to impact health at scale.

People and patients around the world count on the medicines and vaccines we make, so we’re committed to creating an environment where our people can thrive and focus on what matters most. Our culture of being ambitious for patients, accountable for impact and doing the right thing is the foundation for how, together, we deliver for patients, shareholders and our people.

title: Animal Care Technician I - Adoptions & Behavior Counselor
description:
Job Description Summary

Department - Pima Animal Care Center

Job Description

OPEN UNTIL FILLED

Job Type: Classified

Job Classification: 5931 - Animal Care Technician I

Salary Grade: 3

Hiring Pay: $18.79 Per Hour

The first review of applications will be on 08/21/2026.

Pima Animal Care Center (PACC) is looking to add a multiple part-time Adoptions & Behavior Counselors to join our Outcomes Team. As an Adoptions & Behavior Counselor, you will work directly with our community to find the best furry friends for their home. This position is customer service centered and includes working both indoors and outdoors with dogs of varying behavior types. You will run large dog play groups, provide dog enrichment, and assess dog behavior.

This position will work 19 hours max a week and must work a minimum of three days including one weekend day. Nontraditional work hours and rotating schedules.

Essential Functions:

As defined under the Americans with Disabilities Act, this classification may include any of the following tasks, knowledge, skills, and other characteristics. This list is ILLUSTRATIVE ONLY and is not a comprehensive listing of all functions and tasks performed by incumbents of this class. Work assignments may vary depending on the department’s need and will be communicated to the applicant or incumbent by the supervisor.

  • Provides humane care and safe handling for a variety of animals, including dogs, cats, and small pets, while monitoring behavior and health;

  • Works outdoors in all weather conditions and safely handles live animals, including those that may be injured, frightened, or offensive, using appropriate techniques to minimize risks to self and others;

  • Demonstrates excellent customer service to the public and volunteers by answering questions, addressing concerns, and guiding decisions regarding intakes, outcomes, redemptions and animal care in adherence to PACC policies;

  • Handles animals for behavioral assessments and playgroups, identifying placement or behavior concerns, and participates in decisions regarding outcomes, including euthanasia;

  • Accurately organizes and documents information on animal behavior, history, medical records and outcomes, utilizing shelter software and other systems for recordkeeping, communication, and scheduling;

  • Administers vaccinations and medications under veterinary guidance, assesses animals for signs of illness or injury and documents and communicates health concerns;

  • Facilitates adoption and foster processes by assisting with enrichment, behavioral evaluations, animal meet and greets, matchmaking and note reviews;

  • Supports intake and admissions by providing correct intake pathways, checking animals for health concerns, identifying ages/breeds and finding kennel placements;

  • Maintains a clean and sanitary facility, including kennels, workspaces, public lobbies, and treatment spaces;

  • Frequently lifts and carries heavy objects, bends, stoops, reaches, and performs other physical tasks as required;

  • Safeguards and accounts for scheduled drugs and funds received for PACC services;

  • Operates County-owned vehicles to transport animals and supplies.

Minimum Qualifications:

High school diploma or General Education Development (G.E.D.) certificate.

(Relevant experience and/or education from an accredited college or university may be substituted.)

Qualifying education and experience must be clearly documented in the "Education" and “Work Experience" sections of the application. Do not substitute a resume for your application or write "see resume" on your application.

Preferred Qualifications: (Be specific in describing your experience in your application. Ensure the descriptions provided illustrate your competencies, specifically addressing the required and preferred qualifications.):

  • Bilingual (English/Spanish).

  • Minimum one (1) year experience working in customer service.

  • Minimum one (1) year experience working in an animal shelter or other relevant animal care setting.

  • Experience working or volunteering with dogs and/or cats.

​

Selection Procedure:
Pima County Human Resources Department reserves the right to admit to the selection process only those candidates that meet the minimum qualifications. All applications will be assessed based on an evaluation of the listed education and experience. Candidates meeting the minimum qualifications may be further evaluated/scored against any advertised Preferred Qualifications. The hiring authority will interview and select the successful candidate from a referral list provided by Human Resources. Additional assessments/testing may be required as part of the selection process.

Supplemental Information:

Licenses and Certificates: Some positions require a valid Arizona Class D driver license at the time of application or appointment. Failure to obtain/maintain the required licensure shall be grounds for termination.

Special Notice Items: The County requires pre-employment background checks. Successful candidates will receive a post-offer, pre-employment background screening to include verification of work history, education, and criminal conviction history. A prior criminal conviction will not automatically disqualify a candidate from employment with the County. Within nine months of appointment, employees must receive the full series of pre-exposure rabies immunizations. Medical inability to be immunized or previous immunization must be verified by the County Physician prior to employment. Recommended boosters are required for the duration of employment, unless medically excused or physiologically unable to develop immunity. This position will require a post-job offer physical and/or drug screen. This position will require post-job offer proof of immunization(s) or immunization(s) and/or a TB screening.

Physical/Sensory Requirements: Physical and sensory abilities will be determined by position. Action Activity - bending, climbing, crawling, kneeling, reaching, squatting, and stooping; Motion Activity - grasping; Hearing Activity - in noisy areas on a radio, behind themselves; Speaking Activity - in person, on a phone, on a radio; Vision - must be able to operate a motor vehicle, distinguish color, have depth perception, have peripheral vision. Frequently required to lift, push or pull objects weighing up to 100 pounds.

Working Conditions: Working conditions will be determined by the position.

Ensure products continue to comply all requirements throughout its lifecycle.

Plan and implement country-specific and technology-specific certification requirements to support product commercialization and lifecycle compliance. You will report to Product compliance engineering manager based in Singapore.

Please note that roles based out of SJS or Sunbury will move to Timber Square, Southwark, from Q4 2027

title: Sr. SOC Analyst
description:
About Us

Zelis is modernizing the healthcare financial experience in the United States (U.S.) across payers, providers, and healthcare consumers. We serve more than 750 payers, including the top five national health plans, regional health plans, TPAs and millions of healthcare providers and consumers across our platform of solutions. Zelis sees across the system to identify, optimize, and solve problems holistically with technology built by healthcare experts – driving real, measurable results for clients.

At Zelis, AI is woven into the fabric of how we work. Every associate is expected - and empowered - to partner with AI to challenge the status quo, accelerate innovation, and amplify their impact. This is a place for builders with a growth mindset who act with agility, embrace change, and use modern technology to shape smarter solutions, exceptional experiences, and the future of our industry for our clients, customers, and our culture.

Why We Do What We Do

In the U.S., consumers, payers, and providers face significant challenges throughout the healthcare financial journey. Zelis helps streamline the process by offering solutions that improve transparency, efficiency, and communication among all parties involved. By addressing the obstacles that patients face in accessing care, navigating the intricacies of insurance claims, and the logistical challenges healthcare providers encounter with processing payments, Zelis aims to create a more seamless and effective healthcare financial system.

Zelis India plays a crucial role in this mission by supporting various initiatives that enhance the healthcare financial experience. The local team contributes to the development and implementation of innovative solutions, ensuring that technology and processes are optimized for efficiency and effectiveness. Beyond operational expertise, Zelis India cultivates a collaborative work culture, leadership development, and global exposure, creating a dynamic environment for professional growth. With hybrid work flexibility, comprehensive healthcare benefits, financial wellness programs, and cultural celebrations, we foster a holistic workplace experience. Additionally, the team plays a vital role in maintaining high standards of service delivery and contributes to Zelis’ award-winning culture.

Position Overview

This role is a senior Information Security position (7+ years total, 5+ relevant) focused on L2 Security Operations within Infrastructure Security Services. Key technical areas include SIEM (rule tuning, log source integration, correlation optimization), Vulnerability Management (CVE analysis, false positive/negative triage, custom scripting), Cortex XDR (threat hunting, policy configuration, incident detection), and PAM (privileged account/session management, compliance reporting across Windows/UNIX/LDAP/Databases). Core responsibilities span incident response, threat protection, identity & access management, and vulnerability management end-to-end. The role also carries leadership duties — leading complex incident investigations/forensics, mentoring L1/L2 analysts, and collaborating with security engineers and IT teams. Additional expectations include staying current on threat intelligence/trends, driving process improvements, and maintaining thorough incident documentation.

Job Description

Zelis is one of the leading healthcare technology Product organizations with $1.4 Billion revenue with year-on-year growth of 22% and client retention rate of 120%. we offer wide range of innovative solutions to the healthcare payers, providers, and consumers. Our services include network analytics, payment integrity and optimization, provider credentialing, and provider engagement.

Zelis is an US based Software Product development organization founded in 1995 with a headcount 2400+ talented professionals working in 7 offices in US and 1 global capacity center located in Hyderabad, India.

URL:

Position: L2 SOC Analyst

Location: Hyderabad

Work Mode: Work from Office -Rotational Shifts

Overview:

As a L2 SOC Analyst at Zelis, you will play a critical role in maintaining the security of our clients' systems and data. You will be responsible for monitoring, analyzing, and responding to security alerts and incidents, ensuring that potential threats are identified and escalated for mitigation in a timely manner

Job Description:

Primary Responsibilities:

Undergraduate degree or equivalent experience

  • Minimum 7 plus overall experience out of minimum 5 Yrs. of relevant experience in Information security domain.
  • Proven expertise of Security Operations (L2/ L1) in Infrastructure Security Services domains.
  • Ability to resolve issues pertaining to security solutions implemented at client locations.
  • Working experience on incident response, threat protections, SecOps, identity & Access management & vulnerability management

Technical Skills

SIEM – Skills

  • Create, modify, and tune the SIEM rules to adjust the specifications of alerts and incidents.
  • Knowledge Integrating various log sources like Windows, Linux, Pala alto firewall , AWS, Etc.
  • To provide continual correlation rule tuning, incident classification and prioritization recommendations.
  • Report query adjustments, and various other SIEM configuration activities.
  • Ability to fully optimize the SIEM system capabilities as well as the audit and logging features of the event log sources.
  • Work closely with the other teams related to Network, Device, Policy, connectivity issues etc.
  • Identify new opportunities/threats in the network to improve the security of the network
  • Monitor and administer enterprise log correlation (SIEM)
  • Select, design, implement and manage security measures to reduce the risk of loss
  • VM – Skills

Collecting, analyzing, interpreting, evaluating, and integrating vulnerability data from multiple sources to update existing product

  • Vulnerability/exploit research and creating signatures for the same

title: Internship: Global Supply Chain Planning, Belgium - 2026
description:
Business Introduction We manufacture and supply reliable, high-quality medicines and vaccines to meet patients’ needs and drive our performance.
Our network of 37 medicines and vaccines manufacturing sites delivered 1.7 billion packs of medicines and 409 million vaccine doses in 2024 to help make a positive impact on the health of millions of people. Technology is transforming how we manufacture medicines and vaccines, enabling us to increase the speed, quality and scale of product supply.
We need the very best minds and capability to help us on our journey to make more complex products, harnessing the power of smart manufacturing technologies including robotics, digital solutions and artificial intelligence to deliver for patients. You will support planning activities that help ensure reliable supply and timely delivery. You will work closely with planners, operations, procurement and logistics to analyse data and improve processes. We value curiosity, collaboration and clear communication. This role gives hands-on responsibility, visible impact and a strong learning path while uniting science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together. Responsibilities This role will provide YOU the opportunity to lead key activities to progress YOUR career. These responsibilities include some of the following: - Support demand and supply planning tasks, including data collection and forecast updates. - Analyse inventory, lead times and service metrics to identify supply risks and opportunities. - Build simple supply scenarios to balance demand, capacity and inventory. - Track shipments and coordinate with logistics and procurement partners to support on-time delivery. - Contribute to small automation or process improvement tasks to increase planning efficiency. - Prepare clear reports and visualisations to share insights with stakeholders. Who you will work with You will collaborate with supply planners, production planners, procurement, logistics and quality colleagues. You will receive coaching and regular feedback. Work will be practical, cross-functional and focused on learning. What you will learn - Core principles of integrated supply chain planning in a regulated environment. - How to interpret forecasts, inventory metrics and supply performance. - Scenario planning and basic risk mitigation techniques. - How to present data clearly to non-technical stakeholders. - Practical use of planning tools and spreadsheets. - Continuous improvement methods relevant to supply planning. This role matters Your work will help reduce supply risk and improve availability for patients. You will take on real tasks and see the impact of your work across the supply chain. Why You? Work arrangements This internship is primarily on site in Belgium. You will be expected to attend core activities and site learning sessions. Exact schedule and duration will be agreed with your educational establishment and follow Belgian regulations. How to apply Ready to grow your supply chain skills and make a real impact? Apply now. Attach your CV and a short note describing your relevant experience and what you want to learn during the internship. If you need an adjustment to apply or to complete the internship, email WW.EarlyCareers@gsk.com so we can support you. We look forward to reading your application and learning how you want to help us get ahead of disease together.

Skills

Business Application Support, Calendar Management, Customer Service, Digital Fluency, Front Desk Operations, Invoice Approval, Office Management, Travel Bookings

1. General Background
The Office of the United Nations High Commissioner for Refugees (UNHCR) was established on December 14, 1950 by the United Nations General Assembly. The UN Refugee Agency is mandated to lead and co-ordinate international action to protect refugees and resolve refugee problems worldwide. Its primary purpose is to safeguard the rights and well-being of refugees. It strives to ensure that everyone can exercise the right to seek asylum and find safe refuge in another State, with the option to return home voluntarily, integrate locally or to resettle in a third country.
UNHCR has helped millions of people to restart their lives. They include asylum seekers, refugees, returnees, stateless people and internally displaced persons. Its interventions in the areas of protection, shelter, health and education have been crucial, healing broken pasts and building brighter futures.

The UNHCR Office in China was established in 1979. Although China has been party to the 1951 Convention and 1967 Protocol since 1982, it has no law comprehensively governing asylum. In the absence of national refugee legislation, UNHCR continues to register asylum seekers, conducts individual refugee status determination under its mandate, seeks durable solutions for refugees, and provides direct assistance to the refugee population in mainland China.

The Standing Committee of China’s National People’s Congress adopted an Exit-Entry Administration Law on 30 June 2012, which came into force on 1 July 2013. This domestic law includes a provision (Article 46) regarding the treatment of refugees, which foresees, interalia, the possibility for persons of concerns to legally reside in China on the basis of a temporary identification to be issued by the authorities. UNHCR has been advocating for implementing regulations concerning Article 46 as well as working on building the capacity of the Government of China to implement its obligations under the 1951 Geneva Convention relating to the Status of Refugees and its 1967 Protocol.
UNHCR will continue to work with all stakeholders in China to ensure persons of concern receive adequate protection and assistance as well as to seek durable solutions for refugees.

The Private Sector Partnerships Service (PSP) sits within UNHCR’s Division of External Relations (DER) and is responsible for mobilizing resources and other forms of support from the private sector. In 2019, UNHCR China Office set up a new Private Sector Partnerships team to mobilize resources from the Chinese private sector to support our work globally. One of the key aspects in PSP’s work is to expand UNHCR’s engagement with the general public including UNHCR’s existing and potential supporters.

Given such, UNHCR China is looking for a digital specialized staff who has experience and skills focusing on supporter engagement and donor development, particularly on engaging digital content creation, data analysis and CRM related work. This incumbent will also cover part of digital multi-channel work including donor communications, E-commerce operation and data analysis as well as IG related admin tasks.

This position is a UNOPS position with a contract which is renewable each calendar year.

2. Purpose and Scope of Assignment

Under the overall supervision of Assistant PSP IG Officer, the individual contractor will assist in the following:
1/ Accountability (key results that will be achieved)
• Support PSP team to achieve individual giving fundraising Key Performance Indicators
• Support to develop donor communications content for daily digital usage
• Support to initiate and execute donor engagement activities for enlarging supporter base and improving donor development performance
• Support to manage E-shop, regular-giving campaigns, CRM system/digital tool and database
• Support to improve, monitor and analyze online fundraising and social media performance
• Support PSP individual giving work on admin, procurement, financial process related tasks
• Support to the development of the Middle Value Donor program

2/ Responsibility (processes and functions undertaken to achieve results)
• Through working efficiently with internal teams, external vendors and media partners, base on daily marketing insights and findings, support to develop daily communications content for donor communications and social media interactions;
• Support to initiate digital supporter interactions or engaging activities on social media and to deliver relevant and contextual push notifications via CRM digital tools;
• Support to design, execute and optimize donor development programs;
• Monitor E-shop back-end system, maintain the E-shop content and ensure its healthy operation;
• Support to release, maintain and optimize the operation of regular giving programs on multi-channels including owned and 3rd party digital platforms;
• Support to draft individual giving report to summarize E-commerce and fundraising performance, supporter data trending and donor care related findings and learning;
• Support to liaise with foundation partners to ensure donor care program compliant with local laws and regulations;
• Extract actionable insights from available database and online monitoring dashboard, using these insights to evolve communications with target audience to engage, convert and upgrade, including for the development of the middle value donor program;
• Accumulate market knowledge of fundraising in Mainland China including key target audiences for UNHCR and the most relevant content, media channels and methods to reach these audiences;
• keep learning and sharing with PSP team on supporter care related cases, insights and new tech trends, then optimize during practice.
• Support on daily communications, administration and procurements with external vendors and internal UNHCR China office;
• Conduct other activities that are assigned by supervisors.

3/ Authority (decisions made in executing responsibilities and to achieve results)
• Engage with individual supporters on behalf of UNHCR China

• Engage with PSP HQ, regional and other teams to get content and campaign related information, to participate conference and sharing
• Provide research, learnings and case sharing on the latest digital fundraising trends

3. Monitoring and Progress Controls

• UNHCR digital channels are continuously optimized to ensure content is effective, relevant and engaging to digital audiences.
• An increased awareness of UNHCR among digital audiences, translating to an increased and stable response to UNHCR's call to action.
• Digital media and coverage of local situation regarding UNHCR's work is regularly monitored, and UNHCR's operational achievements are shared to digital audiences as appropriate.
• Stable and healthy supporter base increasement, align with improvements on donor development related KPI
• Positive donor communication returns including public voice, donor loyalty and donor upgrading scales

Relevant experience includes social media, performance marketing or fundraising within the mainland Chinese context, and experience working on data analysis or performance report developing.

Job Title

Data Governance Lead

Job Description

About IG Group

IG is a FTSE 100 fintech operating across five continents, serving over 1.3m customers and handling billions of dollars in transactions – built on scale, trust, and proof. We didn't pivot to innovation; it's how we've always operated. What that means for the people who work here is real: genuinely complex problems to solve, the technology and resources to tackle them properly, and the kind of scope that's rare in established businesses. The bar is high – bring a curious and forward-thinking mindset and we'll give you the platform to define what comes next. Join us at IG – the future gets built here.

About the Role

IG's Data & AI team is scaling up how the business governs, understands, and trusts its data. As Data Governance Lead, you'll turn our data governance framework into practical, working reality — defining standards, embedding ownership, and resolving the day-to-day trade-offs that determine whether data across the business is genuinely fit for purpose.

About the Team

This role sits within the Data & AI team, reporting into the Head of Data Governance & Strategy. You'll work closely with Risk, Data Engineering, Compliance, and IG's Product teams to embed governance into how data is defined, owned, and used across the organisation. This is an individual contributor role that requires someone comfortable working on their own initiative, building relationships with stakeholders at all levels.

Key Responsibilities

  • Evolve the data governance framework — Working from existing policies, help create standards and procedures for how data is defined, classified, and accessed across the organisation's data estate.

  • Manage adherence to the data ownership model — Identify data owners across the business, clarify their roles, and coordinate their day-to-day governance activities.

  • Lead a data governance council or working group — Run recurring forums with stakeholders from IT, Legal, Compliance, and the business to make decisions on data policy, resolve disputes, and prioritise initiatives.

  • Define and monitor data quality standards — Set data quality rules and KPIs, oversee data quality assessments, and drive remediation of issues with the teams that own the data.

  • Develop the IG governance tooling — Ensure business glossaries and data dictionaries are accurate, complete, and kept up to date, and help implement and administer the underlying tooling.

  • Manage data access and classifications — Oversee how data is classified (e.g. public, internal, confidential, restricted) and work with Security/IT to enforce appropriate access controls.

  • Support audits and risk assessments — Act as the point of contact for internal/external audits related to data handling, providing documentation and evidence of governance controls.

  • Champion data literacy and culture change — Develop communication plans to build awareness of governance policies and encourage responsible data practices across the organisation.

Role Requirements

  • 5+ years' experience in data governance within a regulated environment, preferably UK financial services.

    • Strong working knowledge of UK GDPR and other applicable data protection regulations.

    • Familiarity with established data governance frameworks such as DAMA-DMBOK, DCAM, or DGI, and proven ability to design processes that ensure adherence to an existing governance operating model.

    • Experience defining data quality metrics, running data quality assessments, and implementing remediation processes.

    • Enough technical understanding of databases, data warehouses/lakes, and data pipelines to govern them effectively, even if not hands-on coding.

    • Strong communication skills — able to translate technical governance concepts into business terms, build relationships with stakeholders across Risk, Compliance, Data Engineering, and Product (including holding difficult conversations to land agreed timelines), and run training or change-management initiatives to build a data-literate culture.

    • Experience running governance initiatives as structured programmes, including tracking KPIs, managing timelines, and reporting progress to executive stakeholders or a data governance council.

    Desirable

    • Hands-on experience with data governance or catalogue tooling (e.g. Collibra, Purview, Alation).

    • Professional certification in data management (e.g. CDMP).

    • Experience of data governance considerations in an AI/ML context.

The Perks

Your growth fuels our success! Thrive with tailored development programs, mentoring opportunities with leaders, and clear career progression. Expand your network through committees, sports and social clubs. Enjoy extra time off for volunteering and community work.

  • Competitive salary

  • Flexible Benefits Package on top of your salary (12%)

  • Private medical cover for you and your family

  • Life insurance

  • Contribution to gym memberships

  • 25 Days holiday, with 1 additional day off to celebrate your Birthday & 2 additional days off a year for voluntary work (28 in total

  • The option to buy or sell holiday days.

  • Unlimited access to the LinkedIn Learning Platform

  • Employee-led LGBTQ+, Women’s, Black and Parents & Carers networks with an annual budget for organising events & projects that foster an open, diverse and inclusive culture

title: Data Engineer II
description:
Job Description:

At Rocket India, we’re building data-driven experiences powered by modern cloud technologies, and we’re looking for a Senior Data Engineer – AWS Data Engineering to help design scalable, secure, and high-performing data solutions across our AWS ecosystem. In this role, you’ll develop cloud-native data pipelines, enable modern analytics platforms, and partner with global engineering, analytics, and business teams to deliver reliable data capabilities that support strategic decision-making and advance Rocket’s mission to Help Everyone Home.

About the Role

  • Design, develop, and maintain scalable data ingestion, transformation, and processing pipelines on AWS.
  • Build and optimize ETL/ELT workflows using AWS Glue for data integration, cataloging, and processing.
  • Develop automation, orchestration, and data transformation solutions using Python.
  • Design and support cloud data warehouse solutions using Amazon Redshift and Snowflake.
  • Create, manage, and optimize relational database solutions using Amazon RDS.
  • Develop NoSQL data models and high-performance data applications using Amazon DynamoDB.
  • Build serverless, event-driven data processing solutions using AWS Lambda.
  • Ensure data quality, integrity, security, governance, and reliability across cloud data platforms.
  • Optimize data architectures for scalability, performance, operational resilience, and cost efficiency.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional stakeholders across Product, Engineering, Analytics, and business teams to understand requirements and deliver business-focused data solutions.
  • Monitor, troubleshoot, and continuously enhance production data pipelines, workflows, and platforms.
  • Participate in architecture reviews, code reviews, agile ceremonies, and continuous improvement initiatives.

About You

Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related technical field.
  • 4–6 years of experience in Data Engineering, Data Integration, or Cloud Data Platform development.
  • Hands-on experience working with AWS data and analytics services.
  • Strong expertise in AWS Glue for ETL pipeline development and data catalog management.
  • Proficiency in Python for data processing, automation, and workflow development.
  • Experience with Amazon Redshift and/or Snowflake for enterprise data warehousing solutions.
  • Experience working with relational databases and Amazon RDS.
  • Knowledge of NoSQL database concepts and hands-on experience with Amazon DynamoDB.
  • Experience building serverless applications using AWS Lambda.
  • Strong SQL skills and a solid understanding of data modeling principles.
  • Experience designing, developing, and supporting large-scale data pipelines in cloud environments.
  • Familiarity with Agile development methodologies and DevOps practices.
  • Strong analytical thinking, problem-solving skills, and the ability to work effectively in a collaborative, fast-paced environment.
  • Excellent communication skills with the ability to engage technical and non-technical stakeholders.

Preferred Qualifications

  • AWS Certification(s), such as AWS Certified Data Engineer – Associate, AWS Certified Solutions Architect – Associate, or AWS Certified Developer – Associate.
  • Experience with Infrastructure as Code tools such as Terraform or AWS CloudFormation.
  • Knowledge of data lake architectures and modern cloud data ecosystems.
  • Exposure to CI/CD pipelines, automation frameworks, and release management practices.
  • Experience implementing data governance, data security, and cloud platform best practices.
  • A passion for building scalable, high-quality data solutions with a mindset focused on continuous learning, innovation, and operational excellence.

What You’ll Get

At Rocket India, you’ll be part of a collaborative, technology-led environment where your work contributes to platforms that create meaningful impact at enterprise scale. You’ll have opportunities to solve complex engineering challenges, partner with global teams, and grow your expertise in modern cloud data technologies. We support continuous learning, innovation, and career development while fostering an inclusive culture where team members are empowered to do their best work.

About Us

Rocket India, registered as NSM Services Private Limited and formerly Mr. Cooper, is a wholly owned subsidiary of Rocket Mortgage, LLC, headquartered in Detroit, Michigan. As a core part of Rocket’s global ecosystem, Rocket India builds scalable technology platforms and digital solutions that simplify mortgage origination and servicing. Our teams across Operations, Product, Technology, Innovation, and Customer functions partner with global teams to remove friction, enable smarter decisions, and create lasting value for homeowners while supporting Rocket’s mission to Help Everyone Home.

We are committed to providing a fair and inclusive workplace for all team members and applicants. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to sex, religion, caste, disability, or gender identity, consistent with applicable Indian law, including the Constitution of India, the Code on Wages, 2019, the Rights of Persons with Disabilities Act, 2016, and the Transgender Persons (Protection of Rights) Act, 2019. We welcome applications from persons with disabilities and from all sections of society.”
